declarations.title: Add a project comment
declarations.responsibility: Authorize and validate a comment, then append it once per project request ID.

inputs.name: addComment.deps
inputs.description: Repository, source-anchor validator and optional clock used by the transaction.

inputs.name: addComment.actor
inputs.description: Verified actor who must be an owner or commenter of the project.

inputs.name: addComment.input
inputs.description: Project and request UUIDs, optional thread UUID, source anchor and trimmed comment text of 1–20,000 characters.

outputs.name: addComment
outputs.description: Promise of the updated thread and committed collaboration revision; an identical repeated request returns its existing thread.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid input, denied membership, invalid source anchors, missing threads, conflicting request or anchor reuse, and exhausted write retries.

declarations.title: Validate collaboration cache entries
declarations.responsibility: Key cached bytes by validated project and source identity and discard entries that fail integrity checks.

inputs.name: cacheKey.identity
inputs.description: Principal, project, repository and source revisions with nullable evidence, notes, artifact and profile selectors.

inputs.name: readCache.cache
inputs.description: Cache adapter from which to read or delete an entry.

inputs.name: readCache.identity
inputs.description: Expected identity for the cached bytes.

inputs.name: writeCache.cache
inputs.description: Cache adapter into which to store the entry.

inputs.name: writeCache.identity
inputs.description: Validated identity to bind to the stored bytes.

inputs.name: writeCache.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to hash and copy into the cache; must match artifactHash when supplied.

outputs.name: cacheKey
outputs.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the normalized identity JSON.

outputs.name: readCache
outputs.description: A copy of verified bytes, or null for a miss or a corrupt entry that was deleted.

outputs.name: writeCache
outputs.description: Stores normalized identity, SHA-256 and copied bytes; resolves without a value.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The internal corrupt-cache error is caught and turns into deletion and a null result; adapter failures may still propagate.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid identities or an artifact hash mismatch on write.

declarations.title: Create a collaboration records commit
declarations.responsibility: Write serialized records as a Git blob and tree, then create a commit without moving a branch.

inputs.name: commitRecords.client
inputs.description: Repository-scoped GitHub transport with permission to write Git objects.

inputs.name: commitRecords.input
inputs.type: { parent: string | null; path: string; records: unknown }
inputs.description: Optional parent commit, destination file path and JSON-serializable records.

outputs.name: commitRecords
outputs.description: New commit SHA after creating its blob and tree; the parent tree is reused when a parent is supplied.

declarations.title: Build the collaboration API
declarations.responsibility: Connect project, membership, invitation and comment operations to shared persistence and authorization dependencies.

inputs.name: createCollaboration.deps
inputs.description: Repository, source and cache adapters, repository authorization callback and optional clock.

outputs.name: createCollaboration
outputs.description: API whose methods check membership, read committed records and perform project, member, invitation and comment transactions. Construction itself performs no network access.

declarations.title: Store collaboration records on a private branch
declarations.responsibility: Build a repository adapter that reads validated records and updates their branch with compare-and-swap writes.

inputs.name: createGitHubRepository.options
inputs.description: Private repository identity, scoped token callback, optional fetch, refs/heads branch and safe records-file path.

outputs.name: createGitHubRepository
outputs.description: Read and compareAndSwap methods; missing branch uses the zero revision, stale writes return null, and successful writes return the confirmed commit SHA.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects nonprivate storage, invalid paths or refs, denied repository access, invalid records, unavailable GitHub or unconfirmed writes.

declarations.title: Read verified Git Hub source
declarations.responsibility: Build a source adapter with immutable commit caches, blob integrity checks, LFS materialization and history queries.

inputs.name: createGitHubSource.options
inputs.description: Scoped token callback and optional fetch implementation; each method receives its repository identity.

outputs.name: createGitHubSource
outputs.description: Adapter for resolving refs, reading trees and bytes, validating anchors and querying history. Cached objects and bytes are copied for callers; failed loads are evicted.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid refs or paths, denied repositories, incomplete or mismatched trees, missing regular files, blob integrity failures and unavailable source or LFS data.

declarations.title: Create and accept project invitations
declarations.responsibility: Issue a one-day invitation and atomically accept it for its verified email address.

inputs.name: createInvitation.deps
inputs.description: Persistence and optional clock used to store the invitation.

inputs.name: createInvitation.actor
inputs.description: Verified project owner issuing the invitation.

inputs.name: createInvitation.input
inputs.description: Project UUID, invited email and commenter or viewer role.

inputs.name: acceptInvitation.deps
inputs.description: Persistence and optional clock used to validate and accept the invitation.

inputs.name: acceptInvitation.actor
inputs.description: Verified actor whose normalized email must match the invitation.

inputs.name: acceptInvitation.input
inputs.description: Project UUID, invitation UUID and 64-character lowercase hex invitation code.

outputs.name: createInvitation
outputs.description: Promise of invitation ID, project ID, expiry and plaintext code; only its hash is stored.

outputs.name: acceptInvitation
outputs.description: Promise of the joined project and current role; existing membership is retained and the invitation is marked accepted.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid input, nonowners, invalid or expired or already accepted invitations, email or code mismatches and exhausted write retries.

declarations.title: Create projects and remove members
declarations.responsibility: Authorize a source repository for a new project or let an owner remove a project member.

inputs.name: createProject.deps
inputs.description: Persistence, repository authorization and optional clock.

inputs.name: createProject.actor
inputs.description: Verified actor who becomes the new project owner.

inputs.name: createProject.input
inputs.description: Trimmed project name of 1–200 characters and a positive repository ID.

inputs.name: removeMember.deps
inputs.description: Persistence used for the membership transaction.

inputs.name: removeMember.actor
inputs.description: Verified project owner requesting removal.

inputs.name: removeMember.input
inputs.description: Project UUID and member actor ID.

outputs.name: createProject
outputs.description: Promise of the created project with owner role and committed collaboration revision.

outputs.name: removeMember
outputs.description: Removes the member and project invitations for that email; resolves without a value.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid input, repository authorization failures, denied membership, missing members, removal of the last owner or exhausted write retries.

declarations.title: Authorize and transact collaboration records
declarations.responsibility: Resolve project membership and retry validated record changes against their current repository revision.

inputs.name: currentProject.records
inputs.description: Validated records snapshot to search.

inputs.name: currentProject.actor
inputs.description: Verified actor whose membership is required.

inputs.name: currentProject.projectId
inputs.description: Project UUID to resolve.

inputs.name: currentProject.roles
inputs.description: Allowed roles; defaults to owner, commenter and viewer.

inputs.name: readRecords.deps
inputs.description: Repository dependency used to read and validate a snapshot.

inputs.name: transaction.deps
inputs.description: Repository dependency supporting read and compare-and-swap.

inputs.name: transaction.operation
inputs.description: Async operation that may mutate parsed records and return a result; can run again after write conflicts.

inputs.name: now.deps
inputs.description: Optional clock dependency; otherwise uses the current system date.

outputs.name: currentProject
outputs.description: Matching project with the actor’s membership role.

outputs.name: readRecords
outputs.description: Parsed records from the repository snapshot.

outputs.name: transaction
outputs.description: Operation result and revision; unchanged records avoid a write, and changed records retry at most five times.

outputs.name: now
outputs.description: Injected date or a new Date from the system clock.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid actors or records, denied projects or roles and five unsuccessful write attempts; callback and repository errors propagate.

declarations.title: Read immutable commit facts
declarations.responsibility: Fetch and verify a GitHub commit before returning its tree, parents and summary metadata.

inputs.name: githubCommitFacts.client
inputs.description: Repository transport used for access checks and the commit request.

inputs.name: githubCommitFacts.commit
inputs.description: Exact 40-character lowercase hex commit SHA.

outputs.name: githubCommitFacts
outputs.description: Verified commit facts, or null when GitHub returns 404; the subject is the first paragraph with line breaks collapsed.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid input, denied repository access, a mismatched returned SHA or unavailable GitHub data.

declarations.title: Fetch a verified blob batch
declarations.responsibility: Read a bounded batch of GitHub text blobs and verify their sizes and Git hashes.

inputs.name: githubGraphql.options
inputs.description: Repository identity, scoped read-token callback and optional fetch implementation.

inputs.name: githubGraphql.input
inputs.description: Commit and 1–64 tree-attested regular-file entries with expected paths, Git SHAs and optional sizes.

outputs.name: githubGraphql
outputs.description: Map from paths to verified UTF-8 blob bytes; the response must stay below 16 MiB.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: All failures, including invalid batches and integrity or repository mismatches, are converted to github-unavailable.

declarations.title: Build Git Hub history operations
declarations.responsibility: Provide branch, ancestry, commit, changed-path and optional-ref queries over a source adapter.

inputs.name: ensureAncestry.client
inputs.description: Transport used to compare the requested commit with the branch tip.

inputs.name: ensureAncestry.commit
inputs.description: Commit that must equal the tip or be its ancestor.

inputs.name: ensureAncestry.tip
inputs.description: Branch-tip commit to compare against.

inputs.name: githubHistory.adapter
inputs.description: Source adapter for resolving refs and reading immutable trees.

inputs.name: githubHistory.options
inputs.description: Scoped token callback and optional fetch implementation.

outputs.name: ensureAncestry
outputs.description: Resolves without a value when the commits match or GitHub confirms the requested ancestor.

outputs.name: githubHistory
outputs.description: History methods that list branches and commits, compare each commit to its first parent, resolve optional refs, read facts and test reachability.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects unreachable anchors, invalid input or source data, unavailable GitHub and histories exceeding 100 pages of 100 records.

declarations.title: Read one page of path history
declarations.responsibility: Fetch a bounded history page for distinct paths and merge duplicate commits.

inputs.name: githubHistoryPage.context
inputs.description: Source adapter for resolving the commit and transport for GitHub history requests.

inputs.name: githubHistoryPage.repository
inputs.description: Repository whose history is being read.

inputs.name: githubHistoryPage.input
inputs.description: Exact commit SHA, at most 64 safe paths, page starting at 1 and page size 1–100; defaults are 1 and 30.

outputs.name: githubHistoryPage
outputs.description: Distinct commits in response insertion order, completion flag and next page number or null; an empty path list returns an empty complete page.

declarations.title: Materialize Git LFS bytes
declarations.responsibility: Recognize Git LFS pointers and download content only from permitted HTTPS locations with matching size and hash.

inputs.name: githubLfs.options
inputs.description: Repository identity, scoped read-token callback and optional fetch implementation.

inputs.name: githubLfs.bytes
inputs.description: Raw blob bytes; ordinary blobs pass through, while recognized LFS pointers must use the exact supported v1 format.

outputs.name: githubLfs
outputs.description: Original bytes for ordinary blobs, or downloaded bytes matching the pointer’s SHA-256 and declared size of at most 50,000,000 bytes.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Malformed pointers and oversized declarations fail directly; download, location, response and integrity failures become lfs-unavailable.

declarations.title: Batch immutable source reads
declarations.responsibility: Build a batched raw reader that shares cached promises with single-file reads.

inputs.name: githubRawMany.context
inputs.description: Source adapter, token and fetch options, shared raw-byte promise cache and repository/ref cache-key function.

outputs.name: githubRawMany
outputs.description: Reader that validates an exact commit and safe regular-file paths, deduplicates paths, loads batches of at most 64 and returns copied raw bytes without LFS expansion.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid commits or paths, missing regular blobs and failed batch integrity checks; failed cached promises are removed.

declarations.title: Test commit reachability
declarations.responsibility: Check whether a commit is the tip itself or an ancestor of it.

inputs.name: githubReaches.client
inputs.description: Repository transport for access validation and GitHub comparison.

inputs.name: githubReaches.input
inputs.description: Exact lowercase 40-character hex tip and candidate commit SHAs.

outputs.name: githubReaches
outputs.description: True for identical SHAs or a confirmed ancestor; false for a missing comparison or a nonancestor.

declarations.title: Build scoped Git Hub requests
declarations.responsibility: Provide repository-scoped API requests, exact ref resolution and base64 conversion.

inputs.name: githubTransport.options
inputs.description: Repository identity, scoped token callback and optional fetch implementation.

inputs.name: githubTransport.permission
inputs.description: Contents permission requested for each token: read or write.

inputs.name: refPath.ref
inputs.description: Full heads, notes or tags ref with a safe path and valid ref characters.

inputs.name: readRef.client
inputs.description: Transport used to resolve the ref.

inputs.name: readRef.ref
inputs.description: Full ref to look up exactly, including notes refs.

inputs.name: exactRef.client
inputs.description: Transport used to require an existing exact ref.

inputs.name: exactRef.ref
inputs.description: Full ref that must exist.

inputs.name: base64.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to encode as standard base64.

inputs.name: decode64.value
inputs.description: Base64 text to decode; whitespace is ignored.

outputs.name: githubTransport
outputs.description: Request and repository-check methods; requests reject redirects and can return explicitly accepted statuses with null data.

outputs.name: refPath
outputs.description: Encoded API ref path with the refs/ prefix removed.

outputs.name: readRef
outputs.description: Exact matching ref SHA, or null for a missing ref.

outputs.name: exactRef
outputs.description: Exact matching ref SHA; a missing ref rejects.

outputs.name: base64
outputs.description: Standard base64 text.

outputs.name: decode64
outputs.description: Decoded bytes.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid paths, refs or content, missing or mismatched refs, denied repository identity or privacy and unavailable GitHub requests.

declarations.title: Validate collaboration values
declarations.responsibility: Define collaboration schemas and shared parsing, hashing and path checks.

inputs.name: fail.code
inputs.description: Machine-readable failure code attached to the thrown error.

inputs.name: parseCollaborationInput.schema
inputs.description: Zod schema used to validate and transform the value.

inputs.name: parseCollaborationInput.value
inputs.description: Untrusted value to parse.

inputs.name: digest.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to hash through WebCrypto.

inputs.name: digest.algorithm
inputs.description: WebCrypto digest algorithm; defaults to SHA-256.

inputs.name: safePath.value
inputs.description: Repository-relative path without empty or dot segments, backslashes or control characters.

outputs.name: id
outputs.description: UUID validation schema.

outputs.name: sha
outputs.description: Schema for 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

outputs.name: hash
outputs.description: Schema for 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

outputs.name: label
outputs.description: Schema that trims text and requires 1–200 characters.

outputs.name: email
outputs.description: Email schema limited to 320 characters and normalized to lowercase.

outputs.name: actorSchema
outputs.description: Strict verified-actor schema with ID, email, name and emailVerified true.

outputs.name: repositorySchema
outputs.description: Strict repository schema with positive numeric repository and installation IDs, owner, name and privacy flag.

outputs.name: branch
outputs.description: Branch-name schema limited to 1–255 characters with forbidden Git-ref patterns rejected.

outputs.name: entityId
outputs.description: Harness unit-ID schema limited to 240 characters.

outputs.name: anchorSchema
outputs.description: Strict anchor schema binding branch, commit and entity to optional version, image, state, viewport and normalized image region.

outputs.name: fail
outputs.description: Always throws an Error carrying the supplied code.

outputs.name: parseCollaborationInput
outputs.description: Validated and transformed value; also exported under the alias parse.

outputs.name: digest
outputs.description: Lowercase hexadecimal digest.

outputs.name: safePath
outputs.description: The unchanged path after validation.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Parsing failures use invalid-input, unsafe paths use invalid-path, and fail uses the supplied code; WebCrypto failures can propagate.

declarations.title: Validate collaboration record snapshots
declarations.responsibility: Define strict project and record schemas with identity, ownership and binding checks.

outputs.description: Strict project schema for UUID, name, repository identity, creation time and owner actor ID.

outputs.name: recordsSchema
outputs.description: Strict version-1 records schema for projects, members, invitations and threads; rejects duplicate identities or request IDs, unbound records and projects without an owner.

declarations.title: Verify a source comment anchor

errors.description: Rejects invalid or unreachable anchors, invalid source JSON, inconsistent or ambiguous unit plans, invalid design versions or images and image-integrity failures.

declarations.title: iOS remote bridge
declarations.responsibility: Provide the native iOS remote bridge, its camera pairing scan and protected cache.

inputs.name: scan
inputs.type: Device name only; the offer is read by the camera of this phone, never handed in

inputs.name: offer
inputs.type: QR text of one short-lived single-use pairing offer, read by the rule of pairingOffer

outputs.name: status
outputs.type: RemotePhoneStatus with explicit offline cached state

errors.name: scan-failure
errors.type: camera or offer refusal by its remoteScanFailures code; nothing is sent

errors.name: scan-ended
errors.type: Disconnect ends an open scan; a late camera answer begins no pairing

dependencies.contract: Remote protocol v1
Secure-channel keys, counters and packet envelope
Relay connection and pairing envelope
Remote approval and control messages; scan input and failure codes
Local contract shared by adapters
QR offer text grammar and refusals, held to the shared offer vectors
Frozen secure-channel known-answer vectors

declarations.title: Agent controls
declarations.responsibility: Lets a person choose an available agent provider, model and reasoning effort, and exposes the resulting choice to its parent.

inputs.name: AgentControls.providers
inputs.description: Provider availability, display names, reasons, models and supported reasoning efforts. Starts with Codex selected. Compact mode switches away from an unavailable provider to the first available provider when one exists; the expanded layout does not make that switch. An empty list produces a no-provider notice.

inputs.name: AgentControls.choice
inputs.description: Bindable selection, initially null. The component replaces it with the selected provider, model and reasoning effort when the provider is available and the model is nonempty; otherwise it sets null. An empty effort is returned as null. A supplied value does not initialize the internal pickers.

inputs.name: AgentControls.compact
inputs.description: Optional layout switch, false by default. True uses model and effort icon pickers; false shows provider buttons and model and effort dropdowns.

inputs.name: AgentControls.action
inputs.description: Required content supplied by the parent, rendered after the model and effort controls in either layout, such as a send button.

outputs.name: AgentControls
outputs.description: Provider, model and effort controls followed by the supplied action. Unavailable provider buttons and unusable dropdowns are disabled. Invalid model selections fall back to the provider default, then its first model, then empty; effort falls back to the model default, then its first supported effort, then empty. Shows the selected provider reason when present.

declarations.title: Agent reasoning picker
declarations.responsibility: Offers the reasoning efforts supported by the selected model in a compact picker.

inputs.name: AgentEffortPicker.efforts
inputs.description: Required effort names in display order. An empty list disables the picker and labels it as using the model default.

inputs.name: AgentEffortPicker.effort
inputs.description: Required bindable current effort. Choosing an offered effort replaces this value and closes the dialog. No fallback is selected for an invalid value.

outputs.name: AgentEffortPicker
outputs.description: Reasoning icon opening a list of effort buttons with the current choice marked. Its tooltip names the effort or model default when no efforts are listed.

declarations.title: Agent model picker
declarations.responsibility: Presents models grouped by provider and updates both identifiers of the chosen agent model.

inputs.name: AgentModelPicker.providers
inputs.description: Required providers with labels, models, availability and reasons. Unavailable providers stay visible with disabled model buttons; an available provider with no models gets an explicit empty message.

inputs.name: AgentModelPicker.provider
inputs.description: Required bindable provider identifier. Selecting a model stores its provider identifier unchanged. Together with model, determines the selected button and tooltip.

inputs.name: AgentModelPicker.model
inputs.description: Required bindable model identifier. Selecting a model stores its identifier unchanged and closes the picker. Does not choose a default model.

outputs.name: AgentModelPicker
outputs.description: Model icon and provider-grouped dialog with reasons, selected state and empty-provider messages. An enabled choice updates provider and model together.

declarations.title: Agent settings preference
declarations.responsibility: Lets a person set how many designs a visual Plan requests on this device.

outputs.name: AgentSettings
outputs.description: Agents section with a Design options dropdown populated from supported counts. Loads the shared device preference on mount and sends changes to its settings store. The preference applies across projects and composers. If saving fails, shows an alert that the choice resets on reload.

declarations.title: Annotated image
declarations.responsibility: Shows a design image with region threads and controls for whole-image or region comments.

inputs.name: AnnotatedImage.src
inputs.description: Required image URL. A nonempty source change clears drawn and selected-thread regions. No dedicated image-load failure message is provided.

inputs.name: AnnotatedImage.title
inputs.description: Required alternative text for the image.

inputs.name: AnnotatedImage.caption
inputs.description: Optional text above the image, empty by default.

inputs.name: AnnotatedImage.threads
inputs.description: Required thread records. Those with regions become numbered pins; clicking one highlights its region and calls select. Threads without regions have no pins.

inputs.name: AnnotatedImage.writable
inputs.description: Enables whole-image and keyboard-region actions and permits starting pointer selection. Existing pins remain available when false. Already-created selections and an already-open keyboard form do not recheck this flag at submission.

inputs.name: AnnotatedImage.comment
inputs.description: Called with null for the whole image or a rectangle in fractions of image dimensions. Pointer rectangles smaller than one percent in either dimension are discarded. Keyboard percentages are converted to fractions and dimensions capped at the remaining image area. Errors are not caught here.

inputs.name: AnnotatedImage.select
inputs.description: Called with an existing thread when its pin is clicked; the component also highlights its region.

outputs.name: AnnotatedImage
outputs.description: Image viewer with full-size toggle, thread pins and drag/numeric-region selection. Keyboard defaults are x=10%, y=10%, width=40%, height=30%. A completed region offers a comment action. Calling comment does not itself persist a comment.

declarations.title: Approval button
declarations.responsibility: Saves approval of the latest displayed plan or design with its exact contract and selected images.

inputs.name: ApprovalButton.entity
inputs.description: Entity providing category, identifier, latest version and contract hash. Approval requires a hash; pages, shells and components also require selected images. Functions use Plan wording.

inputs.name: ApprovalButton.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace providing writability, approval bridge and project context. Missing or nonwritable snapshot blocks approval. Refreshes the workspace after saving the decision.

inputs.name: ApprovalButton.design
inputs.description: Version to approve; must equal the entity’s latest version. Its selected image hashes are sent with the approval. Versions with options also send the selected option identifier.

inputs.name: ApprovalButton.approved
inputs.description: True disables approval and shows the approved-version label.

inputs.name: ApprovalButton.option
inputs.description: Optional selected option identifier, empty by default. Determines the images whose hashes are approved and is included when the design has options.

outputs.name: ApprovalButton
outputs.description: Approval button disabled for existing approval, an older version, missing contract hash or required images, a nonwritable workspace or an in-progress approval. Catches save/refresh failures as alerts and clears busy state afterward. Explains that approval saves a decision and only a Change request starts code work.

declarations.title: Catalog view
declarations.responsibility: Lists the selected category of project entities with text search, a changed-only filter and sorting.

inputs.name: CatalogView.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace supplying the current category, optional project snapshot and entity-card context. A missing snapshot contributes an empty entity list. The category must be nonempty because it is used to build the heading.

outputs.name: CatalogView
outputs.description: Category heading, project breadcrumb, filters and matching entity cards. Search starts empty and matches displayed names and summaries without case sensitivity; changed-only starts off. Sorting defaults to name, or uses descending string order of design versions, treating missing versions as empty. Displays an empty-view message when no entities match.

dependencies.contract: The shared Select component supplies keyboard and value selection behavior through the $shared alias.

declarations.title: Choice dialog
declarations.responsibility: Wraps supplied choices in a modal opened from an icon button.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.label
inputs.description: Required accessible name for the trigger and dialog.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.title
inputs.description: Required tooltip on the opening button.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.disabled
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default, disabling the trigger. Does not close an already-open dialog.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.width
inputs.description: Required preferred width in pixels, capped at viewport width minus 24 pixels.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.maxHeight
inputs.description: Required maximum height in pixels, capped at dynamic viewport height minus 24 pixels; overflow scrolls.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.gap
inputs.description: Optional gap between dialog-grid children in pixels; defaults to 6.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.icon
inputs.description: Required content rendered inside the trigger button.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.children
inputs.description: Required content function receiving a close callback for dismissing the dialog after selection.

outputs.name: ChoiceDialog
outputs.description: Trigger and modal. Opening focuses an enabled aria-pressed=true choice when present. Escape closes this dialog and stops propagation; backdrop click also closes it. Closing returns focus to the trigger.

declarations.title: Composer
declarations.responsibility: Collects a comment or agent request and sends it through the appropriate parent callback only when its mode and prerequisites permit submission.

inputs.name: Composer.modes
inputs.description: Ordered modes allowed in this context: comment, plan or change. Uses the first mode initially and whenever the previously chosen mode is no longer offered. An empty list disables entry and submission. Shows mode buttons only when more than one mode is offered.

inputs.name: Composer.providers
inputs.description: Provider choices passed to the agent controls for Plan and Change. Submission of either agent request requires a non-null agent choice; comments do not use these providers.

inputs.name: Composer.approved
inputs.description: Whether Change is permitted for the current design. False disables its mode button and blocks Change submission, even when Change is the only offered mode. Does not block Plan or Comment.

inputs.name: Composer.running
inputs.description: Whether work is already running. True disables the message box and submission in every mode; it does not itself disable mode or provider selection.

inputs.name: Composer.notice
inputs.description: Optional hint shown in the non-agent layout, empty by default. A nonempty value replaces the ordinary comment hint. It is not displayed while Plan or Change is selected.

inputs.name: Composer.placeholder
inputs.description: Optional message-box prompt for Plan and Change, empty by default. Empty uses “Describe the next design…”. Comment uses “Leave a comment…” regardless of this value.

inputs.name: Composer.visual
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. A visual Plan includes the device setting for the number of design options in its request. Change and Comment never include that count.

inputs.name: Composer.compact
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default, enabling the compact composer styling and compact agent pickers.

inputs.name: Composer.comment
inputs.description: Required asynchronous callback for submitting trimmed comment text. A true result clears the text; false leaves it available for retry. The component does not catch a rejected promise or display a callback error.

inputs.name: Composer.send
inputs.description: Required asynchronous callback for Plan and Change. Receives trimmed text, request mode, provider, model and effort, plus the design-option count for a visual Plan. A true result clears the text; false preserves it. Rejected promises are not caught here.

outputs.name: Composer
outputs.description: Message form with permitted mode choices, agent controls for Plan and Change, and a send button. Blocks submission without a mode, with blank text, while running, without an agent choice for a request, or for an unapproved Change. Loads device agent settings on mount. Comments use the comment callback and never start an agent through this component.

dependencies.contract: The shared Select component supplies keyboard and value selection behavior through the $shared alias.

declarations.title: Contract panel
declarations.responsibility: Presents an entity’s declared inputs, outputs and errors in ordinary language, with technical names and types available on expansion.

inputs.name: ContractPanel.contract
inputs.description: Required contract containing input, output and error arrays. Each field supplies its name and type and may supply a description. Missing descriptions are shown explicitly; this panel does not derive an explanation from the type.

outputs.name: ContractPanel
outputs.description: Accepts, Returns and Can fail with sections. Uses a readable form of the final part of each field name and its recorded description, or “No description recorded.” when absent. Empty groups show “Nothing declared.” An expandable Technical contract section shows the full names and types.

declarations.title: Coverage panel
declarations.responsibility: Shows recorded evidence coverage and observed test behavior for the displayed entity without calculating a new verification verdict.

inputs.name: CoveragePanel.entity
inputs.description: Entity whose kind informs evidence notices and whose category and identifier scope the behavior display. Function entities pass their identifier to the behavior panel; other categories leave that filter unset.

inputs.name: CoveragePanel.evidence
inputs.description: Evidence state supplying loading or failure notices and, only when ready, the recorded result. Uses the result’s after side for coverage, including its commit, record, gaps, scenario and state standings, test statuses and capture slots. Coverage checks may carry browser-error diagnostics from the test attempt that produced their result.

outputs.name: CoveragePanel
outputs.description: Evidence panel with a runtime-capture label, recorded commit and record identifier when available, and any evidence notice. When no notice blocks it, shows coverage gaps, scenarios, states and captures from the record. Only passed coverage receives a check mark; other standings receive a cross with recorded reasons. Shows observed behavior when rows exist, otherwise explicitly says no input and observed output were recorded at that commit. Each check with recorded diagnostics also offers an expandable browser-error display with observations, expectations and test-attempt context.

declarations.title: Design panel
declarations.responsibility: Displays a selected design version and option, or a function’s written plan, and connects image annotations to conversation callbacks.

inputs.name: DesignPanel.entity
inputs.description: Entity supplying design versions, options, images, notes, image-linked threads and measures. Functions display written planned behavior instead of images, even when old versions recorded pictures. Pages also display size and performance text.

inputs.name: DesignPanel.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace used to retrieve images and determine the viewed revision and planning availability. Only a pinned view supplies a commit for selecting a before image. Planning capability controls the guidance shown when no version exists.

inputs.name: DesignPanel.annotatable
inputs.description: Whether the displayed image or one of its regions may start a conversation. Passed to the image as its writable flag; false also prevents the annotation callback from being called.

inputs.name: DesignPanel.version
inputs.description: Bindable version identifier, empty by default. If it does not identify one of the entity’s versions, it is replaced with the last version in the supplied list, or empty when there are none. Selecting a version updates this binding.

inputs.name: DesignPanel.option
inputs.description: Bindable design-option identifier, empty by default. Determines which option’s images and direction are shown. Selecting an option updates this value; the parent is responsible for providing the intended selection when a version contains alternatives.

inputs.name: DesignPanel.onthread
inputs.description: Required callback passed to the annotated image for selecting an existing thread. Receives the selected thread record so the parent can open its conversation.

inputs.name: DesignPanel.onannotate
inputs.description: Required asynchronous callback for a whole-image or region annotation. Called only when an image is selected and annotations are enabled; receives a target anchored to the version and image, with the region or null. Rejections are caught and displayed as text.

outputs.name: DesignPanel
outputs.description: Version and option selectors, available viewport and image-state selectors, and the selected annotated image, with a prior image when available. Viewport and state selections fall back to available images. Displays loading or image errors explicitly. A version without a displayed image shows its behavior notes or a missing-notes message; no version shows planning guidance or a no-committed-plan/design message. Function plans distinguish proposals from observed test results.

dependencies.contract: The shared Select component supplies keyboard and value selection behavior through the $shared alias.

declarations.title: Details panel
declarations.responsibility: Shows an entity’s kind and measurements and lets a person read its recorded source files at the displayed revision.

inputs.name: DetailsPanel.entity
inputs.description: Entity supplying its kind, size and performance text, owned source paths and identifier. A source request is scoped to this identifier. An empty source list produces “No source files recorded.”

inputs.name: DetailsPanel.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace supplying the source-reading bridge, snapshot revision commit and project context. These are required when a source is selected. Failures during that request, including unavailable required context, are caught and shown as text.

outputs.name: DetailsPanel
outputs.description: Details with kind and measurement text, using “Not measured” when an unavailable measure has no text. An expandable Source section lists recorded files. Selecting one clears the previous text and error, requests that file at the displayed commit and shows its returned text; a failed request displays an alert.

declarations.title: Catalog card
declarations.responsibility: Shows a page or other project item with its summary, preview, verification status and link to open or review it.

inputs.name: EntityCard.entity
inputs.description: The project item to show, including its summary, preview and recorded verification status.

inputs.name: EntityCard.workspace
inputs.description: The selected project and revision, used to load the preview and open the item.

outputs.name: EntityCard
outputs.description: A catalog card. Implemented pages have a compact open icon; planned items link to their design or behavior review.

declarations.title: Entity view
declarations.responsibility: Coordinates an entity’s overview, design or plan, its uses and consumers, evidence, history, details and conversation within the current workspace.

inputs.name: EntityView.workspace
inputs.description: Loaded workspace with an entity, navigation context, capabilities, revision and bridge operations. The entity must exist before rendering. The URL suffix selects a section, with unknown suffixes falling back to Overview and an old designs suffix opening Plan for a function. Agent-backed annotation requires agent capability and a writable snapshot; comment capability also permits annotations.

outputs.name: EntityView
outputs.description: Entity identity, verification, tabs and selected content with optional details and conversation. Components retain runtime screenshots above every tab and read evidence on direct section entry. Other entities read evidence on Overview, Evidence and History. Existing routing, annotation and teardown behavior is preserved.

declarations.title: History panel
declarations.responsibility: Displays entity history and retrieves earlier pages without mixing different project or revision views.

inputs.name: HistoryPanel.entity
inputs.description: Initial history and optional coverage metadata. Without metadata, history is treated as complete. Changes of view or coverage reset additionally loaded pages.

inputs.name: HistoryPanel.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace supplying project/revision identity, known commits, navigation and an optional history bridge. Only event commits present in the snapshot’s commit list become links.

outputs.name: HistoryPanel
outputs.description: Timeline with names, formatted dates, details and commit references, or an empty-history message. Load more requires incomplete history, a next page and bridge support and is disabled during loading. Discards responses for another view; displays current-view errors as alerts. Incomplete history without a usable next-page operation is explicitly labeled not loaded.

declarations.title: Hosted connection
declarations.responsibility: Shows shared-project connectivity and the browser sign-in handoff for this device.

inputs.name: HostedConnection.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace used once to create connection state. Loads that state on mount and disposes it on unmount; the connection store owns endpoint and session operations.

inputs.name: HostedConnection.compact
inputs.description: Optional compact styling flag, false by default; does not change the available connection actions.

outputs.name: HostedConnection
outputs.description: Renders when support and status exist. Shows not-configured guidance, signed-in identity with Disconnect, or browser sign-in code with expiry/waiting text and Cancel. Shows only the store-approved address, otherwise an invalid-address alert. Other states offer Connect shared projects. Busy disables actions; store errors are alerts.

declarations.title: Entity icon
declarations.responsibility: Draws a small decorative icon for a category or action.

inputs.name: Icon.name
inputs.description: Which icon to draw. An unrecognized name uses the page icon.

inputs.name: Icon.size
inputs.description: The icon’s width and height in pixels; 22 when no size is supplied.

outputs.name: Icon
outputs.description: A line icon hidden from screen readers. The surrounding control supplies its accessible name.

declarations.title: Image thumbnail
declarations.responsibility: Loads a small preview of one recorded design image.

inputs.name: ImageThumbnail.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace supplied to the image-URL helper for preview retrieval and effect cleanup.

inputs.name: ImageThumbnail.entityId
inputs.description: Required entity identifier in the image request.

inputs.name: ImageThumbnail.version
inputs.description: Required design-version identifier in the image request.

inputs.name: ImageThumbnail.sha256
inputs.description: Required image hash in the request; this view does not independently verify bytes.

inputs.name: ImageThumbnail.title
inputs.description: Required alternative text for the thumbnail.

outputs.name: ImageThumbnail
outputs.description: Image when the helper supplies a nonempty URL; otherwise Preview unavailable, including while loading. Ignores the helper’s error argument, so loading and failure are not distinguished.

declarations.title: Measures panel
declarations.responsibility: Displays recorded size and performance without estimating missing measurements.

inputs.name: MeasuresPanel.size
inputs.description: Required measure whose nonempty text is displayed, otherwise Not measured. Its available flag controls measured styling.

inputs.name: MeasuresPanel.performance
inputs.description: Required performance measure with the same text fallback; available controls measured styling.

outputs.name: MeasuresPanel
outputs.description: Size & performance panel with the two supplied values. Does not calculate measurements or infer availability from displayed text.

declarations.title: Message list
declarations.responsibility: Shows conversation entries with authors, timestamps, optional status details and entity-reference links.

inputs.name: MessageList.messages
inputs.description: Required entries in display order. User names fall back to You; other authors display their provider followed by CLI, or Harness. Optional pending state, note, detail and version are displayed.

inputs.name: MessageList.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace for resolving references within the shown project and revision.

inputs.name: MessageList.entity
inputs.description: Optional viewed entity for reference resolution before the catalog lists it; defaults to null.

outputs.name: MessageList
outputs.description: Polite live list with author badges, formatted timestamps and reference-aware text. Shows pending styling and optional note/detail/design version. Empty lists prompt a conversation about the design.

declarations.title: Nav bar
declarations.responsibility: Provides project, category and revision navigation, workspace search, agent settings access and optional host-account controls.

inputs.name: NavBar.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace supplying category links, project and revision pickers, search context and navigation. Settings is offered only when agent capability is enabled and includes the current workspace path as its return location. Search navigation uses only entries accepted by the current search context.

inputs.name: NavBar.account
inputs.description: Optional content supplied by the host for account controls, such as the signed-in identity. When omitted, no account container is rendered; this component does not supply sign-in or sign-out behavior itself.

outputs.name: NavBar
outputs.description: Top bar with a Harness link to Pages, project and revision pickers, category links highlighting the current category, search, an agent-capability-dependent Settings link and any supplied account content. Accepted search selections navigate through the workspace; selections without a current path do not trigger that navigation.

dependencies.contract: The Settings icon opens /settings for an agent-capable workspace and keeps its internal return path.

declarations.title: Plan badge
declarations.responsibility: Marks content with a short plan label.

inputs.name: PlanBadge.label
inputs.description: Optional badge text, defaulting to Plan. Explicitly empty text stays empty.

outputs.name: PlanBadge
outputs.description: A styled span with the given label; it does not inspect plan or approval state.

declarations.title: Prior image
declarations.responsibility: Shows an earlier committed design image without annotation controls.

inputs.name: PriorImage.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace used by the image-URL helper to load the earlier image.

inputs.name: PriorImage.entityId
inputs.description: Required entity identifier for the image request.

inputs.name: PriorImage.version
inputs.description: Required earlier version, used in the request and Before caption.

inputs.name: PriorImage.sha256
inputs.description: Required image hash for the request; the component does not choose which image is earlier.

inputs.name: PriorImage.title
inputs.description: Required alternative text for the image.

outputs.name: PriorImage
outputs.description: Figure labeled Before and the supplied version. Shows the returned image or Loading earlier image. Ignores the helper’s error argument, so a failure can remain indistinguishable from loading.

declarations.title: Project agent
declarations.responsibility: Offers a catalog-level agent conversation for proposing a new entity and presents the request, response, progress and recoverable saved draft.

inputs.name: ProjectAgent.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace used to create the project-agent state and provide category context and navigation. The component is intended to be recreated when the project changes. Its launcher is shown only when the agent state allows it and no entity is open.

outputs.name: ProjectAgent
outputs.description: Initially closed “Work with agent” launcher and an expandable conversation panel. Opening focuses the message box; closing or Escape restores focus to the launcher. Shows recorded request, response, status, errors and a cancel button when a status and run identifier exist. Links a saved draft for explicit opening. The compact composer offers Plan and a disabled Change choice because approval is false; active work blocks sending and the current category informs the request prompt.

declarations.title: Project gate
declarations.responsibility: Offers the initial choice of a local project or a project on a connected computer.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.available
inputs.description: Whether local folder opening is available. Together with busy controls the local Open Project button; also selects local-project versus read-only browser-preview guidance. Does not disable recent-project choices.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.local
inputs.description: Whether projects can be opened from this device. Defaults to true. False hides Open Project and describes projects available from a connected computer.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.busy
inputs.description: Whether a project operation is in progress. Disables the local Open Project button and all recent-project choices.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.open
inputs.description: Required callback for the local Open Project button. The component does not choose a folder itself or catch callback failures.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.projects
inputs.description: Optional recent-project choices, empty by default. Each supplies id, name, local/shared kind and optional root. Shared projects are labeled Shared project; other entries show their root or device location.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.choose
inputs.description: Optional callback receiving a selected recent-project identifier. Defaults to a no-op, so selecting a listed project does nothing when omitted.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.children
inputs.description: Optional additional content rendered after recent projects. Omitted content renders nothing.

outputs.name: ProjectGate
outputs.description: Harness welcome screen with a local Open Project button, explanatory preview/connection text, optional recent projects and supplied extra content. Open is disabled while unavailable or busy; recent-project choices are disabled while busy. Choosing a project invokes the supplied chooser. Shared entries say Shared project; others show their root or device location.

declarations.title: Project switcher
declarations.responsibility: Lets a person switch between listed projects or open another local project.

inputs.name: ProjectSwitcher.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace supplying current project, project list, snapshot and navigation operations. After switchProject resolves, the dropdown resets to the resulting workspace project identifier.

outputs.name: ProjectSwitcher
outputs.description: Dropdown grouped into local-device/connected-computer projects and Shared projects. Shows Add local project only for a local workspace with a bridge and disables it while busy. Selection changes call switchProject. This component does not catch rejected promises or display switching errors.

declarations.title: RecordedPreview
declarations.responsibility: Shows the pinned runtime screenshot of an implemented visual unit.

inputs.name: workspace
inputs.description: The selected project and commit, and its evidence connection.

inputs.name: entityId
inputs.description: The page or component to preview.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: The readable name used for the screenshot description.

inputs.name: thumbnail
inputs.description: The recorded scenario, state and viewport; older pages may name their state in the recorded contract.

outputs.name: preview
outputs.description: A checked screenshot with its state and tested commit, or an explicit loading or unavailable state.

declarations.title: Reference text
declarations.responsibility: Turns known unit references in ordinary text into links within the displayed workspace.

inputs.name: ReferenceText.text
inputs.description: Required plain text parsed for [[unit:<id>]] references. Unknown references and ordinary text remain as written; nothing is interpreted as markup.

inputs.name: ReferenceText.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace providing the project, revision and navigation context for resolved links.

inputs.name: ReferenceText.entity
inputs.description: Optional viewed entity, null by default, available for reference lookup before the catalog lists it.

outputs.name: ReferenceText
outputs.description: Inline text interleaved with recognized unit links and category icons. Adds no surrounding element and leaves unresolved references as text.

declarations.title: Used In and Uses
declarations.responsibility: Shows recorded dependencies or the entities recorded as using the current entity.

inputs.name: RelationshipsPanel.relationships
inputs.description: Required relationships filtered by direction and deduplicated by identifier; the last matching duplicate supplies displayed values. Includes category, title and plan flag.

inputs.name: RelationshipsPanel.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace used to link known-category entities. Records without a category remain plain text.

inputs.name: RelationshipsPanel.direction
inputs.description: Required uses or used-by. Uses groups dependencies by category; used-by produces one Used In list with kind badges.

outputs.name: RelationshipsPanel
outputs.description: Lists dependencies or users with names, category icons and optional plan badges. Verification marks stay on entity pages. Dependencies are grouped by kind; empty lists explain missing records.

declarations.title: Remote approval
declarations.responsibility: Lets a computer user grant selected projects and optional agent permission to a requesting phone.

inputs.name: RemoteApproval.request
inputs.description: Required phone request supplying name, platform, device identity and pairing identity. Approval sends both displayed identities; denial sends the pairing identifier.

inputs.name: RemoteApproval.projects
inputs.description: Required project choices; none are initially selected. An empty list explains that a local project is needed.

inputs.name: RemoteApproval.store
inputs.description: Host state providing busy and approve/deny operations. Approval receives selected project identifiers and agents=false unless explicitly checked. Operation failures are delegated to this store.

outputs.name: RemoteApproval
outputs.description: Request fieldset showing phone identity, project checkboxes and Plan/Change permission. Approve is disabled while busy or without a chosen project; Deny is disabled while busy. Submits exactly the selected project list and agent flag.

declarations.title: Remote connection
declarations.responsibility: Chooses connection controls appropriate to the current computer or phone environment.

inputs.name: RemoteConnection.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace whose remote.host or remote.phone selects the panel; host takes precedence if both are set.

inputs.name: RemoteConnection.compact
inputs.description: Optional compact flag, false by default, forwarded to the chosen panel.

outputs.name: RemoteConnection
outputs.description: Host panel or phone panel when matching remote mode and context stores exist; otherwise nothing. Does not initiate pairing itself.

declarations.title: Remote devices
declarations.responsibility: Lists approved phones, granted projects and connection status with a revoke action.

inputs.name: RemoteDevices.devices
inputs.description: Required approved-device records with identities, names, project grants and connection information. Online means Connected; otherwise shows last-seen time or Not connected.

inputs.name: RemoteDevices.projects
inputs.description: Required identifier/name lookup for grants; absent projects say Project no longer listed.

inputs.name: RemoteDevices.store
inputs.description: Host store supplying busy state and revoke. A click passes the device identifier; busy disables the button.

outputs.name: RemoteDevices
outputs.description: Approved-phone list with project badges, permission summaries, connectivity and Revoke actions, or No phone is approved for an empty list. Revocation effects and errors are handled outside this list.

declarations.title: Remote host panel
declarations.responsibility: Manages computer-side phone access, pairing offers, pending approvals and approved devices.

inputs.name: RemoteHostPanel.store
inputs.description: Host store with status, busy/errors and access/pairing operations. Missing status renders nothing; unsupported or disabled status shows its explanation.

inputs.name: RemoteHostPanel.compact
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. True initially shows only summary and Manage; opening reveals controls in a sheet. False displays controls directly.

outputs.name: RemoteHostPanel
outputs.description: Access panel with enable/disable actions, status, an unspent pairing code, pending requests and approved devices. An offer already represented by a request is not shown as scannable. Pair a phone appears without a scannable offer and requires online/not busy. Store errors appear only inside the expanded body.

declarations.title: Remote offer code
declarations.responsibility: Displays a live pairing offer as a QR code and allows replacing or hiding it.

inputs.name: RemoteOfferCode.offer
inputs.description: Required scan content and expiration. QR is drawn only while parsed expiration is in the future; scan content is not printed as text.

inputs.name: RemoteOfferCode.store
inputs.description: Host store providing busy state and createPairing/closePairing for New code/Hide code. Busy disables these actions.

outputs.name: RemoteOfferCode
outputs.description: QR with instructions and countdown while live and drawable. Checks expiry every second and clears the timer on cleanup. Invalid/expired timestamps show expired; QR failures show cannot-show guidance. New code is always offered, Hide code only when a symbol is displayed.

declarations.title: Remote phone panel
declarations.responsibility: Guides pairing from a phone and displays connection status and granted access.

inputs.name: RemotePhonePanel.store
inputs.description: Phone status and operations, including scan/disconnect, busy/errors, scan failure and fixture flag. Scan receives the entered device name, initially iPhone.

inputs.name: RemotePhonePanel.compact
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. Compact hides unpaired setup form/instructions, grant/device details and fixture notice; applicable connection actions and store errors remain.

outputs.name: RemotePhonePanel
outputs.description: Connection panel when status and labels exist. Full unpaired view offers a phone-name input limited to 80 characters and QR scan/retry. Other states display status and a disconnect action labeled Cancel for pairing/pending approval, Connect again for revoked, otherwise Disconnect. Full mode shows grant and phone identity. Busy disables buttons; errors are alerts.

declarations.title: Revision picker
declarations.responsibility: Selects the displayed branch or commit and allows returning to its branch tip.

inputs.name: RevisionPicker.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace supplying snapshot, revision, branch/commit lists, pinned state and navigation. Values follow the displayed revision. Branch navigation supplies only branch; commit navigation includes both.

outputs.name: RevisionPicker
outputs.description: Branch/commit dropdowns when snapshot and revision exist, with shortened hashes, subjects and tip. Distinguishes historical, pinned-tip and current-tip views. Offers Go to tip for pinned or historical views. This component does not catch or display navigation errors.

dependencies.contract: The shared Select component supplies keyboard and value selection behavior through the $shared alias.

declarations.title: Run status
declarations.responsibility: Shows run status text and, when applicable, its cancel action.

inputs.name: RunStatus.text
inputs.description: Required status text; empty suppresses the entire area, including Cancel. Known unit references become links.

inputs.name: RunStatus.active
inputs.description: Whether Cancel run appears when text exists; no run state is inferred.

inputs.name: RunStatus.cancel
inputs.description: Required click callback. Completion and cancellation errors are outside this component.

inputs.name: RunStatus.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace for resolving status-text unit links.

inputs.name: RunStatus.entity
inputs.description: Optional viewed entity for reference lookup, null by default.

outputs.name: RunStatus
outputs.description: Status region with linked/plain text and optional Cancel run button; nothing for empty text.

declarations.title: Runtime artifact
declarations.responsibility: Presents recorded test result contents only after a verified read, keeping missing or unreadable evidence explicit.

inputs.name: RuntimeArtifact.cell
inputs.description: Required result cell with capture and optional read. Missing capture means Not recorded; null media means bytes not stored. Only read.verified allows details.

inputs.name: RuntimeArtifact.label
inputs.description: Required accessible name for the artifact group when a stored capture exists.

inputs.name: RuntimeArtifact.lost
inputs.description: Whether reading failed instead of still pending. True makes absent reads unverified rather than loading.

inputs.name: RuntimeArtifact.refusal
inputs.description: Optional backend refusal, preferred over the read problem and generic hash-check failure message.

inputs.name: RuntimeArtifact.unit
inputs.description: Optional function identifier passed to case rendering, enabling callable rows scoped to that function.

outputs.name: RuntimeArtifact
outputs.description: Verified cases plus expandable assertions, steps, traces and other facts. Unstated assertions remain unknown. Raw JSON renders only while expanded; non-JSON recorded text is shown. Each formatted text value is capped at 12,000 characters with a shortened marker. No capture, missing bytes, pending read and failed verification have distinct messages.

declarations.title: Runtime audio
declarations.responsibility: Plays recorded audio with transcripts and matching before/after clips.

inputs.name: RuntimeAudio.result
inputs.description: Required evidence result with audio entries, declarations, comparison mode and commit scope. Groups clips by comparison identity; after falls back to current.

inputs.name: RuntimeAudio.evidence
inputs.description: Evidence state providing a URL for side and file. Promise failures are caught and shown as unverified.

outputs.name: RuntimeAudio
outputs.description: Audio panel when clips exist or audio is declared. Commit mode pairs before/after; other modes show current. Includes playback controls, transcript when present, standing/status and reading/error states. Missing sides and declared-but-absent clips are explicit gaps.

declarations.title: Runtime behavior
declarations.responsibility: Shows recorded end-to-end behavior and comparison without presenting pending reads as verified changes.

inputs.name: RuntimeBehavior.result
inputs.description: Required behavior rows, scenarios, scope and after-side record. Comparison has two sides only for commit mode with a parent.

inputs.name: RuntimeBehavior.evidence
inputs.description: Read state: undefined is pending, null is failure, populated data supplies comparison input. Refusal messages are forwarded to run panels.

inputs.name: RuntimeBehavior.unit
inputs.description: Optional function identifier forwarded to result rows on both sides.

outputs.name: RuntimeBehavior
outputs.description: Current or compared behavior with verdict/reasons, result groups, recorded duration and scenario outcomes. Pending reads show a reading verdict unless already fixed as not-compared or unknown with a reason. Failed reads say Behavior unknown. Missing groups or duration are explicitly marked absent.

declarations.title: Runtime evidence
declarations.responsibility: Combines recorded screenshots, behavior and audio while identifying evidence gaps and offline copies.

inputs.name: RuntimeEvidence.entity
inputs.description: Entity whose kind informs notices and category chooses panels. Pages/shells/components are visual; functions have no screenshot panel and scope behavior rows by identifier.

inputs.name: RuntimeEvidence.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace supplying offline status and cache timestamp for the saved-copy warning.

inputs.name: RuntimeEvidence.evidence
inputs.description: State whose ready result feeds the panels and whose status/error feeds notices. A notice takes precedence over results.

outputs.name: RuntimeEvidence
outputs.description: Runtime section identifying current tip or commit/parent. Labels offline content as saved and not server-checked. Shows screenshots for non-functions that are visual or declare screen options; behavior for nonvisual entities or existing behavior rows; audio when appropriate. Uses recorded runtime evidence, not proposed designs.

declarations.title: Runtime pane
declarations.responsibility: Shows one recorded screenshot or the reason its capture is unavailable.

inputs.name: RuntimePane.item
inputs.description: Evidence item with file, phase, missing flag/note and display facts. Missing items are not fetched. Before phase reads before; other phases read after.

inputs.name: RuntimePane.title
inputs.description: Required figure heading and accessible name.

inputs.name: RuntimePane.role
inputs.description: Required descriptive badge such as Parent commit or Branch tip.

inputs.name: RuntimePane.evidence
inputs.description: URL-reading state. Failed promises become displayed problems; callbacks from superseded requests are ignored.

outputs.name: RuntimePane
outputs.description: Figure with screenshot after URL resolution, plus standing/status. Missing capture, failed verification and loading have separate messages. Non-Fresh capture standings receive stale styling.

declarations.title: Runtime run
declarations.responsibility: Presents one side of recorded behavior by scenario, state and artifact.

inputs.name: RuntimeRun.shown
inputs.description: Grouped results and scenario titles. Overall passes only when groups exist and every group passes on the chosen side.

inputs.name: RuntimeRun.side
inputs.description: Required before or after, selecting outcomes and cells. Only after displays difference paths.

inputs.name: RuntimeRun.title
inputs.description: Required heading and accessible name.

inputs.name: RuntimeRun.role
inputs.description: Required descriptive badge for this side.

inputs.name: RuntimeRun.lost
inputs.description: Required failure flag forwarded so unread artifacts are not left pending.

inputs.name: RuntimeRun.refusals
inputs.description: Required hash-to-refusal map. Each artifact uses its capture hash or the empty-string key when no hash exists.

inputs.name: RuntimeRun.unit
inputs.description: Optional function identifier forwarded to artifact case rendering.

outputs.name: RuntimeRun
outputs.description: Run status, state headings and result artifacts with Passed/Failed/Not recorded labels. After-side results list differences. Empty groups do not count as passing.

declarations.title: Runtime screens
declarations.responsibility: Lets a person inspect recorded captures by scenario, state and viewport with comparison and provenance explained.

inputs.name: RuntimeScreens.result
inputs.description: Required comparison mode, scope, captures and incomparability reasons. Shared explorer helpers determine selected captures and provenance.

inputs.name: RuntimeScreens.options
inputs.description: Required scenarios with states and viewports. Selection is reconciled through the picker helper; viewport size is displayed.

inputs.name: RuntimeScreens.evidence
inputs.description: Evidence state forwarded to panes for reading recorded bytes.

outputs.name: RuntimeScreens
outputs.description: Current or before/after screenshots with controls when a valid option exists. Scenario picker is disabled with fewer than two options. Lists incomparability reasons. Current views distinguish fresh, inherited with origin commit, and absent capture. Child panes handle image loading and errors.

declarations.title: Segmented choice
declarations.responsibility: Offers a labeled group of string-valued choices.

inputs.name: SegmentedChoice.value
inputs.description: Optional bindable selected string, empty by default. Click replaces it. Values outside the options leave all buttons unselected; no fallback is chosen.

inputs.name: SegmentedChoice.options
inputs.description: Required option strings in display order, serving as both labels and keys. Callers should supply unique strings. Empty renders no buttons.

inputs.name: SegmentedChoice.label
inputs.description: Required accessible name of the group.

outputs.name: SegmentedChoice
outputs.description: Buttons with active styling and aria-pressed for the selected value. Selection updates the binding without submitting a form.

declarations.title: Status bar
declarations.responsibility: Summarizes revision, access limits, cache provenance and connection controls for the displayed project.

inputs.name: StatusBar.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace providing busy/snapshot, revision, source/comment capabilities, pinned/offline state, cache and connection context. It supplies the facts; the view does not verify publication or connectivity.

outputs.name: StatusBar
outputs.description: Footer with loading, offline, local/shared, historical and access-limited status. Offline copies are read-only and not server-checked, with save time when available; local unpublished revisions are named accordingly. Includes compact hosted/remote controls and seven-character commit.

declarations.title: Status icon
declarations.responsibility: Displays a verification marker and lets a person inspect the reason behind it.

inputs.name: StatusIcon.status
inputs.description: Verification state: verified, failed, unverified or unknown. Only verified renders a check and passed styling; all other states render a cross. The marker does not independently evaluate evidence.

inputs.name: StatusIcon.reason
inputs.description: Required explanatory text, used as the accessible label and tooltip. An empty string falls back to “No verification recorded for this revision.”

outputs.name: StatusIcon
outputs.description: Verification button showing a check or cross. Click, keyboard focus or pointer hover opens the explanatory text as a status message; blur or pointer leave closes it. The accessible label and native tooltip carry the same explanation.

declarations.title: Thread history
declarations.responsibility: Shows entity events and lets a person choose a plan or design version.

inputs.name: ThreadHistory.entity
inputs.description: Entity history, versions, category, identifier and title. Functions show plan versions without image requests; other categories may show each version’s first relevant image.

inputs.name: ThreadHistory.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace supplied to version thumbnails for image retrieval.

inputs.name: ThreadHistory.version
inputs.description: Required current version for highlighting and choosing its currently viewed option thumbnail.

inputs.name: ThreadHistory.option
inputs.description: Optional current-version option, empty by default. Other versions use their approved or first option through the helper.

inputs.name: ThreadHistory.select
inputs.description: Required callback receiving the clicked version. Does not itself mutate the version prop.

outputs.name: ThreadHistory
outputs.description: Expandable event history with titles, raw recorded timestamps and details, plus a selectable version strip. Empty history is explicit. Versions show thumbnails where applicable and Plan/Design or approval labels. An approval tied to a known option names that option.

declarations.title: Thread links
declarations.responsibility: Groups existing conversations by whether they belong to the image currently in view.

inputs.name: ThreadLinks.threads
inputs.description: Required thread records, kept in supplied order within each group. Empty groups are omitted.

inputs.name: ThreadLinks.thread
inputs.description: Required current thread or null. Its identifier marks the matching button active and pressed.

inputs.name: ThreadLinks.aim
inputs.description: Required image/conversation target used by the same-image helper to classify threads.

inputs.name: ThreadLinks.select
inputs.description: Called with the clicked thread; this component does not update the current-thread prop itself.

outputs.name: ThreadLinks
outputs.description: Threads on this image followed by Other threads. Buttons show the pin number and version, falling back to Initial plan. Empty input renders no groups.

declarations.title: Thread panel
declarations.responsibility: Coordinates an entity conversation, comments, agent requests, selected design and approval controls.

inputs.name: ThreadPanel.entity
inputs.description: Required current entity with versions, history, threads, category and latest version. Supplies identity for comments and requests. Function comments default to the function rather than an old image.

inputs.name: ThreadPanel.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace held by the run and comment stores for this view. Supplies bridge, revision, context and capabilities, which determine offered modes and approval controls. Loads comments/providers and subscribes to run events on mount.

inputs.name: ThreadPanel.thread
inputs.description: Optional bindable current thread, initially null. Takes precedence over target and design when choosing the conversation anchor. Selecting/opening a thread updates it; a thread on another option of the same version is cleared when that option changes.

inputs.name: ThreadPanel.target
inputs.description: Optional bindable image or region awaiting a thread, initially null. Used when no thread is selected. Cleared on thread selection or creation and when it belongs to a different option of the shown version.

inputs.name: ThreadPanel.version
inputs.description: Optional bindable version, initially empty. Chooses design and approval context; history selection updates it. A handled run event may advance it to the entity latest version.

inputs.name: ThreadPanel.option
inputs.description: Optional bindable current design option, empty by default. Determines approval and image target. Selecting a same-version thread can adopt its option.

inputs.name: ThreadPanel.close
inputs.description: Required callback for closing the conversation; invoked by its close button.

outputs.name: ThreadPanel
outputs.description: Conversation sidebar with history, grouped threads, saved/pending messages, streaming response, status/cancel, errors and a composer. Plan/Change opens a planning thread when necessary; Change includes recorded approval details. Human comments use the comments store without starting an agent. Shared comment success refreshes and selects the saved thread. Approval appears only for a selected design with approval capability.

declarations.title: Workspace link
declarations.responsibility: Opens an address within the selected project while preserving normal browser behavior for modified clicks.

inputs.name: WorkspaceLink.workspace
inputs.description: The selected project and the navigation action used when the link is opened here.

inputs.name: WorkspaceLink.to
inputs.description: The destination address within the app. The hosting app adds its own address prefix.

inputs.name: WorkspaceLink.class
inputs.description: Optional appearance classes for the link.

inputs.name: WorkspaceLink.label
inputs.description: Optional screen-reader name when the visible content does not explain the action.

inputs.name: WorkspaceLink.title
inputs.description: Optional short tooltip shown when the pointer rests over the link.

inputs.name: WorkspaceLink.children
inputs.description: The visible text or icon inside the link.

outputs.name: WorkspaceLink
outputs.description: A navigation link. Ordinary clicks open here; modified clicks keep the browser’s usual behavior.

declarations.title: Shared workspace shell
declarations.responsibility: Assembles workspace navigation, the catalog or entity view, project-agent controls and status.

inputs.name: WorkspaceShell.workspace
inputs.description: Required workspace supplying current project, entity, snapshot, errors and navigation context. Entity views are keyed by project and entity; catalogs by project. Project-agent state is keyed by project and snapshot writability.

inputs.name: WorkspaceShell.account
inputs.description: Optional host-account content forwarded to the navigation bar. Omitted means no supplied account controls.

outputs.name: WorkspaceShell
outputs.description: Workspace shell showing navigation, any workspace error alert, either entity detail or category catalog, status footer and project-agent component. Keyed views are recreated at the stated identity boundaries.

declarations.title: app
declarations.responsibility: Owns the app entry point.

declarations.title: Check the approved change
declarations.responsibility: Checks that a Change request still names the approved design, contract, images and thread.

inputs.name: approvalMatch.entity
inputs.description: The entity details, including its latest version, contract hash, last design version’s approval and threads.

inputs.name: approvalMatch.request
