inputs.description: The requested mode, thread and approval binding. Plan requests pass without an approval check. A Change must identify the current approved version, contract, image hashes and design option.

outputs.name: approvalMatch
outputs.description: No return value. Returning normally means the applicable approval and thread checks passed; it does not execute or verify a change.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Refuses a missing or outdated approval, a different design or contract, different image hashes or option, a thread outside this entity, or a thread anchored to another version or option. Image hash order is ignored, but the complete sorted lists must match.

declarations.title: Check stored capture bytes
declarations.responsibility: Checks the stored capture’s size, hash and media type before returning its bytes.

inputs.name: artifactAnswer.capture
inputs.description: The listed capture’s kind, recorded media type, SHA-256 hash, stored-media marker and optional explanation for missing bytes.

inputs.name: artifactAnswer.bytes
inputs.description: The bytes held by the capture’s record, or undefined when unavailable. At most 11 MiB is accepted, including exactly 11 MiB.

outputs.name: artifactAnswer
outputs.description: A promise for the original bytes, their checked recorded hash, and the media type selected from the capture kind and byte signatures. Unsupported media is rejected by the media checker.

errors.name: not-stored
errors.description: Rejects when bytes are absent or the capture’s media marker is null. The message includes the recorded gap when available.

errors.name: too-large
errors.description: Rejects bytes longer than 11 MiB, reporting the actual and allowed lengths.

errors.name: hash-mismatch
errors.description: Rejects when hashing the supplied bytes with SHA-256 does not reproduce the recorded hash.

declarations.title: Read and check capture bytes
declarations.responsibility: Reads a recorded capture through the desktop connection and independently checks its hash.

inputs.name: artifactBytes.bridge
inputs.description: A connection with an optional artifact reader. A connection without that operation is refused.

inputs.name: artifactBytes.query
inputs.description: The exact capture request, including its binding and expected SHA-256 hash. Passed unchanged to the artifact reader.

outputs.name: unreadArtifact
outputs.description: The message used when the connection cannot read recorded bytes.

outputs.name: damagedArtifact
outputs.description: The message used when returned bytes do not match the requested recorded hash.

outputs.name: artifactBytes
outputs.description: A promise for copied bytes, the reader’s media type and the independently calculated SHA-256 hash. The bytes must match the requested hash, regardless of the hash claimed by the answer.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects if artifact reading is unavailable or the bytes have a different hash. Backend and hashing failures propagate.

declarations.title: Choose a capture’s media type
declarations.responsibility: Chooses an allowed media type from the capture kind, recorded type and byte signatures.

inputs.name: artifactMedia.capture
inputs.description: The capture kind and recorded media type. Supported kinds are screenshot, audio, output, assertions and trace.

inputs.name: artifactMedia.bytes
inputs.description: The bytes to inspect. Screenshots need a PNG or JPEG signature. Audio needs a supported recorded type and matching signature. Text results must be valid UTF-8 without a null character.

outputs.name: artifactLimit
outputs.description: The shared maximum artifact size, 11 MiB or 11,534,336 bytes. This function exports the limit; media-type selection does not itself enforce it.

outputs.name: artifactMedia
outputs.description: PNG or JPEG for screenshots; WAV, MPEG, MP4 or Ogg for supported audio. Results use application/json only when recorded as JSON and successfully parsed; otherwise they use UTF-8 plain text. No HTML type is returned.

errors.name: type-not-attested
errors.description: Throws when the capture kind is unsupported, screenshot or audio signatures do not match an accepted format, the recorded audio type is unsupported, or a result is not valid text. Invalid JSON falls back to plain text.

declarations.title: Request a recorded capture
declarations.responsibility: Builds a request for the stored bytes of a capture listed in an evidence result, keeping its exact scenario, state and revision identifiers.

inputs.name: artifactQuery.result
inputs.description: The evidence answer containing the before and after captures, their verification records, and the notes and evidence revisions used for the read.

inputs.name: artifactQuery.scope
inputs.description: The entity, project context, branch, commit and viewing mode to carry into the byte request. The caller must supply the scope that belongs to the result; this function does not check that they match.

inputs.name: artifactQuery.side
inputs.description: Choose before or after to search only the captures listed on that side.

inputs.name: artifactQuery.file
inputs.description: Either the stored filename of a capture or the exact capture object already held in the selected side. Object matching uses the same object, not a copy with equal fields. Only captures with stored media are eligible.

outputs.name: artifactQuery
outputs.description: A request containing the supplied scope and the selected record, scenario, state, evidence identifier, image hash and pinned revisions. A missing viewport becomes null. Returns null if that side has no record or does not list a matching capture with stored media; it does not read the bytes or build a file address.

declarations.title: Package bytes for transport
declarations.responsibility: Encodes bytes for transport with their length, media type and SHA-256 hash.

inputs.name: binaryAnswer.bytes
inputs.description: The bytes to encode. Their length and hash are calculated directly from this array.

inputs.name: binaryAnswer.mediaType
inputs.description: The media type to label the answer with; defaults to image/png. The function does not inspect the bytes to verify this label.

outputs.name: binaryAnswer
outputs.description: An object containing base64 data, encoding set to base64, the supplied media type, byte length and calculated SHA-256 hash.

declarations.title: Decode a transported capture
declarations.responsibility: Decodes transported artifact bytes and checks the supplied length and hash.

inputs.name: binaryArtifact.value
inputs.description: A transported binary answer with base64 data, encoding, byte length, hash and a string media type.

outputs.name: binaryArtifact
outputs.description: A promise for decoded bytes with the supplied media type and hash after the transport checks pass. The media label is retained, not independently inferred from the bytes.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects a non-string media type, unsupported encoding or unreadable base64, and bytes whose length or SHA-256 differs from the supplied values.

declarations.title: Render the Harness app icon
declarations.responsibility: Creates a square PNG of the shared gold Harness mark on navy for iOS or Mac.

inputs.name: brandIcon.size
inputs.description: The requested width and height in pixels. Callers should supply a usable whole-number image size; this helper does not validate a supported size range.

inputs.name: brandIcon.variant
inputs.description: The icon treatment: ios by default for an opaque navy background, or mac for a rounded navy plate inside a transparent margin.

outputs.name: brandIcon
outputs.description: PNG bytes at the requested square size, using RGB for iOS and RGBA transparency for Mac. Geometry comes from the shared brand tiles; no file is written.

declarations.title: Respond to cached or denied access
declarations.responsibility: Makes the shown project read-only when it goes offline and removes shared project content when access is denied.

inputs.name: offlineCapabilities.source
inputs.description: The original source, local or github, to retain while disabling all change actions for an offline view.

inputs.name: offlineView.snapshot
inputs.description: The snapshot whose cache information should be inspected. It counts as cached when its cache status is offline or its cache explicitly says read-only.

inputs.name: forgetShared.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace whose shared content and pending navigation may need to be invalidated. A displayed GitHub-backed project is cleared only when the event names it or the whole session.

inputs.name: forgetShared.projectId
inputs.description: The denied project identity, or the special value $projects for the entire session. Pending navigation is preserved only when its target is listed as a local project.

inputs.name: forgetShared.notice
inputs.description: The message to store as the workspace error when the shown shared project is removed.

inputs.name: cacheStatus.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace to update in place when a cache event arrives, including its shown project, pending target, project list and allowed actions.

inputs.name: cacheStatus.event
inputs.description: A project identity and fresh, offline or denied status, with an optional cached time. An offline event applies only to the shown project. A denied event removes affected shared content. A fresh event does not restore a cached view; that requires a newly loaded snapshot.

outputs.name: everyProject
outputs.description: The special project identity $projects, used for events about the complete session or project discovery.

outputs.name: deniedNotice
outputs.description: The message: Access to this shared project ended. Connect again or ask its owner.

outputs.name: offlineNotice
outputs.description: The message: Offline cached view. Comments and changes need a connection.

outputs.name: offlineCapabilities
outputs.description: Capabilities with comments, agents, planning and approval disabled, the supplied source retained, and the offline notice as the reason.

outputs.name: offlineView
outputs.description: The cached timestamp, or null when it was not recorded, wrapped as cached-view information. Returns null when the snapshot is not marked offline or read-only.

outputs.name: forgetShared
outputs.description: No return value. A session-wide denial removes shared projects from the list. Matching pending navigation is invalidated unless its target is listed as local. A matching displayed GitHub-backed project loses its snapshot, entity and cached view, receives closed capabilities and the notice, and triggers a project-list refresh for a single-project denial.

outputs.name: cacheStatus
outputs.description: No return value. A matching offline event marks the shown snapshot unwritable, records the cached time and disables change actions when first entering offline mode; existing cache metadata is updated. Denied events apply the shared-content removal rules. Other events leave the workspace unchanged.

declarations.title: Mark a saved project view offline
declarations.responsibility: Marks a phone’s saved snapshot as dated and read-only without claiming it is current or published.

inputs.name: cachedSnapshot.snapshot
inputs.description: The saved project snapshot whose project identity, branch, commit and visible content should be retained.

inputs.name: cachedSnapshot.saved
inputs.description: The saved timestamp and the identity of the phone holding this copy. These values are copied without date or identity validation.

outputs.name: cachedSnapshot
outputs.description: A new snapshot with writing disabled and replacement offline cache metadata. Publication is unknown; the cache identity uses the phone, project, branch and commit while unavailable repository, tree and revision details use empty, zero or null values. Existing capabilities and other content remain as supplied.

declarations.title: Assemble entity details
declarations.responsibility: Combines an entity’s catalog entry, contract, relationships, plan and source history for a revision.

inputs.name: catalogDetail.context
inputs.description: The source adapter and planning reader used to obtain history, source details, size and contract hashes.

inputs.name: catalogDetail.data
inputs.description: The requested identity and revision, catalog entries, unit definitions and optional plan from that revision. The identity must appear in the supplied catalog entries.

outputs.name: catalogDetail
outputs.description: A promise for the catalog entry enriched with a plan contract when present, otherwise the unit contract and hash; relationships; design versions and threads; source details; and merged history deduplicated by identity and sorted newest first. Design-only entries have no source files or size measurement. Performance is reported as not measured.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects when the requested identity is absent from the supplied catalog entries. Failures from history, source or size readers also propagate.

declarations.title: Read an entity’s source history
declarations.responsibility: Reads up to 100 Git commits affecting a unit’s owned source paths at the requested revision.

inputs.name: catalogHistory.root
inputs.description: The repository directory in which to read Git history.

inputs.name: catalogHistory.revision
inputs.description: The Git revision from which to read history, passed as supplied to Git.

inputs.name: catalogHistory.unit
inputs.description: The unit definition whose owned source paths restrict the history. No owned paths means an empty history without running Git.

outputs.name: catalogHistory
outputs.description: A promise for commit history entries containing the hash, author timestamp and subject, with no design version. Each entry states that source changed and verification is recorded separately. Git read failures reject the promise.

declarations.title: Build catalog entries
declarations.responsibility: Turns active units and plans into catalog entries, marks owned file changes, and excludes pages that only load data from the visible list.

inputs.name: catalogUnit.unit
inputs.description: The unit definition, including its identity, kind, active status, title, responsibility, owned files and optional recorded-preview selection. Inactive units and kinds without a catalog category are omitted.

inputs.name: catalogUnit.changed
inputs.description: The changed file paths to compare with this unit. A change counts when it equals an owned path or falls beneath an owned directory; paths are compared as supplied.

inputs.name: catalogListed.units
inputs.description: The unit definitions for the revision being listed. A page is excluded only when it owns at least one file and every owned file is a page loader named +page.js, +page.ts, +page.server.js or +page.server.ts.

inputs.name: catalogListed.items
inputs.description: The existing catalog entries to filter. Entries keep their order; only identities belonging to loader-only pages are removed.

inputs.name: planCatalog.plan
inputs.description: The plan whose goal, lifecycle, threads and design versions should appear. The last version in the supplied array is treated as the latest; its first image supplies the thumbnail.

inputs.name: planCatalog.unit
inputs.description: An existing catalog entry to enrich, or null to create a planned entry from the plan identity, category and title. An existing entry keeps its identity, kind, title and verification status.

inputs.name: planCatalog.changed
inputs.description: Changed file paths used to mark the plan as changed when its stored path, or a path beneath it, appears. An existing changed mark is retained.

outputs.name: catalogUnit
outputs.description: A catalog entry, or null for an inactive or uncategorized unit. New entries start with unknown verification, no plan, no design versions and zero threads. Pages receive a recorded-thumbnail request even without an explicit preview; components receive one only with a preview; other categories have no thumbnail.

outputs.name: catalogListed
outputs.description: A new list with loader-only pages removed by identity. This filters the list without changing or deleting the supplied entries or unit definitions.

outputs.name: planCatalog
outputs.description: A catalog entry with the plan goal, lifecycle, thread count and latest design information. A latest design image takes priority; without one, the existing implemented screenshot selection is retained. Planned-only entries without an image keep an explicit gap. Approval alone does not verify behavior, and only a current approval marks the latest version approved.

declarations.title: Choose a catalog category
declarations.responsibility: Maps a unit’s declared kind to its catalog category.

inputs.name: categoryOf.kind
inputs.description: The declared kind: page, shell, component, function, shared-function, config or service.

outputs.name: categoryOf
outputs.description: The corresponding plural category. Both function and shared-function map to functions. Other ordinary kind names return null; names and source files are not consulted.

declarations.title: Run and record an approved change
declarations.responsibility: Runs the selected agent with the approved design and records its public reply and observed changes, leaving verification pending.

inputs.name: changeExecute.context
inputs.description: The prepared Change context: selected runner, request with approval, entity, project directory and revision, planning access, cancellation signal and event callback. Approval is assumed already checked.

inputs.name: changeExecute.options
inputs.description: A temporary directory for the first approved image, when one exists, and a callback to observe file paths reported by the runner.

inputs.name: recordChange.context
inputs.description: The same run context used to identify the entity, thread, approval, branch and public reply when recording the outcome.

inputs.name: recordChange.outcome
inputs.type: { before: SourceSnapshot; host: ReturnType<typeof hostChanges>; failure: Error | null; }
inputs.description: The before-change source snapshot, host-operation recorder and failure or null. These determine changed files, observed host operations and completed, failed or cancelled status.

outputs.name: changeExecute
outputs.description: A promise that completes without a return value after the runner finishes. Emits progress and public text, retains the reply for recording and supplies write access with the approved reference image when present. It does not run verification.

outputs.name: recordChange
outputs.description: A promise that completes after comparing source snapshots, recording host operations, emitting changed files and appending an agent message to the thread. The message retains up to 20,000 characters of reply, counts changed files and host operations, names known owning units and states that verification is pending.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Thrown when the cancellation signal is aborted after the runner returns; runner cancellation can also propagate. Recording marks an aborted or cancelled run as cancelled.

declarations.title: Describe the units changed
declarations.responsibility: Names distinct registered owners of changed files and counts files without owners.

inputs.name: changedUnits.paths
inputs.description: The changed file paths to look up. Paths are not included in the returned notice; repeated input paths can still increase the unowned-file count.

inputs.name: changedUnits.owners
inputs.description: A lookup returning owning unit identities for each path. Only identities matching the unit-reference grammar are included; an empty result counts the path as unowned.

outputs.name: changedUnits
outputs.description: A notice with distinct valid unit identities sorted and written as unit references, limited to 40 named units with any remainder counted. Also counts paths with no owners. Returns an empty string when neither valid owners nor unowned paths can be reported.

declarations.title: Check Claude CLI availability
declarations.responsibility: Checks the installed Claude CLI and subscription sign-in, then reports the configured model choice.

inputs.name: claudeState.command
inputs.description: The executable and initial arguments for Claude CLI. The helper appends version and JSON authentication-status commands, each with a ten-second timeout.

outputs.name: claudeState
outputs.description: A promise for Claude availability, version, reason and model choices. A logged-in claude.ai subscription enables the configured Claude Opus 5.5 choice with low through max effort and xhigh as default. Image generation remains false. Discovery failures return unavailable with a reason and no models.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The subscription requirement can produce an Error internally, but this function catches it and reports its message in the returned unavailable state. Normal discovery errors are not rethrown.

declarations.title: Run one Claude request
declarations.responsibility: Runs the requested Claude model, forwards public output and reports only a completed matching-model result.

inputs.name: claudeTurn.command
inputs.description: The Claude executable and initial arguments. The helper adds noninteractive streaming output, the requested model, bypassPermissions and disabled session persistence.

inputs.name: claudeTurn.turn
inputs.description: The model, optional effort, working directory, prompt, access mode, cancellation signal and callbacks. The prompt goes to standard input. Read-only access limits available tools to Read, Glob and Grep; reported Write and Edit paths are sent to the optional file callback.

outputs.name: claudeTurn
outputs.description: A promise for the final public result text and the exact model reported by Claude. Public streamed events are forwarded while it runs; malformed JSON lines are ignored.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects if Claude reports another model, returns no completed result, marks its final result as an error, or the CLI process fails. Cancellation and process time or output limits also propagate.

declarations.title: Prepare a CLI environment
declarations.responsibility: Builds a subprocess environment with the configured environment filtering and executable search paths.

outputs.name: cliEnvironment
outputs.description: A new environment based on scrubEnvironment, with PATH entries deduplicated in order and common user, Bun, Homebrew and system executable directories appended. It does not change the parent process environment.

declarations.title: Run an owned CLI process
declarations.responsibility: Runs a CLI command with bounded output and time, forwarding complete output lines and supporting cancellation.

inputs.name: killOwnedProcess.pid
inputs.description: The owned process ID to terminate, or undefined to do nothing. On Windows it targets that process; elsewhere it targets the process group with that ID.

inputs.name: cliProcess.command
inputs.description: The executable and arguments to spawn directly with the prepared CLI environment and piped input and output.

inputs.name: cliProcess.options
inputs.description: Optional working directory, input text, cancellation signal, output-line callback and limits. Defaults are empty input, ten minutes and 16,000,000 output bytes. An already-aborted signal prevents the process from starting.

outputs.name: killOwnedProcess
outputs.description: No return value. Sends SIGTERM to the owned target; termination errors, including an already-exited process, are ignored.

outputs.name: cliProcess
outputs.description: A promise for UTF-8 standard output when the process exits with code zero. Rejects for startup failures, cancellation, timeout, excessive output or nonzero exit. Nonzero-exit messages include up to the last 2,000 characters of standard error.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Rejects with RunCancelled when the supplied signal is already aborted or is aborted while the process runs. Active cancellation also sends termination to the owned process or process group.

declarations.title: Connect to Codex app-server
declarations.responsibility: Starts a Codex app-server connection, initializes it and exposes request and event operations.

inputs.name: codexRpc.command
inputs.description: The executable and arguments to start. By default starts Codex app-server over standard input and output with the OpenAI provider selected.

outputs.name: codexRpc
outputs.description: A promise for an initialized connection with send, request, subscribe and dispose operations. Requests use incrementing IDs and a default thirty-second timeout; subscriptions return an unsubscribe function. Disposing terminates the owned process and rejects pending requests.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Initialization failure rejects and disposes the connection. Process failure, closure or an oversized message rejects pending requests. Sending after closure fails. The message reader has a 96,000,000-byte limit.

declarations.title: Check Codex CLI availability
declarations.responsibility: Checks the Codex version, ChatGPT sign-in and available model and image-generation capabilities.

inputs.name: codexState.command
inputs.description: The Codex executable and initial arguments used for a version check with a ten-second timeout.

inputs.name: codexState.server
inputs.description: The app-server executable and arguments used to query the account, first model-list page and provider capabilities.

outputs.name: codexState
outputs.description: A promise for Codex availability, version, model choices and image-generation support. Requires a ChatGPT account; account reading does not request token refresh. Successful discovery reports the server’s model list and image-generation capability. Failure returns unavailable with a reason and no models; the connection is disposed.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The ChatGPT sign-in requirement can produce an Error internally, but discovery errors are caught and their message is returned as the unavailable reason.

declarations.title: Run one Codex request
declarations.responsibility: Runs one ephemeral Codex turn with the requested model, forwards public results and closes the connection afterward.

inputs.name: codexTurn.command
inputs.description: The executable and arguments for the Codex app-server connection.

inputs.name: codexTurn.turn
inputs.description: The requested model, effort, working directory, prompt, access mode, signal and callbacks, plus an optional local reference image. Write access requests danger-full-access; read-only access requests the read-only sandbox. The thread uses OpenAI, never asks for approval, enables image generation and is ephemeral.

outputs.name: codexTurn
outputs.description: A promise for completed public message text joined with newlines, the selected model and image-generation result items. Public text, image status and reported file changes are forwarded to callbacks. The connection is disposed after success or failure.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects a different model or provider, startup/request failures, a non-retrying server error, an unsuccessful terminal status or a turn taking more than fifteen minutes.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Rejects when already cancelled or when cancellation is observed during the turn. Attempts to interrupt an active turn before closing its connection.

declarations.title: Prepare conversation entries
declarations.responsibility: Converts shared comments, local pending drafts and newly submitted agent requests into display entries.

inputs.name: commentEntries.thread
inputs.description: The committed thread whose comments should be shown, including author names, timestamps and its design-image anchor.

inputs.name: threadInfo.thread
inputs.description: The committed thread to summarize as a numbered pin, with its image anchor and comments.

inputs.name: threadInfo.pin
inputs.description: The pin number to copy into the thread summary; this helper does not allocate or validate pin numbers.

inputs.name: pendingEntries.results
inputs.description: The shared or pending comment results to inspect. Only pending drafts are included.

inputs.name: pendingEntries.entityId
inputs.description: The exact entity identity whose pending drafts should be shown. This filter does not additionally compare project identity.

inputs.name: pendingEntries.threads
inputs.description: Thread summaries used to add a thread number to a pending draft when its thread identity is found.

inputs.name: requestEntry.runId
inputs.description: The run identity to use for the temporary displayed request entry.

inputs.name: requestEntry.request
inputs.description: The request text, mode, provider and model to display as a user message.

inputs.name: requestEntry.design
inputs.description: The associated design version, or undefined. Its version and first image hash are included when present.

outputs.name: commentEntries
outputs.description: User entries in comment order, retaining comment identity, time, author name, text and thread image anchor; agent mode, provider and model are null.

outputs.name: threadInfo
outputs.description: A thread summary with the supplied pin, the thread’s image anchor and the number of comments.

outputs.name: pendingEntries
outputs.description: Pending entries for the requested entity, in input order, labelled as remaining on this device and not shared. Each retains the local draft identity, saved time and backend reason, plus the thread number when known.

outputs.name: requestEntry
outputs.description: A temporary user entry with the run identity, current ISO timestamp, submitted text and agent choices, plus the optional design anchor. It does not save or send the request.

declarations.title: Choose composer actions
declarations.responsibility: Chooses the available comment and agent actions and defines visual-plan option counts.

inputs.name: visualCategory.category
inputs.description: The catalog category to classify. Pages, shells and components are visual categories.

inputs.name: composeModes.capabilities
inputs.description: The project capabilities. Comments and agents are the flags used here; planning and approval flags are not checked separately.

inputs.name: composeModes.writable
inputs.description: Whether the shown revision permits writing. Agent actions require this to be true.

outputs.name: designCounts
outputs.description: The selectable design-option counts, all whole numbers from 1 through 10.

outputs.name: defaultDesignCount
outputs.description: The default visual design-option count, 3.

outputs.name: visualCategory
outputs.description: True for pages, shells and components; false for other category strings.

outputs.name: composeModes
outputs.description: An ordered list beginning with comment when comments are allowed, followed by plan and change only when agents are allowed and the view is writable. Returns an empty list when none apply.

declarations.title: Remember the newly created thread
declarations.responsibility: Remembers a new entity’s thread for one selection in the same workspace and project.

inputs.name: rememberCreatedThread.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace whose current project identity should be attached to the remembered selection.

inputs.name: rememberCreatedThread.created
inputs.description: The created entity identity and thread identity, or null when there is no thread. A truthy thread identity is remembered; a null one makes no change.

inputs.name: createdThread.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace from which to consume the remembered selection, using its current project identity.

inputs.name: createdThread.entity
inputs.description: The displayed entity and its threads, used to find the remembered thread after matching project and entity.

outputs.name: rememberCreatedThread
outputs.description: No return value. Stores the entity, thread and current project in workspace-local memory without changing the URL.

outputs.name: createdThread
outputs.description: The matching thread, or null if none is remembered, the project or entity differs, or the thread is absent. The remembered selection is consumed even when no match is found.

declarations.title: Validate the design-option count
declarations.responsibility: Returns the requested design count and rejects explicit counts outside the Plan rules.

inputs.name: designCount.request
inputs.description: A Plan or Change request with an optional designOptions count. An explicit count is allowed only on Plan and must be an integer from 1 to 10.

outputs.name: defaultDesignOptions
outputs.description: The default count, 3.

outputs.name: designCount
outputs.description: The supplied valid count, or 3 when omitted. The omitted-count default is returned even for Change; this helper does not itself generate designs.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws if a Change explicitly supplies a count, or a Plan count is not a whole number from 1 to 10.

declarations.title: Choose design directions
declarations.responsibility: Returns distinct predefined directions for visual design options in their established order.

inputs.name: designDirections.count
inputs.description: The number of directions to take from the predefined list of ten. Callers normally supply a validated count from 1 to 10; this helper applies array slicing without validating it.

outputs.name: designDirections
outputs.description: A new list beginning with the most direct reading of the proposal, followed by the selected density, spacing, action-first, split-screen, cards, list, bold, calm and narrow-screen directions. Counts above ten return at most ten.

declarations.title: Describe the requested design
declarations.responsibility: Builds a product-design prompt with Harness styling and the selected thread’s visual context.

inputs.name: designPrompt.context
inputs.description: The entity title and requested thread identity. A matching thread supplies state, viewport and optional region; defaults are default state, desktop viewport and the whole image.

inputs.name: designPrompt.prompt
inputs.description: The proposal or feedback to append unchanged after the design instructions.

outputs.name: designPrompt
outputs.description: A prompt describing the navy-and-gold Harness interface, control placement, entity, state and viewport. When a reference image is attached by the caller, it asks for revisions focused on the thread’s region while preserving other design decisions. The helper generates text only.

declarations.title: Expose desktop project operations
declarations.responsibility: Connects desktop project, planning, evidence and agent operations to the selected project session.

inputs.name: desktopBridge.context
inputs.description: The project session, provider discovery, run service, folder chooser and optional session-liveness check. The folder chooser returns a directory or null for cancellation.

outputs.name: desktopBridge
outputs.description: A desktop operations object without the run-event subscription. Most operations assert any supplied project identity and track a pending request until completion; open, select and list operations are delegated separately. Planning writes are serialized per repository. Opening returns the selected project snapshot or null when cancelled.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Returned operations can reject stale project context and underlying service failures. Planning changes refuse a busy repository or ended client. Opening a thread refuses an unknown entity; source reading refuses a draft without registered source. Hosted connection refuses when sign-in is not configured.

declarations.title: Register desktop connection bootstrap
declarations.responsibility: Registers the single IPC operation that supplies a trusted renderer with its local socket connection details.

inputs.name: desktopIpc.port
inputs.description: The IPC handler registry, providing handle and removeHandler operations.

inputs.name: desktopIpc.bootstrap
inputs.description: A callback that checks the caller and returns its local connection bootstrap, or null for an untrusted caller. Trust checking is delegated to this callback.

outputs.name: bootstrapChannel
outputs.description: The IPC channel name transport:bootstrap.

outputs.name: desktopIpc
outputs.description: A cleanup function that removes the bootstrap handler. Project operations themselves use the socket supplied by the bootstrap.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The registered request rejects with Untrusted renderer when the bootstrap callback returns null. Callback and handler-registration failures can also propagate.

declarations.title: Describe an approved device’s permissions
declarations.responsibility: Builds the action permissions for a device allowed to read and comment on a computer’s project.

inputs.name: deviceCapabilities.agents
inputs.description: Whether the approved device is also allowed to use agents. This value controls agent, planning and approval actions together.

outputs.name: deviceCapabilities
outputs.description: Capabilities with comments enabled and local as the source. Agents, planning and approval equal the supplied flag. The reason explains read-and-comment-only access when false, or that comments remain pending on the computer until connected when true.

declarations.title: Read unit references in text
declarations.responsibility: Recognizes unit-reference markers while preserving all surrounding and malformed text.

inputs.name: isUnitId.value
inputs.description: The identity to check for lower-case dotted segments, each starting with a letter and otherwise containing letters, digits or hyphens, with at least two segments and at most 200 characters.

inputs.name: entityReferences.value
inputs.description: The text to divide into plain-text pieces and complete [[unit:identity]] markers. Invalid or unfinished markers remain ordinary text.

outputs.name: isUnitId
outputs.description: True when the identity matches the reference grammar; it does not check whether that unit is actually registered.

outputs.name: entityReferences
outputs.description: Ordered text and reference pieces whose text joins back to the original exactly. Reference pieces include the parsed identity and original marker. Empty input produces an empty list.

declarations.title: Explain unavailable evidence
declarations.responsibility: Provides the notice shown while recorded evidence is absent, loading or failed.

inputs.name: evidenceNotice.status
inputs.description: The evidence state: idle, planned, unavailable, loading, ready or failed.

inputs.name: evidenceNotice.error
inputs.description: The backend failure text, used only for a failed read.

inputs.name: evidenceNotice.kind
inputs.description: The entity kind inserted into the planned-but-not-implemented notice.

outputs.name: unavailableEvidence
outputs.description: The notice that recorded runtime evidence is unavailable on this connection.

outputs.name: readingEvidence
outputs.description: The notice that recorded evidence is being read.

outputs.name: evidenceNotice
outputs.description: Null for ready evidence. Otherwise a text notice with alert true only for failed reads. Planned and unavailable states have specific explanations; idle and loading use the reading notice.

declarations.title: Validate an evidence request
declarations.responsibility: Keeps and validates the allowed evidence-request fields, adding capture details only for artifact reads.

inputs.name: evidencePayload.channel
inputs.description: The channel name. Exactly evidence:artifact requires capture-binding fields; every other channel value uses only the evidence scope.

inputs.name: evidencePayload.x
inputs.description: The request object. Scope needs a valid entity identifier up to 120 characters, a 40-character lowercase hexadecimal commit, a nonblank branch up to 255 characters and current or commit mode. Artifact reads additionally require before or after, a 64-character lowercase hexadecimal record hash, scenario/state/evidence identifiers, nullable viewport, 64-character SHA-256 and nullable 40-character notes and evidence revisions. Identifier segments use lowercase letters or digits separated by dots or hyphens.

outputs.name: evidencePayload
outputs.description: A fresh object containing only validated scope fields and, for artifact reads, the capture binding. Extra fields, including project identity, paths and addresses, are omitted here. Invalid, missing, blank, oversized or wrongly formatted fields throw a validation error; nullable fields accept null, not omission.

declarations.title: Select evidence for the shown revision
declarations.responsibility: Builds the evidence request for an entity at the displayed revision, distinguishing a branch view from a specifically selected commit.

inputs.name: evidenceQuery.view
inputs.description: The displayed snapshot, whether the address pins a commit, and the optional project identity. Pinning remains true even when the selected commit happens to be the branch tip.

inputs.name: evidenceQuery.entityId
inputs.description: The entity identity to include unchanged in the request.

outputs.name: evidenceQuery
outputs.description: A request with the entity, displayed commit and branch, and project context; null when no snapshot revision is available. A pinned view uses commit mode, which asks for comparison with the first parent. An unpinned view uses current mode for the shown branch view.

declarations.title: Read and compare recorded results
declarations.responsibility: Reads result artifacts through their recorded bindings and delegates hash checks and behavior comparison to the reports explorer.

inputs.name: evidenceReading.bridge
inputs.description: The desktop connection’s optional artifact reader. Without it, requested artifacts remain unread.

inputs.name: evidenceReading.result
inputs.description: The evidence answer containing behavior rows and the captures listed on each side.

inputs.name: evidenceReading.scope
inputs.description: The entity, project and revision scope to carry into artifact requests. The caller must supply the scope corresponding to the evidence answer.

outputs.name: evidenceReading
outputs.description: A promise for the behavior after artifact reading and comparison, plus backend refusal messages keyed by capture hash. Captures are found on the after side first, then before. Refused or unavailable reads remain unread; damaged bytes do not become verified results. Unexpected comparison failures can still reject.

declarations.title: Explain an entity’s verification
declarations.responsibility: Shows the verification result for an entity at the displayed commit, keeping missing or unreadable evidence distinct from failed verification.

inputs.name: evidenceVerdict.read
inputs.description: The evidence read state, optional result and failure text. Idle and planned states use the catalog judgment; loading, unavailable and failed reads produce an unknown judgment with an explanation.

inputs.name: evidenceVerdict.entity
inputs.description: The entity identity and kind, plus its catalog verification status and note. The identity selects the unit within the evidence; the catalog status is used only before an evidence judgment is available.

inputs.name: evidenceVerdict.commit
inputs.description: The displayed commit to compare with the after side of the evidence. Evidence for another commit produces an unknown judgment.

outputs.name: evidenceVerdict
outputs.description: A status and readable reason. Idle or planned reads repeat the catalog status and note. Otherwise missing, unreadable, mismatched or unrecorded evidence is unknown. A matching side with the entity and a verification record uses the reports verdict: verified when it passes, failed otherwise, with its reasons.

declarations.title: Clear the disconnected computer’s view
declarations.responsibility: Clears the workspace’s remote project view and replaces a project address with the start address.

inputs.name: forgetRemote.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace to invalidate and clear, including project list, snapshot, entity, cached-view state, capabilities, selected project and pending target.

inputs.name: forgetRemote.notice
inputs.description: The error notice to show after clearing; defaults to an empty string.

outputs.name: forgetRemote
outputs.description: No return value. Invalidates pending work, empties the project list, clears displayed and selected content, disables change capabilities and sets the notice. If a browser address exists and is not the start address, replaces it with / without adding a history entry.

declarations.title: Read several Git file contents
declarations.responsibility: Reads the requested paths at one Git revision in a single batch operation.

inputs.name: gitBlobs.root
inputs.description: The repository directory passed to Git.

inputs.name: gitBlobs.request
inputs.description: The revision and paths to read. Empty paths return an empty map without starting Git. Paths containing newline, carriage return or a null character are refused.

outputs.name: gitBlobs
outputs.description: A promise for a map from each requested path to its returned byte buffer. Duplicate paths share one map key. The Git command permits at most 64,000,000 output bytes.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects unsupported paths, Git execution failures or a response with a missing header boundary or invalid size. Missing objects can produce an invalid-response error. Revision strings are passed through without separate validation.

declarations.title: Read repository content
declarations.responsibility: Reads Git output, resolves commit revisions and retrieves tracked file names or text.

inputs.name: gitRead.root
inputs.description: The repository directory for the Git command.

inputs.name: gitRead.args
inputs.description: The Git arguments to execute directly. Callers must choose read-only arguments when a read is intended; this helper does not restrict commands.

inputs.name: gitRevision.root
inputs.description: The repository whose revision should be resolved.

inputs.name: gitRevision.revision
inputs.description: The revision to resolve as a commit; defaults to HEAD. Must be nonempty, at most 300 characters and contain no null character.

inputs.name: gitFiles.root
inputs.description: The repository whose tracked files should be listed.

inputs.name: gitFiles.revision
inputs.description: The revision to resolve before listing files.

inputs.name: gitText.root
inputs.description: The repository containing the requested text.

inputs.name: gitText.revision
inputs.description: The revision to resolve before reading the file.

inputs.name: gitText.path
inputs.description: The repository-relative file path. Absolute slash-prefixed paths, parent-directory segments and null characters are refused.

outputs.name: gitRead
outputs.description: A promise for standard output with Git terminal prompting disabled and a 64,000,000-byte output buffer limit. Git execution failures reject.

outputs.name: gitRevision
outputs.description: A promise for the resolved commit hash with surrounding whitespace removed.

outputs.name: gitFiles
outputs.description: A promise for recursively listed tracked paths, split on null separators so spaces and newlines in names are preserved.

outputs.name: gitText
outputs.description: A promise for the file text at the resolved commit. Text exceeding 2,000,000 bytes is refused.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws or rejects invalid revisions, unsafe paths, oversized source text or Git execution failures.

declarations.title: Combine history pages
declarations.responsibility: Combines loaded history pages while keeping the first occurrence of each event.

inputs.name: historyPages.pages
inputs.description: The history pages supplied as separate arguments, in the order they were read.

outputs.name: historyPages
outputs.description: One list in page order, with duplicate event identities removed. The first event with each identity is retained; no timestamp sorting is performed.

declarations.title: Record observed host file operations
declarations.responsibility: Tracks reported file operations outside the project and records before and after hashes when available.

inputs.name: hostChanges.root
inputs.description: The project directory used to resolve relative reported paths and distinguish files inside the project.

outputs.name: hostChanges
outputs.description: An observer and an asynchronous record operation. The observer remembers each qualifying absolute path once and starts its first hash read. Recording reads the final hashes, keeps observed operations even when hashes match, and appends a dated record when any exist. Missing or unreadable files have null hashes.

declarations.title: Check a device-approval address
declarations.responsibility: Accepts a plain secure device-approval URL and rejects other addresses.

inputs.name: hostedAddress.value
inputs.description: The candidate URL, or undefined. It must use HTTPS, or HTTP on localhost, 127.0.0.1 or IPv6 loopback, and have a /native/ path followed by one identifier of 1–128 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

outputs.name: hostedAddress
outputs.description: The normalized URL when accepted, otherwise null. User information, query strings, fragments, other paths and invalid URLs are rejected. No request is sent.

declarations.title: Check hosted artifact bytes
declarations.responsibility: Checks a hosted capture’s supported media type, size and expected hash before returning it.

inputs.name: hostedArtifact.media
inputs.description: The received bytes and declared media type. Supported types are PNG, JPEG, WAV, MPEG audio, MP4 audio, Ogg, JSON and plain text; this helper lowercases the base type and discards parameters before checking.

inputs.name: hostedArtifact.sha256
inputs.description: The expected SHA-256 hash of the requested file.

outputs.name: hostedArtifact
outputs.description: A promise for the checked bytes, hash and serving type. Bytes must be at most 11 MiB, match the hash, and identify the declared base media type. Plain text is returned with UTF-8 charset.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects unsupported or mismatched media, a different hash or excessive size. Hash errors explain that the file differs from the requested recording; unsupported content receives the shared unsupported-kind message.

declarations.title: Check a hosted media declaration
declarations.responsibility: Accepts the small set of media declarations the app knows how to display.

inputs.name: hostedAttestation.stated
inputs.description: The declared media type. Accepts PNG, JPEG, WAV, MPEG, MP4, Ogg, JSON and plain text, case-insensitively. Surrounding whitespace is ignored. Only JSON and plain text may include charset=utf-8; other parameters and aliases are refused.

outputs.name: unshownHostedArtifact
outputs.description: The shared message for a hosted artifact type the app does not display.

outputs.name: hostedAttestation
outputs.description: An object with the normalized base media type and its category: screenshot, audio or output. This checks the declaration, not the bytes.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws for unsupported types, malformed declarations or parameters not permitted for that type.

declarations.title: Read shared-project permissions
declarations.responsibility: Converts a matching hosted project role into the actions allowed in the desktop view.

inputs.name: hostedCapabilities.value
inputs.description: The hosted project response object, including its project identity and role.

inputs.name: hostedCapabilities.projectId
inputs.description: The expected project identity; the response identity must match exactly.

outputs.name: hostedCapabilities
outputs.description: Shared-project capabilities with GitHub as source. Owners and commenters may comment; viewers may not. Agents, planning and approval are disabled, with an explanation that shared comments need server acknowledgment.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws for an invalid response object, a different project identity or a role other than owner, commenter or viewer.

declarations.title: Define hosted revision details
declarations.responsibility: Defines the accepted structure of a revision’s registry, comparisons, records and explanations.

outputs.name: hostedEvidenceDetail
outputs.description: A strict validation schema for a 40-character commit hash; registry availability, units, scenarios and graph; nullable comparison; optional source impact and side; verification records; explanations; and optional range-reason count. Uses the shared field limits and rejects undeclared keys. It defines structure only and performs no read by itself.

declarations.title: Define hosted evidence fields
declarations.responsibility: Defines reusable validation fields for hosted units, scenarios and captures.

outputs.name: hostedEvidenceFields
outputs.description: A collection of validation schemas and builders: general strings up to 1,000,000 characters, nonempty names up to 300, lowercase 40-character commit hashes and 64-character content hashes, arrays up to 5,000 items, finite numbers, booleans and accepted mode/status values. Includes strict capture, scenario and unit objects with their contracts, ownership, runtime and budget details. These schemas check structure, not proof of execution.

declarations.title: Build a hosted evidence URL
declarations.responsibility: Validates evidence-request fields and builds their ordered hosted API address.

inputs.name: hostedEvidencePath.input
inputs.description: The project and evidence scope; artifact operations also need the capture-binding fields at runtime. Project IDs are 1–128 characters, beginning with a letter or digit and continuing with letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens.

inputs.name: hostedEvidencePath.operation
inputs.description: Choose evidence for metadata or artifact for capture bytes.

outputs.name: hostedEvidencePath
outputs.description: A relative API URL for the encoded project and operation, with validated fields in a fixed query order. Null values are omitted and extra input fields are discarded. No network call is made.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws for an invalid project identity or missing or invalid evidence/artifact fields.

declarations.title: Define hosted verification records
declarations.responsibility: Defines the accepted structure of a hosted verification record and its recorded results.

outputs.name: hostedEvidenceRecord
outputs.description: A strict validation schema for record identity, passed/failed status, validity and problems; source commit and optional base; profile and timestamps; optional gate statuses; failures; tests; scenarios and captures; measurements; and budget findings. Test and scenario status values are constrained, numeric values must be finite, and shared list and text limits apply to the surrounding record fields. The schema does not establish that a record is truthful. Tests and inherited origin-test summaries may include optional browserErrors arrays validated by the shared browser-diagnostic schema.

declarations.title: Define a hosted evidence answer
declarations.responsibility: Defines the complete accepted structure of hosted evidence, including identity, viewing scope, captures and behavior comparisons.

outputs.name: hostedEvidenceSchema
outputs.description: A strict validation schema covering the read identity, revision scope, after side and nullable before side, scenario coverage and captures, and behavior rows and summary. Uses fixed status choices, 40-character commit hashes, 64-character content hashes, bounded lists and text, and fixed notes/evidence reference names. It rejects undeclared keys. Matching an answer to a particular request requires additional checks outside this schema.

declarations.title: Check a cached hosted image
declarations.responsibility: Decodes a cached image, checks its size and hash, and passes it to the image validator.

inputs.name: hostedImage.value
inputs.description: The cached image encoded as a base64 string. Other value types are refused.

inputs.name: hostedImage.sha256
inputs.description: The expected SHA-256 hash, compared with the decoded bytes.

outputs.name: hostedImage
outputs.description: Validated image bytes after base64 decoding and a matching hash, with decoded size at most 25,000,000 bytes. Image-format checks are delegated to the image validator.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws when the input is not text, decoded bytes exceed the limit or the hash differs. Image-validator failures also propagate.

declarations.title: Describe a hosted read failure
declarations.responsibility: Turns a failed hosted response into a bounded public error without repeating arbitrary server prose.

inputs.name: hostedPublicFailure.response
inputs.description: The HTTP response to inspect. At most 4,096 body bytes are read as JSON to look for a recognized public error code.

outputs.name: hostedPublicFailure
outputs.description: A promise for a HostedFailureValidator error object, marked denied for status 401 or 403 and failed otherwise. A recognized code is included in the message; malformed, oversized or unrecognized bodies fall back to the HTTP status. The error object is returned, not thrown here.

declarations.title: Read a bounded hosted response
declarations.responsibility: Reads response bytes while enforcing a maximum size even when Content-Length is missing.

inputs.name: hostedResponse.response
inputs.description: The HTTP response whose body should be consumed. A numeric Content-Length above the limit is refused before reading.

inputs.name: hostedResponse.limit
inputs.description: The maximum accepted byte count. Exactly that many bytes is allowed; the caller supplies the appropriate limit.

outputs.name: hostedResponse
outputs.description: A promise for all response bytes joined in order, or an empty array when no body exists. Cancels a read that fails or exceeds the limit and releases its reader lock.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects an oversized declared or actual body and propagates stream failures. The message names the byte limit during streaming.

declarations.title: Load a design image
declarations.responsibility: Reads a design image for the shown project and commit and provides a temporary browser URL that the caller can release.

inputs.name: imageUrl.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace supplying the image reader, current snapshot commit and optional project identity. No read is started if the reader connection or commit is absent.

inputs.name: imageUrl.request
inputs.description: The entity identity, design version and SHA-256 image identifier to send to the image reader, or null to request no image. This helper passes those identifiers through without validating them itself.

inputs.name: imageUrl.apply
inputs.description: Receives empty URL and error strings immediately. On success it receives a temporary URL with an empty error; on a failed read it receives an empty URL and the failure converted to text. Returned bytes are presented as a PNG image.

outputs.name: imageUrl
outputs.description: A cleanup function that suppresses later results and releases the temporary URL if one was created. Call it when the view is removed or its project, commit or image changes; it does not cancel the underlying read.

declarations.title: Check request fields
declarations.responsibility: Checks basic request objects, text, identifiers, choices and normalized image regions.

inputs.name: ipcFields.value
inputs.description: The value expected to be a non-null object other than an array.

inputs.name: textField.value
inputs.description: The value expected to be a nonblank string.

inputs.name: textField.max
inputs.description: The maximum text length; defaults to 300 characters.

inputs.name: textField.pattern
inputs.description: An optional regular expression the text must match.

inputs.name: nullableText.value
inputs.description: Either null or a nonblank string of at most 300 characters. Undefined is not accepted as null.

inputs.name: nullableText.pattern
inputs.description: An optional pattern for non-null text.

inputs.name: enumField.value
inputs.description: The value to select from an allowed list.

inputs.name: enumField.allowed
inputs.description: The exact values permitted for the selection.

inputs.name: regionField.value
inputs.description: Either null or an image rectangle with finite x, y, width and height fractions from 0 to 1. Width and height must be positive and the rectangle must stay inside the image, allowing a 0.000001 edge tolerance.

outputs.name: ipcFields
outputs.description: The original object, without filtering its keys or copying it.

outputs.name: textField
outputs.description: The original accepted string, without trimming it.

outputs.name: nullableText
outputs.description: Null for null input, otherwise the accepted string.

outputs.name: hashPattern
outputs.description: A pattern for exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

outputs.name: commitPattern
outputs.description: A pattern for exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

outputs.name: idPattern
outputs.description: A pattern for lowercase letter-or-digit segments separated by dots or hyphens.

outputs.name: versionPattern
outputs.description: A pattern for v followed by at least three decimal digits.

outputs.name: enumField
outputs.description: The supplied value when it exactly matches an allowed entry.

outputs.name: regionField
outputs.description: Null or a new rectangle containing only x, y, width and height.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws when an object, text field, identifier, allowed choice or image region fails its check.

declarations.title: Validate desktop operation requests
declarations.responsibility: Builds the allowed request shape for desktop operations and rejects invalid field values.

inputs.name: approvalPayload.value
inputs.description: An approval object with a version, up to 24 image hashes, contract hash and optional option o1 through o10. Hashes must be 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; version is v plus at least three digits, at most 20 characters.

inputs.name: threadPayload.x
inputs.description: Thread fields naming an entity and either a complete image anchor or null version, image hash, state and viewport. An unanchored thread must also have a null region. Optional design option is o1 through o10.

inputs.name: creationProject.value
inputs.description: The explicit project identity for a creation request: local- plus 64 hexadecimal characters, or a UUID-shaped identifier. Matching is case-insensitive.

inputs.name: creationPayload.x
inputs.description: A creation request with only intent, projectId, category, mode, provider, model, effort, text and optional designOptions. Requires create intent, plan mode, a catalog category and codex or claude provider.

inputs.name: runPayload.x
inputs.description: An existing-entity run request, or a creation request when intent is present. Existing runs need mode, approval or null, provider, model, effort or null, entity, thread and nonblank text up to 20,000 characters. Change needs approval and forbids a design-option count.

inputs.name: ipcPayload.channel
inputs.description: The operation name used to choose a payload shape. The caller is responsible for allowing known operations before this helper; unknown names can fall through to an entity-shaped payload.

inputs.name: ipcPayload.input
inputs.description: The untrusted operation input. Most operations require an object; project opening and provider listing ignore input and return null.

outputs.name: approvalPayload
outputs.description: A validated approval binding with version, hashes, contract hash and optional option. Unrecognized fields are omitted.

outputs.name: threadPayload
outputs.description: A validated thread request with only its entity, image-anchor values, region and optional option.

outputs.name: creationProject
outputs.description: The accepted project identity unchanged.

outputs.name: creationPayload
outputs.description: A validated creation request. Design count is omitted or a whole number from 1 to 10; effort is null or text. Unknown keys are refused.

outputs.name: runPayload
outputs.description: A validated run or creation request. Extra keys on an existing-entity run are omitted. Plan may omit its count; any supplied count must be 1–10.

outputs.name: ipcPayload
outputs.description: The validated operation-specific payload, retaining only selected fields. History pages must be integers 1–10,000; revision and image identifiers follow the shared patterns. No operation is executed.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws for invalid or missing fields, incomplete image anchors, a Change without approval or with design options, invalid creation identity or keys, invalid history pages, and shared field-validation failures.

declarations.title: Load the selected workspace
declarations.responsibility: Loads the project snapshot and optional entity named by a workspace address, determines available actions, and makes cached views read-only.

inputs.name: loadWorkspace.bridge
inputs.description: The desktop connection used to select a project, read its snapshot and optional entity, and obtain its allowed actions. Project selection is skipped when the connection does not offer it.

inputs.name: loadWorkspace.route
inputs.description: The parsed address naming the optional project, branch, commit and entity. A newly selected snapshot is reused only when no commit is pinned and its branch matches any requested branch; otherwise a separate snapshot is requested.

inputs.name: loadWorkspace.selection
inputs.description: A mutable record of the last selected project identity, or null when unknown. Switching clears it before selection, so a failed selection leaves it null. Successful selection and a returned snapshot identity update it.

outputs.name: loadWorkspace
outputs.description: A promise containing the snapshot, entity or null, allowed actions, and cached-view information or null. Entity reads use the returned snapshot commit and project identity. A cached snapshot is returned with writing disabled and all change actions disabled, even if its saved capabilities allowed them.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The promise rejects if the snapshot names a different project from the one requested. Project-selection, snapshot and entity-read failures also propagate. Failure to read capabilities instead yields disabled actions and a reason.

declarations.title: Open a local project
declarations.responsibility: Asks the desktop connection to open a project folder, navigates to its branch’s pages, and refreshes the available-project list.

inputs.name: openProject.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace to update, including its desktop connection, selected-project record, navigation and project-list operations. Without a connection this does nothing. With one, it marks the workspace busy and clears the previous error before opening.

outputs.name: openProject
outputs.description: A promise that finishes without a return value. A chosen project updates the selection, navigates to its pages at the returned branch, then refreshes the project list. Cancelling the picker skips those steps. Caught failures are stored as text in workspace.error, and the busy flag is cleared when the attempt finishes.

declarations.title: pairingInput
declarations.responsibility: Owns the pairingInput shared function.

retired.reason: The phone has no typed link or code any more: it scans, and scanNotice holds what a scan can say.

declarations.title: Save a proposed design version
declarations.responsibility: Generates visual design options or keeps behavior notes, then saves one version for review.

inputs.name: planDesign.context
inputs.description: The prepared Plan context, including entity, selected thread, project revision, request, image model and generator, planning connection, cancellation signal and progress callback.

inputs.name: planDesign.prompt
inputs.description: The proposal text. Visual categories use it to build image instructions; functions, configs and services retain it as notes without generating images.

outputs.name: planDesign
outputs.description: A promise for a saved-version message. Pages, shells and components generate the requested 1–10 options, three by default, sequentially before saving one version. A single option is saved as one image. A version and thread notice are then saved and emitted for review; temporary generation files are removed after the main attempt.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Rejects when cancellation is observed after a generation or before saving. Generated options are not saved if generation fails or is cancelled before the save step.

declarations.title: Convert stored planning details
declarations.responsibility: Converts stored plan contracts, approvals, threads and messages into desktop display records.

inputs.name: planningConvert.plan
inputs.description: The stored plan with its contract fields and contract hash.

inputs.name: approvalInfo.record
inputs.description: The stored approval, including image records, version, contract hash, reviewer timestamp, current flag and optional design option.

inputs.name: threadInfo.thread
inputs.description: The stored thread with its pin, optional image anchor and messages.

inputs.name: messageInfo.message
inputs.description: The stored message, its author, text, mode, optional agent metadata and artifact references.

outputs.name: planningConvert
outputs.description: An entity contract retaining inputs, outputs and hash, and converting each error name into a field of type error.

outputs.name: approvalInfo
outputs.description: An approval summary with image hashes, version, contract hash, timestamp, current status and optional option.

outputs.name: threadInfo
outputs.description: A thread summary with its anchor and message count. Missing anchors become null image fields.

outputs.name: messageInfo
outputs.description: A display message whose person author becomes user and other authors become agent. Version comes from the first image reference, then notes, then a Change target; image hash comes from the first image reference. Missing agent details become null.

declarations.title: Append a planning conversation message
declarations.responsibility: Saves a planning message with the design artifact or approved Change target it actually refers to.

inputs.name: planningMessage.context
inputs.description: The project planning API and repository context used to read the current plan and append the message.

inputs.name: planningMessage.draft
inputs.description: The message’s entity, thread, author, text, mode, provider/model and optional version, image hash and Change outcome. Null mode defaults to plan. User messages use Local reviewer; other authors use the provider name or Harness.

outputs.name: planningMessage
outputs.description: A promise for the saved display message. A matching image becomes an image reference; a notes-only function, service or config version can become a notes reference. Otherwise no artifact reference is added. Change messages retain the current approval target and default to requested status.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects a Change message without a current plan approval or whose version differs from that approval. Planning read/write errors also propagate.

declarations.title: Read planning records at a revision
declarations.responsibility: Reads stored plans and converts their versions, messages, images and history for the desktop.

inputs.name: planningReads.context
inputs.description: The repository directory and planning API used to load the plan snapshot.

inputs.name: planningReads.revision
inputs.description: The revision whose complete planning snapshot is requested.

inputs.name: planRecord.context
inputs.description: The repository and API used while converting one plan.

inputs.name: planRecord.plan
inputs.description: The stored plan to convert, including its versions, contract, threads and lifecycle.

inputs.name: planRecord.revision
inputs.description: The revision from which to read that plan’s prompt and notes files.

inputs.name: planVersion.context
inputs.description: The repository and API used to read one design version’s text.

inputs.name: planVersion.data
inputs.type: { version: StoredVersion; plan: PlanDetail; revision: string }
inputs.description: The stored version, containing plan and revision; the plan supplies approvals and the version supplies image and option metadata.

inputs.name: readPlanMessages.context
inputs.description: The planning context used to read messages.

inputs.name: readPlanMessages.data
inputs.type: { entityId: string; threadId: string; revision: string }
inputs.description: The entity, thread and revision whose messages are requested.

inputs.name: readPlanImage.context
inputs.description: The planning context used to read an image.

inputs.name: readPlanImage.query
inputs.description: The entity, version, image hash and revision, plus an optional design option. The image must appear in that entity/version.

inputs.name: readPlanHistory.context
inputs.description: The planning context used to read history.

inputs.name: readPlanHistory.entityId
inputs.description: The entity whose planning history is requested.

inputs.name: readPlanHistory.revision
inputs.description: The revision limiting that history.

outputs.name: planningReads
outputs.description: A promise for converted plan records. Any rejected plan in the snapshot causes the whole read to reject with its reported path and reason.

outputs.name: planRecord
outputs.description: A promise for a desktop plan record with plural category, contract, converted versions and threads.

outputs.name: planVersion
outputs.description: A promise for a design version with prompt and optional notes read at the requested revision, image and option metadata, the last approval for that version, and any exact image-revision binding.

outputs.name: readPlanMessages
outputs.description: A promise for the selected thread’s messages converted to display records.

outputs.name: readPlanImage
outputs.description: A promise for the stored image bytes after the planning API read; the optional design option is passed through.

outputs.name: readPlanHistory
outputs.description: A promise for commit history entries with event-kind summaries and null design-version fields.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects corrupt plan snapshots, missing threads, images absent from the requested entity/version, and underlying planning or Git read failures.

declarations.title: Write plans, designs and approvals
declarations.responsibility: Adapts desktop planning requests into stored plans, design versions, image threads and approvals.

inputs.name: planningWrites.context
inputs.description: The repository and planning API used to create a plan.

inputs.name: planningWrites.draft
inputs.description: The category, title, goal and optional proposed contract. The title must yield a nonempty lowercase letters-and-digits slug, limited to 64 characters.

inputs.name: ensurePlan.context
inputs.description: The repository and planning API used to find or create a unit’s plan.

inputs.name: ensurePlan.unit
inputs.description: The existing unit definition whose identity, kind, title, responsibility and contract seed a plan when none exists. shared-function maps to function.

inputs.name: addPlanDesign.context
inputs.description: The repository and planning API used to add a design.

inputs.name: addPlanDesign.draft
inputs.description: The design proposal, generator, base revision, expected latest version, optional image or separate options, notes and optional revised-image binding. Missing expectedLatest defaults to the current plan’s latest version.

inputs.name: openPlanThread.context
inputs.description: The planning context used to open a thread.

inputs.name: openPlanThread.draft
inputs.description: The entity and optional image anchor, including version, hash, state, viewport, region and option. An anchored image must belong to that entity/version and have the supplied state and viewport.

inputs.name: approvePlanDesign.context
inputs.description: The planning context used to approve a design.

inputs.name: approvePlanDesign.draft
inputs.description: The entity, design version, selected image hashes, contract hash and optional design option. Images must match the requested version or selected option.

outputs.name: reviewer
outputs.description: The local author identity: a person named Local reviewer.

outputs.name: planningWrites
outputs.description: A promise for the created plan record. New contracts use default state and desktop viewport for visual categories, diagram for others; missing proposed input/output/error lists become empty.

outputs.name: ensurePlan
outputs.description: A promise for the existing plan, or a new plan seeded from the unit. New plans preserve input/output fields but take only error names.

outputs.name: addPlanDesign
outputs.description: A promise for the added design version. Images are packaged as one image per option or a single image; the stored revised image is used to determine its option when found.

outputs.name: openPlanThread
outputs.description: A promise for the newly opened thread converted to its desktop summary.

outputs.name: approvePlanDesign
outputs.description: A promise for the saved approval summary, binding the selected images, contract hash and any design notes hash.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects titles that produce no slug, invalid image anchors or state/viewport mismatches, unknown design versions, mismatched approval images and failures from the planning API or follow-up reads.

declarations.title: Prepare a new-unit Plan
declarations.responsibility: Checks a creation request’s selected project and runner before returning a context for proposing a new unit.

inputs.name: prepareProjectRun.preparation
inputs.description: The project session, provider discovery, image generator and event callback.

inputs.name: prepareProjectRun.request
inputs.description: A creation request with create intent, plan mode, explicit project identity and chosen provider, model and effort.

inputs.name: prepareProjectRun.controller
inputs.description: The cancellation controller whose signal will govern the run.

outputs.name: prepareProjectRun
outputs.description: A promise for a fresh run identity, selected mutable project and revision, planning access, exact chosen runner and cancellation signal. No entity or design is created by this helper.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects a non-Plan creation request, invalid or unselected project, non-writable project, unavailable provider/model/effort or underlying preparation failure.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Rejects when the controller is already aborted after project and provider preparation, before returning the context.

declarations.title: Prepare an entity’s agent run
declarations.responsibility: Checks the writable project, chosen runner, thread and approval, then records the user request before a run starts.

inputs.name: imageModel.preparation
