inputs.description: The preparation services used to discover an image-capable Codex provider.

inputs.name: imageModel.request
inputs.description: The requested mode; only a Plan can require an image model.

inputs.name: imageModel.category
inputs.description: The entity category. Pages, shells and components require image orchestration for Plan.

inputs.name: prepareRun.preparation
inputs.description: The session, provider discovery, generator and event callback used for preparation.

inputs.name: prepareRun.request
inputs.description: The entity request with thread, mode, provider, model, effort, text and optional approval.

inputs.name: prepareRun.controller
inputs.description: The cancellation controller whose signal is passed into the prepared run.

inputs.name: messageFor.context
inputs.description: The request whose entity, thread, mode, provider, model and approval anchor should be copied into a message.

inputs.name: messageFor.author
inputs.description: Whether the message is written by the user or agent.

inputs.name: messageFor.text
inputs.description: The exact text to put in the message.

inputs.name: recordRunFailure.context
inputs.description: The failed run’s request, planning/session access, revision, cancellation signal and optional failureRecorded flag.

inputs.name: recordRunFailure.error
inputs.description: The error to report; Error messages are kept up to 200 characters, with a generic message for other values.

outputs.name: imageModel
outputs.description: A promise for the default listed Codex image-orchestration model for a visual Plan; an empty string for other cases.

outputs.name: prepareRun
outputs.description: A promise for the prepared run context with a new identity. Checks thread membership and Change approval, selects image support if needed, checks cancellation, then appends the user request. It does not launch the runner.

outputs.name: messageFor
outputs.description: A message draft retaining request metadata and the approved version and first approved image hash when present; absent approval produces null anchors.

outputs.name: recordRunFailure
outputs.description: A promise completing after an agent failure message is appended, or immediately if failureRecorded is true. Change failures include failed or cancelled status and up to 600 characters of error detail.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects invalid project mutability, unavailable runner/model/effort, missing thread, invalid Change approval, absent required image capability/default model, and planning or branch failures.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Rejects if cancellation is observed after preparing the context and before appending the request.

declarations.title: Find the image a design replaced
declarations.responsibility: Finds a supported before-image for a design shown at the commit that introduced it.

inputs.name: priorImage.versions
inputs.description: The design versions in historical order.

inputs.name: priorImage.shown
inputs.description: The displayed version identity and optional selected image.

inputs.name: priorImage.commit
inputs.description: The selected commit, or null for a branch view.

outputs.name: priorImage
outputs.description: The prior version and image hash, or null without a selected image or matching introducing commit. Uses an explicit revised-image binding first. Without one, versions with design options are not paired; a single design falls back to the preceding version’s image with the same state and viewport.

declarations.title: Determine allowed project actions
declarations.responsibility: Determines which actions the shown project allows, using reported capabilities and requiring an available operation before enabling comments.

inputs.name: projectCapabilities.bridge
inputs.description: The desktop connection. Its optional capabilities reader is used when the snapshot does not state capabilities, and its addComment operation must exist before comments can be enabled.

inputs.name: projectCapabilities.snapshot
inputs.description: The shown project snapshot, including optional capabilities and project identity. Capabilities stated in the snapshot take precedence over a separate read.

outputs.name: closedCapabilities
outputs.description: The default read-only capabilities: comments, agents, planning and approval all disabled, with local as the source.

outputs.name: projectCapabilities
outputs.description: A promise for the available actions and their source, with an optional reason. Uses snapshot capabilities first, otherwise asks the connection for this project. If that read fails, disables all actions and explains that the project did not report its permissions. For an older connection without a capabilities reader, agents, planning and approval stay enabled and comments stay disabled. Reported comments are enabled only when addComment is a function.

declarations.title: Keep the current project in the list
declarations.responsibility: Reads the connection’s project list and ensures the currently shown project appears in the project switcher.

inputs.name: listedProjects.bridge
inputs.description: The desktop connection, optionally offering a project-list operation. An older connection without that operation is accepted.

inputs.name: projectList.projects
inputs.description: The projects already listed, in display order. Existing entries are kept as supplied, including their names and any duplicates.

inputs.name: projectList.snapshot
inputs.description: The shown project snapshot, or null when no project is shown. Its identity is used to avoid appending it again; an absent identity is represented by an empty string.

outputs.name: listedProjects
outputs.description: A promise for the connection’s listed projects, or an empty list when the operation is absent. A failure from the listing operation is passed back as a rejected promise.

outputs.name: projectList
outputs.description: The original list when there is no snapshot or its project identity is already present. Otherwise a new list appends the shown project with its name and identity. A GitHub-backed snapshot is marked shared; all other snapshots are marked local.

declarations.title: Read a new-unit proposal
declarations.responsibility: Validates a bounded agent proposal and builds the instructions used to request one.

inputs.name: projectProposal.answer
inputs.description: The agent response: one JSON object, optionally enclosed in one JSON Markdown fence. Trimmed response length is at most 20,000 characters. It must contain category, title, goal, proposal and contract only.

inputs.name: proposalPrompt.request
inputs.description: The requested catalog category and text. The category is presented as a hint, not forced as the proposal’s final category.

inputs.name: proposalPrompt.known
inputs.description: Known unit identities to include as allowed references; defaults to an empty list.

outputs.name: projectProposal
outputs.description: A proposal in one of the six catalog categories, with trimmed title, goal and notes. Title is at most 160 characters and cannot look like a path; goal is at most 600 and notes at most 6,000 with no code fences. Contract inputs, outputs and errors are required lists of at most 24 items. Field names/types and error strings are nonblank and at most 160 characters; duplicate errors are refused. Invalid answers throw before any write.

outputs.name: proposalPrompt
outputs.description: A prompt requesting exactly that proposal shape, allowing registry/contracts reading, forbidding writes and other units’ implementation reads, and appending the request and allowed references. It generates instructions only.

declarations.title: Discard one cached scope
declarations.responsibility: Attempts to remove a cached lookup and the projection it names.

inputs.name: projectionCacheDiscard.directory
inputs.description: The directory containing the cached lookup and projection files.

inputs.name: projectionCacheDiscard.scope
inputs.description: The exact scope string whose hash selects the lookup.

outputs.name: projectionCacheDiscard
outputs.description: A promise completing after attempts to remove the lookup and, when its identity can be read, its named projection. Missing, unreadable or malformed lookup files and unlink failures are swallowed; completion does not prove every file was removed.

declarations.title: Purge cached project access
declarations.responsibility: Removes recognized cache files belonging to a principal and optionally one project, including unusable entries.

inputs.name: projectionCachePurge.directory
inputs.description: The directory to scan for lookup and projection JSON cache files with 64-character hexadecimal names.

inputs.name: projectionCachePurge.principalId
inputs.description: The principal identity whose cache entries should be removed.

inputs.name: projectionCachePurge.projectId
inputs.description: Optional project identity. If omitted or empty, all matching-principal projects are selected; otherwise that project and the shared project-list entry are selected.

outputs.name: projectionCachePurge
outputs.description: A promise completing after matching files are removed. Recognized files with missing or unparseable identity are also removed, regardless of principal. A directory-listing failure is treated as no entries; unlink failures propagate.

declarations.title: Order units for a proposal
declarations.responsibility: Prioritizes existing unit references for a new-unit proposal prompt.

inputs.name: proposalUnits.listed
inputs.description: The catalog entries available to the proposal. Planned-only entries are excluded.

inputs.name: proposalUnits.request
inputs.description: The request text and category hint. Recognized registered identities mentioned in the text receive priority.

outputs.name: proposalUnits
outputs.description: Distinct existing unit identities, ordered first by mentions in the request, then by the requested category, then the remaining catalog categories. Each category otherwise keeps input order. No maximum list length is imposed here.

declarations.title: Prepare and check model choices
declarations.responsibility: Converts listed provider models for display and checks the requested model and effort.

inputs.name: providerModels.models
inputs.description: The provider’s models with identifiers, display names, hidden flags, effort choices, default effort and default-model flag.

inputs.name: validateModel.models
inputs.description: The model choices available for selection.

inputs.name: validateModel.model
inputs.description: The exact model identity requested.

inputs.name: validateModel.effort
inputs.description: The optional effort to check. Null or an empty string skips effort validation.

outputs.name: providerModels
outputs.description: Visible models in input order, with identifiers and effort values retained and hidden models removed.

outputs.name: validateModel
outputs.description: No return value when the model exists and any nonempty requested effort is supported. No default model or effort is substituted.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws when the requested model is absent or its requested effort is unsupported.

declarations.title: Extract public assistant text
declarations.responsibility: Extracts text parts from assistant events while ignoring other event content.

inputs.name: publicCliEvents.value
inputs.description: The candidate CLI event. It must be an assistant event with a message object and content array to yield text.

outputs.name: publicCliEvents
outputs.description: An ordered list of string text parts whose type is text. Non-assistant events, malformed structures, reasoning parts and tool bodies produce no text entries.

declarations.title: Build a bounded QR symbol
declarations.responsibility: Encodes short printable ASCII text as QR modules and a drawing path.

inputs.name: qrSymbol.text
inputs.description: Nonempty text of at most 320 characters using printable ASCII from ! through ~; spaces, control characters and non-ASCII text are refused.

outputs.name: qrLimits
outputs.description: Limits of 320 input bytes, four quiet modules around the symbol, at most 77 modules per side and error-correction level M.

outputs.name: qrSymbol
outputs.description: The module count per side, quiet-margin size and SVG-style path of dark horizontal runs offset by the margin. The caller draws the symbol; no image file is written.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws when text fails the allowed character/length checks or the generated symbol exceeds 77 modules. QR-library failures can also propagate.

declarations.title: Build an entity’s evidence answer
declarations.responsibility: Builds the entity-specific evidence and behavior answer and refuses a response too large for transport.

inputs.name: recordedAnswer.input
inputs.description: The history scope naming the entity, the identity of the read, and already-read and validated current/parent revision details. This helper assumes those inputs belong together.

outputs.name: recordedAnswer
outputs.description: The supplied scope and identity with projected evidence for the named entity and behavior derived from the original evidence. Current mode yields no before comparison. The answer is serialized for size checking and is never truncated to fit.

errors.name: answer-too-large
errors.description: Throws when the serialized answer exceeds the transport message limit minus 1,024 bytes reserved for its wrapper, approximately 16 MiB.

declarations.title: Find a precisely bound capture
declarations.responsibility: Finds a listed capture by its complete evidence binding and identifies the record holding its bytes.

inputs.name: recordedCapture.evidence
inputs.description: The entity’s before/after evidence, already read at the intended revisions.

inputs.name: recordedCapture.binding
inputs.description: The requested side, judging-record identity, scenario, state, evidence identifier, nullable viewport and SHA-256 hash. Every field must match the selected evidence.

outputs.name: recordedCapture
outputs.description: The listed capture and its scenario’s origin-record identity. Inherited captures therefore point to the record that originally stored them. The helper selects a record; it does not read or hash bytes.

errors.name: capture-unlisted
errors.description: Throws when the chosen side or judging record is absent, no capture matches the entire binding, or that record has no matching scenario.

declarations.title: Load a recorded screenshot
declarations.responsibility: Loads the selected runtime screenshot for the shown project and commit, reports its loading state, and releases the image when the view is finished.

inputs.name: workspace
inputs.description: The shown project snapshot, project context, pinned-commit setting and evidence connection. Without a snapshot or evidence reader, the preview reports that recorded screenshots cannot be read.

inputs.name: entityId
inputs.description: The exact entity whose runtime screenshot is requested. The evidence answer must identify this entity and the shown commit, and must match the project when the request names one.

inputs.name: thumbnail
inputs.description: A recorded-thumbnail selection. Supply scenario, state and viewport together, or leave all three absent. A partial selection is an error. When absent, the function looks for a recorded scenario state that explicitly names the entity and is required, preferring its desktop screenshot viewport when available.

inputs.name: apply
inputs.description: Receives loading immediately, then ready with an image URL and caption, missing with a reason, or error with a reason. Only a usable stored screenshot matching the selected scenario, state and viewport can become ready. The caption names the state and original tested commit, including whether the image was inherited. Read failures, mismatched identity, damaged bytes and media other than PNG or JPEG report error.

outputs.name: stop
outputs.description: A cleanup function to call when the preview is replaced or removed. It ignores late results and releases any image URL already created; it does not cancel the underlying request.

declarations.title: Keep an entity’s evidence detail
declarations.responsibility: Reduces revision and record details to what belongs to one entity while preserving its evidence sides.

inputs.name: recordedProjection.evidence
inputs.description: The entity-scoped evidence whose coverage determines which scenario states to retain.

inputs.name: recordedProjection.entityId
inputs.description: The exact unit identity to retain in registry details, reasons, failures, measurements, budgets and change summaries.

outputs.name: recordedProjection
outputs.description: A new evidence object with each detailed side reduced to the entity and its covered scenario states. Keeps all tests, existing captures and coverage, and the corresponding judging record; removes unrelated units, graph edges, changed-file lists and uncertainty lists. A side without detail is retained unchanged. The supplied evidence is not mutated.

declarations.title: Recorded evidence scope
declarations.responsibility: Build the selected entity and revision scope from recorded facts, refusing a stale current view or an unregistered entity.

inputs.name: recordedTip.query
inputs.description: Entity ID, branch, commit and current-or-commit viewing mode to check.

inputs.name: recordedTip.tip
inputs.description: Actual tip commit of the selected branch.

inputs.name: recordedScope.query
inputs.description: Entity ID, branch, commit and viewing mode to describe.

inputs.name: recordedScope.facts
inputs.description: Branch tip, registered kind, commit metadata, judged evidence and legacy record IDs.

outputs.name: recordedTip
outputs.description: Returns nothing when the requested current commit is still the branch tip; otherwise throws.

outputs.name: recordedScope
outputs.description: Scope containing the selected location, tip comparison, first parent or null and supplied evidence summary.

errors.name: stale-tip
errors.description: The current-mode commit no longer equals the supplied branch tip.

errors.name: entity-unregistered
errors.description: The supplied entity kind is absent or has no supported explorer category.

declarations.title: Unit reference instructions
declarations.responsibility: Build agent instructions for referencing a bounded list of unit IDs.

inputs.name: referencePrompt.ids
inputs.description: Candidate IDs; invalid grammar and duplicates are removed, preserving the first occurrence, up to 120 IDs.

outputs.name: referencePrompt
outputs.description: Instructions to use registered unit references, followed by the accepted IDs or none.

declarations.title: Read a relay message
declarations.responsibility: Parse a relay message and check its recognized message shape.

inputs.name: relayFrame.text
inputs.description: JSON text; text longer than the configured frame allowance plus 4096 characters is refused.

outputs.name: relayFrame
outputs.description: The parsed ready, device-open, device-close, packet, pairing-request, device-revoked or ack frame; null for invalid JSON or failed checks.

declarations.title: Read a remote evidence file
declarations.responsibility: Accept supported remote evidence bytes only when their stated size and hash match the requested file.

inputs.name: remoteArtifact.value
inputs.description: Base64 content with media type, byte length and SHA-256 hash.

inputs.name: remoteArtifact.asked
inputs.description: Required hash of the requested file; undefined is refused.

outputs.name: artifactLimit
outputs.description: Maximum accepted file size: 11 MiB.

outputs.name: artifactMediaTypes
outputs.description: Exact allowed media types for PNG, JPEG, WAV, MPEG audio, MP4 audio, Ogg audio, JSON and UTF-8 plain text.

outputs.name: unshownArtifact
outputs.description: Message explaining that this kind of file cannot be shown.

outputs.name: largeArtifact
outputs.description: Message explaining that the file exceeds the size limit.

outputs.name: otherArtifact
outputs.description: Message explaining that the response is not the requested file.

outputs.name: remoteArtifact
outputs.description: Decoded bytes with their media type and verified SHA-256 hash.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects unsupported types, oversized files, absent or mismatched requested hashes, unreadable base64 or mismatched decoded length or hash.

declarations.title: Compare remote access
declarations.responsibility: Identify the connected computer, phone and grant so views can react to access changes.

inputs.name: remoteAuthority.status
inputs.description: Remote status containing optional host, device and access grant.

inputs.name: authorityChange.known
inputs.description: Previously remembered holder and serialized grant.

inputs.name: authorityChange.next
inputs.description: New holder and serialized grant.

inputs.name: authorityChange.steady
inputs.description: Whether the connection remained steady between these observations.

inputs.name: excludes.status
inputs.description: Status whose project grant is checked.

inputs.name: excludes.projectId
inputs.description: Project ID to check, or null for no selected project.

outputs.name: noAuthority
outputs.description: Initial authority with no holder and an empty grant.

outputs.name: remoteAuthority
outputs.description: Combined host/device identity and JSON serialization of the grant.

outputs.name: authorityChange
outputs.description: none for identical steady access; holder for a changed known holder; grant otherwise, including reconnection.

outputs.name: excludes
outputs.description: True when a non-null project is absent from the grant; false when no project is selected.

declarations.title: Decode remote bytes
declarations.responsibility: Decode base64 and verify its declared byte length and SHA-256 hash.

inputs.name: remoteBinary.value
inputs.description: Base64 data with encoding, declared byte length and SHA-256 hash.

outputs.name: unreadableMedia
outputs.description: Message for unsupported encoding or unreadable base64.

outputs.name: damagedMedia
outputs.description: Message for content that does not match its declared length or hash.

outputs.name: remoteBinary
outputs.description: Decoded bytes after length and hash verification.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects unreadable content or a length/hash mismatch; underlying digest failures can also propagate.

declarations.title: Remote failure wording
declarations.responsibility: Convert failures to remote error codes and messages, suppressing unsafe ordinary error text.

inputs.name: remoteFailureText.error
inputs.description: Failure to describe; declared RemoteFailure values retain their code and message.

inputs.name: remoteFailureText.roots
inputs.description: Project roots to hide when inspecting ordinary errors; defaults to an empty list, with the home directory also considered.

outputs.name: remoteFailureText
outputs.description: Declared remote failure unchanged, or code failed with an ordinary message only when short, nonempty and free of detected paths; otherwise generic failure wording.

declarations.title: Available remote methods
declarations.responsibility: Determine which remote methods a paired phone may offer from its current status.

inputs.name: remoteGrant.status
inputs.description: Native status or null; a grant and connecting, online or offline state are required.

outputs.name: remoteGrant
outputs.description: Set of allowed attached methods, or grant-derived read/comment methods and optional agent methods when no explicit list exists; otherwise an empty set.

declarations.title: Create and register a remote host
declarations.responsibility: Create a disabled host identity or register an existing identity and enable its relay connection.

inputs.name: registerRemoteHost.state
inputs.description: Existing host state; successful registration updates enabled, origin and generation in this object.

inputs.name: registerRemoteHost.name
inputs.description: Computer name sent with the registration.

inputs.name: registerRemoteHost.register
inputs.description: Callback receiving host ID, public key, credential hash and name and returning registration details.

outputs.name: remoteHostIdentity
outputs.description: New disabled state with generated keys, host ID and credential, no origin, generation zero and empty device/revocation lists.

outputs.name: registerRemoteHost
outputs.description: Imported key pair after accepting a matching host ID and valid relay origin.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects invalid relay registration; key generation/import and registration failures also propagate.

declarations.title: Public phone-access status
declarations.responsibility: Build displayable computer status from persisted state and live relay and pairing activity.

inputs.name: remoteHostStatus.input
inputs.description: Support flag, persisted state, runtime, phase, reason, display name and available project IDs/names.

outputs.name: remoteHostStatus
outputs.description: Public status with enabled state, connection phase, host, pairing offer and requests, approved device summaries and projects; private keys and credentials are omitted.

declarations.title: Phone-access wording
declarations.responsibility: Format connection, identity, permission and lock-state wording for phone access.

inputs.name: relayName.origin
inputs.description: Relay origin to display; invalid URLs produce an empty label.

inputs.name: timeLeft.milliseconds
inputs.description: Remaining milliseconds; rounded up to seconds and clamped at zero.

inputs.name: keyLabel.deviceId
inputs.description: Device ID whose first 12 characters are grouped in fours.

inputs.name: identityLabel.deviceId
inputs.description: Full device ID to group in fours.

inputs.name: grantLabel.grant
inputs.description: Grant whose agents flag determines permission wording.

inputs.name: grantSummary.grant
inputs.description: Grant containing project list and agents flag.

inputs.name: hostLine.status
inputs.description: Host status used for relay and connection-state wording.

inputs.name: hostSummary.status
inputs.description: Host status used for enabled state and approved-phone count.

inputs.name: remoteLabels.status
inputs.description: Mobile connection status used for heading and supporting text.

outputs.name: lockNote
outputs.description: Explanation that approved phones work while the computer is locked and awake, but not asleep.

outputs.name: awakeNote
outputs.description: Wording for an awake computer.

outputs.name: lockedNote
outputs.description: Wording for a locked, awake computer.

outputs.name: unlockedNote
outputs.description: Wording for an unlocked, awake computer.

outputs.name: approveNote
outputs.description: Instruction to approve the phone on the computer.

outputs.name: awayNote
outputs.description: Explanation that an offline computer is asleep or disconnected and nothing is sent until it returns.

outputs.name: revokedNote
outputs.description: Instruction to pair again after revocation.

outputs.name: relayName
outputs.description: Relay host and optional port, or an empty string for an invalid URL.

outputs.name: timeLeft
outputs.description: Minutes and two-digit seconds remaining.

outputs.name: keyLabel
outputs.description: Short grouped device identifier.

outputs.name: identityLabel
outputs.description: Full grouped device identifier.

outputs.name: grantLabel
outputs.description: Plan and Change allowed, or Read and comment only.

outputs.name: grantSummary
outputs.description: Project count followed by permission wording.

outputs.name: hostLine
outputs.description: Phone-access-on line with relay and applicable registering, connecting or offline suffix.

outputs.name: hostSummary
outputs.description: Phone access off, or the approved-phone count.

outputs.name: remoteLabels
outputs.description: Heading and supporting text for the mobile state, using host name and lock state where available.

declarations.title: Serve desktop renderer files
declarations.responsibility: Serve files beneath the renderer root with a content policy and fallback to the app entry page.

inputs.name: rendererPolicy.html
inputs.description: HTML whose inline scripts are hashed for the script policy.

inputs.name: rendererPolicy.connect
inputs.description: Additional trusted connection-policy text; defaults to empty.

inputs.name: rendererAssets.root
inputs.description: Directory containing the built renderer.

inputs.name: rendererAssets.url
inputs.description: Requested URL; must use harness://app.

inputs.name: rendererAssets.connect
inputs.description: Additional trusted connection-policy text; defaults to empty.

outputs.name: rendererPolicy
outputs.description: Content policy allowing local assets and the HTML inline-script hashes, with restricted frames, objects and base URLs.

outputs.name: rendererAssets
outputs.description: Response with file bytes, media type, content policy and no-sniff header; missing files fall back to index.html, while rejected routes or escaped paths receive a refusal response.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Malformed URLs or escapes and filesystem/read failures can reject the operation.

declarations.title: Read a renderer route
declarations.responsibility: Extract branch, commit, category, entity and tab from an explorer route.

inputs.name: rendererPath.path
inputs.description: Path beginning with /harness/branch to parse; other paths use the default route.

outputs.name: rendererPath
outputs.description: Parsed route; defaults are pages and null branch, commit, entity and tab. Branch/entity are URI-decoded; unknown categories become pages.

declarations.title: Process agent RPC messages
declarations.responsibility: Match incoming replies to requests and manage request sending and timeouts.

inputs.name: rpcMessages.state
inputs.description: Pending-request map, notification listeners and sender.

inputs.name: rpcMessages.line
inputs.description: One JSON message line; invalid JSON is ignored.

inputs.name: rpcRequest.state
inputs.description: Pending-request map and sender used for the new request.

inputs.name: rpcRequest.frame
inputs.type: { id: number; method: string; params: unknown }
inputs.description: Request ID, method and parameters to send.

inputs.name: rpcRequest.timeoutMs
inputs.description: Milliseconds before the pending request is rejected as timed out.

outputs.name: rpcMessages
outputs.description: Settles matching requests, dispatches notifications or rejects incoming interactive requests as unavailable; returns nothing.

outputs.name: rpcRequest
outputs.description: Reply result, or rejection from the remote error, send failure or timeout.

declarations.title: Build an agent task context
declarations.responsibility: Assemble entity facts, recent thread messages, allowed unit references and task instructions for an agent run.

inputs.name: runContext.context
inputs.description: Run context containing project planning access, revision, entity, thread and requested work.

outputs.name: runContext
outputs.description: Prompt with entity contract, its uses and consumers, up to 20 recent messages truncated to 2000 characters each, reference instructions and requested work. Includes the shared coverage-first bug repair rules; assembling the prompt runs no repair or test.

declarations.title: Pairing scan messages
declarations.responsibility: Map known scan failures to readable notices and validate a phone display name.

inputs.name: scanFailure.cause
inputs.description: Unknown value to inspect for a recognized scan failure code.

inputs.name: scanNotice.cause
inputs.description: Failure to describe; unknown failures fall back to String(cause).

inputs.name: phoneName.value
inputs.description: Phone name to trim and validate.

outputs.name: scanFailures
outputs.description: Recognized camera, cancellation and pairing-offer failure codes.

outputs.name: nameNotice
outputs.description: Instruction to provide a phone name.

outputs.name: scanNotices
outputs.description: Readable notice for each recognized scan failure.

outputs.name: scanFailure
outputs.description: Recognized failure code or null.

outputs.name: scanNotice
outputs.description: Known failure notice or string conversion of the unknown cause.

outputs.name: phoneName
outputs.description: Trimmed name when nonempty and at most 80 characters; otherwise null.

declarations.title: Filter agent environment
declarations.responsibility: Copy environment variables while removing provider credentials and the Electron Node-mode flag.

inputs.name: scrubEnvironment.env
inputs.description: Environment map; defaults to process.env.

outputs.name: scrubEnvironment
outputs.description: New map excluding case-sensitive OPENAI_ and ANTHROPIC_ prefixes and ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; other entries are retained.

declarations.title: Choose the app environment
declarations.responsibility: Connect the native mobile or desktop adapter when available, otherwise select the web environment.

inputs.name: selectEnvironment.host
inputs.description: Host providing Capacitor detection and an optional desktop bridge.

outputs.name: selectEnvironment
outputs.description: Mobile environment when Capacitor reports native, else desktop when the bridge exists, else web with no bridge and local false.

declarations.title: Compare source snapshots
declarations.responsibility: Report sorted added, deleted and modified files by comparing snapshot values.

inputs.name: sourceChanges.before
inputs.description: Earlier map of paths to content hashes or link markers.

inputs.name: sourceChanges.after
inputs.description: Later map of paths to content hashes or link markers.

outputs.name: sourceChanges
outputs.description: Changes sorted by path across both maps; equal values are omitted.

declarations.title: Read working source hashes
declarations.responsibility: Snapshot tracked and nonignored untracked working files for later change comparison.

inputs.name: fileHash.path
inputs.description: Filesystem path to inspect.

inputs.name: sourceSnapshot.root
inputs.description: Repository root used to list working source paths.

outputs.name: fileHash
outputs.description: SHA-256 for a regular file, link: plus target for a symbolic link, or null for missing/nonfile paths.

outputs.name: sourceSnapshot
outputs.description: Map of Git-listed paths to current file hashes or link markers, omitting paths with no file value.

declarations.title: Split an output stream into lines
declarations.responsibility: Decode UTF-8 chunks and deliver complete lines while bounding the buffered text.

inputs.name: streamLines.options
inputs.type: { onLine: (line: string) => void; maxBytes: number; onOverflow: () => void; }
inputs.description: Line and overflow callbacks plus maximum buffered byte count.

outputs.name: streamLines
outputs.description: write accepts byte chunks and emits newline-delimited strings; end flushes any remaining text. Oversized buffered text invokes the overflow callback and clears the buffer.

declarations.title: Choose comment targets
declarations.responsibility: Resolve design options and image targets and build comment anchors for the viewed revision.

inputs.name: imageTarget.version
inputs.description: Design version containing the selected image.

inputs.name: imageTarget.image
inputs.description: Selected image metadata.

inputs.name: imageTarget.region
inputs.description: Selected image rectangle, or null.

inputs.name: optionImages.design
inputs.description: Design version to inspect, or undefined.

inputs.name: optionImages.option
inputs.description: Option ID whose images are requested.

inputs.name: designOption.design
inputs.description: Design version whose option is selected.

inputs.name: designOption.wanted
inputs.description: Preferred option ID; defaults to empty.

inputs.name: shownApproval.design
inputs.description: Design and approval to inspect.

inputs.name: shownApproval.latest
inputs.description: Latest version ID against which approval is checked.

inputs.name: shownApproval.option
inputs.description: Displayed option ID; defaults to empty.

inputs.name: versionOption.versions
inputs.description: Available design versions.

inputs.name: versionOption.version
inputs.description: Version ID to find.

inputs.name: versionOption.wanted
inputs.description: Preferred option ID for that version.

inputs.name: otherOption.item
inputs.description: Optional target with version and option.

inputs.name: otherOption.version
inputs.description: Version currently shown.

inputs.name: otherOption.option
inputs.description: Option currently shown.

inputs.name: designTarget.design
inputs.description: Design version from which to select a target.

inputs.name: designTarget.option
inputs.description: Option whose first image should be selected.

inputs.name: threadAnchor.revision
inputs.description: Viewed branch and commit.

inputs.name: threadAnchor.entityId
inputs.description: Entity receiving the comment.

inputs.name: threadAnchor.target
inputs.description: Selected version, image hash, state, viewport and region.

inputs.name: sameImage.left
inputs.description: First target to compare.

inputs.name: sameImage.right
inputs.description: Second target to compare.

outputs.name: entityTarget
outputs.description: Entity-wide target with null version, image, state, viewport and region.

outputs.name: imageTarget
outputs.description: Image target with version, hash, state, viewport, region and option when present.

outputs.name: optionImages
outputs.description: All images for a single design, matching option images for an optioned design, or an empty list without a design.

outputs.name: designOption
outputs.description: Valid preferred option, otherwise the current approved option when valid, otherwise the first option; empty for a single design.

outputs.name: shownApproval
outputs.description: Whether the current approval names the latest version and, for options, matches the shown option and image hashes.

outputs.name: versionOption
outputs.description: Resolved option for the requested version.

outputs.name: otherOption
outputs.description: Whether the item belongs to the same version but a different nonempty option.

outputs.name: designTarget
outputs.description: First image target of the selected option, or an entity-wide target when there is no image.

outputs.name: threadAnchor
outputs.description: Comment anchor combining revision, entity and target fields.

outputs.name: sameImage
outputs.description: True when both targets share a nonempty image hash and version.

declarations.title: Format a timestamp
declarations.responsibility: Display recognizable ISO-like timestamps in the reader’s locale.

inputs.name: timeLabel.value
inputs.description: Text beginning with a date and hour/minute timestamp to try formatting.

outputs.name: timeLabel
outputs.description: Localized medium date and short time when parsing succeeds; original text otherwise.

declarations.title: Check a desktop IPC sender
declarations.responsibility: Accept messages only from the expected window main frame at an allowed URL.

inputs.name: trustedSender.event

declarations.title: Read and build workspace addresses
declarations.responsibility: Recognizes workspace addresses, reads their project and revision selection, and builds links to catalog entries and their sections.

inputs.name: isWorkspacePath.path
inputs.description: The path to check for a /harness address or a /projects/{project}/harness address. This recognition step does not validate the category or commit.

inputs.name: workspaceRoute.path
inputs.description: The workspace path to read, optionally naming a project, encoded branch, commit, category, entity and section. A named commit must contain exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters. The category defaults to pages when absent.

inputs.name: workspacePath.target
inputs.description: The category to link to, plus optional project, branch, commit, entity and section. Project, branch and entity names are URL-encoded. A section is included only when an entity is supplied. This builder does not validate a supplied commit.

outputs.name: routeSuffixes
outputs.description: The recognized entity sections: designs, plan, used-in, uses, relationships, evidence, history and details. Relationships remains accepted as an older address. An overview has no section suffix.

outputs.name: isWorkspacePath
outputs.description: True when the path has a recognized workspace prefix, otherwise false. A true result alone does not mean the full path can be read successfully.

outputs.name: workspaceRoute
outputs.description: The decoded project, branch and entity, the commit, category and recognized section. Missing selections are null, except the default pages category. An unknown section is treated as no section.

outputs.name: workspacePath
outputs.description: A workspace path carrying the supplied selections. A missing project creates a legacy /harness link; absent branch and commit leave the revision unspecified.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Reading fails for a non-workspace address, a commit other than a full 40-character lowercase hexadecimal hash, or an unknown catalog category. Invalid URL escapes in decoded names can also throw; recognition can encounter that decoding error for project names.

outputs.name: workspaceSearch
