declarations.title: Agent activity records
declarations.responsibility: Defines the stored registration, heartbeat and completion records, plus the types used to report agents and repository activity.

outputs.name: agentRegistrationSchema
outputs.description: Zod schema for a version 1 registration: nonempty identity, label and registration time; nullable provider, model and process identity; positive integer heartbeat allowance. Extra fields are rejected.

outputs.name: agentBeatSchema
outputs.description: Zod schema for a heartbeat with a nonempty time, nullable branch, task and loop, and an array of nonempty unit ids. Extra fields are rejected.

outputs.name: agentEndSchema
outputs.description: Zod schema for a final completion time, completed or failed status, and nullable outcome. Extra fields are rejected.

declarations.title: Agent liveness
declarations.responsibility: Determines whether an agent finished, lost its process, exceeded its heartbeat allowance or is still working.

inputs.name: agentLiveness.agent
inputs.description: Registration and latest heartbeat facts, heartbeat allowance in seconds, optional process identity, and any final completed or failed record. Dates are expected to be parseable strings.

inputs.name: agentLiveness.now
inputs.description: Time of the assessment in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; a heartbeat is stale only when its age is greater than the allowance.

inputs.name: agentLiveness.processOf
inputs.description: Lookup for the named process, returning existence and start time. Called only for an unfinished agent with a non-null pid; undefined existence means the process could not be checked.

outputs.name: agentLiveness
outputs.description: State and explanation: a final status wins, an absent or reused process is gone, an overdue heartbeat is stale, and otherwise the agent is working.

declarations.title: Agent statement validation
declarations.responsibility: Validates and normalizes the short facts an owner supplies about an agent before those facts are stored.

inputs.name: agentStatement.input
inputs.description: Optional CLI strings for agent identity and work. Ids use 1–64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores and begin alphanumerically; units are comma-separated lowercase unit ids; pid and ttl must be positive whole numbers.

outputs.name: agentStatement
outputs.description: Normalized statement with trimmed text, sorted unique unit ids, numeric pid or null, and ttlSeconds defaulting to 900. Text limits are label 120, provider/model/loop 80, task/outcome 200 characters; units are at most 40, ttl at most 86400, and pid at most 2147483647.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown when the id or unit list has an invalid shape, a text field contains controls or exceeds its limit, or pid or ttl is outside its whole-number range. The message names the offending option.

declarations.title: Analytics command options
declarations.responsibility: Adds the shared analytics attribution options to an existing Commander command.

inputs.name: analyticsOptions.command
inputs.description: Commander command to extend in place with --loop, --step, --task, --agent-model and --report value options.

outputs.name: analyticsOptions
outputs.description: The same command after the five attribution options have been registered, allowing further command configuration.

declarations.title: Analytics record types
declarations.responsibility: Defines attribution context, recorded analytics events, query filters and loop metrics.

declarations.title: Kernel benchmark measurements
declarations.responsibility: Builds benchmark entries from measured values or explicit unavailability, including the source and artifact sizes recorded by a kernel build.

inputs.name: benchMeasurement.context
inputs.description: Machine profile and tested commit, or null when the run cannot be attributed to a clean revision.

inputs.name: benchMeasurement.entry
inputs.description: Target, metric, unit, method and either a numeric value or an unavailable reason; optionally workload, sample count and artifact identities.

inputs.name: sizeMeasurements.context
inputs.description: Machine profile and tested commit to attach to every size entry.

inputs.name: sizeMeasurements.build
inputs.description: Kernel build record containing Wasm and native artifact sizes and hashes, plus reference and crate source sizes and files.

outputs.name: kernelUnits
outputs.description: Maps module and HTTP targets to function.impact-kernel, and Wasm and process targets to kernel.impact-kernel.

outputs.name: benchMeasurement
outputs.description: Benchmark entry with the target owner, profile and revision; absent workload becomes null and absent artifacts become an empty array. An unavailable value becomes null with its reason.

outputs.name: sizeMeasurements
outputs.description: Seven byte measurements: unavailable module and HTTP artifact sizes, measured Wasm and process artifacts, and module, Wasm and process source sizes. Values come from the supplied build record.

declarations.title: Runtime timing samples
declarations.responsibility: Times complete runtime invocations and summarizes warmed samples or repeated rounds into latency and throughput measurements.

inputs.name: median.values
inputs.description: Numeric samples to sort on a copy; meaningful medians require a nonempty array.

inputs.name: timeCall.runtime
inputs.description: Initialized runtime whose invoke method performs the whole operation being timed.

inputs.name: timeCall.request
inputs.description: Operation and optional input to pass unchanged to the runtime.

inputs.name: benchSamples.runtime
inputs.description: Initialized runtime used for three warm-up calls and then every measured call.

inputs.name: benchSamples.request
inputs.description: Operation and optional input repeated for warm-up and measurement.

inputs.name: benchSamples.iterations
inputs.description: Number of timed calls after warm-up; callers should supply a positive integer.

inputs.name: benchRounds.runtime
inputs.description: Initialized runtime used for warm-up and all measured rounds.

inputs.name: benchRounds.request
inputs.description: Operation and optional input repeated in every call.

inputs.name: benchRounds.shape
inputs.description: Positive integer round and per-round call counts. This helper does not validate them.

inputs.name: roundMeasurements.result
inputs.description: Round summary containing the fastest call, median of round medians, throughput and total sample count.

inputs.name: roundMeasurements.where
inputs.description: Human-readable description of where calls were timed, included in each measurement method.

outputs.name: median
outputs.description: Middle sorted value, or the average of the two middle values. An empty input yields NaN.

outputs.name: timeCall
outputs.description: Elapsed milliseconds for one successful whole invocation, including the runtime transport work.

outputs.name: benchSamples
outputs.description: Median call latency, calls per second based on total measured duration, and the requested iteration count after three warm-up calls.

outputs.name: benchRounds
outputs.description: Fastest single call, median of round medians, calls per second derived from that median, and rounds times iterations samples.

outputs.name: roundMeasurements
outputs.description: Three entries for latency-floor-ms, latency-warm-ms and throughput-ops, each with its value, unit and boundary description.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when an invocation returns ok: false, naming the runtime kind and failure message. Invocation promise rejections also propagate.

declarations.title: Kernel benchmark record schemas
declarations.responsibility: Defines observational kernel benchmark records, their provenance and the measurements and runtime choice they contain.

outputs.name: measurementsDirectory
outputs.description: Repository-relative directory specification/measurements/impact-kernel used for kernel measurements.

outputs.name: representativeWorkload
outputs.description: The representative runtime-selection workload id, graph-1k.

outputs.name: calibrationNote
outputs.description: Notice that calibration measurements are observational and cannot establish or satisfy a verification budget baseline.

outputs.name: calibrationSchema
outputs.description: Strict Zod schema requiring kind calibration, verified false and a nonempty note.

outputs.name: benchMeasurementSchema
outputs.description: Measurement schema extended to allow a tested revision to be null; a present revision is a 40-character lowercase hexadecimal commit id.

outputs.name: kernelBenchmarkSchema
outputs.description: Zod schema for a version 1 kernel benchmark, including machine profile, source revision and dirty state, calibration provenance, workload sizes, measurements and measured or unmeasured runtime choice.

declarations.title: Decision-point counting
declarations.responsibility: Counts the supported code and Svelte template decision markers used for complexity measurements.

inputs.name: blockComplexity.masked
inputs.description: Source with comments and string contents already masked; matching keywords and operators are counted textually.

inputs.name: blockComplexity.base
inputs.description: Initial count: 1 for a function, or 0 when no function base is needed.

inputs.name: templateComplexity.markup
inputs.description: Markup to scan for Svelte if, each and await blocks and else-if branches.

outputs.name: blockComplexity
outputs.description: Base plus occurrences of if, for, while, case, catch, logical-and, logical-or, nullish-coalescing and recognized conditional question marks.

outputs.name: templateComplexity
outputs.description: Number of recognized Svelte block and else-if decision markers, or zero when there are none.

declarations.title: Named code block spans
declarations.responsibility: Finds named top-level functions and class methods in masked JavaScript or TypeScript source.

inputs.name: blockSpans.masked
inputs.description: JavaScript or TypeScript text with non-code contents masked while preserving offsets and grouping punctuation.

outputs.name: blockSpans
outputs.description: Spans sorted by start offset, each naming a function or Class.method with its kind and source bounds. Supported declarations and assigned function values are included; unrecognized or incomplete bodies are omitted.

declarations.title: Browser diagnostic records
declarations.responsibility: Define the recorded browser errors and expectations associated with one test attempt.

outputs.name: browserDiagnosticSchema
outputs.description: Strict schema for one test attempt: nonempty test name, file and project strings, nonnegative retry number, optional browser name, observed errors and expected errors. Observations distinguish console errors from uncaught exceptions and retain message, page and optional source, nonnegative line/column and stack. Expectations require a nonempty message and reason and may require an exact source.

declarations.title: Budget verdicts
declarations.responsibility: Compares one unit’s measurements with reviewed frozen limits and compatible performance baselines, preserving missing and unavailable evidence as explicit findings.

inputs.name: isFrozen.metric
inputs.description: Metric name to test for a frozen size, complexity, dependency or emitted-artifact limit.

inputs.name: budgetFindings.input
inputs.description: Unit, current profile, default target, performance budgets and measurements, optional reviewed baseline, and whether source size and complexity should be checked.

inputs.name: performanceLimit.metric
inputs.description: Metric whose worse direction determines the tolerated limit; only throughput-ops treats larger values as better.

inputs.name: performanceLimit.baseline
inputs.description: Reviewed numeric value in the same unit as the measurement.

inputs.name: performanceLimit.tolerance
inputs.description: Allowed fractional regression, such as 0.05 for five percent.

outputs.name: frozenMetrics
outputs.description: The source metrics source-bytes, complexity and dependencies whose limits never allow unreviewed growth.

outputs.name: isFrozen
outputs.description: True for those source metrics or any metric beginning with artifact-bytes.

outputs.name: budgetFindings
outputs.description: Findings for requested source checks, measured emitted targets and each performance budget. Each reports passed, exceeded, missing-baseline, missing-measurement, unavailable, incomplete or incompatible as supported by the evidence.

outputs.name: performanceLimit
outputs.description: Baseline decreased by tolerance for throughput, otherwise increased by tolerance, rounded to twelve significant digits. A value exactly at the limit remains acceptable.

declarations.title: Reviewed budget history
declarations.responsibility: Combines repeated ledger events into review histories and selects the reviewed limits relevant to a unit’s source and emitted targets.

inputs.name: budgetReviews.ledgers
inputs.description: Budget ledgers from one or more revisions; identical events are deduplicated by canonical JSON.

inputs.name: frozenLimits.baseline
inputs.description: Reviewed baseline containing frozen metrics and optional unavailable reasons, or undefined when none exists.

inputs.name: emittedLimits.unit
inputs.description: Unit manifest whose execution targets determine which emitted limits are relevant.

inputs.name: emittedLimits.baseline
inputs.description: Reviewed baseline to read target-specific limits and unavailable reasons from; may be undefined.

outputs.name: budgetReviews
outputs.description: Map from unit id to unique reviews sorted by their at timestamp, including the measured commit, reviewer, reason and before/after limits.

outputs.name: frozenLimits
outputs.description: Only source-bytes, complexity and dependencies limits and their unavailable reasons; undefined when the baseline is absent.

outputs.name: emittedLimits
outputs.description: Limits and unavailable reasons keyed by emitted runtime kind; undefined when the unit emits nothing, and an empty limits map when targets exist without reviewed limits.

declarations.title: Budget ledger schemas
declarations.responsibility: Defines the validated performance baselines and reviewed baseline or approval events stored in the budget ledger.

outputs.name: performanceBaselineSchema
outputs.description: Strict Zod schema for a numeric performance baseline with nonempty workload, metric, profile, unit and method, a supported runtime target and complete comparison context.

outputs.name: budgetEventSchema
outputs.description: Zod union of strict baseline and approval records. Both name a unit, verification record, reviewer, reason, time and performance baselines; baseline stores metrics, approval stores before and after limits, and either may explain unmeasured metrics.

declarations.title: Standardized bug repair rules
declarations.responsibility: Share coverage-first standardized bug repair rules between framework guidance and app agents.

outputs.name: bugRepairPolicy
outputs.description: Six reusable instructions: diagnose the missed coverage, extend standardized tests, prove the defect before repair, repeat the same test, retain evidence and respect planning-only requests. Each call returns a new list; it runs no agent or test.

declarations.title: Compiled build identity
declarations.responsibility: Hashes a build’s paths and content identities, ignoring embedded stamp values so stamping does not change the build identity.

inputs.name: buildIdentity.files
inputs.description: Built files with forward-slash paths inside the build directory and SHA-256 content hashes; input order does not affect the result.

inputs.name: builtFileHash.bytes
inputs.description: Original bytes of one emitted file, optionally containing harness-build stamp slots.

outputs.name: buildIdentity
outputs.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest over each content hash and path in sorted path order.

outputs.name: builtFileHash
outputs.type: { sha256: string; stamps: string[]; slots: number }
outputs.description: SHA-256 of the bytes with all valid stamp slots emptied, all nonzero identities found in those slots, and the total slot count. Files without slots are hashed unchanged.

declarations.title: Build stamp slots
declarations.responsibility: Defines the embedded build stamp format and reads a filled identity without treating an empty slot as a known build.

inputs.name: buildStamp.slot
inputs.description: Optional stamp text beginning with harness-build: and followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

outputs.name: buildStampPattern
outputs.description: Global regular expression matching filled or empty harness-build slots with exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

outputs.name: sdkPackage
outputs.description: The SDK package identity reported by the console: @dafuga01/harness version 0.1.3.

outputs.name: emptyBuildStamp
outputs.description: An empty stamp slot consisting of harness-build: followed by 64 zeros.

outputs.name: buildStamp
outputs.description: The 64-character identity of a correctly shaped nonzero slot, or null for a missing, malformed or all-zero slot.

declarations.title: Canonical JSON serialization
declarations.responsibility: Serializes JSON-shaped values with sorted object keys at every depth while preserving array order.

inputs.name: canonicalJson.value
inputs.description: JSON-shaped value to serialize. Undefined object properties are omitted; arrays retain order. Objects are read through enumerable own keys rather than a custom JSON serializer.

outputs.name: canonicalJson
outputs.description: Compact JSON text with recursively sorted object keys and unchanged array order for JSON-serializable input.

declarations.title: Code name casing
declarations.responsibility: Converts names into kebab, Pascal, camel or snake case using the same word boundaries.

inputs.name: toKebabCase.value
inputs.description: Text to split at lowercase-or-digit to uppercase transitions and non-alphanumeric separators.

inputs.name: toPascalCase.value
inputs.description: Text to split into normalized lowercase words before capitalizing each word.

inputs.name: toCamelCase.value
inputs.description: Text to split into words before building Pascal case and lowering its first character.

inputs.name: toSnakeCase.value
inputs.description: Text to split at case transitions and non-alphanumeric separators.

outputs.name: toKebabCase
outputs.description: Lowercase words joined by hyphens; empty or separator-only input becomes an empty string.

outputs.name: toPascalCase
outputs.description: Words joined with each first letter capitalized; empty input becomes an empty string.

outputs.name: toCamelCase
outputs.description: Joined words with a lowercase first character and capitalized later word initials.

outputs.name: toSnakeCase
outputs.description: Lowercase words joined by underscores; empty or separator-only input becomes an empty string.

declarations.title: Harness audit rule catalog
declarations.responsibility: Defines the standard audit limits and expresses supplied limits as human-readable rule summaries.

inputs.name: harnessRuleSummariesFor.limits
inputs.description: Numeric limits for file, function, class and method lines, nesting, parameters, complexity and classes per file.

outputs.name: harnessRuleLimits
outputs.description: Default limits: 220 file lines, 55 function lines, 120 class lines, 35 method lines, nesting 4, parameters 4, complexity 10 and one class per file.

outputs.name: harnessRuleSummaries
outputs.description: Rule summary strings generated from the default limits, followed by fixed naming, structure, dependency and coverage guidance.

outputs.name: harnessRuleSummariesFor
outputs.description: Ordered rule summaries using the supplied numeric limits together with the fixed Harness guidance; no files are inspected or changed.

declarations.title: Measured runtime selection
declarations.responsibility: Chooses the simplest runtime within tolerance of the fastest matching cold-latency measurement and explains omitted candidates.

inputs.name: chooseRuntime.input
inputs.description: Available measurements plus the exact workload and machine profile to consider. Only latency-cold-ms entries for those labels participate.

outputs.name: chooseRuntime
outputs.description: Chosen runtime, measured or unmeasured basis, workload and profile, selection rule, candidates and exclusions. Module, Wasm and process are considered in that order within five percent of the fastest; no winner falls back to unmeasured module. HTTP is never selected automatically.

declarations.title: Repository path classification
declarations.responsibility: Determines a file’s owning workspace and whether it belongs to the registry, ignored files, global inputs, tests, source or other files.

inputs.name: classifyPath.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative path using forward slashes, to compare with workspace roots and configured patterns.

inputs.name: classifyPath.config
inputs.description: Workspace roots and ignored, global and test patterns used for classification.

outputs.name: classifyPath
outputs.description: Classification, workspace name and root, workspace-relative path, and source identity when recognized. The deepest matching workspace wins; registry, ignored, global, test and source checks run in that order.

declarations.title: Bounded cleanup time
declarations.responsibility: Creates a shared deadline that ends waits and supplies fallback answers when cleanup work fails or takes too long.

inputs.name: cleanupDeadline.milliseconds
inputs.description: Milliseconds before the deadline aborts. A timer starts immediately and is unreferenced so it does not keep the process alive.

outputs.name: cleanupDeadline
outputs.description: Deadline with an AbortSignal, expiry check, promise race with fallback, bounded pause and cancel method. Cancellation aborts immediately; within returns its fallback for failed or late work without stopping work that ignores the signal.

declarations.title: CLI action classification
declarations.responsibility: Reduces CLI arguments to the known command action used for attribution.

inputs.name: commandAction.args
inputs.description: CLI arguments beginning with the command and optional subcommand; executable and script names should already be removed.

outputs.name: commandAction
outputs.description: Known top-level action, known command plus subcommand, command plus help for an unknown subcommand, or help-or-unknown for an unrecognized top-level command.

declarations.title: Evidence commit identity
declarations.responsibility: Reads the repository’s configured Git identity and supplies fallback author and committer environment values without changing Git configuration.

inputs.name: commitIdentity.git
inputs.description: Git adapter for the repository whose user.name and user.email should be read.

outputs.name: commitIdentity
outputs.description: Author and committer name/email environment entries. Missing or empty settings fall back to Harness and harness@localhost.

declarations.title: Commit message validation
declarations.responsibility: Cleans a hook message as Git would and reports stored-message prefix and length violations.

inputs.name: writtenMessage.file
inputs.description: Message-file contents supplied to a commit-msg hook, not a filesystem path.

inputs.name: writtenMessage.options
inputs.description: Optional Git cleanup mode and comment marker; defaults to strip and #. Verbatim preserves internal text; whitespace and scissors keep comment lines.

inputs.name: commitMessage.message
inputs.description: Commit message as stored, whose first line is the subject and remaining text is the body including trailers.

outputs.name: commitPrefixes
outputs.description: The allowed subject prefixes feat:, fix:, chore: and cleanup:.

outputs.name: writtenMessage
outputs.description: Cleaned message text: trimmed ends, configured comment and whitespace cleanup, and scissors removal in non-verbatim modes. No file is read or written.

outputs.name: commitMessage
outputs.description: Problem messages for an empty subject, a subject over 72 characters, a missing allowed prefix followed by a space and content, or a body over 60 words or 400 characters. An empty array means all checks pass; counts trim ends and normalize line endings.

declarations.title: Benchmark comparison context
declarations.responsibility: Identifies a benchmark’s full request and records the invocation boundary and sampling protocol needed for valid comparisons.

inputs.name: requestDigest.request
inputs.description: Complete JSON-shaped request, including operation and input, to fingerprint with canonical serialization.

inputs.name: comparisonContext.request
inputs.description: Complete JSON-shaped request actually sent by the benchmark.

inputs.name: comparisonContext.sampling
inputs.description: Round count and calls per round used by the benchmark; this helper copies rather than validates them.

outputs.name: requestDigest
outputs.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of canonical request JSON, independent of object-key order.

outputs.name: comparisonContext
outputs.description: Context containing the request digest, public-invocation boundary, harness-rounds/1 protocol and sampling with three warm-up calls.

declarations.title: Measurement comparability
declarations.responsibility: Determines whether a measurement and baseline describe the same quantity and sampling method before their numeric values are compared.

inputs.name: comparisonDifferences.metric
inputs.description: Metric name used to enforce the expected unit for known latency, throughput and memory metrics; custom metrics require matching units.

inputs.name: comparisonDifferences.measured
inputs.description: Current measurement’s unit, method description and comparison context; missing or invalid metadata is reported as incomplete.

inputs.name: comparisonDifferences.baseline
inputs.description: Reviewed baseline’s unit, method description and comparison context.

outputs.name: comparisonDifferences
outputs.description: Comparable with no differences when definitions match; incomplete when metadata is missing or invalid; otherwise incompatible with ordered differences for unit, request, boundary, protocol, sampling and method.

declarations.title: Measurement comparison schema
declarations.responsibility: Defines the protocol, units and complete context required to compare benchmark measurements.

outputs.name: roundsProtocol
outputs.description: Protocol id harness-rounds/1 for warmed rounds of complete invocations.

outputs.name: warmupCalls
outputs.description: Three calls made before timed benchmark rounds.

outputs.name: measurementBoundaries
outputs.description: Allowed boundaries: public-invocation for the whole runtime call, or fixture for a declared test value.

outputs.name: metricUnits
outputs.description: Expected units: milliseconds for cold, warm and floor latency; ops/s for throughput; bytes for memory.

outputs.name: comparisonSchema
outputs.description: Strict Zod schema for a 64-character lowercase SHA-256 request digest, supported boundary, nonempty trimmed protocol and strict sampling counts with nonnegative warm-up and positive rounds and iterations.

declarations.title: Complexity coverage classification
declarations.responsibility: States whether a file’s decision points can be counted, are absent by file kind, or belong to an unsupported language.

inputs.name: complexityCoverage.path
inputs.description: File path whose lowercased extension determines the supported language or declarative format.

inputs.name: complexityCoverage.scripted
inputs.description: Whether an HTML file contains script; defaults to false and has no effect on other extensions.

inputs.name: uncountedLanguage.path
inputs.description: Path of an unsupported file to label by its lowercased extension.

outputs.name: complexityCoverage
outputs.description: Counted for supported JavaScript, TypeScript and Svelte files; declarative for supported data or presentation formats and scriptless HTML; unsupported otherwise.

outputs.name: uncountedLanguage
outputs.description: Known language name, an extension followed by files, or files without an extension when no extension exists.

declarations.title: Unit version identity
declarations.responsibility: Fingerprints a unit’s manifest, owned source, contract and runtime independently so changes can be attributed to the affected part.

inputs.name: componentVersion.manifest
inputs.description: Unit manifest identifying its owned source and contract/runtime definitions.

inputs.name: componentVersion.files
inputs.description: Map from repository-relative source paths to content hashes; owned paths missing a nonempty hash are omitted.

outputs.name: componentVersion
outputs.description: Unit id, separate SHA-256 hashes for the canonical manifest, sorted owned paths and hashes, contract and runtime, plus the sorted owned file list used for the source hash.

declarations.title: Protected console handlers
declarations.responsibility: Creates console handlers that check host policy before releasing stored JSON, media, build identity or downloadable reports.

inputs.name: consoleAccess.options
inputs.type: { policy: ConsolePolicy; data: ConsoleSource; exporter?: ConsoleExporter; host?: ConsoleHost; }
inputs.description: Host policy and data source, with optional report exporter and build identity. Data may be shared or opened from each admitted request; policy must return exactly true to admit it.

outputs.name: consoleAccess
outputs.description: Guard, page entry, JSON, media and report handlers. Denials return 403, absent or invalid resources return 404, legacy addresses may redirect with 308, and media supports byte-range 206 or 416 responses. Policy exceptions deny access; data is opened only after admission.

declarations.title: Bundled console data
declarations.responsibility: Reads console JSON and media lazily from modules compiled into a server bundle.

inputs.name: consoleBundle.modules
inputs.description: Maps of JSON and media module loaders. JSON modules default-export text; media modules default-export base64 and export a MIME type string. Loader paths end in the requested filename plus .ts.

outputs.name: consoleBundle
outputs.description: Data reader with async json and media methods. Missing loaders or wrong export types yield undefined; media is decoded into original bytes with its MIME type. No module loads until requested.

declarations.title: Canonical explorer addresses
declarations.responsibility: Maps earlier console addresses into explorer pages and chooses a useful indexed branch or retained commit when none is selected.

inputs.name: defaultCommit.index
inputs.description: Indexed branches and revisions used to resolve a requested commit or fallback.

inputs.name: defaultCommit.asked
inputs.description: Requested commit id; used only when present in the index.

inputs.name: commitBranch.index
inputs.description: Indexed revisions and their containing branches.

inputs.name: commitBranch.commit
inputs.description: Commit whose containing branch should be chosen.

inputs.name: explorerHome.index
inputs.description: Indexed branches and revisions available for the initial Pages view.

inputs.name: explorerExact.path
inputs.description: Explorer path without the host base; trailing slashes are ignored.

inputs.name: explorerExact.search
inputs.description: Optional query string, defaulting to empty; a tab is included when checking the canonical form.

inputs.name: explorerAddress.index
inputs.description: History index used to resolve old addresses and fallback selections.

inputs.name: explorerAddress.path
inputs.description: Path relative to the console base, including root, legacy page, report, analytics or explorer routes.

inputs.name: explorerAddress.search
inputs.description: Optional query string carrying legacy selection or explorer tab state; defaults to empty.

inputs.name: consoleCanonical.index
inputs.description: History index used to resolve the requested address.

inputs.name: consoleCanonical.url
inputs.description: Current URL whose path and query should be normalized.

inputs.name: consoleCanonical.base
inputs.description: Host route prefix to remove before parsing and prepend to a replacement path.

outputs.name: defaultCommit
outputs.description: Requested known commit, otherwise an indexed main/master branch head, another indexed head, first revision, or an empty string.

outputs.name: commitBranch
outputs.description: First main/master branch containing the commit, otherwise its first branch, or null when none is recorded.

outputs.name: explorerHome
outputs.description: Pages location at an indexed preferred or first branch tip, otherwise the first retained revision with no branch; undefined for an empty history.

outputs.name: explorerExact
outputs.description: True when the path and recognized tab already match the explorer formatter’s output after removing trailing slashes.

outputs.name: explorerAddress
outputs.description: Replacement explorer path for a recognized noncanonical address; undefined for an exact explorer address or an unrecognized path.

outputs.name: consoleCanonical
outputs.description: Replacement path including the host base, or undefined when no replacement is resolved. This helper returns text and does not perform a redirect.

declarations.title: Console data module generation
declarations.responsibility: Turns recognized history-index files into server module text and estimates the resulting bundled size.

inputs.name: consoleDataModules.files
inputs.description: History-index files with relative paths and bytes. Recognized JSON records and hash-named media are converted; unrelated paths are ignored.

inputs.name: bundledSize.modules
inputs.description: Generated host files whose text sizes and individually gzipped sizes should be summed.

outputs.name: consoleDataModules
outputs.description: Host file entries under src/lib/server/harness/data: JSON default-exports its text; media default-exports base64 and exports its extension-derived MIME type. This function does not write files.

outputs.name: bundledSize
outputs.description: File count, total contents string length and sum of gzipped byte lengths, or null for an empty list.

declarations.title: Console HTML document
declarations.responsibility: Builds a complete console document with inline viewer assets and host settings while leaving history and media to protected endpoints.

inputs.name: consoleDocument.assets
inputs.description: Compiled JavaScript and CSS text to inline in the HTML document.

inputs.name: consoleDocument.options
inputs.description: Console base path with optional title, export availability and navigation links. Title defaults to Harness and exportable defaults to false.

outputs.name: consoleDocument
outputs.description: Complete HTML string with escaped title, serialized settings and inline assets protected against closing their elements. It contains the viewer shell, not history data, and does not enforce access policy itself.

declarations.title: Console host integration files
declarations.responsibility: Produces SvelteKit server modules and routes that connect the console to a host policy and bundled or private-bucket history.

inputs.name: consoleHostFiles.options
inputs.description: Console base route, policy module and export name, and optionally a bucket binding and prefix. These values are inserted into generated source and should already be validated by the caller.

outputs.name: consoleServerDirectory
outputs.description: Server-only output directory src/lib/server/harness.

outputs.name: consoleHostFiles
outputs.description: Six path/content entries: server module, root and catch-all document routes, and JSON, export and media endpoints. All endpoints use protected console access; no filesystem writes occur here.

declarations.title: Console installation manifest
declarations.responsibility: Reads and writes the host’s console installation record, retaining file ownership and change history.

inputs.name: consoleManifest.host
inputs.description: Host project directory containing harness.console.json.

inputs.name: writeConsoleManifest.host
inputs.description: Host project directory in which harness.console.json will be written.

inputs.name: writeConsoleManifest.manifest
inputs.description: Installation record to serialize, including file entries, ownership and changes. The files array is sorted on a copy before writing.

outputs.name: consoleManifestFile
outputs.description: Installation record filename harness.console.json.

outputs.name: consoleManifest
outputs.description: Parsed installation record with schemaVersion forced to 1, missing files and changes defaulted to empty arrays, and missing file ownership defaulted to harness. Read failures return an empty record; malformed JSON still rejects.

outputs.name: writeConsoleManifest
outputs.description: Resolves after writing tab-indented JSON with a trailing newline and files sorted by path. The target file is replaced; write failures reject.

declarations.title: Local console access policy
declarations.responsibility: Admits local owner requests only when owner mode, loopback binding and the actual peer address all qualify.

inputs.name: loopbackAddress.address
inputs.description: Possible loopback address; undefined becomes empty, then whitespace is trimmed and casing normalized.

inputs.name: consolePolicy.owner
inputs.description: Owner configuration: mode must be loopback, bind must match a loopback address, and no nonblank addressHeader may be configured.

outputs.name: loopbackAddress
outputs.description: True for localhost, ::1, and supported 127.* IPv4 or IPv4-mapped forms after normalization.

outputs.name: consolePolicy
outputs.description: Policy returning true only for an enabled loopback owner server whose request supplies a matching getClientAddress result. Missing or throwing address lookup denies access; client headers are ignored.

outputs.name: denyAll
outputs.description: Policy that always returns false.

declarations.title: Legacy console page routes
declarations.responsibility: Parses and formats the earlier commit-based console paths, preserving branch names and view-specific selections.

inputs.name: consoleRoute.path
inputs.description: Console-relative path naming an optional branch, 40-character lowercase hexadecimal commit and supported view, optionally followed by base, record or unit selection.

inputs.name: consoleRoutePath.route
inputs.description: Branch or null, commit, supported view and optional comparison base, history record and selected unit to encode.

outputs.name: consoleViews
outputs.description: Supported view names: map, compare, history, growth and activity.

outputs.name: consoleRoute
outputs.description: Parsed route with decoded branch and selections, or undefined for an invalid page shape, branch encoding or unknown view. Trailing slashes are ignored and unrelated selection parts are skipped.

outputs.name: consoleRoutePath
outputs.description: Canonical commit-based path with encoded branch segments and selections; comparison base appears only for compare and record only for history.

declarations.title: Private console object data
declarations.responsibility: Reads console JSON and media from a supplied private object store under one prefix.

inputs.name: consoleStore.bucket
inputs.description: Object-store binding providing asynchronous get calls that return text/byte readers or null for absent objects.

inputs.name: consoleStore.prefix
inputs.description: Optional object-key prefix, defaulting to empty; trailing slashes are removed when constructing a prefixed key.

outputs.name: consoleStore
outputs.description: Async JSON and media readers. JSON reads the requested relative key; media reads media/name and derives its MIME type from the extension, defaulting to application/octet-stream. Missing objects yield undefined.

declarations.title: CPU interval accounting
declarations.responsibility: Converts two CPU readings into machine use and process groups, assigning descendants to their nearest recognized owner without counting lifetime CPU for new processes.

inputs.name: cpuMetrics.before
inputs.description: Earlier timestamp, cumulative machine counters and process CPU totals in milliseconds.

inputs.name: cpuMetrics.after
inputs.description: Later timestamp, machine counters, logical core count and current process list used to attribute interval CPU.

outputs.name: cpuMetrics
outputs.description: Available snapshot with current sampling time, elapsed interval, machine utilization or null when counters do not advance, Codex/Harness/agent group totals and agents sorted by core utilization. New processes and counter decreases contribute zero elapsed CPU.

declarations.title: Process CPU parsing
declarations.responsibility: Parses process-list rows into CPU totals and recognized application roles without returning command arguments.

inputs.name: cpuProcesses.value
inputs.description: Process-list text whose rows contain pid, parent pid, cumulative CPU time and command. Malformed rows are skipped; time may include a day prefix and fractional seconds.

inputs.name: cpuProcesses.monitorPid
inputs.description: Pid to classify as Harness regardless of its command; defaults to the current process id.

outputs.name: cpuProcesses
outputs.description: Parsed processes with numeric pids and CPU milliseconds, plus an optional Codex, Harness or agent role and safe label. Command strings are used only for classification and are not returned.

declarations.title: Manifest derivation
declarations.responsibility: Builds an active unit manifest from source facts while retaining declared contracts, responsibilities, dependencies and runtime choices.

inputs.name: deriveManifest.input
inputs.description: Unit id and kind, nonempty owned source-file facts, source-path owner map, optional predecessor ids and previous manifest. The previous manifest supplies declarations to preserve.

outputs.name: deriveManifest
outputs.description: Active manifest with sorted source paths, exported symbols, derived or preserved contract, source-based dependencies plus declared dependencies, merged predecessor lineage, runtime, scenarios, preview and budgets. This function returns data without writing the registry.

declarations.title: Fallback unit responsibility
declarations.responsibility: Creates an explicitly derived placeholder from a unit’s kind and title when no human responsibility has been declared.

inputs.name: derivedResponsibility.kind
inputs.description: Unit kind used to choose a known purpose phrase; unknown kinds use the kind followed by unit.

inputs.name: derivedResponsibility.title
inputs.description: Unit title inserted unchanged into the placeholder sentence.

outputs.name: derivedResponsibility
outputs.description: Placeholder sentence of the form Owns the title purpose. It names a kind and title only and is not a reviewed description of behavior.

declarations.title: Emitted size selection
declarations.responsibility: Names per-target artifact limits and selects build measurements that qualify for those frozen limits.

inputs.name: emittedKey.target
inputs.description: Target name to append to the artifact-bytes ledger key.

inputs.name: emittedSizes.measurements
inputs.description: Measurements with metric and optional target, profile and workload fields; the helper filters without changing entries.

outputs.name: emittedMetric
outputs.description: The metric name artifact-bytes used for emitted output sizes.

outputs.name: emittedKey
outputs.description: Ledger key artifact-bytes: followed by the supplied target.

outputs.name: emittedSizes
outputs.description: Entries whose metric is artifact-bytes, target is defined, and profile and workload are both absent or empty. Benchmark sizes with a profile or workload are excluded; original order and objects are preserved.

declarations.title: Expected CLI errors
declarations.responsibility: Provides the error class used for deliberate CLI failures and the functions to throw or recognize it.

inputs.name: fail.message
inputs.description: Human-readable failure message to attach to the expected CLI error.

inputs.name: isExpectedCliError.error
inputs.description: Any value to test for membership in the ExpectedCliError class.

outputs.name: fail
outputs.description: Never returns: immediately throws a new ExpectedCliError containing the supplied message.

outputs.name: isExpectedCliError
outputs.description: True only when the value is an instance of ExpectedCliError, narrowing its TypeScript type.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The Error subclass thrown by fail, with its name set to ExpectedCliError.

declarations.title: Verification evidence manifest
declarations.responsibility: Lists a verification run’s own captures and test logs, then records their identities and Git or LFS storage beside the serialized record.

inputs.name: recordFiles.record
inputs.description: Verification record whose scenario captures and test logs should be listed. Captures from referenced scenarios belong to their original record and are excluded.

inputs.name: evidenceManifest.record
inputs.description: Verification record supplying id, source commit and tree, status, captures and logs for the evidence manifest.

inputs.name: evidenceManifest.recordJson
inputs.description: Exact serialized record.json bytes to hash and count; they are not regenerated from the supplied object.

outputs.name: recordFiles
outputs.description: Unique file entries in capture-then-log order, retaining the first entry for each path and carrying hashes, byte sizes and capture media types.

outputs.name: evidenceManifest
outputs.description: Version 1 evidence manifest with record identity, source and status, followed by record.json and the run’s own files. Hash and size for record.json come from the supplied bytes; media extensions select LFS and other files use Git.

declarations.title: Change explanation schema
declarations.responsibility: Defines the scratch location, attempt outcomes and validated explanation of a particular unit change.

outputs.name: explanationsFile
outputs.description: Scratch NDJSON path .cache/harness/explanations.ndjson, outside the source tree.

outputs.name: explanationOutcomes
outputs.description: Allowed attempt outcomes: improved, not-improved and not-applicable.

outputs.name: explanationSchema
outputs.description: Strict Zod schema naming the unit, symbol, optional file, added/modified/removed change, nullable before/after fingerprints, behavior, simplification and performance attempts, and recording time. Text is trimmed and nonempty.

declarations.title: Legacy explorer selection
declarations.responsibility: Maps an earlier console selection to the corresponding explorer entity and section.

inputs.name: explorerLegacy.route
inputs.description: Legacy route with branch, commit, view and optional unit.

outputs.name: explorerLegacy
outputs.description: Explorer location preserving branch and commit. No unit opens Pages; a selected unit opens its kind category, defaulting to functions, with history section for history or growth views.

declarations.title: Explorer address parsing
declarations.responsibility: Parses and formats branch or commit explorer addresses with category, entity, section and tab selection.

inputs.name: explorerKindCategory.kind
inputs.description: Declared unit kind to map into a displayed category.

inputs.name: explorerRoute.path
inputs.description: Console-relative path beginning with an encoded branch segment or full lowercase 40-character commit hash; trailing slashes are ignored.

inputs.name: explorerRoute.search
inputs.description: Optional query string containing tab selection; defaults to empty.

inputs.name: explorerRoutePath.location
inputs.description: Branch or commit scope and category, with optional entity, details/history section and tab.

outputs.name: explorerCategories
outputs.description: Navigation categories in order: pages, shells, components, functions, configs and services.

outputs.name: explorerKindCategory
outputs.description: Mapped category, or null for an unsupported kind; only shell maps to shells.

outputs.name: explorerSections
outputs.description: Supported entity sections: details and history; omitted section means overview.

outputs.name: explorerTabs
outputs.description: Allowed tabs by section. Overview includes overview, used-in, uses, relationships and tests; details includes contract, measurements and source; history has none.

outputs.name: explorerRoute
outputs.description: Parsed location, or undefined for malformed scope, encoding, category or selection. A bare branch or commit opens Pages; invalid/default tabs are omitted.

outputs.name: explorerRoutePath
outputs.description: Canonical path with encoded branch/entity segments and only a valid nondefault tab in the query.

declarations.title: Generated export updates
