inputs.name: splitTopLevel.masked
inputs.description: Masked text whose top-level separator positions should be found.

inputs.name: splitTopLevel.separators
inputs.description: String of individual separator characters to recognize at nesting depth zero.

inputs.name: parseParameters.code
inputs.description: Original parameter-list or object-type text containing the type spellings to retain.

inputs.name: parseParameters.masked
inputs.description: Corresponding masked text with identical offsets for delimiter analysis.

inputs.name: parseParameters.options
inputs.description: Owner prefix for field names and optional separator characters, default comma.

inputs.name: normalizeType.text
inputs.description: Raw type text to normalize.

outputs.name: splitTopLevel
outputs.description: Indexes of separator characters outside tracked brackets/generics; text itself is not split or changed.

outputs.name: parseParameters
outputs.description: Contract items named owner.parameter with normalized explicit type or unknown when absent. Empty pieces are skipped and unrecognized/destructured names become input.

outputs.name: normalizeType
outputs.description: Whitespace-collapsed type text with trailing comma/semicolon removed, or unknown for empty text.

declarations.title: Process peak memory
declarations.responsibility: Runs a command under the system time utility and extracts its peak resident memory when available.

inputs.name: peakMemory.command
inputs.description: Executable to run under /usr/bin/time.

inputs.name: peakMemory.args
inputs.description: Arguments passed to that executable.

inputs.name: peakMemory.input
inputs.description: Text sent to the process standard input.

outputs.name: peakMemory
outputs.description: Peak resident bytes from a successful BSD/GNU time report, converting GNU kilobytes by 1024; otherwise an unavailable explanation. Execution is synchronous and the command actually runs.

declarations.title: Model picker tool dispatch
declarations.responsibility: Validates picker tool arguments and routes catalog, status, switch and cancellation operations to the provider-switch service.

inputs.name: pickerMcpTools.service
inputs.description: Provider-switch service exposing catalog, observed sessions, status, request and cancellation operations.

inputs.name: pickerMcpTools.name
inputs.description: Operation name: list_models, list_observed_sessions, request_model_switch, cancel_model_switch, open_model_picker or get_provider_status.

inputs.name: pickerMcpTools.input
inputs.description: Operation arguments, validated against the applicable strict schema for status, switch or cancel. List operations ignore input.

outputs.name: pickerSessionSchema
outputs.description: Strict object schema with an optional string session_id.

outputs.name: pickerSwitchSchema
outputs.description: Strict schema requiring session_id, provider openai or harness-claude, model and effort strings.

outputs.name: pickerCancelSchema
outputs.description: Strict schema requiring session_id and request_id strings.

outputs.name: pickerMcpTools
outputs.description: Promise of the service result: model/session lists, switch request, cancellation or status. Missing session for status becomes null; this dispatcher does not itself launch a UI.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown for an unknown operation; schema parse and service failures may also reject.

declarations.title: Provider selection identity
declarations.responsibility: Defines provider selection data and checks exact selection equality and explicit session-id shape.

inputs.name: sameSelection.a
inputs.description: First provider, model and effort selection to compare.

inputs.name: sameSelection.b
inputs.description: Second selection to compare without normalization.

inputs.name: validateSessionId.value
inputs.description: Explicit session id beginning with an ASCII letter/digit, followed by letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, at most 128 characters total.

outputs.name: sameSelection
outputs.description: True only when provider, model and effort all match exactly.

outputs.name: validateSessionId
outputs.description: The original session id when it matches the required shape.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when the session id is empty, too long or contains an unsupported character.

declarations.title: Model picker storage paths
declarations.responsibility: Computes the picker state and provider catalog locations from environment overrides or the user’s Codex directory.

outputs.name: pickerPaths
outputs.description: Picker home from HARNESS_PICKER_HOME or CODEX_HOME/harness/picker, plus OpenAI models_cache.json and Harness Claude catalog paths under CODEX_HOME. Without CODEX_HOME, the root is the user home .codex directory. No directories are created or files read.

declarations.title: Provider switch state types
declarations.responsibility: Defines pending provider switches, session observations and control interfaces, and derives a request revision marker.

inputs.name: switchRevision.record
inputs.description: Switch request whose id and status identify the revision, or null when no request exists.

outputs.name: desktopControlUnavailable
outputs.description: User-facing notice that desktop control is unavailable, requests remain pending and provider settings have not changed.

outputs.name: switchRevision
outputs.description: Request id followed by a colon and its current status, or null for no request.

declarations.title: Pinned Rust tool selection
declarations.responsibility: Resolves a Rust executable from the nearest declared toolchain and isolates child compilation from host compiler overrides.

inputs.name: pinnedToolchain.tool
inputs.description: Lowercase Rust tool name beginning with a letter and containing only letters, digits and hyphens.

inputs.name: pinnedToolchain.options
inputs.description: Optional working directory, environment and command runner. Defaults use the current directory, process environment and synchronous subprocess execution.

outputs.name: pinnedToolchain
outputs.description: Resolved executable and copied child environment with the pinned RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN, matching rustc path, cleared wrappers and toolchain directories prepended to PATH and library search paths.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown for an invalid tool name, absent/malformed nearest rust-toolchain.toml, invalid starting directory, unavailable rustup or unsuccessful/empty tool resolution.

declarations.title: Buffered console output
declarations.responsibility: Routes console.log through the stdout stream so large piped output is queued instead of truncated at a direct-write buffer boundary.

outputs.name: pipedOutput
outputs.description: Returns nothing and replaces global console.log with a formatter that writes one newline-terminated string to process.stdout.

declarations.title: Validated planning artifact paths
declarations.responsibility: Recognizes exact planning files and their ancestor directories only when the containing plan and contract hash are valid.

inputs.name: planningArtifactPaths.root
inputs.description: Repository root used to read plan and optional unit manifests; undefined returns an empty set.

inputs.name: planningArtifactPaths.files
inputs.description: Repository-relative paths to examine for supported plan, design, approval and thread artifacts.

outputs.name: planningArtifactPaths
outputs.description: Set of accepted artifact paths and ancestor directory paths ending in slash. Invalid plans, mismatched locations/hashes and unrelated files contribute nothing; no files are changed.

declarations.title: Shared platform service classification
declarations.responsibility: Distinguishes private descendants from vetted shared Xcode services, protecting processes whose identity or authority cannot be established.

inputs.name: classifyProcess.known
inputs.description: Tracked pid and start time identifying the process to classify.

inputs.name: classifyProcess.context
inputs.description: Developer-tool authority supplier, command group, optional probes and cancellation signal.

inputs.name: stillPrivate.known
inputs.description: Tracked process identity to recheck immediately before signalling.

inputs.name: stillPrivate.judgedAs
inputs.description: Executable path recorded when the process was judged private, or null when none was known.

inputs.name: stillPrivate.context
inputs.description: Probe context used for the final identity and executable check.

outputs.name: macAuthority
outputs.description: Selected canonical Xcode authority from synchronous xcode-select, or null when selection cannot be established.

outputs.name: platformServices
outputs.description: Promise of the selected Xcode authority using bounded asynchronous probes, or null when unavailable.

outputs.name: classifyProcess
outputs.description: Verdict with standing, reason and executable: gone for changed/absent identity, private for ordinary known programs, delegated for a fully vouched system-adopted service, otherwise protected.

outputs.name: stillPrivate
outputs.description: True only if start time and executable still match and the process is not named as a guarded shared service or launcher; performs no signal itself.

declarations.title: Portable JSON admission
declarations.responsibility: Checks whether values can retain their meaning across supported JSON runtimes within the nesting bound.

inputs.name: portableJson.value
inputs.description: Value to inspect: finite numbers, well-formed strings, booleans, null, arrays and plain/null-prototype objects are supported. Undefined object fields are ignored; unsupported values are refused.

inputs.name: portableJson.level
inputs.description: Current container nesting depth, default zero; recursive calls advance it.

outputs.name: maxJsonDepth
outputs.description: Maximum supported array/object nesting depth, 64.

outputs.name: portableJson
outputs.description: True when inspected values pass numeric, Unicode, prototype and depth checks; false otherwise. Input is checked in place rather than cloned or serialized.

outputs.name: notPortable
outputs.description: Shared runtime failure with code invalid-json and message request is not valid JSON.

declarations.title: previewBinding
declarations.responsibility: Validates a visual unit preview against its declared screenshot state and viewport.

inputs.name: unit
inputs.description: A visual unit and its optional preview binding.

inputs.name: scenarios
inputs.description: The scenario contracts stored at the same revision.

outputs.name: issues
outputs.description: Empty when no preview is declared or its own required screenshot state and viewport exist; otherwise readable validation problems.

declarations.title: Process descendant tracking
declarations.responsibility: Tracks a command’s process identities through parent and group observations and signals only still-matching tracked processes.

inputs.name: processDescendants.root
inputs.description: Root command pid to begin tracking while that command has not yet been reaped.

inputs.name: processDescendants.read
inputs.description: Optional process-table reader, defaulting to the system ps reader; null or rejection means unreadable.

inputs.name: signalProcesses.known
inputs.description: Tracked pids and start times eligible for a fresh identity check before signalling.

inputs.name: signalProcesses.signal
inputs.description: SIGTERM or SIGKILL to send to still-matching identities.

outputs.name: processTable
outputs.description: System process rows containing pid, parent, group and start time, or null if the bounded ps read fails or omits this process.

outputs.name: processDescendants
outputs.description: Tracker with look, survivors, alive and closed methods. It remembers parent provenance and start times, marks unsupported group-only identities unproven, and stops treating a reused root pid as the original command.

outputs.name: signalProcesses
outputs.description: Resolves after attempting signals only for supplied identities still present in a fresh process table. Empty/unreadable tables send no signals; kill errors are ignored.

declarations.title: Bounded process probes
declarations.responsibility: Provides bounded system-tool calls for reading process state and executable paths, with shared concurrency control.

inputs.name: processProbes.limits
inputs.description: Optional cancellation signal and per-tool timeout in milliseconds; default timeout is 3000.

outputs.name: processProbes
outputs.description: Probe methods for running tools, reading process facts with ps and resolving executable paths with lsof. At most eight tools run concurrently process-wide; timeout/cancellation/failure yields not-ok, and unreadable facts or paths yield null.

declarations.title: Project kind detection
declarations.responsibility: Infers whether a directory is a Harness app or library from explicit metadata and conventional local files.

inputs.name: detectProjectKind.root
inputs.description: Project directory to inspect for package.json, svelte.config.js and src/index.ts.

outputs.name: detectProjectKind
outputs.description: App or lib from explicit package harness.kind first; otherwise app for Svelte configuration/dependency/check script, lib for a readable package and src/index.ts, or unknown. Read/parse/access failures are treated as missing evidence.

declarations.title: Committed project activity
declarations.responsibility: Assembles loop usage, recent commits and the latest change to each listed file from caller-provided repository facts.

inputs.name: projectActivity.source
inputs.description: Repository identity and kind, newest-first revisions, callbacks for reasons/changes/owners, loop states and limits for work, files, reasons and units.

outputs.name: projectActivity
outputs.description: Version 1 activity with newest commit or null, loop summaries, bounded work entries and each path once at its latest listed change. Reasons and unit ids are deduplicated; owned files are preferred within a commit.

declarations.title: Pushed source commits
declarations.responsibility: Selects new source-branch tips from the lines Git supplies to a pre-push hook.

inputs.name: pushedRefs.input
inputs.description: Git pre-push input containing four whitespace-separated fields per reference line.

outputs.name: pushedRefs
outputs.description: Unique local commit strings in encounter order for nondeleted updates to source branches. Malformed lines, deletions, evidence/notes/archive refs, tags and other refs are omitted.

declarations.title: Read browser diagnostics
declarations.responsibility: Read and validate the browser diagnostics written for one check attempt.

inputs.name: readBrowserDiagnostics.directory
inputs.description: Directory for this check attempt; only its browser-errors.ndjson file is read.

outputs.name: readBrowserDiagnostics
outputs.description: Parsed browserErrors when the file contains valid nonblank JSON lines. Returns an empty object for a missing or empty file, or a failure message for a nonregular file, a file over 2000000 bytes, read failure or any invalid line; partial results are not returned.

declarations.title: Read snapshot text
declarations.responsibility: Reads snapshot files in bounded groups while preserving their requested order and failures.

inputs.name: snapshot
inputs.description: The readable snapshot that supplies each requested file.

inputs.name: paths
inputs.description: Files to read, in the order their complete text must be returned. Repeated paths keep their positions.

outputs.name: texts
outputs.description: Unchanged file text in requested order; at most 64 reads run together. An empty request returns an empty list.

errors.name: Read failed
errors.description: A failed file read rejects the whole request; no file is silently omitted.

declarations.title: Capture evidence writing
declarations.responsibility: Writes a requested evidence file and appends its metadata to the capture index.

inputs.name: evidenceRequested.env
inputs.description: Environment to check, default process.env; HARNESS_EVIDENCE_DIR must be nonempty and TAKE_SCREENSHOT exactly 1.

inputs.name: recordCapture.line
inputs.description: Capture metadata whose file names the output under the evidence directory.

inputs.name: recordCapture.bytes
inputs.description: Raw bytes or text to write as the capture.

inputs.name: recordCapture.env
inputs.description: Optional environment supplying the evidence directory and opt-in flag.

outputs.name: evidenceRequested
outputs.description: True only when both evidence directory and screenshot flag request evidence.

outputs.name: recordCapture
outputs.description: False with no writes when evidence is not requested; otherwise creates the evidence directory, writes the file, appends its JSON index line and returns true.

declarations.title: Verification ancestry checks
declarations.responsibility: Checks that inherited base and scenario evidence comes from available, matching, passing and sound records without cycles.

inputs.name: recordLineage.record
inputs.description: Verification record whose base and referenced scenario ancestry should be checked.

inputs.name: recordLineage.source
inputs.description: Lookup for stored records and callback reporting record identity, seal and evidence problems.

inputs.name: recordLineage.path
inputs.description: Optional ancestor id trail, default empty, used to detect cyclic inheritance.

outputs.name: recordLineage
outputs.description: Problem strings for missing, mismatched, failed, damaged or cyclic ancestry and changed inherited states. An empty list means no examined lineage violation; checks are cached per object only within this call.

declarations.title: Record a regression
declarations.responsibility: Run and preserve the failing-test commit or its unchanged passing fix.

inputs.name: Request
inputs.description: Loop, phase, committed revision and test inputs

outputs.name: Result
outputs.description: A commit-linked result with the observed outcome and immutable evidence

errors.name: Invalid proof
errors.description: Refuses mixed product/test commits, changed tests, invalid phases or unsuccessful proof.

declarations.title: History record projection
declarations.responsibility: Builds the display form of a verification record with resolved media and explicit inherited evidence origins.

inputs.name: recordView.record
inputs.description: Stored verification record to project without changing its results. Optional browser diagnostics on its tests are retained.

inputs.name: recordView.context
inputs.type: { valid: boolean; problems: string[]; resolve: MediaResolver; /** The checks an earlier record ran, by its id; undefined when it cannot be read. */ origins?: (record: string) => DiagnosticTest[] | undefined; }
inputs.description: Validity and problems supplied by the caller, a media resolver, and optional lookup for origin-record test summaries and browser diagnostics.

outputs.name: recordView
outputs.description: Record view retaining source, timings, gates, measurements, budgets and reason status, with concise tests and captures augmented by resolved media/gaps. Inherited scenarios name their actual origin and scoped origin tests when available. Current test summaries and available scenario-scoped origin tests retain their optional browser diagnostics, without substituting current-run diagnostics for inherited evidence.

declarations.title: Recorded build projection
declarations.responsibility: Keeps only the declared build identity fields in a verification record.

inputs.name: recordedBuilds.observed
inputs.description: Optional observed build entries; undefined means the project declared no build.

outputs.name: recordedBuilds
outputs.description: Empty object when observations are undefined, otherwise builds containing only id, directory, buildId and files. An explicitly empty array remains builds: [].

declarations.title: Freeze regression inputs
declarations.responsibility: Keep test inputs fixed between the failing-test commit and its fix.

inputs.name: Request
inputs.description: Two committed source revisions and the selected test files

outputs.name: Result
outputs.description: The frozen test inputs, or why the commit sequence is invalid

errors.name: Invalid proof
errors.description: Refuses a product repair in the test commit, reused commits or changed test inputs.

declarations.title: Read regression history
declarations.responsibility: Show the selected commit’s failing test and its exact passing fix.

inputs.name: Request
inputs.description: A source commit, its stored notes and an evidence reader

outputs.name: Result
outputs.description: Linked failure and pass results, with explicit gaps for missing or corrupt proof

errors.name: Invalid proof
errors.description: Missing or damaged proof stays visible as a gap; it cannot become a passing result.

declarations.title: Regression result contract
declarations.responsibility: Describe a committed regression result and its display in history.

inputs.name: Request
inputs.description: Stored regression result or paired history data

outputs.name: Result
outputs.description: Validated commit identities, test inputs and observed results

errors.name: Invalid proof
errors.description: Rejects missing fields, malformed hashes and unknown record fields.

declarations.title: Report process environment
declarations.responsibility: Combines report settings with explicit environment overrides for report configuration and Cloudflare context.

outputs.name: reportsEnvironment
outputs.description: Copied process environment with PROJECT_REPORTS_CONFIG_FILE and PROJECT_REPORTS_CLOUDFLARE_CONFIG_HOME filled from settings only when not already set. Reads HARNESS_REPORTS_SETTINGS_FILE or the default user report-settings.json; missing file is allowed.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with Invalid Harness report settings file for a non-ENOENT read failure or JSON parse failure.

declarations.title: Application repository identity
declarations.responsibility: Identifies an application by its normalized upstream repository or local Git store and compares checkouts or a plain site directory.

inputs.name: repositoryIdentity.directory
inputs.description: Checkout directory to identify through Git metadata and upstream addresses.

inputs.name: sameRepository.left
inputs.description: First checkout directory to compare.

inputs.name: sameRepository.right
inputs.description: Second checkout directory to compare.

inputs.name: sameSite.site
inputs.description: Hosted site directory whose repository or plain-directory identity defines ownership.

inputs.name: sameSite.directory
inputs.description: Candidate directory whose membership in the site should be checked.

outputs.name: repositoryIdentity
outputs.description: Cached SHA-256 identity from a normalized network remote or canonical local Git store, following local clone origins up to the hop limit; null for missing or ambiguous origins.

outputs.name: sameRepository
outputs.description: True only when both directories have the same non-null repository identity. Shared template history alone does not establish identity.

outputs.name: sameSite
outputs.description: True for another checkout of a known site repository, or the exact canonical directory of a site outside Git. Unknown-origin repositories do not fall back to path equality.

declarations.title: Required change explanations
declarations.responsibility: Finds unit additions/removals, symbol changes and otherwise-unexplained declared-manifest changes that need reasons.

inputs.name: presentUnits.side
inputs.description: Revision source index and unit manifests to filter for active units with present owned source.

inputs.name: requiredReasons.base
inputs.description: Earlier revision’s source blocks and manifests.

inputs.name: requiredReasons.head
inputs.description: Later revision’s source blocks and manifests.

outputs.name: presentUnits
outputs.description: Map of active manifests with at least one owned path present in the source index.

outputs.name: requiredReasons
outputs.description: Sorted required reasons with unit/symbol, change kind and before/after fingerprints. Identical named blocks can move files unchanged; whole-unit changes use *, and declared-manifest changes use <manifest> only when no symbol changes already require reasons.

declarations.title: Tracked import resolution
declarations.responsibility: Resolves a scanned reference to a tracked repository file, external package or explicit uncertainty.

inputs.name: resolveImport.from
inputs.description: Repository-relative importing file path using forward slashes.

inputs.name: resolveImport.reference
inputs.description: Scanned reference with import kind, optional literal specifier, type-only flag and detail for computed references.

inputs.name: resolveImport.context
inputs.description: Tracked path set and owning workspace root for relative and $lib resolution.

outputs.name: resolveImport
outputs.description: Resolved file path, external package/framework name or non-literal/unresolved uncertainty, retaining via and typeOnly. Tries supported extensions, index files and .js-to-.ts fallback; does not read the filesystem.

declarations.title: Response assessment types
declarations.responsibility: Defines response-check CLI options, normalized request and criteria, evaluation settings and the reported assessment outcome.

declarations.title: Direct revision changes
declarations.responsibility: Combines recorded impact with registry-version differences to identify what a commit itself changed.

inputs.name: revisionChanges.input
inputs.description: Stored impact or null, current registry, optional parent registry and fallback parent commit. Registry comparison requires both registries to be available.

outputs.name: revisionChanges
outputs.description: Sorted direct, added and removed unit ids with the parent commit, or null when neither impact nor comparable registries exist. Indirect dependents are excluded; added/removed ids are removed from direct.

declarations.title: Commit-specific explanations
declarations.responsibility: Selects reasons that explain a commit’s own first-parent changes rather than merely belonging to a longer verification range.

inputs.name: revisionReasons.sources
inputs.description: First parent, optional own required changes, noted explanations and intact-record explanations with each record’s comparison base.

outputs.name: revisionReasons
outputs.description: Unique explanations in stable canonical order plus a count of held reasons belonging only to other changes/ranges. Exact-base record reasons are retained; known own changes are matched by fingerprints, otherwise notes not held solely by longer records are kept.

declarations.title: Stored revision registry
declarations.responsibility: Projects a revision’s declared units and scenarios with their graph, version identities and reviewed limits.

inputs.name: revisionRegistry.manifests
inputs.description: Unit manifests stored at the revision; entries are sorted by id without filtering status.

inputs.name: revisionRegistry.scenarios
inputs.description: Scenario manifests stored at the revision; entries are sorted by id.

inputs.name: revisionRegistry.blobs
inputs.description: Optional owned-file path to blob-hash map, default empty; absent files contribute an explicit absent marker to unit versions.

inputs.name: revisionRegistry.baselines
inputs.description: Optional reviewed budget baseline map by unit, default empty.

outputs.name: revisionRegistry
outputs.description: Registry view containing units, scenarios and declared dependency/coverage edges, with per-unit version hashes and applicable reviewed limits. Available is false with a gap when there are no units.

declarations.title: Revision evidence summary
declarations.responsibility: Summarizes a commit’s attached records into coverage and explicit gaps without treating unusable evidence as passing.

inputs.name: revisionSummary.status
inputs.description: Attached record status, validity and problems from history inspection.

inputs.name: revisionSummary.views
inputs.description: Readable record views supplying profile, finish time and comparison base by record id.

outputs.name: revisionSummary
outputs.description: Coverage, gaps and record summaries. No records is unverified; any usable passed record is verified; usable failures yield failed; only unusable records yield invalid. Unreadable metadata is unknown and invalid-record problems are named as gaps.

declarations.title: Isolated verification command
declarations.responsibility: Runs a bounded command, captures its log and settles descendants before deciding whether the check passed.

inputs.name: runIsolated.run
inputs.description: Executable, arguments, working directory, environment, timeout, log path and output-byte cap, with optional process-observation hooks and cleanup bound for tests.

outputs.name: runIsolated
outputs.description: Result with passed/failed/timeout status, exit code, duration, descendant settlement and log path/size/SHA-256. Writes the merged output log; passing requires exit zero, no counted survivors and known cleanup. macOS signals only judged private processes; other platforms clean the process group.

declarations.title: Fetch runtime handler
declarations.responsibility: Wraps a unit runtime in the common HTTP JSON request and response protocol.

inputs.name: runtimeFetch.runtime
inputs.description: Unit runtime to invoke for accepted POST requests.

outputs.name: runtimeFetch
outputs.description: Async Request handler returning JSON with no-store headers and the status supplied by runtimeReply. Creating the handler does not start a server or close the runtime.

declarations.title: HTTP runtime reply
declarations.responsibility: Rejects unsupported methods and invalid JSON before invoking a served unit.

inputs.name: runtimeReply.runtime
inputs.description: Runtime to invoke after HTTP admission.

inputs.name: runtimeReply.method
inputs.description: HTTP method, accepted only when exactly POST.

inputs.name: runtimeReply.read
inputs.description: Async body-text reader, called only for POST requests.

outputs.name: runtimeReply
outputs.description: 405 invalid-request for other methods, 400 invalid-json for unreadable/malformed/nonportable input, otherwise 200 with the runtime’s own response, including application failure envelopes.

declarations.title: Runtime envelopes and deadlines
declarations.responsibility: Validates runtime response envelopes and applies a timeout to both yielded and thread-blocking calls.

inputs.name: runtimeResponse.value
inputs.description: Unknown value to inspect for ok true with an output property, or ok false with string error code/message.

inputs.name: runtimeResponseText.text
inputs.description: JSON text returned by a byte transport.

inputs.name: runtimeDeadline.timeoutMs
inputs.description: Milliseconds allowed for the call, measured from deadline creation.

outputs.name: runtimeResponse
outputs.description: Original valid envelope, or invalid-response failure explaining that the value is not an envelope.

outputs.name: runtimeResponseText
outputs.description: Validated parsed envelope, or invalid-response for non-JSON text.

outputs.name: runtimeDeadline
outputs.description: Deadline with an expired promise and settle method. The timer produces runtime-timeout; settle clears it and rejects a result arriving strictly after the elapsed limit, including work that blocked the timer.

declarations.title: Shared runtime protocol
declarations.responsibility: Defines request, response and runtime interfaces and constructs consistent transport failures.

inputs.name: runtimeFailure.code
inputs.description: Stable failure code to return unchanged.

inputs.name: runtimeFailure.message
inputs.description: Human-readable failure detail to return unchanged.

inputs.name: runtimeTimeout.timeoutMs
inputs.description: Timeout duration in milliseconds to name in the failure message.

outputs.name: defaultRuntimeTimeoutMs
outputs.description: Default runtime timeout of 30000 milliseconds.

outputs.name: runtimeFailure
outputs.description: Failure envelope with ok false and the supplied code/message.

outputs.name: runtimeTimeout
outputs.description: Failure envelope with code runtime-timeout and a message naming the timeout duration.

declarations.title: Svelte component contract scan
declarations.responsibility: Derives a component’s props, markup output and nested script exports from its source.

inputs.name: scanComponent.code
inputs.description: Svelte source containing script blocks and markup.

inputs.name: scanComponent.name
inputs.description: Component symbol name used to prefix prop inputs.

outputs.name: scanComponent
outputs.description: Export scan containing a component symbol with props and markup output, followed by script exports and sorted unique detected error names. Inline $props object types become fields; named/untyped props remain a single props input.

declarations.title: Export signature scan
declarations.responsibility: Extracts top-level exports, visible class methods and syntactically identifiable error names from source.

inputs.name: scanExports.code
inputs.description: JavaScript/TypeScript source text to scan after masking comments and literal contents.

outputs.name: scanExports
outputs.description: Source-ordered symbols with inputs and explicit return/type text where readable, otherwise unknown; sorted unique thrown-error, fail-call and HTTP-error names. Type declarations remain type symbols rather than runtime calls.

declarations.title: Source dependency scanning
declarations.responsibility: Extracts literal and uncertain module references from script, Svelte and CSS source.

inputs.name: scanImports.code
inputs.description: Source text to scan for module references.

inputs.name: scanImports.language
inputs.description: Source family: ts scans scripts, svelte scans its script blocks, css scans quoted @import references, and other returns no references.

inputs.name: svelteScripts.code
inputs.description: Svelte source from which script-block contents should be extracted.

outputs.name: scanImports
outputs.description: References with specifier or null, via and typeOnly, plus a short detail for computed calls. Script references are source-ordered and deduplicated by kind/specifier or detail; member calls are excluded.

outputs.name: svelteScripts
outputs.description: Contents of matched script blocks in source order, excluding tags.

declarations.title: Scenario evidence coverage
declarations.responsibility: Judges gathered captures against required states, media validity and the verified revision/build identity.

inputs.name: scenarioCoverage.input
inputs.description: Scenario contract, exact verified commit, gathered captures, whether the producing check failed, and optionally declared/compiled build identities.

outputs.name: scenarioCoverage
outputs.description: Scenario states with capture statuses plus prefixed failure messages for missing/unproven requirements or invalid evidence. Screenshots require valid dimensions and revision/build provenance; audio requires valid duration/transcript and stated provenance; benchmarks must match their schema.

declarations.title: Scenario capture requirements
declarations.responsibility: Expands required evidence across applicable states and viewports and separates missing from inapplicable states.

inputs.name: scenarioRequirements.scenario
inputs.description: Scenario manifest containing state coverage, evidence requirements and named viewports.

outputs.name: scenarioRequirements
outputs.description: Required capture combinations only for required evidence on required states, plus unproven missing states and excluded inapplicable states with reasons. Evidence without viewports produces one requirement per state.

declarations.title: Verification record identity
declarations.responsibility: Records tested component versions, attributes benchmark measurements, references earlier scenarios and seals complete verification records.

inputs.name: recordComponents.impact
inputs.description: Impact report identifying direct, indirect, added and removed units.

inputs.name: recordComponents.sides
inputs.description: Base and head manifests/source facts used to identify the tested version, using base for removed units.

inputs.name: recordComponents.measured
inputs.description: Additional measured unit ids to include even when not reached by impact.

inputs.name: benchmarkMeasurements.gathered
inputs.description: Gathered captures whose parsed benchmark payloads may supply measurements.

inputs.name: benchmarkMeasurements.context
inputs.description: Current machine profile id and verified commit to attach to benchmark measurements.

inputs.name: referencedScenario.prior
inputs.description: Earlier verification record from which unaffected scenario evidence may be referenced.

inputs.name: referencedScenario.id
inputs.description: Scenario id to find in the prior record.

inputs.name: sealRecord.draft
inputs.description: Verification record fields except id, to hash canonically.

inputs.name: recordIntact.record
inputs.description: Record whose stored id should be compared with its current contents.

outputs.name: recordComponents
outputs.description: Sorted unique tested/measured components with source, manifest, contract and runtime hashes, files, target and change classification. Missing manifests are omitted.

outputs.name: benchmarkMeasurements
outputs.description: Measurements from valid benchmark payloads, attributed to the supplied profile/commit with empty artifacts; invalid payloads contribute nothing.

outputs.name: referencedScenario
outputs.description: Earlier nonfailed scenario marked referenced with its original referencedRecord retained, or the prior record id; undefined for missing/failed scenarios.

outputs.name: sealRecord
outputs.description: Record with id set to the SHA-256 of canonical draft JSON; no storage write occurs.

outputs.name: recordIntact
outputs.description: True when recomputing the canonical record hash matches its id.

declarations.title: Protected descendant settlement
declarations.responsibility: Stops proven private command processes under a deadline while leaving shared or uncertain processes untouched and recording the outcome.

inputs.name: haltProcesses.watch
inputs.description: Tracker whose alive method returns followed identities or null when unreadable.

inputs.name: haltProcesses.context
inputs.description: Command group, service authority and probes used to classify each process.

inputs.name: haltProcesses.limit
inputs.description: Grace duration and shared deadline for timeout termination.

inputs.name: settleProcesses.watch
inputs.description: Tracker of the ended command and descendants to settle.

inputs.name: settleProcesses.context
inputs.description: Classification context for private versus delegated/protected processes.

inputs.name: settleProcesses.timing
inputs.description: Optional settling/grace periods, default 2000/500 ms, and optional whole-cleanup bound; default bound adds 10000 ms slack.

outputs.name: haltProcesses
outputs.description: Resolves after bounded TERM then KILL attempts on freshly rechecked private processes only. Unreadable or expired observations cause no further signal.

outputs.name: settleProcesses
outputs.description: Settlement with counted survivors, stopped/resisted totals, unknown flag and log report. Vetted delegated services are handed over; protected/unproven processes remain and fail the check; errors or deadline exhaustion return unknown.

declarations.title: Process settlement reporting
declarations.responsibility: Explains which descendants were delegated, stopped or left running and which outcomes count against a check.

inputs.name: unknownSettlement.why
inputs.description: Reason cleanup could not establish what remains.

inputs.name: settlementReport.asked
inputs.description: Judged processes asked to end during the final settling step.

inputs.name: settlementReport.last
inputs.description: Judged processes present at the final observation.

inputs.name: settlementReport.signalled
inputs.description: Optional predicate identifying every process signalled during cleanup; defaults to membership in asked.

outputs.name: unknownSettlement
outputs.description: Unknown settlement with no asserted survivors, zero stopped/resisted, unknown true and a report explaining that the check fails.

outputs.name: settlementReport
outputs.description: Settlement counting asked-but-absent processes as stopped and final nondelegated processes as running; survivors includes both because either counts against the command. Reports delegated, signalled-running, untouched-running and stopped outcomes.

declarations.title: Stored source impact
declarations.responsibility: Stores compact revision snapshots and computes source impact between them without requiring a live repository.

inputs.name: storedSide.side
inputs.description: Impact-side snapshot containing tracked files, manifests, scenarios and dependency graph.

inputs.name: impactView.report
inputs.description: Computed impact report to reduce to history-facing source impact.

inputs.name: impactView.base
inputs.description: Compared-from commit, or null for the initial state.

inputs.name: sideImpact.base
inputs.description: Stored earlier commit/side, or null to represent the state before the first commit.

inputs.name: sideImpact.head
inputs.description: Stored later commit/side to compare against.

outputs.name: storedSide
outputs.description: Version 1 compact side with path/hash files, unit ownership, scenarios, node ids/kinds and numeric edge indexes. Edges with missing endpoints are omitted.

outputs.name: impactView
outputs.description: Source impact containing base, expansion, units, affected scenarios, uncertainty and changed paths.

outputs.name: sideImpact
outputs.description: Computed source impact using the normal ImpactService and TypeScript kernel against the supplied stored sides. No repository reads are required.

declarations.title: Undeclared snapshot files
declarations.responsibility: Finds files created outside tracked source, declared outputs and shared links in a verification snapshot.

inputs.name: declaredOutput.path
inputs.description: Snapshot-relative file or directory path to test against output patterns.

inputs.name: declaredOutput.outputs
inputs.description: Declared output glob patterns.

inputs.name: snapshotAdditions.directory
inputs.description: Snapshot root directory to walk recursively.

inputs.name: snapshotAdditions.bounds
inputs.description: Tracked paths, declared output patterns and shared-link paths that are allowed.

inputs.name: snapshotAdditions.prefix
inputs.description: Optional relative subtree prefix ending in slash when nonempty; defaults to empty.

outputs.name: declaredOutput
outputs.description: True when a pattern matches the path or its directory form with a trailing slash.

outputs.name: snapshotAdditions
outputs.description: Sorted paths of untracked non-directory entries outside allowed outputs/links. Allowed directories are not entered; filesystem errors reject.

declarations.title: Source change blocks
declarations.responsibility: Splits source into named functions/methods and remainder blocks with line bounds, fingerprints and decision counts.

inputs.name: sourceBlocks.code
inputs.description: Original source text to divide into blocks.

inputs.name: sourceBlocks.language
inputs.description: Source family; ts scans script blocks, svelte also emits template and first style remainder, and other families produce one module remainder.

outputs.name: sourceBlocks
outputs.description: Blocks with name, kind, line bounds, 16-character normalized-content hash and complexity. Script fingerprints ignore masked comments and normalize whitespace; named functions start complexity at one, module decisions at zero.

declarations.title: Source branch naming
declarations.responsibility: Combines local and remote-tracking source branches without moving local names to conflicting remote tips.

inputs.name: sourceBranches.refs
inputs.description: Listed Git refs with heads and optional symbolic targets.

inputs.name: sourceBranches.remotes
inputs.description: Configured remote names, used to disambiguate tracking prefixes by longest match.

outputs.name: sourceBranches
outputs.description: Branches sorted by name. Local branches keep their tips; a remote-only agreed tip keeps the plain branch name, while conflicting tips use remote:branch. Evidence, notes, archives, tags and remote HEAD/symbolic refs are excluded.

declarations.title: Masked source boundaries
declarations.responsibility: Tracks bracket depths and finds approximate statement and function-body bounds in masked source.

inputs.name: sourceNesting.masked
inputs.description: Masked source whose literal/comment contents no longer contribute brackets.

inputs.name: matchingBrace.nesting
inputs.description: Depth arrays previously computed from the same masked source.

inputs.name: matchingBrace.open
inputs.description: Offset of an opening curly brace.

inputs.name: statementEnd.masked
inputs.description: Masked source containing the statement.

inputs.name: statementEnd.nesting
inputs.description: Matching depth arrays for the source.

inputs.name: statementEnd.start
inputs.description: Offset at which statement scanning begins.

inputs.name: bodyEnd.masked
inputs.description: Masked source containing a signature and possible body.

inputs.name: bodyEnd.nesting
inputs.description: Matching depth arrays for the source.

inputs.name: bodyEnd.from
inputs.description: Offset after which to look for a function body.

outputs.name: sourceNesting
outputs.description: Curly and parenthesis/square-bracket depths before every character, with one trailing position.

outputs.name: matchingBrace
outputs.description: Inclusive closing-brace offset when depth returns to its opening level; last source offset if no close is found.

outputs.name: statementEnd
outputs.description: Inclusive statement end at a same-depth semicolon, recognized next statement or closing brace, otherwise the final source offset.

outputs.name: bodyEnd
outputs.description: Inclusive function-body end, skipping recognized return-type braces, or -1 for a bodiless/unrecognized signature.

declarations.title: Source index types
declarations.responsibility: Defines source-file facts, exported symbols, resolved references, tree access and dependency graph types.

declarations.title: Formatted JSON output
declarations.responsibility: Formats JSON-shaped data using the project’s tab-indented layout and short primitive-array style.

inputs.name: stableJson.value
inputs.description: JSON-shaped value to render; undefined object fields are omitted, while nullish values elsewhere become null.

outputs.name: stableJson
outputs.description: Formatted text with a trailing newline. Objects retain entry order; primitive arrays stay inline when they fit the 100-column layout calculation, otherwise values expand with tabs.

declarations.title: Tree content differences
declarations.responsibility: Compares file paths and content hashes to identify added, modified and removed files.

inputs.name: treeChanges.base
inputs.description: Earlier path/hash tree listing.

inputs.name: treeChanges.head
inputs.description: Later path/hash tree listing.

outputs.name: treeChanges
outputs.description: Changes sorted by path. Equal hashes at equal paths are unchanged; renames appear as removal plus addition. Duplicate paths within a listing use the last hash.

declarations.title: Conventional unit identity
declarations.responsibility: Derives a unit kind and name from a workspace-relative conventional source path.

inputs.name: unitIdentity.path
inputs.description: Forward-slash path relative to its workspace, using supported src, scripts, db or crates conventions.

inputs.name: unitIdentity.workspace
inputs.description: Optional workspace prefix, default empty.

outputs.name: unitIdentity
outputs.description: Kind, kebab-case name and dotted id, or undefined for unrecognized/empty identities. Rust crate files share one kernel id; route files and conventional folder suffixes follow their specific naming rules.

declarations.title: Retired unit continuity
declarations.responsibility: Finds retired identities continued through identical symbol lists or reuse of a name with a numeric suffix.

inputs.name: unitLineage.unit
inputs.description: Current unit id and ordered exported-symbol list.

inputs.name: unitLineage.retired
inputs.description: Candidate manifests to examine for retired predecessors.

outputs.name: unitLineage
outputs.description: Sorted predecessor ids, excluding the current id, whose nonempty symbols match in order or whose id is reused with a numeric suffix.

declarations.title: Static unit measurements
declarations.responsibility: Measures owned source, complexity, dependencies and emitted target sizes while stating unavailable or partial results.

inputs.name: unitMeasurements.unit
inputs.description: Unit manifest whose source, dependencies and runtime targets define the measurement scope.

inputs.name: unitMeasurements.files
inputs.description: Source-file facts by owned path, including read/coverage state, blocks and references.

inputs.name: unitMeasurements.testedRevision
inputs.description: Verified revision attached to every emitted measurement.

inputs.name: unitMeasurements.artifacts
inputs.description: Optional path-indexed built-artifact sizes and SHA-256 digests, default empty.

inputs.name: emittedTargets.unit
inputs.description: Unit whose Wasm and process execution targets should be selected.

outputs.name: unitMeasurements
outputs.description: Source bytes/lines, complexity, dependency count and per-target artifact bytes, with null values and unavailable reasons or partial notes where appropriate. Measurements have no workload/profile and are attributed to the supplied revision.

outputs.name: emittedTargets
outputs.description: Only runtime targets of kind wasm or process, in manifest order.

declarations.title: Declared source ownership
declarations.responsibility: Builds a lookup from exact file and directory declarations to their owning unit ids.

inputs.name: unitOwners.units
inputs.description: Units with ids and source entries; a trailing slash means every path under that directory.

outputs.name: unitOwners
outputs.description: Lookup function returning sorted unique owner ids for a path, from exact file matches and directory prefixes. No owner is inferred from naming.

declarations.title: Unit and scenario schemas
declarations.responsibility: Defines validated unit contracts, execution targets, dependency kinds and scenario evidence requirements.

outputs.name: unitIdPattern
outputs.description: Pattern for lowercase alphanumeric identifiers separated by single dots or dashes.

outputs.name: dependencyVias
outputs.description: Allowed dependency relations, including imports, reexports, dynamic imports, require, URL/style references, process, HTTP, Wasm and contract.

outputs.name: runtimeKinds
outputs.description: Execution kinds module, wasm, process and http.

outputs.name: performanceMetrics
outputs.description: Budgeted latency, throughput and memory metric names.

outputs.name: performanceTolerance
outputs.description: Maximum unreviewed performance tolerance, 0.05.

outputs.name: contractItemSchema
outputs.description: Strict name/type contract-item schema with optional description. Name/type are trimmed and nonempty.

outputs.name: unitDependencySchema
outputs.description: Strict dependency schema naming a unit, allowed relation and declared/derived origin, with optional contract.

outputs.name: performanceBudgetSchema
outputs.description: Strict performance budget schema with workload, supported metric, optional target and tolerance from zero through 0.05.

outputs.name: executionTargetSchema
outputs.description: Strict execution-target schema with supported kind, nonempty entry and optional environment/handler.

outputs.name: componentManifestSchema
outputs.description: Strict version 1 unit schema covering identity, declared/derived responsibility, active/retired state, ownership, contract, dependencies, runtime targets, scenarios, optional preview/lineage and frozen budgets.

outputs.name: scenarioManifestSchema
outputs.description: Strict version 1 scenario schema for UI/headless/audio cases, units, state coverage, viewports, tests and evidence requirements.

declarations.title: Unit indexing configuration
declarations.responsibility: Defines registry locations and default indexing rules and matches the supported path-pattern syntax.

inputs.name: pathMatches.path
inputs.description: Forward-slash path to compare with a pattern.

inputs.name: pathMatches.pattern
inputs.description: Exact path, directory prefix ending slash, or supported wildcard pattern.

outputs.name: unitsConfigFile
outputs.description: Configuration filename harness.units.json.

outputs.name: unitsDirectory
outputs.description: Unit manifest directory specification/units.

outputs.name: scenariosDirectory
outputs.description: Scenario manifest directory specification/scenarios.

outputs.name: budgetsLedger
outputs.description: Budget ledger path specification/budgets/ledger.ndjson.

outputs.name: workloadsDirectory
outputs.description: Benchmark workload directory specification/workloads.

outputs.name: unitsConfigSchema
outputs.description: Strict version 1 schema for workspaces, test/global/ignored patterns and declared source-reference mappings.

outputs.name: defaultGlobalFiles
outputs.description: Known root/workspace configuration filenames whose changes can affect every unit and test.

outputs.name: defaultUnitsConfig
outputs.description: Default root workspace, test/ and tests/ patterns, no explicit globals or references, and ignored Markdown, feature/loop specs and .gitignore.

outputs.name: pathMatches
outputs.description: True for exact match, trailing-slash prefix or wildcard match; **/ can span zero or more directories and * remains within a segment.

declarations.title: Scaffold name validation
declarations.responsibility: Validates safe project/code/field names and derives valid route, kebab-case and export names.

inputs.name: validateProjectName.name
inputs.description: Project name to trim and validate as a safe single name.

inputs.name: validateCodeName.name
inputs.description: Code name to trim and validate as a safe single name.

inputs.name: validateFieldName.name
inputs.description: Field name to trim and validate as a safe single name.

inputs.name: validateRouteName.name
inputs.description: Safe code name to convert to kebab-case route text.

inputs.name: validateKebabName.name
inputs.description: Name expected to already use lowercase alphanumeric segments separated by hyphens.

inputs.name: validateKebabName.label
inputs.description: Human-readable field label used in a kebab-case failure message.

inputs.name: validateExportName.name
inputs.description: Safe code name to convert to camelCase and validate as a TypeScript identifier.

outputs.name: validateProjectName
outputs.description: Trimmed safe project name.

outputs.name: validateCodeName
outputs.description: Trimmed safe code name.

outputs.name: validateFieldName
outputs.description: Trimmed safe field name.

outputs.name: validateRouteName
outputs.description: Nonempty kebab-case route name.

outputs.name: validateKebabName
outputs.description: Trimmed lowercase kebab-case name.

outputs.name: validateExportName
outputs.description: CamelCase export name satisfying TypeScript identifier shape.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown for empty names, traversal/separators, unsafe characters, invalid kebab case or an invalid generated export identifier.

declarations.title: Verification note identity checks
declarations.responsibility: Detects contradictions between a stored verification record, its indexing note and the actual commit tree.

inputs.name: verificationNoteIdentity.record
inputs.description: Verification record whose identity fields are authoritative for comparison.

inputs.name: verificationNoteIdentity.note
inputs.description: Verification history-note entry to compare with the record.

inputs.name: verificationNoteIdentity.tree
inputs.description: Actual commit tree hash, or null/undefined when unavailable.

outputs.name: verificationNoteIdentity
outputs.description: All mismatch messages in fixed order for record id, source commit/tree, outcome, note tree/base, profile and finish time; empty when they agree.

declarations.title: Verification evidence schemas
declarations.responsibility: Defines validated captures, measurements, component identities, budget findings and complete verification records.

outputs.name: captureSchema
outputs.description: Strict capture schema with evidence/state/kind, pass/fail status, path/hash/bytes/type/time and optional viewport, provenance, transcript, duration and served build.

outputs.name: scenarioResultSchema
outputs.description: Strict scenario result schema with tested revision, pass/fail/referenced status, optional origin record and state captures.

outputs.name: profileSchema
outputs.description: Strict machine-profile schema requiring identity, platform, architecture, CPU, positive core/memory counts and runtime.

outputs.name: budgetFindingSchema
outputs.description: Strict budget finding schema with unit/metric, supported verdict, nullable baseline/measured values and optional target/detail/differences.

outputs.name: componentVersionSchema
outputs.description: Strict observed-component schema with change kind, target, manifest/source/contract/runtime digests and owned file hashes.

outputs.name: measurementSchema
outputs.description: Strict measurement schema with numeric or null value, method, unit, revision, nullable workload/profile, artifacts and optional unavailability, partiality, sampling and comparison context.

outputs.name: verificationRecordSchema
outputs.description: Strict version 1 complete record schema joining source/base, profile/tools, times/outcome, components, measurements, impact, tests, scenarios/builds, budgets, reasons, gates and failures. Each test may also include browser diagnostics with observed console errors or uncaught exceptions and declared expectations; omission remains valid for older records.

declarations.title: Verification check planning
declarations.responsibility: Builds the commands and timeouts for selected test files and affected scenario checks.

inputs.name: verifyPlan.input
inputs.description: Selected paths, scenario manifests, verification and workspace configuration, and optional test-timeout override.

outputs.name: verifyPlan
outputs.description: Planned checks with ids, runners, targets, workspace cwd, commands and timeouts. Scenario-covered paths are omitted from file checks; per-file/scenario overrides beat defaults, .spec files select Playwright and other files select Vitest. No commands run here.

declarations.title: Verification configuration schemas
declarations.responsibility: Defines verification setup, runner defaults, capture-index records and benchmark workload formats.

outputs.name: verifyConfigFile
outputs.description: Verification configuration filename harness.verify.json.

outputs.name: verificationsDirectory
outputs.description: Scratch record directory .cache/harness/verifications.

outputs.name: snapshotsDirectory
outputs.description: Scratch snapshot directory .cache/harness/snapshots.

outputs.name: captureIndex
outputs.description: Capture index filename captures.ndjson.

outputs.name: verifyConfigSchema
outputs.description: Strict version 1 configuration schema for writing policy, setup, shared links, declared outputs/builds/tools, runner templates, per-file commands and positive timeout.

outputs.name: defaultVerifyConfig
outputs.description: Empty setup/link/output/build/tool/check lists, Bun Vitest/Playwright runner templates and a 600000 ms test timeout.

outputs.name: captureLineSchema
outputs.description: Strict capture-index line schema requiring evidence, kind, state, plain filename and media type, plus optional viewport/provenance/audio/server details.

outputs.name: reportedMeasurementSchema
outputs.description: Benchmark measurement schema before run attribution, including metric/value/method/workload and optional target, samples and comparison context.

outputs.name: benchmarkCaptureSchema
outputs.description: Benchmark payload schema requiring a measurements array; extra object fields are not retained by normal Zod parsing.

outputs.name: workloadSchema
outputs.description: Strict version 1 workload schema with id, operation/input request, 1–50 rounds and 1–100000 iterations.

declarations.title: Versioned writing limits
declarations.responsibility: Counts note and commit text consistently and reports length violations under the revision’s declared writing policy.

inputs.name: writingPolicy.version
inputs.description: Supported writing-policy version, 1 or 2.

inputs.name: writingHeld.config
inputs.description: Verification-config JSON text, or undefined when absent.

inputs.name: writingDeclared.config
inputs.description: Verification-config JSON text to check for an applicable numeric writing version.

inputs.name: writingCount.text
inputs.description: Text to trim, normalize line endings and count.

inputs.name: writingProblems.field
inputs.description: Field label to include in any violation message.

inputs.name: writingProblems.text
inputs.description: Text to measure against the supplied bounds.

inputs.name: writingProblems.limit
inputs.description: Character limit and optional word limit; null word limit means no word-count cap.

inputs.name: explanationProblems.reason
inputs.description: Unit/symbol reason with behavior and simplification/performance attempt text.

inputs.name: explanationProblems.version
inputs.description: Policy version of the revision the reason explains.

outputs.name: writingVersions
outputs.description: Supported writing versions 1 and 2.

outputs.name: writingVersion
outputs.description: Current writing version, 2.

outputs.name: writingLimits
outputs.description: Shared bounds: behavior 30 words/200 characters; legacy attempt 20/140; subject 72 characters; body 60/400.

outputs.name: writingPolicy
outputs.description: Bounds for the requested version, reducing attempt words to 15 under version 2.

outputs.name: writingHeld
outputs.description: Highest supported version not above the numeric declaration, or null for absent/invalid/below-one declarations; future versions use the newest supported policy.

outputs.name: writingDeclared
outputs.description: True when writingHeld finds an applicable policy.

outputs.name: writingCount
outputs.description: Whitespace-delimited words and Unicode-code-point characters after trimming and CR/LF normalization.

outputs.name: writingProblems
outputs.description: Empty-field or exceeded word/character messages, or an empty list when within bounds.

outputs.name: explanationProblems
outputs.description: Behavior and attempt violations prefixed with unit and symbol, using whole-unit naming for *.

declarations.title: Account menu
declarations.responsibility: Shows the signed-in person and links for leaving the workspace, managing project members and signing out.

inputs.name: AccountMenu.projectId
inputs.description: Optional project identifier. When a person is signed in and this value is nonempty, adds a Members link for that project; otherwise omits that link.

outputs.name: AccountMenu
outputs.description: When a person is signed in, shows their name with their email as a tooltip, a Projects link, an optional Members link and a Sign out button. Projects and Members use full document navigation. Sign out calls the session operation and is disabled while the session is busy. Renders nothing when there is no signed-in person.

declarations.title: Email proof panel
declarations.responsibility: Collects the emailed verification code needed to finish sign-in.

inputs.name: EmailProofPanel.proof
inputs.description: Required email-proof status with target email, sent flag and optional expiry. Input is disabled until sent; the sent flag also chooses Send or Resend wording.

outputs.name: EmailProofPanel
outputs.description: Email confirmation form with send/resend, numeric code entry, Verify and Cancel. Verify requires exactly the configured number of digits and a nonbusy session, and clears code on reported success. Cancel clears code then signs out. Session errors are shown; successful verification does not itself assume a signed-in actor.

declarations.title: Web workspace
declarations.responsibility: Hosts the shared desktop-style workspace in the browser without local-folder access.

outputs.name: HostedWorkspace
outputs.description: On mount connects the browser bridge in nonlocal mode, loads projects and opens matching workspace paths. Follows browser back/forward events and removes its listener and bridge on cleanup. Shows the workspace and project account menu when a snapshot exists, otherwise loading or project-open error content. Document title includes the loaded project name.

declarations.title: Hub frame
declarations.responsibility: Provides the shared-project page frame around supplied content.

inputs.name: HubFrame.children
inputs.description: Required page-content snippet rendered in the main area.

outputs.name: HubFrame
outputs.description: Harness header linking to the project home through full document navigation, Shared projects label, account controls and supplied main content.

declarations.title: Invitation form
declarations.responsibility: Creates a project invitation and presents its link and one-time code for the owner to share.

inputs.name: InvitationForm.projectId
inputs.description: Required project identifier sent to the invitation operation. Authorization and invitation validity remain server responsibilities.

outputs.name: InvitationForm
outputs.description: Email and role form, initially Commenter, also offering Viewer. Trims email and blocks empty or concurrent submissions. On success shows the invitation link, code and expiry with separate-copy actions and a reminder that no email is sent here. Errors clear the invitation and appear as alerts. Clipboard failure gives manual-copy guidance; success shows a copied status.

declarations.title: Invite accept
declarations.responsibility: Accepts a project invitation using the signed-in account and the separately supplied code.

inputs.name: InviteAccept.projectId
inputs.description: Required project identifier sent with acceptance and used for the destination workspace.

inputs.name: InviteAccept.invitationId
inputs.description: Required invitation identifier submitted alongside the trimmed code.

outputs.name: InviteAccept
outputs.description: Invitation-code form showing the session email. Blocks empty or concurrent submissions, calls acceptance, then performs document navigation to the project Pages catalog. Failure displays an alert and allows retry. The code is passed as an operation argument, not inserted into the destination URL.

declarations.title: Login panel
declarations.responsibility: Shows sign-in availability, a Google sign-in button or the pending email-confirmation step.

inputs.name: LoginPanel.reason
inputs.description: Optional introductory text, defaulting to guidance to sign in with Google to open invited projects. Used only in the ordinary sign-in view.

outputs.name: LoginPanel
outputs.description: Shows checking/error state before session status, configuration guidance when disabled, or email confirmation when pending. Otherwise renders a Google button only when a configured client ID, no actor, no pending proof and a holder are available. Obtains a fresh challenge and ignores stale challenge completion; challenge/button failures and session errors become alerts.

declarations.title: Members panel
declarations.responsibility: Lists project members and exposes invitations to owners.

inputs.name: MembersPanel.projectId
inputs.description: Required project identifier used for project and member reads on mount and passed to the owner invitation form. Prop changes do not independently trigger another load.

outputs.name: MembersPanel
outputs.description: Members heading and table of names, emails and roles once the project is loaded. Empty lists are explicitly labeled. Owners see an invitation form; others see an owner-only explanation. Read failures are alerts.

declarations.title: Native approval
declarations.responsibility: Lets a signed-in person review a desktop connection request and submit its displayed code.

inputs.name: NativeApproval.handoffId
inputs.description: Required identifier used to read the native request and approve it. Loading occurs on mount; prop changes alone do not reload.

outputs.name: NativeApproval
outputs.description: When framed, offers only guidance to open a standalone tab. Otherwise shows reading, expired, already-approved or pending request content. Pending form describes scope and account, then submits a trimmed uppercase code while blocking empty/concurrent requests. Success clears code and shows return-to-desktop guidance; errors are alerts. A failed initial request read falls back to pending after obtaining a fallback scope.

declarations.title: Project create

inputs.description: Required callback receiving the new project identifier after creation resolves. A synchronous callback exception is caught by the same failure handler as creation.

outputs.name: ProjectCreate
outputs.description: Loads GitHub configuration/connection and repositories on mount. Shows setup or connection guidance until usable, then repository and project-name fields. Name is trimmed and limited to 80 characters by the input; repository selection becomes a numeric ID. Blocks missing fields or concurrent saves, reports truncated lists and errors, and invokes created after success. Server remains responsible for checking repository administration.

declarations.title: Project list
declarations.responsibility: Lists shared projects with repository, membership role and navigation actions.

inputs.name: ProjectList.projects
inputs.description: Required project summaries in display order, including identity, name, source repository and role.

outputs.name: ProjectList
outputs.description: Project cards with owner/repository and role, full-document Open links to Pages, and Members links only for owners. An empty list explains creating a shared project or receiving an invitation.

declarations.responsibility: Validate supplied authentication settings and disable unavailable integrations without fallback credentials.

inputs.description: Environment settings for Google sign-in, session secret, public origin, deployment environment and optional GitHub App.

outputs.name: authConfig
outputs.description: Configuration when client ID is valid, secret has at least 32 characters and environment is local, staging or production; otherwise null. Origin must be HTTPS, or loopback HTTP in local mode, without credentials, path, query or fragment. GitHub and collaboration settings are independently nullable.

declarations.title: Authentication cookie headers
declarations.responsibility: Read opaque authentication cookies and construct secure cookie headers.

inputs.description: Cookie value to place in the header.

outputs.name: clearCookie

outputs.name: authDisabled

inputs.name: authFail.code
inputs.description: Declared authentication failure code to throw.

outputs.name: authFail
outputs.description: Never returns; throws AuthFailure for the supplied code.

errors.name: AuthFailure
errors.description: Error named AuthFailure with code, mapped status and a generic Hub auth message rather than provider details.

declarations.title: Authentication HTTP helpers
declarations.responsibility: Build uncached auth responses and validate bounded JSON requests and authentication headers.

inputs.name: authHttp.body
inputs.description: JSON-serializable response body.

inputs.name: authHttp.options
inputs.description: Optional HTTP status, default 200, and separate Set-Cookie values.

inputs.name: authRedirect.location
inputs.description: Redirect destination supplied by the caller.

inputs.name: authRedirect.cookies
inputs.description: Cookie headers to append; defaults to none.

inputs.name: authFailure.error
inputs.description: Unknown failure to turn into a public auth response.

inputs.name: sameOrigin.request
inputs.description: Request whose Origin header is checked.

inputs.name: sameOrigin.origin
inputs.description: Expected exact Origin header value.

inputs.name: hasAuthorization.request
inputs.description: Request to inspect for an Authorization header.

inputs.name: bearerToken.request
inputs.description: Request to inspect for an opaque Bearer token.

inputs.name: boundedText.body
inputs.description: Byte stream to read, or null for an empty body.

inputs.name: boundedText.limit
inputs.description: Maximum accumulated body size in bytes.

inputs.name: readJson.request
inputs.description: Request requiring application/json and an object body of at most 16384 bytes.

inputs.name: authPath.request
inputs.description: Request whose URL path is checked.

outputs.name: authHttp
outputs.description: JSON response with no-store and no-sniff headers and optional cookies.

outputs.name: authRedirect
outputs.description: 303 redirect with no-store, no-sniff and no-referrer headers and optional cookies.

outputs.name: authFailure
outputs.description: AuthFailure code/status response, or opaque auth-unavailable with status 500 for other failures.

outputs.name: sameOrigin
outputs.description: True when the Origin header exactly equals the supplied origin.

outputs.name: hasAuthorization
outputs.description: True when the Authorization header exists, even if invalid or empty.

outputs.name: bearerToken
outputs.description: Token from exact Bearer syntax with 32 to 128 allowed characters, otherwise null.

outputs.name: boundedText
outputs.description: Strict UTF-8 text; null for oversized, invalid UTF-8 or failed streams. Oversized reads cancel the stream.

outputs.name: readJson
outputs.description: Parsed non-array JSON object; rejects invalid content type, body size, encoding or JSON with invalid-request.

outputs.name: authPath
outputs.description: Path within /api/auth/ or /api/github/, otherwise null.

declarations.title: Authentication secret operations
declarations.responsibility: Derive separate lookup and encryption keys and generate opaque or human-entered codes.

inputs.name: authSecrets.secret
inputs.description: Session secret used to derive keys; this helper does not enforce its configuration length.

inputs.name: randomToken.bytes
inputs.description: Number of random bytes; defaults to 32.

inputs.name: sha256Url.value
inputs.description: Text to hash as UTF-8.

inputs.name: safeEqual.left
inputs.description: First string to compare.

inputs.name: safeEqual.right
inputs.description: Second string to compare.

inputs.name: normalizeCode.value
inputs.description: Code to uppercase and strip to ASCII letters and digits.

outputs.name: authSecrets
outputs.description: Helpers for purpose-bound HMAC lookup hashes and context-bound AES-GCM encryption. open returns null for a malformed value or failed decryption. Keys are derived lazily and retained by the returned helpers.

outputs.name: randomToken
outputs.description: Random bytes encoded as unpadded base64url.

outputs.name: sha256Url
outputs.description: SHA-256 digest encoded as base64url.

outputs.name: safeEqual
outputs.description: True for equal strings; unequal lengths return immediately, while equal lengths compare every character.

outputs.name: userCode
outputs.description: Eight random characters from the configured unambiguous alphabet, displayed as two groups of four.

outputs.name: normalizeCode
outputs.description: Uppercase ASCII letters and digits with other characters removed.

outputs.name: emailCode
outputs.description: Eight random decimal digits, including leading zeros.

declarations.title: Same-site browser API

outputs.name: browserApi

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects non-API paths, coded HTTP failures, network/timeouts, invalid response JSON and media read failures. HTTP failures include status/code and readable wording.

errors.name: Error

outputs.name: d1CredentialStores
outputs.description: Session store: create inserts a record, find returns a validated row or null, and revoke marks the named session and its direct child sessions revoked when not already revoked.

inputs.description: Validator used to turn stored database rows into typed records.

outputs.name: d1EmailStores

inputs.description: Validator used to turn stored database rows into typed records.

outputs.name: d1GrantStore
outputs.description: Store for reading grant state, connecting at an expected generation, leasing refresh, rotating held tokens and revoking grants. Conditional mutations return whether a row matched. Missing records read as generation zero with no grant or lease.

inputs.description: Validator used to turn stored database rows into typed records.

outputs.name: d1OneTimeStores
outputs.description: Stores that create and atomically consume unexpired challenges/GitHub states, plus native exchanges that can be found, approved with the matching code while pending, and consumed once while approved and unexpired.
