errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws Invalid relay address when the origin or host ID is invalid.

declarations.title: Encode and compare protocol bytes
declarations.responsibility: Provide UTF-8, base64, hashing, random-byte and deterministic JSON helpers for the remote protocol.

inputs.name: cryptoSource.bytes
inputs.description: Byte array to expose to WebCrypto without copying.

inputs.name: remoteBytes.text
inputs.description: Text to encode as UTF-8.

inputs.name: bytesText.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to decode as strict UTF-8.

inputs.name: toBase64.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to encode as padded standard base64.

inputs.name: fromBase64.text
inputs.description: Strict standard base64 with valid padding and no whitespace.

inputs.name: toBase64Url.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to encode as unpadded URL-safe base64.

inputs.name: fromBase64Url.text
inputs.description: Unpadded URL-safe base64 text; a length congruent to one modulo four is rejected.

inputs.name: toHex.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to encode as lowercase hexadecimal.

inputs.name: concatBytes.parts
inputs.description: Byte arrays to concatenate in argument order.

inputs.name: sha256.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes whose SHA-256 digest is requested.

inputs.name: randomBytes.length
inputs.description: Requested byte-array length, subject to typed-array and WebCrypto limits.

inputs.name: safeEqual.left
inputs.description: First string to compare.

inputs.name: safeEqual.right
inputs.description: Second string to compare.

inputs.name: stableJson.value
inputs.description: JSON-like value to serialize with recursively sorted object keys.

outputs.name: cryptoSource
outputs.description: The same byte array with a WebCrypto-compatible type.

outputs.name: remoteBytes
outputs.description: New UTF-8 byte array.

outputs.name: bytesText
outputs.description: Decoded text; malformed UTF-8 rejects.

outputs.name: toBase64
outputs.description: Padded standard base64 text.

outputs.name: fromBase64
outputs.description: Decoded byte array.

outputs.name: toBase64Url
outputs.description: URL-safe base64 without padding.

outputs.name: fromBase64Url
outputs.description: Decoded byte array.

outputs.name: toHex
outputs.description: Two lowercase hexadecimal characters per byte.

outputs.name: concatBytes
outputs.description: New array containing all supplied parts in order.

outputs.name: sha256
outputs.description: 32-byte SHA-256 digest.

outputs.name: randomBytes
outputs.description: New byte array filled with cryptographic random values.

outputs.name: safeEqual
outputs.description: True only for equal strings; unequal lengths return early, while equal lengths compare every character.

outputs.name: stableJson
outputs.description: JSON text with sorted object keys and undefined object properties omitted; unsupported primitive values become null.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects malformed encodings or UTF-8; invalid random lengths, unsupported JSON values such as BigInt, circular structures and WebCrypto failures may also throw.

declarations.title: Create remote protocol identities
declarations.responsibility: Define protocol encodings and derive identifiers, challenges and request or credential hashes.

inputs.name: remoteIdentity.publicKey
inputs.description: 65-byte uncompressed P-256 public point as bytes or unpadded base64url.

inputs.name: credentialHash.binding
inputs.description: Host or device role, host ID, optional device ID and credential text to bind together.

inputs.name: pkceChallenge.verifier
inputs.description: PKCE verifier text to hash with the S256 transform.

inputs.name: randomId.bytes
inputs.description: Number of random bytes to encode; defaults to 16.

inputs.name: normalizeCode.value
inputs.description: Human-entered code to uppercase and strip of nonalphanumeric characters.

inputs.name: requestDigest.request
inputs.description: Wire request whose method and deterministically serialized input identify its operation.

outputs.name: remotePatterns
outputs.description: Regular expressions describing protocol IDs, public keys, credentials, codes and other encoded wire values.

outputs.name: remoteIdentity
outputs.description: First 40 lowercase hex characters of the public-key SHA-256 digest.

outputs.name: credentialHash
outputs.description: SHA-256 hex digest bound to role, host, device and credential using a protocol-specific prefix.

outputs.name: pkceChallenge
outputs.description: Unpadded base64url SHA-256 digest of the UTF-8 verifier.

outputs.name: randomId
outputs.description: Random lowercase hexadecimal identifier with two characters per requested byte.

outputs.name: randomCredential
outputs.description: 43-character base64url credential generated from 32 random bytes.

outputs.name: pairingCode
outputs.description: Random pairing code displayed as two groups of four characters separated by a hyphen.

outputs.name: normalizeCode
outputs.description: Uppercase alphanumeric code with punctuation and other characters removed.

outputs.name: requestDigest
outputs.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the method and stable input JSON; excludes the request ID.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects malformed public-key encodings or a point without the required 65-byte uncompressed shape; byte, hash and serialization failures may propagate.

declarations.title: Generate and derive remote keys
declarations.responsibility: Create P-256 key pairs, validate imported pairs and derive shared secrets and AES keys.

inputs.name: sharedSecret.privateKey
inputs.description: Local P-256 private key authorized for key agreement.

inputs.name: sharedSecret.publicKey
inputs.description: Peer 65-byte uncompressed P-256 public point.

inputs.name: importRemoteKeys.stored
inputs.description: Base64url private scalar and public point to import and cross-check.

inputs.name: exportRemoteKeys.pair
inputs.description: Key pair with an exportable private key and its public bytes.

inputs.name: deriveBytes.ikm
inputs.description: Input key material for HKDF-SHA256.

inputs.name: deriveBytes.salt
inputs.description: HKDF salt bytes.

inputs.name: deriveBytes.info
inputs.description: HKDF context bytes or text encoded as UTF-8.

inputs.name: deriveBytes.length
inputs.description: Requested output length in bytes.

inputs.name: aesKey.bytes
inputs.description: Raw AES key bytes to import.

outputs.name: remoteKeys
outputs.description: Fresh P-256 public bytes and extractable private CryptoKey.

outputs.name: sharedSecret
outputs.description: 32-byte ECDH shared secret.

outputs.name: importRemoteKeys
outputs.description: Imported key pair after a fresh probe confirms the public and private halves agree.

outputs.name: exportRemoteKeys
outputs.description: Private scalar and public point encoded as base64url; this helper does not persist them.

outputs.name: deriveBytes
outputs.description: HKDF-SHA256 output of the requested byte length.

outputs.name: aesKey
outputs.description: Nonextractable AES-GCM key with encrypt and decrypt usages.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects malformed or mismatched key pairs, unexportable private keys and unsupported cryptographic inputs or lengths.

declarations.title: Authenticate encrypted packets
declarations.responsibility: Seal packet bytes with AES-GCM and bind them to direction, counter and continuation flag.

inputs.name: sealPacket.context
inputs.description: AES-GCM key, d2h or h2d direction, packet counter and continuation flag.

inputs.name: sealPacket.plaintext
inputs.description: Plain packet bytes to encrypt.

inputs.name: openPacket.context
inputs.description: Matching key, direction, counter and continuation flag expected for this packet.

inputs.name: openPacket.data
inputs.description: Unpadded base64url ciphertext followed by its authentication tag.

outputs.name: sealPacket
outputs.description: Base64url ciphertext and 16-byte tag using a nonce derived from the counter.

outputs.name: openPacket
outputs.description: Authenticated plaintext bytes.

errors.name: SecureFailure
errors.description: Any decoding, parameter or authentication failure while opening becomes SecureFailure with reason tag.

declarations.title: Derive directional session keys
declarations.responsibility: Bind triple P-256 key agreement to both peers and the current session context.

inputs.name: sessionKeys.input
inputs.description: Host or device role, both identities, generation, local static and ephemeral pairs, peer public keys and both session nonces.

outputs.name: sessionKeys
outputs.description: Nonextractable AES-256-GCM send and receive keys; opposite roles derive matching keys for each direction.

declarations.title: Dispatch authorized wire requests
declarations.responsibility: Apply connection policy and deadlines, then execute requests with mutation replay tracking.

inputs.name: wireDispatch.context
inputs.description: Attachment and allowed methods, pending-request count, limits, response ledger, handler and error translator, plus optional session epoch binding.

inputs.name: wireDispatch.request
inputs.description: Already validated request with ID, method and input.

outputs.name: wireDispatch
outputs.description: Response with the same ID, a value or null on success, or a declared failure. Mutations join ledger work by ID and input digest; timeouts do not cancel that work.

declarations.title: Activity agents
declarations.responsibility: Shows declared agent activity while making stale, unavailable and unreadable registrations explicit.

inputs.name: ActivityAgents.agents
inputs.description: Required roster or null. Null means live activity is not available in this recorded history, not zero working agents. Roster supplies counts, tracking state and declared agent details.

inputs.name: ActivityAgents.sampledAt
inputs.description: Optional sample timestamp, empty by default. Supplies displayed UTC read time and freshness calculation.

inputs.name: ActivityAgents.reading
inputs.type: { now: number; failed: boolean; refresh: () => void }
inputs.description: Optional current clock, refresh-failure flag and refresh callback. When absent the view uses the sample time for freshness and offers no refresh button.

outputs.name: ActivityAgents
outputs.description: Working-agents card with current or Unknown count, stale/failed-read notices and registration guidance when tracking was never used. Lists agents with state, model, checkout, branch and details. Working agents expose task/loop and four unit chips initially; nonworking declarations stay behind a disclosure. Unreadable registrations are reported as uncounted.

declarations.title: Activity files
declarations.responsibility: Separates currently uncommitted files from recent committed file changes.

inputs.name: ActivityFiles.files
inputs.description: Required committed changes with path, status, last-change commit/time and unit owners. Kept in supplied order.

inputs.name: ActivityFiles.worktrees
inputs.description: Required checkout snapshots or null. Null denotes unavailable live checkout state; an empty array or no changes displays no uncommitted changes. Includes truncation information.

inputs.name: ActivityFiles.href
inputs.description: Required callback forming a commit-page link for each committed file.

inputs.name: ActivityFiles.registry
inputs.description: Required wording identifying which revision’s registry supplied component ownership labels.

outputs.name: ActivityFiles
outputs.description: Uncommitted and committed lists with paths, status, ownership chips and commit links. Shows six entries initially in each list, with expansion controls. Counts changed files and checkouts, mentions truncation and distinguishes unavailable live state from empty lists. The data is displayed without querying Git.

declarations.title: Activity list
declarations.responsibility: Shows an initial portion of a supplied list with a control to reveal the rest.

inputs.name: ActivityList.items
inputs.description: Required list of generic items in display order. Every row is rendered; rows beyond the preview are hidden while collapsed.

inputs.name: ActivityList.label
inputs.description: Required accessible list name, also normalized into the list ID used by the expansion control.

inputs.name: ActivityList.noun
inputs.description: Required item name used in Show all/Show fewer button text.

inputs.name: ActivityList.preview
inputs.description: Required number of initial visible positions. Used directly without clamping or integer validation.

inputs.name: ActivityList.ordered
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. True renders an ordered list, false an unordered list.

inputs.name: ActivityList.row
inputs.description: Required snippet called with each item to render its row.

outputs.name: ActivityList
outputs.description: Accessible list with hidden overflow rows and a toggle only when item count exceeds preview. Starts collapsed. Row content is not lazily created on expansion.

declarations.title: Activity loops
declarations.responsibility: Summarizes the loop templates recorded for a project.

inputs.name: ActivityLoops.loops
inputs.description: Required loop summary with total tracked loops and per-template counts, completion/open counts, last-use times and names.

outputs.name: ActivityLoops
outputs.description: Loop-type list with totals, formatted last-use time and loop names. Empty types show that no loop is tracked. Does not create, resume or evaluate loops.

declarations.title: Activity work
declarations.responsibility: Shows recent committed work and its recorded component reasons.

inputs.name: ActivityWork.work
inputs.description: Required ordered commit summaries with branches, time, file/unit/reason counts and sampled unit/reason details. Full unit count falls back to listed length for its displayed count.

inputs.name: ActivityWork.href
inputs.description: Required callback producing each commit-page address.

inputs.name: ActivityWork.recorded
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. True labels reasons as recorded on the commit or accepted by its records; false says recorded on the commit.

outputs.name: ActivityWork
outputs.description: Recent-work list with five commits initially, expansion control and per-commit details. Shows branches or on no branch, counts, reasons and notices when additional details live on the commit page. No reasons and no commits are stated explicitly.

declarations.title: Analytics cpu
declarations.responsibility: Shows sampled local CPU usage while distinguishing machine totals from repository-agent activity.

outputs.name: AnalyticsCpu
outputs.description: Starts a CPU client on mount and stops it on cleanup. Displays pending, available sample or unavailable/retry states; failed samples replace old readings. Shows machine, process-group and tracked-combined percentages, sample metadata and repository-agent process rows. Null percentages stay Not measured. Manual refresh delegates to the client. Explains that history filters do not apply, shared app-server CPU is not attributable per chat, cloud inference is excluded and samples are not automatically published.

declarations.title: Analytics filters
declarations.responsibility: Provides history filters through a normal GET form.

inputs.name: AnalyticsFilters.filters
inputs.description: Required initial loop, task, model and optional since/until values. Missing values become empty; dates use their first ten characters. These initialize input defaults rather than live bindings.

outputs.name: AnalyticsFilters
outputs.description: Loop/task/model text fields and UTC-day date inputs submitting to the analytics page, plus a reset link. Explains that live CPU is unaffected. Filtering and invalid-date handling occur outside this component.

declarations.title: Analytics history
declarations.responsibility: Displays recorded loop history and frequency summaries.

inputs.name: AnalyticsHistory.summary
inputs.description: Required aggregate counts for templates, commands, evaluator outcomes and daily activity. Frequency bars scale to the largest count; percentages show each count’s share of its category total. Daily rows appear newest first.

inputs.name: AnalyticsHistory.loops
inputs.description: Required loop history rows supplying names, templates, models, status, timestamps, duration and evaluation count. Empty shows no loops recorded; absent optional timestamps or durations display a dash.

outputs.name: AnalyticsHistory
outputs.description: Loop table with UTC labels and missing values shown as a dash, plus frequency bars for four summary groups. Bars scale to the largest count while percentages represent share of the group total. Daily keys sort newest first; other groups sort by descending count. Empty histories and groups have explicit messages.

declarations.title: Analytics models
declarations.responsibility: Separates model authorship from evaluation and presents recorded usage and first-try results.

inputs.name: AnalyticsModels.models
inputs.description: Required analytics model summary with check/loop author counts, evaluator counts/tokens and per-author first-try figures for response and clean-code checks. Names, including unknown, are preserved.

outputs.name: AnalyticsModels
outputs.description: Role-separated usage cards, token totals and author first-try table. Usage bars scale to the largest count. A zero assessed denominator displays an unavailable rate regardless of its stored rate, with excluded/check counts kept visible. Empty categories are stated explicitly. Does not recompute which checks count as assessments.

declarations.title: Analytics tasks
declarations.responsibility: Displays response and clean-code assessment history by task.

inputs.name: AnalyticsTasks.jev
inputs.description: Required Jev summary containing response and clean-code task arrays. Each row supplies task, loop/step, author model, assessed attempts, first-pass flag, attempts-to-pass and optional report identifier.

outputs.name: AnalyticsTasks
outputs.description: Two task tables with missing text as a dash and links for supplied report IDs. First pass shows Yes when flagged, otherwise No for assessed attempts or Not assessed for none. Null attempts-to-pass is Not yet passed. Describes excluded cached/dry/incomplete runs; relies on supplied assessed counts.

declarations.title: Audio comparison
declarations.responsibility: Summarizes two related recordings as one gallery card while keeping their statuses separate.

inputs.name: AudioComparison.before
inputs.description: Required original recording whose identity preserves its gallery anchor. Missing flag or empty file marks its side unavailable.

inputs.name: AudioComparison.after
inputs.description: Required updated recording supplying the card title, category and main anchor. Missing flag or empty file marks its side unavailable.

inputs.name: AudioComparison.onopen
inputs.description: Required callback for opening the comparison viewer. Its button is disabled until mount completes.

outputs.name: AudioComparison
outputs.description: Paired-audio card with independent before/after badges and positive finite duration labels. Unavailable sides show not-proven. Does not create a combined passing result or play audio itself.

declarations.title: Audio comparison viewer
declarations.responsibility: Opens paired recordings in a modal for listening to either side or both.

inputs.name: AudioComparisonViewer.before
inputs.description: Required before recording, used in before and comparison views.

inputs.name: AudioComparisonViewer.after
inputs.description: Required after recording, used in after/comparison views and as the comparison title.

inputs.name: AudioComparisonViewer.assetBase
inputs.description: Required URL prefix passed to each audio card for its file.

inputs.name: AudioComparisonViewer.onclose
inputs.description: Required callback called after the attached dialog is closed natively, allowing focus to return to its opener.

outputs.name: AudioComparisonViewer
outputs.description: Open audio modal initially in compare mode with Before/After/Compare controls. Mount pauses all document audio. Keyed audio cards are destroyed when leaving view, so their cleanup pauses playback. Each retains its own transcript, availability and status.

declarations.title: Audio evidence
declarations.responsibility: Presents a recording with playback, transcript, provenance and download controls.

inputs.name: AudioEvidence.item
inputs.description: Required audio evidence including file, title, status and optional duration, transcript, source, note and provenance. Missing flag, empty file or playback error yields unavailable/not-proven display. Valid recorded duration takes precedence over loaded metadata.

inputs.name: AudioEvidence.assetBase
inputs.description: Required prefix concatenated directly with the recorded file to form playback/download URL.

inputs.name: AudioEvidence.idPrefix
inputs.description: Optional HTML ID prefix, default evidence-. Additional copies can supply a distinct prefix to avoid duplicate card IDs.

outputs.name: AudioEvidence
outputs.description: Audio card with user-initiated controls and no preload. Playing pauses other document audio; destruction pauses its player. Missing audio exposes notes. Transcript disclosure starts open when text exists. Shows provenance/time and a sanitized download filename with phase and recognized extension. Playback metadata fills missing duration but does not change recorded status.

declarations.title: Audio upload files
declarations.responsibility: Provides the file inputs for a single recording or a before/after pair.

inputs.name: AudioUploadFiles.mode
inputs.description: Required mode string. Exactly comparison renders before and after fields; every other value renders one audio field.

inputs.name: AudioUploadFiles.uploading
inputs.description: Required flag disabling file inputs during an upload.

outputs.name: AudioUploadFiles
outputs.description: Required file pickers accepting WAV, MP3, M4A and OGG extensions/MIME hints, with selected filenames or hints. Performs no upload or byte validation. Parent is expected to remount on reset or mode change to clear file/name state.

declarations.title: Brand mark
declarations.responsibility: Draws the modular Harness H using the surrounding text color.

inputs.name: BrandMark.size
inputs.description: Optional SVG width and height as number or string, default 1em.

inputs.name: BrandMark.label
inputs.description: Optional accessible name, empty by default. Nonempty makes the SVG a named image; otherwise it is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

outputs.name: BrandMark
outputs.description: Nonfocusable tiled H SVG using shared tile geometry and currentColor. Supplies no navigation behavior.

declarations.title: Recorded browser errors
declarations.responsibility: Display recorded console errors and uncaught exceptions alongside their expectations and test-attempt context.

inputs.name: BrowserErrors.diagnostics
inputs.description: Optional recorded test-attempt diagnostics. Missing or empty arrays render nothing; each supplied attempt may contain observations, expectations or both.

outputs.name: BrowserErrors
outputs.description: Expandable Browser errors group with the total classified row count, test/file/project or browser identity and retry number. Rows show expected, unexpected or missing-expected status, message, expectation reason and available source/page/stack as escaped text. Source line and column display one-based coordinates. A supplied attempt with no rows still appears under a zero-entry summary.

declarations.title: Contract example
declarations.responsibility: Shows one contract field as a readable type, description and honestly labelled examples.

inputs.name: ContractExample.field
inputs.description: The selected field, including its public type, explanation, example values and their declared, illustrative or missing status.

outputs.name: ContractExample
outputs.description: Readable examples with safe markup text and structured values. Missing examples stay explicit; this is documentation, not a test result.

declarations.title: Coverage list
declarations.responsibility: Shows a report’s acceptance criteria and coverage checks.

inputs.name: CoverageList.report
inputs.description: Required report containing acceptance strings and coverage items with title, status and optional viewport/detail.

inputs.name: CoverageList.section
inputs.description: Optional all, acceptance or coverage, default all, selecting which portions render.

inputs.name: CoverageList.embedded
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. True removes panel styling and section headings and adds the localized section name as an accessible label.

outputs.name: CoverageList
outputs.description: Acceptance list and/or coverage check rows with status badges. Coverage is omitted when empty; there is no extra empty-state message. Does not assess criteria itself.

declarations.title: Entity cases
declarations.responsibility: Shows recorded case inputs beside observed outputs or errors.

inputs.name: EntityCases.document
inputs.description: Required parsed recorded result passed to the case extractor. Caller is responsible for reading and checking its bytes before supplying it.

inputs.name: EntityCases.unit
inputs.description: Optional unit identifier limiting direct invocation rows to that function.

inputs.name: EntityCases.callable
inputs.description: Optional flag, true by default. Controls wording distinguishing observed end-to-end behavior from a direct function call; false is suitable for noncallable entities.

outputs.name: EntityCases
outputs.description: Gap explanation when cases cannot be extracted, otherwise a Case/Input/Observed output table using recorded values. Failed cases show the recorded error. Full recorded JSON is serialized only when its disclosure opens; does not invent missing outputs.

declarations.title: Typed contract
declarations.responsibility: Lists typed inputs, outputs and errors with compact example previews and full details in a shared modal.

inputs.name: EntityContract.unit
inputs.description: The entity at the selected revision, including the fields and examples its contract records.

inputs.name: EntityContract.category
inputs.description: The kind of entity; config outputs are labelled Provides.

inputs.name: EntityContract.contract
inputs.description: Prepared contract facts such as purpose, route, required states and execution targets.

inputs.name: EntityContract.last
inputs.description: Optional parent commit when the selected revision removed this entity.

outputs.name: EntityContract
outputs.description: Name, type and example tables with ellipsis for long previews. Trailing info controls open all examples and the field description in the shared modal.

declarations.title: Entity search
declarations.responsibility: Searches supplied revision entities and offers keyboard or link navigation.

inputs.name: EntitySearch.entries
inputs.description: Required list of entities, or null while the host loads them. Null yields no matches and loading wording; the component does not fetch entries.

inputs.name: EntitySearch.scope
inputs.description: Required label and optional pinned commit. Label names searched scope; pinned takes precedence in placeholder wording over loading.

inputs.name: EntitySearch.href
inputs.description: Required callback providing complete result link targets.

inputs.name: EntitySearch.open
inputs.description: Required callback for chosen results within the host. Choosing clears the query and closes the popup before calling it.

outputs.name: EntitySearch
outputs.description: Combobox with up to 12 helper-ranked results for a nonblank query while expanded. Input resets active index; arrows wrap, Enter opens active result, Escape first closes then clears and stops propagation. Losing external focus closes results. Popup shifts left to fit the viewport and adjusts on resize.

declarations.title: Entity search results
declarations.responsibility: Renders an accessible search-result popup and delegates plain-click navigation to its host.

inputs.name: EntitySearchResults.id
inputs.description: Required list ID and prefix for indexed option IDs.

inputs.name: EntitySearchResults.found
inputs.description: Required results in supplied order, with category, name, purpose and identity.

inputs.name: EntitySearchResults.active
inputs.description: Required zero-based active position for aria-selected; an out-of-range value selects none.

inputs.name: EntitySearchResults.loading
inputs.description: Required flag showing Loading entities regardless of current result count.

inputs.name: EntitySearchResults.query
inputs.description: Required query text used in the empty-result message.

inputs.name: EntitySearchResults.scope
inputs.description: Required human-readable revision/search scope displayed above results.

inputs.name: EntitySearchResults.shift
inputs.description: Required pixel amount moving the popup left; used directly as a negative left offset.

inputs.name: EntitySearchResults.href
inputs.description: Required callback supplying each result’s actual link target.

inputs.name: EntitySearchResults.choose
inputs.description: Required callback for ordinary primary-button clicks. Modified or other-button clicks retain native link behavior.

outputs.name: EntitySearchResults
outputs.description: Listbox of result links with category badges and optional purposes. Mouse down is prevented to preserve field focus. Plain click prevents navigation and calls choose. Shows loading or no-match status as applicable.

declarations.title: Evidence card
declarations.responsibility: Presents one screenshot or audio gallery entry with its recorded status and provenance.

inputs.name: EvidenceCard.item
inputs.description: Required evidence record. Media classification selects screenshot or audio display. For screenshots, missing flag or image-load error disables opening and changes displayed status to not-proven.

inputs.name: EvidenceCard.before
inputs.description: Optional original recording. For audio items, presence selects a paired comparison card; otherwise audio is rendered individually. Ignored for screenshots.

inputs.name: EvidenceCard.assetBase
inputs.description: Required prefix concatenated with screenshot files or passed to audio playback.

inputs.name: EvidenceCard.onopen
inputs.description: Required callback invoked by screenshot or paired-audio opening controls. Individual audio playback uses its own controls.

outputs.name: EvidenceCard
outputs.description: Screenshot card with lazy image, title anchor, category, status, provenance and optional viewport/time. Missing screenshots show a placeholder and note. Audio delegates to its single or paired card. The component does not verify evidence bytes.

declarations.title: Evidence grid
declarations.responsibility: Filters report media and coordinates screenshot and paired-audio viewers plus optional uploads.

inputs.name: EvidenceGrid.items
inputs.description: Required evidence list. Helpers pair related audio and choose gallery entries; screenshot-only lists feed image navigation.

inputs.name: EvidenceGrid.assetBase
inputs.description: Required asset prefix forwarded to cards and viewers.

inputs.name: EvidenceGrid.reportId
inputs.description: Optional report identifier. Upload controls appear only when both this value and onUploaded are supplied.

inputs.name: EvidenceGrid.onUploaded
inputs.description: Optional callback receiving an updated report from upload controls. Also gates their visibility alongside reportId.

inputs.name: EvidenceGrid.idPrefix
inputs.description: Optional prefix, empty by default, keeping the gallery heading ID unique on pages with multiple galleries. Does not prefix individual evidence-card IDs.

outputs.name: EvidenceGrid
outputs.description: Gallery with search/category/status and screenshot-size filters, plus media tabs when audio or upload support exists. Shows filtered counts and an empty-result message. Paired audio opens a dedicated viewer; screenshots open a zoom/comparison viewer. Selecting another viewport can adjust filters to reveal it. Audio mode clears the viewport filter. Upload effects and failures belong to child controls.

declarations.title: Evidence provenance
declarations.responsibility: Lists recorded provenance facts for an evidence item.

inputs.name: EvidenceProvenance.item
inputs.description: Required evidence record whose optional provenance list supplies labels and values. Labels serve as row keys.

outputs.name: EvidenceProvenance
outputs.description: Definition list of supplied provenance facts when nonempty; otherwise nothing. Does not derive or verify provenance.

declarations.title: Evidence viewer
declarations.responsibility: Shows full-size screenshots with filtered navigation, viewport switching and before/after comparison.

inputs.name: EvidenceViewer.items
inputs.description: Required full screenshot evidence list, used to find comparison partners and available screen sizes. Partners match comparison identity and viewport with before/after phases.

inputs.name: EvidenceViewer.navigableItems
inputs.description: Required ordered subset for previous/next and arrow-key navigation. Empty prevents movement.

inputs.name: EvidenceViewer.selected
inputs.description: Required selected screenshot or null. Non-null opens the modal; null closes it through the modal open prop.

inputs.name: EvidenceViewer.assetBase
inputs.description: Required prefix concatenated with image files for zoom and download links.

inputs.name: EvidenceViewer.onclose
inputs.description: Required close callback; closing also resets view to after.

inputs.name: EvidenceViewer.onselect
inputs.description: Required callback receiving a navigated item. Viewport switches pass true as the second argument so the host can update filters; ordinary previous/next omit it.

outputs.name: EvidenceViewer
outputs.description: Screenshot lightbox initially showing after, with before/compare choices when a partner exists. Previous/next wraps through the navigable subset and resets to after. Viewport switching prefers the same comparison, then category/title, category, then first candidate. Displays provenance, captions, missing notes and image links. Changing image/view recreates zoom state.

declarations.title: Function card
declarations.responsibility: Shows one function as a compact card with its contract, consumers, verification mark and links to its overview and recorded tests.

inputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard.row
inputs.description: The function at the viewed revision: its name, purpose, contract, consumers and verification result.

inputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard.nav
inputs.description: The selected branch and commit, with navigation that keeps both when opening the function or its tests.

outputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard
outputs.description: A readable function card with declared inputs and output, no design image, an icon to open it and a link to its recorded input-to-output tests.

declarations.title: Gameplay replay
declarations.responsibility: Plays a report’s recorded screenshot frames as a seekable replay.

inputs.name: GameplayReplay.report
inputs.description: Required report supplying evidence frames, ID and run state. Active plus running means live; newly supplied frames are followed by stable frame identity rather than shifting the cursor. The component does not poll for report updates.

inputs.name: GameplayReplay.assetBase
inputs.description: Required prefix for frame image URLs and next-frame preloading.

inputs.name: GameplayReplay.portable
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. True omits the server-generated MP4 download link.

outputs.name: GameplayReplay
outputs.description: Replay when frames exist or the run is live. Starts paused at the helper-selected frame with speed 1. Offers playback, seeking, scenes and native/fullscreen fallback controls. Playback waits during image loading, can retry or skip errors, and waits at the end of live runs but stops for finished runs. Nonportable download links to an export endpoint and shows preparation text for eight seconds. Failed images and empty live recordings have explicit overlays.

declarations.title: Entity artifact
declarations.responsibility: Shows verified recorded result contents and a link to the original artifact.

inputs.name: EntityArtifact.cell
inputs.description: Required result cell with capture and read state. Missing capture or null media produces a gap; details require a verified read.

inputs.name: EntityArtifact.label
inputs.description: Required accessible group name, also naming the original-file link.

inputs.name: EntityArtifact.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required prefix joined with the capture’s media path for the original-file link.

inputs.name: EntityArtifact.lost
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. True turns an absent read into an unverified state instead of pending.

inputs.name: EntityArtifact.unit
inputs.description: Optional function identifier limiting direct-call rows; absent uses general recorded-case presentation.

outputs.name: EntityArtifact
outputs.description: Recorded cases plus expandable assertions, facts, steps, trace and other content after verification. Unknown assertions stay Not stated. Formatted values are shortened after 12,000 characters with a file-opening reminder. Raw JSON is inserted only while expanded. A stored capture always gets an original-file link, including while pending or unverified.

declarations.title: Entity audio
declarations.responsibility: Presents matching recorded audio before and after a commit or at the current tip.

inputs.name: EntityAudio.evidence
inputs.description: Required explorer evidence from which audio gallery items are selected and grouped by comparison identity. Commit mode creates paired panes; after falls back to current.

inputs.name: EntityAudio.scope
inputs.description: Required selected commit and parent information used in pane labels.

inputs.name: EntityAudio.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required asset prefix passed to each audio card.

outputs.name: EntityAudio
outputs.description: Audio section only when at least one clip exists. Pairs before/after in commit mode and shows one current-side card otherwise. Missing sides within a pair are explicit gaps. Cards supply playback, transcript and provenance. No clips renders nothing, even when a scenario declares audio.

declarations.title: Entity behavior
declarations.responsibility: Reads recorded behavior artifacts and presents current or compared end-to-end results with entity reasons.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.behavior
inputs.description: Required metadata for recorded rows before their contents are read. Row before/after hashes form the identity used to retain a completed reading.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.read
inputs.description: Optional already-read behavior, default null. Non-null bypasses local reading; null means no preloaded result and does not itself indicate failure.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.scope
inputs.description: Required mode, commit and parent context. Paired panes require commit behavior with a parent.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required base used by the artifact-reading helper and passed to run panels.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.nav
inputs.description: Required route context and navigation callbacks for full tests and selected-commit links.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.reasons
inputs.description: Optional entity change reasons, displayed separately from test observations. Their behavior summary takes precedence over derived comparison explanation.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.duration
inputs.description: Optional displayed end-to-end duration, defaulting to Not measured; the component does not calculate it.

inputs.name: EntityBehavior.unit
inputs.description: Optional function identifier passed to run/artifact case rendering.

outputs.name: EntityBehavior
outputs.description: Current or before/after test panel. Reads artifacts when not supplied, ignores completion whose row-hash signature no longer matches, and shows pending or unknown rather than premature comparison. Missing groups are explicit. Shows scenario outcomes, duration, original reasons and navigation. A passing current/unchanged verdict is shown only when the helper also reports passing results.

declarations.title: EntityBehaviorScreen
declarations.responsibility: The screen of a function or a service: opens on what its end-to-end checks recorded, with any recorded clip below.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.route
inputs.description: The address shown: category, entity, section and tab.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.scope
inputs.description: The branch and commit shown, and whether that is the branch tip or a selected commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.head
inputs.description: The revision every contract, measurement and capture on the screen is bound to.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.parent
inputs.description: The first parent of a selected commit; none at the branch tip and for a first commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.entities
inputs.description: The units of the shown revision as the explorer lists them.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.lens
inputs.description: What the host answers about an entity: relations, evidence, end-to-end results and history.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.mediaBase
inputs.description: Where the protected media of recorded captures is served from.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.onroute
inputs.description: Goes to another address of the explorer in the same branch and revision mode.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.exportHref
inputs.description: Where a record is downloaded from; empty where the host serves none.

outputs.name: EntityBehaviorScreen.endToEndOverview
outputs.description: A function or a service with its summary and recorded end-to-end results: one run at the tip, both sides at a commit. Relationships and tests by tab.

errors.name: no-registry
errors.description: A revision that stores no unit registry says so; nothing of another revision is shown.

errors.name: entity-missing
errors.description: An entity the shown revision does not hold is said to be missing, with the way back to its collection.

declarations.title: Entity change
declarations.responsibility: Explains a selected historical change with recorded reasons, review notes and before/after measurements.

inputs.name: EntityChange.row
inputs.description: Required history row with commit, subject/date, predecessor, measured size/complexity, changes and budget reviews. Earlier size/complexity are derived as current minus recorded delta only when both exist.

inputs.name: EntityChange.timings
inputs.description: Required measurements, one per profile/target, with before/after values and units. Missing before displays unmeasured and no delta; numeric delta is rounded to four decimal places.

inputs.name: EntityChange.detail
inputs.description: Required revision detail or null while reading. Distinguishes unavailable registry/impact from a known revision with no reasons.

inputs.name: EntityChange.nav
inputs.description: Required route/navigation context used to open this entity at the row’s commit. Both captured-state and comparison actions use that destination.

inputs.name: EntityChange.full
inputs.description: Optional bindable flag, false by default, controlling expansion of original reason text.

outputs.name: EntityChange
outputs.description: Selected-change panel with commit/date/subject, summarized behavior/simplification/performance reasons and original disclosures. Shows budget/baseline reviews with long notes expandable. Measurement table separates source size, complexity and profile timings and labels missing measurements explicitly.

declarations.title: Entity config
declarations.responsibility: Shows the settings a configuration unit declares at the displayed revision.

inputs.name: EntityConfig.entity
inputs.description: Required entity whose contract outputs supply setting names and declared types. Labels use the readable final name segment.

inputs.name: EntityConfig.scope
inputs.description: Required current/commit context, selecting heading and displayed commit.

inputs.name: EntityConfig.nav
inputs.description: Required navigation context used to open this config at its recorded commit from current view.

outputs.name: EntityConfig
outputs.description: Configuration card listing declared outputs, with types over 48 characters labeled structured value. Empty outputs are explicitly described. Current mode offers View commit changes. Explains that config cost is measured through consuming entities; the panel does not display resolved configuration values.

declarations.title: EntityConfigScreen
declarations.responsibility: The screen of a config: opens on what it provides and who uses it; a config is not pictured, run or heard.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.route
inputs.description: The address shown: category, entity, section and tab.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.scope
inputs.description: The branch and commit shown, and whether that is the branch tip or a selected commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.head
inputs.description: The revision every contract, measurement and capture on the screen is bound to.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.parent
inputs.description: The first parent of a selected commit; none at the branch tip and for a first commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.entities
inputs.description: The units of the shown revision as the explorer lists them.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.lens
inputs.description: What the host answers about an entity: relations, evidence, end-to-end results and history.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.mediaBase
inputs.description: Where the protected media of recorded captures is served from.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.onroute
inputs.description: Goes to another address of the explorer in the same branch and revision mode.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.exportHref
inputs.description: Where a record is downloaded from; empty where the host serves none.

outputs.name: EntityConfigScreen.configurationOverview
outputs.description: A config with its summary, what it provides and who uses it. Relationships and tests by tab.

errors.name: no-registry
errors.description: A revision that stores no unit registry says so; nothing of another revision is shown.

errors.name: entity-missing
errors.description: An entity the shown revision does not hold is said to be missing, with the way back to its collection.

declarations.title: Entity details
declarations.responsibility: Chooses contract summary, measurements or source within entity details.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.entity
inputs.description: Required entity supplying the accessible name and unit passed to source/measurement panels.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.contract
inputs.description: Required prepared contract rows passed to the default summary view.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.measure
inputs.description: Required prepared entity measure passed to the default summary view.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.record
inputs.description: Required verification record or null, used only by the measurements panel.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.tab
inputs.description: Optional selected tab. Exactly source shows source; measurements shows measured detail; missing or any other tab uses the summary.

outputs.name: EntityDetails
outputs.description: Named tabpanel containing the selected child view. The default shows contract/measurement summary without source; data fetching and child errors are outside this component.

declarations.title: EntityDetailsScreen
declarations.responsibility: The details screen of an entity of any kind: contract, measurements, and the source only when it is asked for.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.route
inputs.description: The address shown: category, entity, section and tab.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.scope
inputs.description: The branch and commit shown, and whether that is the branch tip or a selected commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.head
inputs.description: The revision every contract, measurement and capture on the screen is bound to.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.parent
inputs.description: The first parent of a selected commit; none at the branch tip and for a first commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.entities
inputs.description: The units of the shown revision as the explorer lists them.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.lens
inputs.description: What the host answers about an entity: relations, evidence, end-to-end results and history.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.onroute
inputs.description: Goes to another address of the explorer in the same branch and revision mode.

outputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.entityDetails
outputs.description: The contract, size and performance of an entity; measurements and the source by tab.

errors.name: no-registry
errors.description: A revision that stores no unit registry says so; nothing of another revision is shown.

errors.name: entity-missing
errors.description: An entity the shown revision does not hold is said to be missing, with the way back to its collection.

declarations.title: EntityFrame
declarations.responsibility: Finds the entity an address names, heads its screen with it, and says that the entity is missing where the revision does not hold it.

inputs.name: EntityFrame.host
inputs.description: Everything the host gives a screen: the shown revision, address, entities and its answers.

inputs.name: EntityFrame.children
inputs.description: The screen of the entity the address names; it is given that entity.

outputs.name: EntityFrame.entityHeaderAndScreen
outputs.description: Entity identity, the persistent component screenshot above its tabs, then the selected section. Captures use the selected revision and retain explicit gaps.

errors.name: no-registry
errors.description: A revision that stores no unit registry says so; nothing of another revision is shown.

errors.name: entity-missing
errors.description: An entity the shown revision does not hold is said to be missing, with the way back to its collection.

declarations.title: Entity header
declarations.responsibility: Shows entity identity, verification and navigation between overview, details and history.

inputs.name: EntityHeader.entity
inputs.description: Required name, category, role, purpose, verdict and optional app route/change. Removed entities receive a removed-at-commit badge. Page route links are enabled only for nonempty routes without bracket, colon, asterisk or parameter-pattern characters checked here.

inputs.name: EntityHeader.nav
inputs.description: Required current route and link/navigation functions. Section selects the overview/details tab row; unrecognized tabs fall back to the first, while history remains selected in its section.

inputs.name: EntityHeader.shared
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default, displaying a Shared badge.

inputs.name: EntityHeader.preview
inputs.description: Optional persistent preview rendered between entity identity and the tabs, including Details and History.

outputs.name: EntityHeader
outputs.description: Breadcrumbs, category icon, name/role/verdict and purpose or details summary. Pages show an openable app route or nonlinked pattern/Not recorded. Offers Details or Back to overview and the appropriate tab row. Navigation retains context through the route helper. An optional preview remains above every tab row.

declarations.title: Entity history
declarations.responsibility: Explores recorded changes to one entity and reads additional revision details on demand.

inputs.name: EntityHistory.entity
inputs.description: Required entity identity/name used for revision details and navigation. Caller is expected to recreate this view for a new entity or commit.

inputs.name: EntityHistory.rows
inputs.description: Required newest-first history through the shown commit, including known changes and unread candidates.

inputs.name: EntityHistory.index
inputs.description: Required index used to derive historical timings and profiles.

inputs.name: EntityHistory.scope
inputs.description: Required viewed commit used for labels and preferred initial selection.

inputs.name: EntityHistory.known
inputs.description: Required revisions already read, used to seed the detail map once at creation. Later prop replacements do not reseed it.

inputs.name: EntityHistory.client
inputs.description: Required revision reader. Failures are swallowed, leaving revision detail unknown rather than supplying false evidence.

inputs.name: EntityHistory.nav
inputs.description: Required context for links to this entity at historical commits.

outputs.name: EntityHistory
outputs.description: History table with selected-profile timings, verdicts and a selected-change panel. Defaults selection to the viewed commit or first listed change and profile to the first valid choice. Reads details for listed changes and up to ten unread commits on demand. Unknown changes and empty known history are explicit. Full-reason selection focuses its disclosure after rendering.

declarations.title: Entity history row
declarations.responsibility: Shows a selectable commit row with recorded change reasons, metrics and verification.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.row
inputs.description: Required commit history row with date, subject, measured size/complexity, deltas, reviews and change classification.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.detail
inputs.description: Required loaded detail or undefined. Its explanations supply summarized reasons and attempts; subject is the fallback when behavior text is absent.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.timing
inputs.description: Required selected-profile timing or undefined. Displays before-to-after when before exists, otherwise after only; missing timing is Not measured.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.verdict
inputs.description: Required passing flag, label and optional reasons forwarded to the verification marker without reevaluation.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.selected
inputs.description: Required flag applying row selection styling and pressed state to the commit button.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.viewed
inputs.description: Required flag marking this as the currently viewed commit and adding its badge.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.to
inputs.description: Required destination for opening this entity at this row’s commit.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.nav
inputs.description: Required navigation context passed to the revision link.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.onselect
inputs.description: Required callback: commit button passes false for the summary, Full reasons passes true for original text. Does not itself navigate.

outputs.name: EntityHistoryRow
outputs.description: Table row with date, short commit, change/viewed badges, bounded reason or subject, attempts, metrics/deltas, optional budget approval, timing and verdict. Long reasons expose a Full reasons button. View revision uses the supplied destination; missing measurements remain explicit.

declarations.title: EntityHistoryScreen
declarations.responsibility: The history screen of an entity of any kind: the commits that changed it through the shown commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.index
inputs.description: The history of the repository as it was built: branches, revisions and what was measured.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.route
inputs.description: The address shown: category, entity, section and tab.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.scope
inputs.description: The branch and commit shown, and whether that is the branch tip or a selected commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.head
inputs.description: The revision every contract, measurement and capture on the screen is bound to.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.parent
inputs.description: The first parent of a selected commit; none at the branch tip and for a first commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.entities
inputs.description: The units of the shown revision as the explorer lists them.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.lens
inputs.description: What the host answers about an entity: relations, evidence, end-to-end results and history.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.client
inputs.description: Reads a stored revision, only for the commits a history lists.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.onroute
inputs.description: Goes to another address of the explorer in the same branch and revision mode.

outputs.name: EntityHistoryScreen.entityHistory
outputs.description: The commits that changed an entity through the shown commit, with reasons, size, timing and verdict.

errors.name: no-registry
errors.description: A revision that stores no unit registry says so; nothing of another revision is shown.

errors.name: entity-missing
errors.description: An entity the shown revision does not hold is said to be missing, with the way back to its collection.

declarations.title: Entity link
declarations.responsibility: Provides a real explorer link with in-app navigation for plain clicks.

inputs.name: EntityLink.to
inputs.description: Required explorer destination.

inputs.name: EntityLink.nav
inputs.description: Required functions for constructing the link and navigating within the host.

inputs.name: EntityLink.label
inputs.description: Optional accessible name when visible content is insufficient.

inputs.name: EntityLink.children
inputs.description: Required visible link content.

inputs.name: EntityLink.class
inputs.description: Optional CSS class forwarded to the anchor.

inputs.name: EntityLink.title
inputs.description: Optional native hover tooltip, forwarded to the link.

outputs.name: EntityLink
outputs.description: Anchor with a real href. A plain click prevents document navigation and calls nav.go; modified/nonprimary clicks keep native behavior. Does not catch navigation errors.

declarations.title: Entity measurements
declarations.responsibility: Shows recorded measurements beside frozen limits and declared performance tolerances.

inputs.name: EntityMeasures.unit
inputs.description: Required unit with budgets, limits and identity. Supplies performance workloads and frozen-policy declarations.

inputs.name: EntityMeasures.record
inputs.description: Required record or null. Measurements and findings are filtered to the unit; unprofiled values supply source/complexity/dependency metrics.

outputs.name: EntityMeasures
outputs.description: Measurement table including source bytes, complexity, dependencies, emitted size and declared performance budgets. Distinguishes policy from numeric limits. Missing record/performance budgets are explicit; helper-formatted values and notes remain visible without estimating data.

declarations.title: Unavailable entity
declarations.responsibility: Explains why an entity cannot be shown and offers a return destination.

inputs.name: EntityMissing.title
inputs.description: Required heading.

inputs.name: EntityMissing.message
inputs.description: Required explanation of the missing entity at this revision.

inputs.name: EntityMissing.nav
inputs.description: Required link/navigation context.

inputs.name: EntityMissing.to
inputs.description: Required destination for recovery navigation.

inputs.name: EntityMissing.action
inputs.description: Optional action text, default Back to the collection.

outputs.name: EntityMissing
outputs.description: Not shown verdict, supplied explanation, statement that another revision is not substituted, and return action.

declarations.title: Entity overview
declarations.responsibility: Shows visual evidence before measurements; contract and usage each have dedicated tabs.

inputs.name: EntityOverview.entity
inputs.description: The entity name, category and removal state at the viewed revision.

inputs.name: EntityOverview.measure
inputs.description: Required prepared measurements passed to the summary.

inputs.name: EntityOverview.children
inputs.description: Required content snippet for evidence appropriate to this entity.

outputs.name: EntityOverview
outputs.description: Visual overviews begin with screenshots, a commit comparison or an explicit capture gap, followed by size and performance. Other entities retain measurement-first evidence. Contract and usage appear in their own tabs.

declarations.title: Full change reasons
declarations.responsibility: Makes original change notes and attempts available when their summaries were shortened.

inputs.name: EntityReasons.reasons
inputs.description: Required prepared reasons containing long flag, original notes and attempts with subjects/outcomes.

inputs.name: EntityReasons.open
inputs.description: Optional bindable disclosure state, false by default.

inputs.name: EntityReasons.id
inputs.description: Optional ID for the disclosure, allowing callers to focus or link it.

outputs.name: EntityReasons
outputs.description: Full reasons disclosure only when long is true, with counts and original behavior/attempt text grouped by usage. Otherwise renders nothing; it does not regenerate or shorten originals.

declarations.title: Used In and Uses
declarations.responsibility: Shows what uses an entity and what that entity uses.

inputs.name: EntityRelations.relations
inputs.description: Required relationship data organized by the usage helper.

inputs.name: EntityRelations.nav
inputs.description: Required route context for related-entity links.

inputs.name: EntityRelations.show
inputs.description: Optional both, used-in or uses, default both. Selects which sections appear.

inputs.name: EntityRelations.compact
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. True hides purpose text while keeping names and badges.

inputs.name: EntityRelations.removed
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default, changing empty-state wording to explain removal at this commit.

outputs.name: EntityRelations
outputs.description: Counted Used In list and categorized Uses groups without verification marks. Changed or added entities receive Changed badges. Unknown-category others remain unlinked. Empty sections explain missing records; removed mode does not substitute old relationships.

declarations.title: Recorded test run
declarations.responsibility: Displays one side of grouped test outcomes and their artifacts.

inputs.name: EntityRun.shown
inputs.description: Required grouped behavior/scenario data. Overall passes only with at least one group and every selected-side group passing.

inputs.name: EntityRun.side
inputs.description: Required before or after, selecting each group/line outcome. After alone displays difference paths.

inputs.name: EntityRun.title
inputs.description: Required pane heading and accessible name.

inputs.name: EntityRun.role
inputs.description: Required descriptive side badge.

inputs.name: EntityRun.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required artifact URL base passed to result viewers.

inputs.name: EntityRun.lost
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default, telling artifacts that reading failed rather than remains pending.

inputs.name: EntityRun.unit
inputs.description: Optional function identifier passed through to callable case rows.

outputs.name: EntityRun
outputs.description: Run pane with overall/state verdicts, scenario/state names, result kinds and Passed/Failed/Not recorded labels. Shows supplied artifacts and after-side differences without calculating new verification.

declarations.title: Entity screenshots
declarations.responsibility: Displays recorded screenshots with scenario selection and comparison context.

inputs.name: EntityScreens.options
inputs.description: Required visual scenarios with declared states and viewports; the picker helper reconciles current selection.

inputs.name: EntityScreens.evidence
inputs.description: Required captures/comparison mode and incomparability reasons.

inputs.name: EntityScreens.scope
inputs.description: Required commit/parent context for labels and links.

inputs.name: EntityScreens.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required prefix concatenated with screenshot files.

inputs.name: EntityScreens.nav
inputs.description: Required navigation to tests or selected-commit view.

inputs.name: EntityScreens.reasons
inputs.description: Required recorded change reasons, shown for paired comparisons with original text available.

outputs.name: EntityScreens
outputs.description: Scenario/state/viewport controls, matching screenshot panes or explicit gaps, and full-size viewer. Commit mode explains incomparable recordings; current mode names inherited capture origins. Scenario choice disables when fewer than two options exist. Image URLs are rendered directly; this view has no load-error handler.

declarations.title: Entity sections
declarations.responsibility: Shows Overview, Used In, Uses or Tests from the selected tab, preserving the branch and commit.

inputs.name: EntitySections.host
inputs.description: Everything the host gives a screen: the shown revision, address, entities and its answers.

inputs.name: EntitySections.entity
inputs.description: The entity the screen shows.

inputs.name: EntitySections.nav
inputs.description: Where the screen is and how it reaches another address.

inputs.name: EntitySections.pane
inputs.description: The evidence an entity of this kind is first shown with.

outputs.name: EntitySections.entityTabPanel
outputs.description: Only the selected section: overview evidence and summary, consumers in Used In, dependencies in Uses, or recorded test results in Tests.

declarations.title: Source ownership
declarations.responsibility: Lists the source ownership and execution targets recorded for an entity.

inputs.name: EntitySource.unit
inputs.description: Required unit with owned files/symbols, runtime targets, identity and version.

outputs.name: EntitySource
outputs.description: Files, symbols and execution-target lists plus identity/version. Empty files or symbols are explicit. Lists ownership only; does not fetch or display file contents.

declarations.title: Measurement summary
declarations.responsibility: Shows recorded size and performance facts for one entity.

inputs.name: EntitySummary.measure
inputs.description: Required prepared size and performance rows including notes, environment, tolerance and over-policy flags.

inputs.name: EntitySummary.compact
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. True hides inline size notes while retaining their tooltips.

outputs.name: EntitySummary
outputs.description: Size and performance cards. Unavailable measurements stay explicit; workload profiles remain separate and supplied tolerance flags remain visible.

declarations.title: Entity verification details
declarations.responsibility: Explains recorded coverage, test outcomes and media for one entity revision.

inputs.name: EntityTests.entity
inputs.description: Required entity with name, identifier, category and supplied verdict.

inputs.name: EntityTests.scope
inputs.description: Required displayed commit/parent context.

inputs.name: EntityTests.evidence
inputs.description: Required coverage, scenarios, records and media. After-side coverage judges the displayed revision; removed declarations are listed separately. Coverage tests may carry diagnostics from their own run or the origin of an inherited result.

inputs.name: EntityTests.behavior
inputs.description: Required behavior results; nonempty rows render a behavior panel keyed to entity and commit.

inputs.name: EntityTests.nav
inputs.description: Required context for behavior-panel navigation.

inputs.name: EntityTests.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required base for recorded artifacts and media gallery.

inputs.name: EntityTests.exportHref
inputs.description: Optional record-download base, empty by default. A record and nonempty base produce a link with its record ID as query.

outputs.name: EntityTests
outputs.description: Verdict and reasons, scenario/state coverage and underlying check outcomes/durations, removed declarations, behavior and media. Missing records/scenarios remain explicit. Inapplicable states are labeled, and repeated slot reasons are suppressed when the state already says them. Each check with recorded browser diagnostics shows expandable expected, unexpected and missing-expected errors with test-attempt context.

declarations.title: EntityVisualScreen
declarations.responsibility: The screen of a page or a component: opens on its screenshots, one at the tip or a pair at a commit, with any recorded clip below.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.route
inputs.description: The address shown: category, entity, section and tab.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.scope
inputs.description: The branch and commit shown, and whether that is the branch tip or a selected commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.head
inputs.description: The revision every contract, measurement and capture on the screen is bound to.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.parent
inputs.description: The first parent of a selected commit; none at the branch tip and for a first commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.entities
inputs.description: The units of the shown revision as the explorer lists them.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.lens
inputs.description: What the host answers about an entity: relations, evidence, end-to-end results and history.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.mediaBase
inputs.description: Where the protected media of recorded captures is served from.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.onroute
inputs.description: Goes to another address of the explorer in the same branch and revision mode.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.exportHref
inputs.description: Where a record is downloaded from; empty where the host serves none.

outputs.name: EntityVisualScreen.screenshotOverview
outputs.description: Page and shell screenshots lead Overview. Components keep their screenshots above every tab through the shared frame; Overview retains measurements and any audio without duplicating the screenshots.

errors.name: no-registry
errors.description: A revision that stores no unit registry says so; nothing of another revision is shown.

errors.name: entity-missing
errors.description: An entity the shown revision does not hold is said to be missing, with the way back to its collection.

declarations.title: ExplorerCatalogScreen
declarations.responsibility: Lists components and functions in searchable card grids, and shells, configs and services in tables.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.route
inputs.description: The address shown: category, entity, section and tab.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.scope
inputs.description: The branch and commit shown, and whether that is the branch tip or a selected commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.head
inputs.description: The revision every contract, measurement and capture on the screen is bound to.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.entities
inputs.description: The units of the shown revision as the explorer lists them.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.lens
inputs.description: What the host answers about an entity: relations, evidence, end-to-end results and history.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.onroute
inputs.description: Goes to another address of the explorer in the same branch and revision mode.

outputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.collection
outputs.description: Responsive grids show components with revision-bound screenshots and functions with readable input and output contracts. Search, changed-only, ordering, overview links and test links preserve the selected branch and commit. Shells, configs and services use tables.

errors.name: no-registry
errors.description: A revision that stores no unit registry says so; nothing of another revision is shown.

declarations.title: ExplorerContent
declarations.responsibility: Shows any address of the explorer for a host without a page for each screen: picks the one screen entry the address is and draws nothing of its own.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.index
inputs.description: The history of the repository as it was built: branches, revisions and what was measured.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.head
inputs.description: The revision every contract, measurement and capture on the screen is bound to.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.parent
inputs.description: The first parent of a selected commit; none at the branch tip and for a first commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.scope
inputs.description: The branch and commit shown, and whether that is the branch tip or a selected commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.route
inputs.description: The address shown: category, entity, section and tab.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.entities
inputs.description: The units of the shown revision as the explorer lists them.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.lens
inputs.description: What the host answers about an entity: relations, evidence, end-to-end results and history.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.client
inputs.description: Reads a stored revision, only for the commits a history lists.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.mediaBase
inputs.description: Where the protected media of recorded captures is served from.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.onroute
inputs.description: Goes to another address of the explorer in the same branch and revision mode.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.exportHref
inputs.description: Where a record is downloaded from; empty where the host serves none.

outputs.name: ExplorerContent.anyExplorerScreen
outputs.description: The one screen the address is, for a host without a page for each screen.

errors.name: no-registry
errors.description: A revision that stores no unit registry says so; nothing of another revision is shown.

errors.name: entity-missing
errors.description: An entity the shown revision does not hold is said to be missing, with the way back to its collection.

declarations.title: Catalog controls
declarations.responsibility: Edits search, changed-only and ordering choices for a catalog.

inputs.name: ExplorerControls.noun
inputs.description: Required lowercase plural entity name used in search labels and placeholder.

inputs.name: ExplorerControls.filter
inputs.description: Required bindable filter object whose search, changedOnly and order are updated directly.

outputs.name: ExplorerControls
outputs.description: Search field, changed-only switch and order dropdown populated from supported catalog orders. Does not filter records itself.

declarations.title: ExplorerFrame
declarations.responsibility: Draws the root of an explorer screen with its styles, and says that a revision has no registry instead of drawing the screen.

inputs.name: ExplorerFrame.host
inputs.description: Everything the host gives a screen: the shown revision, address, entities and its answers.

inputs.name: ExplorerFrame.children
inputs.description: The screen to draw inside.

outputs.name: ExplorerFrame.screenRoot
outputs.description: The root of a screen with the styles of the explorer.

errors.name: no-registry
errors.description: A revision that stores no unit registry says so; nothing of another revision is shown.

declarations.title: Entity catalog
declarations.responsibility: Frames and filters a category’s entities with accessible status and empty-state guidance.

inputs.name: ExplorerIndex.category
inputs.description: Required category used for headings, icon and explanatory text.

inputs.name: ExplorerIndex.rows
inputs.description: Required complete category rows before filtering.

inputs.name: ExplorerIndex.list
inputs.description: Required snippet receiving filtered/sorted rows to render as cards or table.

outputs.name: ExplorerIndex
outputs.description: Catalog with search empty, changed-only off and name ordering initially. Shows count status, distinct no-registry/no-match states and Show all clearing search/changed-only but preserving order. Adds verification legend and category-specific guidance.

declarations.title: Visual catalog card
declarations.responsibility: Summarizes a page or visual component with its recorded screenshot, capture origin and verification.

inputs.name: ExplorerPageCard.row
inputs.description: Facts for one page or visual component: its name, purpose, usages, contained components, changed flag and verification.

inputs.name: ExplorerPageCard.shot
inputs.description: A usable screenshot or null. Includes its original captured commit and whether the shown revision reuses validated unchanged evidence. Missing media or image-load failure shows an explicit gap.

inputs.name: ExplorerPageCard.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required screenshot asset prefix.

inputs.name: ExplorerPageCard.nav
inputs.description: The selected branch, commit and navigation actions; opening the card keeps that scope.

inputs.name: ExplorerPageCard.category
inputs.description: Defaults to pages. Components retain the same screenshot card while showing their consumers and contained components, with an Open component icon.

outputs.name: ExplorerPageCard
outputs.description: A linked screenshot card with readable purpose, component count or usages, shared/changed markers and icon-only verification. Captions identify in-context evidence and its captured commit, using Reused from for inherited proof. A 36-pixel icon opens the page or component. Image errors show a gap and reset when the file changes.

declarations.title: ExplorerPagesScreen
declarations.responsibility: The Pages screen: lists the pages of the app as cards, each with its own screenshot at the shown revision.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.route
inputs.description: The address shown: category, entity, section and tab.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.scope
inputs.description: The branch and commit shown, and whether that is the branch tip or a selected commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.head
inputs.description: The revision every contract, measurement and capture on the screen is bound to.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.entities
inputs.description: The units of the shown revision as the explorer lists them.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.lens
inputs.description: What the host answers about an entity: relations, evidence, end-to-end results and history.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.mediaBase
inputs.description: Where the protected media of recorded captures is served from.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.onroute
inputs.description: Goes to another address of the explorer in the same branch and revision mode.

outputs.name: ExplorerPagesScreen.pageCards
outputs.description: Page screenshot cards selected from the shown revision, with the original capture commit visible. Validated unchanged captures may be reused; missing or rejected evidence stays an explicit gap. Search, changed-only, ordering and links retain the selected scope.

errors.name: no-registry
errors.description: A revision that stores no unit registry says so; nothing of another revision is shown.

declarations.title: Entity catalog table
declarations.responsibility: Lists non-page entities with columns appropriate to their category.

inputs.name: ExplorerTable.category
inputs.description: Required non-page category: shells, components, functions, configs or services. Determines columns and labels.

inputs.name: ExplorerTable.rows
inputs.description: Required catalog rows in display order. Used-by text falls back to pages where no direct users exist.

inputs.name: ExplorerTable.nav
inputs.description: Required navigation context for entity links and actions.

outputs.name: ExplorerTable
