outputs.description: Named table with entity/shared badges, category-specific usage/responsibility/target columns, verdict and Open action. Shells/components show summaries under names; configs show changed state. Empty rows produce an empty table without a separate message.

declarations.title: Explorer action
declarations.responsibility: Renders a button or real navigation link with optional icons.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.href
inputs.description: Optional address. Nonempty and enabled renders an anchor; otherwise a button.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.onclick
inputs.description: Optional handler. For links, only plain clicks are intercepted; other clicks remain native. Buttons invoke it directly if supplied.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.disabled
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. True renders a disabled button even when href exists.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.tone
inputs.description: Optional gold or plain styling, default gold.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.icon
inputs.description: Optional trailing icon.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.lead
inputs.description: Optional leading icon.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.label
inputs.description: Optional fuller accessible name.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.children
inputs.description: Required visible action content.

outputs.name: HarnessAction
outputs.description: Styled action with leading/trailing icons at size 18. Buttons have type button. Handler failures are not caught.

declarations.title: Recorded project activity
declarations.responsibility: Loads and displays the activity captured when a repository history was built.

inputs.name: HarnessActivity.client
inputs.description: Required history client whose activity operation supplies the stored snapshot.

inputs.name: HarnessActivity.base
inputs.description: Required base passed to activity commit links.

outputs.name: HarnessActivity
outputs.description: Loading message, recorded activity with as-of commit and explicit nonlive notice, or missing-record/rebuild guidance when reading fails. Never calls recorded activity live.

declarations.title: Revision impact comparison
declarations.responsibility: Presents changed and affected units, recorded reasons, measurements and media for two revisions.

inputs.name: HarnessCompare.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required media prefix for the paired gallery.

inputs.name: HarnessCompare.base
inputs.description: Required comparison base or undefined. No base receives explicit guidance. Removed units come from this registry.

inputs.name: HarnessCompare.head
inputs.description: Required selected revision supplying active units, reasons and records.

inputs.name: HarnessCompare.client
inputs.description: Required source-comparison client used to derive compared sides when base exists. Failure falls back to null comparison data.

inputs.name: HarnessCompare.selected
inputs.description: Required unit identifier or null, selecting a unit-detail panel when found.

inputs.name: HarnessCompare.onselect
inputs.description: Required callback for selecting impact-list or map units.

outputs.name: HarnessCompare
outputs.description: Impact groups and uncertainty/source explanations, reasons for directly touched units, before/after measured metrics and emitted sizes, media, dependency map and selected-unit detail. Removed units use base records/scenarios. Missing measurements stay unavailable.

declarations.title: Revision media comparison
declarations.responsibility: Aligns recorded screenshots and audio between selected revisions.

inputs.name: HarnessCompareMedia.base
inputs.description: Required base revision or undefined; undefined displays no-base guidance.

inputs.name: HarnessCompareMedia.head
inputs.description: Required head revision. Each side prefers a selected record, then a valid passed record, then its first record.

inputs.name: HarnessCompareMedia.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required media prefix forwarded to the gallery.

outputs.name: HarnessCompareMedia
outputs.description: Scenario/state/viewport controls and optional record selectors when a side has multiple records. Defaults to first available scenario and all states/viewports. Missing records and no recorded media are explicit; aligned-state text and gallery come from the comparison helper.

declarations.title: Explorer console
declarations.responsibility: Loads recorded repository revisions and supplies the selected explorer screen with navigation, entities and evidence.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.base
inputs.description: Required URL prefix used for the data client, media and export addresses.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.path
inputs.description: Required address within the base, including any query string. Determines the selected branch, revision and screen.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.navigate
inputs.description: Required host callback receiving the next relative address and whether to replace browser history. Corrections replace history; user navigation normally adds an entry.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.links
inputs.description: Compatibility input accepted by the prop type but not read or rendered by this component.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.exportable
inputs.description: Optional export availability flag, defaulting to true. False supplies the screen with an empty export address.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.content
inputs.description: Required screen component rendered once its selected revision and parent context are ready.

outputs.name: HarnessConsole
outputs.description: Explorer header and selected screen, with loading, unavailable-address, truncated-history and missing-registry notices. Index and selected-revision failures become visible problem text; unavailable parent data becomes null.

declarations.title: Build output size history
declarations.responsibility: Shows recorded emitted sizes and limits separately for each build target.

inputs.name: HarnessEmittedGrowth.unit
inputs.description: Required unit identifier used to label this history.

inputs.name: HarnessEmittedGrowth.growth
inputs.description: Required target definitions and revision rows, including sizes, changes, limits and review notes. Targets remain separate rather than being added together.

inputs.name: HarnessEmittedGrowth.reasons
inputs.description: Required lookup for recorded explanations at a commit. A changed row without explanations says none were recorded.

inputs.name: HarnessEmittedGrowth.oncompare
inputs.description: Required callback invoked with the commit when the user chooses before-and-after evidence.

outputs.name: HarnessEmittedGrowth
outputs.description: Per-target size history with signed changes and review notes. Missing sizes remain unavailable; missing limits distinguish reviewed nonbuildable targets from targets with no limit yet.

declarations.title: Verification failure details
declarations.responsibility: Presents verification failure causes while keeping the original failure list accessible.

inputs.name: HarnessFailures.record
inputs.description: Required caller-provided record label used in accessible names for the original failure list.

inputs.name: HarnessFailures.failures
inputs.description: Required original failure messages. The grouping helper determines whether to present plain failures or grouped subjects and causes.

inputs.name: HarnessFailures.problems
inputs.description: Optional additional record problems, defaulting to an empty list. These remain visible separately from grouped failures.

outputs.name: HarnessFailures
outputs.description: Plain or grouped failure explanations, counts and an expandable complete original list in a focusable scrolling region, followed by any record problems.

declarations.title: Unit measurement history
declarations.responsibility: Displays recorded source, build-output and timing changes for a selected unit.

inputs.name: HarnessGrowth.index
inputs.description: Required repository measurements, unit choices, revisions and benchmark profiles used to build the history.

inputs.name: HarnessGrowth.client
inputs.description: Required client used to read recorded explanations for revisions where source or emitted measurements changed. Those asynchronous reads have no local failure handler.

inputs.name: HarnessGrowth.unit
inputs.description: Required selected unit identifier or null. Null selects the first indexed unit, or an empty identifier when there are no units.

inputs.name: HarnessGrowth.onunit
inputs.description: Required callback receiving the unit chosen in the selector.

inputs.name: HarnessGrowth.oncompare
inputs.description: Optional callback for opening before-and-after evidence at a changed commit. Defaults to doing nothing.

outputs.name: HarnessGrowth
outputs.description: Source size, complexity and dependency history, recorded explanations, build-target size history and timings grouped by compatible profile. Missing measurements stay unavailable. Uses the selected unit or the first indexed unit and fetches revision explanations for changed rows.

declarations.title: Explorer header and notices
declarations.responsibility: Provides explorer navigation and visible data-loading or missing-address messages.

inputs.name: HarnessHeader.base
inputs.description: Required explorer URL prefix, passed to the navigation bar and prepended to a missing-address home link.

inputs.name: HarnessHeader.links
inputs.description: Optional additional-view links, defaulting to an empty list. Used by the legacy header only.

inputs.name: HarnessHeader.problem
inputs.description: Required problem text. A nonempty value is displayed as an alert.

inputs.name: HarnessHeader.missing
inputs.type: { message: string; home: string | null } | null
inputs.description: Required missing-address information or null. Shows its message and a newest-revision link when home is provided.

inputs.name: HarnessHeader.navbar
inputs.description: Optional navigation-bar context without its base, defaulting to null. When supplied, replaces the legacy heading and links.

outputs.name: HarnessHeader
outputs.description: Navigation bar or legacy heading, followed by problem and missing-address alerts. It renders supplied state and performs no data fetching.

declarations.title: Revision verification history
declarations.responsibility: Shows a revision’s recorded verification runs, scenarios and captured evidence.

inputs.name: HarnessHistory.summary
inputs.description: Required revision summary supplying commit metadata, coverage, gaps and record validation problems.

inputs.name: HarnessHistory.detail
inputs.description: Required full revision whose verification records and evidence are displayed.

inputs.name: HarnessHistory.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required address prefix for captured media and other artifact links.

inputs.name: HarnessHistory.exportHref
inputs.description: Required record-download address. Empty hides the download; otherwise the selected record identifier is appended as a query parameter.

inputs.name: HarnessHistory.record
inputs.description: Optional requested record identifier. If absent or not found, chooses a valid passed record, then the first record, then none.

inputs.name: HarnessHistory.onrecord
inputs.description: Optional callback receiving a clicked record identifier. Defaults to doing nothing; the host must update the selected record.

outputs.name: HarnessHistory
outputs.description: Revision metadata and coverage notice, selectable run records with failures, and the chosen run’s scenario outcomes, inherited results, exemptions and artifacts. Selects the requested record when found, otherwise a valid passed record, then the first record. Non-media artifacts receive links or explicit gaps; screenshot and audio evidence appears in the gallery. A supplied export address adds a download for the selected record.

declarations.title: Explorer icon
declarations.responsibility: Renders a named explorer SVG icon with optional accessible labeling.

inputs.name: HarnessIcon.name
inputs.description: Required icon-catalog name selecting its path and whether it uses solid styling.

inputs.name: HarnessIcon.size
inputs.description: Optional square size in pixels, defaulting to 20.

inputs.name: HarnessIcon.label
inputs.description: Optional accessible label. A nonempty label makes the SVG an image; otherwise it is hidden from assistive technology.

outputs.name: HarnessIcon
outputs.description: An unfocusable SVG with a 24-unit view box and the selected catalog path.

declarations.title: Historical report references
declarations.responsibility: Shows older reports as historical context without presenting them as build-bound verification.

inputs.name: HarnessLegacy.reports
inputs.description: Required historical reports. Reports linked to the selected commit appear first.

inputs.name: HarnessLegacy.commit
inputs.description: Required currently selected commit, used for ordering and link behavior.

inputs.name: HarnessLegacy.known
inputs.description: Required set of commits available to the explorer. Only a different known commit receives a navigation control.

inputs.name: HarnessLegacy.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required media prefix for historical report evidence.

inputs.name: HarnessLegacy.onselect
inputs.description: Required callback for opening a different known report commit.

outputs.name: HarnessLegacy
outputs.description: Report outcomes, dates, environments, summaries and expandable checks, with an evidence gallery for one expanded report at a time. Explicitly labels these reports as historical context rather than verified evidence for the current build.

declarations.title: Unit dependency map
declarations.responsibility: Lets users inspect, search and select units in a dependency diagram or list.

inputs.name: HarnessMap.units
inputs.description: Required units supplying diagram nodes, dependencies and searchable identifiers, kinds and responsibilities.

inputs.name: HarnessMap.marks
inputs.description: Optional map of added, removed, directly changed or indirectly affected units, defaulting to an empty map. Marks add styling and a legend.

inputs.name: HarnessMap.selected
inputs.description: Optional selected unit identifier, defaulting to null. Highlights its neighborhood and controls relevant dependency edges.

inputs.name: HarnessMap.onselect
inputs.description: Required callback invoked when a diagram node or list entry is selected.

outputs.name: HarnessMap
outputs.description: Searchable dependency diagram with pan, pinch, zoom and fit controls, plus a sorted unit list. Search dims unmatched nodes; arrow keys move among nodes and Enter or Space selects. Long displayed identifiers are shortened without changing the identifiers passed to callbacks.

declarations.title: Explorer navigation bar
declarations.responsibility: Provides repository, category, revision and scoped entity navigation.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.base
inputs.description: Required explorer mount address. Used for the brand link before a branch is resolved and as the fallback search link.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.repository
inputs.description: Required repository label or null. A missing or empty label hides the repository name.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.scope
inputs.description: Required current explorer location and revision context, or null while unresolved. Null disables category navigation and hides revision controls and search.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.index
inputs.description: Required repository index or null. Revision selectors appear only when a scope and index are available.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.commits
inputs.description: Required branch revision choices in newest-first order. The viewed revision is added if absent from this list.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.href
inputs.description: Required function producing a complete address, including the mount, for a location.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.onroute
inputs.description: Required callback for ordinary navigation clicks and revision or search selections. Modified links retain normal browser behavior.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.search
inputs.description: Optional searchable entities for the viewed revision, or null entries while loading. The search helper excludes entries for a mismatched revision.

outputs.name: HarnessNavbar
outputs.description: Repository/category links, revision controls and entity search for the available scope. Unavailable category destinations are disabled text. Plain link clicks use the route callback, while normal modified-link behavior is preserved. Search entries are accepted only for their matching revision context.

declarations.title: Branch and revision selectors
declarations.responsibility: Lets users choose a branch, viewed commit and optional comparison base.

inputs.name: HarnessSelectors.index
inputs.description: Required repository index supplying branch choices and the truncated-history notice.

inputs.name: HarnessSelectors.branch
inputs.description: Required selected branch name.

inputs.name: HarnessSelectors.commit
inputs.description: Required selected viewed commit.

inputs.name: HarnessSelectors.commits
inputs.description: Required available viewed revisions, shown with their abbreviated commits and descriptions.

inputs.name: HarnessSelectors.bases
inputs.description: Required comparison revisions or null. Null hides the base selector; an empty list leaves it with no revision choices.

inputs.name: HarnessSelectors.from
inputs.description: Required selected comparison-base commit.

inputs.name: HarnessSelectors.onbranch
inputs.description: Required callback receiving the selected branch name.

inputs.name: HarnessSelectors.oncommit
inputs.description: Required callback receiving the selected viewed commit.

inputs.name: HarnessSelectors.onbase
inputs.description: Required callback receiving the selected comparison-base commit.

inputs.name: HarnessSelectors.tip
inputs.type: { note: string; viewed: string; href: string | null; onfollow: () => void } | null
inputs.description: Optional branch-tip notice, defaulting to null. Supplies its note, viewed commit, destination and follow callback; the tip action is disabled without a destination.

outputs.name: HarnessSelectors
outputs.description: Branch and revision controls, an optional base control and branch-tip action, and a notice when the index retains only part of the history.

declarations.title: Standalone explorer shell
declarations.responsibility: Hosts the explorer using browser history outside a framework router.

inputs.name: HarnessShell.base
inputs.description: Required explorer URL prefix, removed from the current browser path to initialize the relative route and added back for navigation.

inputs.name: HarnessShell.links
inputs.description: Optional compatibility links, defaulting to an empty list. Forwarded to the console, which currently does not render them.

inputs.name: HarnessShell.exportable
inputs.description: Optional export flag, defaulting to true, forwarded to the console.

outputs.name: HarnessShell
outputs.description: The generic explorer screen inside the console. Browser back and forward update the relative path; console navigation pushes or replaces browser history.

declarations.title: Explorer section tabs
declarations.responsibility: Renders a selectable horizontal strip of explorer sections.

inputs.name: HarnessTabs.view
inputs.description: Required selected section value.

inputs.name: HarnessTabs.onview
inputs.description: Required callback receiving the chosen section after a plain link click or enabled button click.

inputs.name: HarnessTabs.tabs
inputs.description: Optional tab definitions. When omitted, uses map, compare, history, growth and activity; an explicitly empty list renders no tabs. Definitions may provide destinations and disabled state.

inputs.name: HarnessTabs.label
inputs.description: Optional accessible navigation label, defaulting to Views.

outputs.name: HarnessTabs
outputs.description: Links for enabled tabs with destinations and buttons otherwise. Keeps the selected tab visible within the scrolling strip as selection or size changes, without moving focus or scrolling the page.

declarations.title: Unit contract and evidence
declarations.responsibility: Presents a unit’s technical contract, dependencies, budgets and recorded scenario coverage.

inputs.name: HarnessUnit.unit
inputs.description: Required unit definition whose ownership, interfaces, dependencies and limits are displayed.

inputs.name: HarnessUnit.units
inputs.description: Required surrounding registry, used to resolve dependency relationships and find consumers.

inputs.name: HarnessUnit.scenarios
inputs.description: Required scenarios, filtered to those covering this unit.

inputs.name: HarnessUnit.records
inputs.description: Required verification records. Prefers a valid passed record, then any valid record, to show measured results and scenario status.

inputs.name: HarnessUnit.removed
inputs.description: Optional removed-unit label, defaulting to false. The caller must supply the appropriate historical unit and evidence.

inputs.name: HarnessUnit.onselect
inputs.description: Required callback receiving a dependency or consumer identifier when selected.

outputs.name: HarnessUnit
outputs.description: Ownership and interface details; dependencies and consumers; runtime, source, emitted-size and performance budgets; unprofiled measurements for this unit; and scenario requirements, exemptions, viewports, tests and recorded outcomes. Scenarios without a selected record remain not tested.

declarations.title: Verification verdict indicator
declarations.responsibility: Shows whether supplied evidence passed and exposes its explanation in an accessible tooltip.

inputs.name: HarnessVerdict.passed
inputs.description: Required verdict. Only the literal value true is treated as proven.

inputs.name: HarnessVerdict.label
inputs.description: Optional displayed verdict text. When omitted or null, uses Full coverage passed or Verification failed according to passed; an empty string is retained.

inputs.name: HarnessVerdict.reasons
inputs.description: Optional failure explanations, defaulting to an empty list. Suppressed for a proven verdict.

inputs.name: HarnessVerdict.framed
inputs.description: Optional outlined presentation, defaulting to false.

inputs.name: HarnessVerdict.bare
inputs.description: Accepted compatibility prop that is not read and has no effect.

outputs.name: HarnessVerdict
outputs.description: Verdict icon and tooltip. Hover or keyboard focus reveals the explanation; clicking pins it, while Escape, blur or an outside pointer action closes it. The tooltip stays within the viewport and supports keyboard scrolling when its content overflows.

declarations.title: Explorer route screen
declarations.responsibility: Connects a framework route to the explorer console and a supplied screen component.

inputs.name: HarnessScreen.title
inputs.description: Required page title, followed by the Harness name in the document title.

inputs.name: HarnessScreen.content
inputs.description: Required explorer screen component to render through the console.

outputs.name: HarnessScreen
outputs.description: Explorer console bound to the current route and query beneath /harness. Navigation uses the framework router with the requested history replacement while preserving focus and avoiding automatic page scrolling.

declarations.title: HubView
declarations.responsibility: Owns the HubView Svelte component.

retired.reason: No production importer, mount or export; legacy report routes use the live Harness console.

declarations.title: Zoomable evidence image
declarations.responsibility: Lets users inspect a recorded image at fitted, actual or enlarged size.

inputs.name: ImageZoom.src
inputs.description: Required image address. The component loads this directly into the image element.

inputs.name: ImageZoom.alt
inputs.description: Required image alternative text.

outputs.name: ImageZoom
outputs.description: An image initially fitted to its stage, with fit, actual-size and stepped zoom controls. Zoom preserves the pointer or viewport-center position; an enlarged image can be dragged with the primary mouse button. Trackpad zoom is bounded between fit and four times natural size.

declarations.title: Evidence dialog
declarations.responsibility: Displays titled evidence or text in a native modal dialog with optional footer content.

inputs.name: Modal.open
inputs.description: Optional open state, defaulting to false. Used only when isOpen is null or undefined.

inputs.name: Modal.isOpen
inputs.description: Optional open-state alias that takes precedence over open, including when false.

inputs.name: Modal.title
inputs.description: Optional dialog heading, defaulting to an empty string.

inputs.name: Modal.variant
inputs.description: Optional presentation, defaulting to image. Text adds text styling; lightbox fills the viewport.

inputs.name: Modal.onClose
inputs.description: Optional close request callback for the close button, backdrop and native cancel event. Called alongside onclose when both are supplied; the parent owns open state.

inputs.name: Modal.onclose
inputs.description: Optional alternate close request callback, invoked after onClose for the same close actions. It does not replace onClose.

inputs.name: Modal.children
inputs.description: Optional dialog body content; omitted content renders nothing.

inputs.name: Modal.footer
inputs.description: Optional footer content. The footer is rendered only when this snippet is supplied.

outputs.name: Modal
outputs.description: A native dialog when isOpen, or otherwise open, is true. It shows the title, child content and optional footer in the selected image, text or lightbox presentation. Close-button and backdrop actions invoke both supplied close callbacks; Escape also invokes them through the cancel event. The parent owns the open state.

declarations.title: Project activity overview
declarations.responsibility: Presents recorded repository activity alongside available live agent and worktree observations.

inputs.name: ProjectActivity.activity
inputs.description: Required recorded activity, including repository identity, branch/head, work and loops. Its kind controls whether registry information is described as recorded.

inputs.name: ProjectActivity.live
inputs.description: Required live observations or null. Supplies agent and worktree state when available.

inputs.name: ProjectActivity.base
inputs.description: Required explorer prefix used for commit links. A commit uses the current branch when it belongs there, otherwise a listed matching branch.

inputs.name: ProjectActivity.reading
inputs.type: { now: number; failed: boolean; refresh: () => void }
inputs.description: Optional live-reading state, supplying the current time, failed-read flag and refresh callback to the live views.

outputs.name: ProjectActivity
outputs.description: Repository identity and commit navigation, agent observations, worktrees, recorded work and loops. Missing live data remains distinguishable from observations. This component renders supplied data and does not fetch it.

declarations.title: Session model picker
declarations.responsibility: Lets a user inspect a session and queue or cancel its provider, model and reasoning-effort change.

inputs.name: ProviderPicker.label
inputs.description: Optional heading, defaulting to Model picker.

outputs.name: ProviderPicker
outputs.description: Connects to the picker client on mount and closes that connection on destruction. Displays session status and active/queued selections, allows binding a trimmed session identifier, refreshes state, and queues supported model/effort selections. Queuing does not immediately change the observed active model or global defaults. Operation failures appear as error text and controls lock while an operation runs.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An invalid non-array response while listing queued sessions raises Queued sessions could not be read. inside the operation handler. That handler catches it and displays its message; ordinary operation failures are also caught, rather than deliberately thrown to the caller.

declarations.title: Active and queued model cards
declarations.responsibility: Distinguishes an observed active model from a pending or completed model-switch request.

inputs.name: ProviderPickerCards.active
inputs.description: Required observed session or null. Null shows that the active selection is unknown; an observation supplies selection, client, idle state and time.

inputs.name: ProviderPickerCards.request
inputs.description: Required switch request or null. Shows requested selection, status, queue time and reason when present.

inputs.name: ProviderPickerCards.models
inputs.description: Required known models used to resolve a friendly model label, falling back to the model identifier.

inputs.name: ProviderPickerCards.providers
inputs.description: Required provider-name lookup used in selection labels.

inputs.name: ProviderPickerCards.locked
inputs.description: Required flag disabling cancellation while another operation locks the controls.

inputs.name: ProviderPickerCards.oncancel
inputs.description: Required callback invoked by the cancel action for a pending request.

outputs.name: ProviderPickerCards
outputs.description: Separate active-session and switch-request cards. A pending request has a cancel action; no request receives an explicit empty state. The cards do not perform the cancellation themselves.

declarations.title: Recorded test value
declarations.responsibility: Presents recorded values as labelled fields, typed values, lists and result tables.

inputs.name: RecordedValue.value
inputs.description: The input, observed output or error exactly as read from verified evidence.

outputs.name: RecordedValue
outputs.description: A readable, bounded preview. Full original data stays available in its recording.

declarations.title: Regression proof
declarations.responsibility: Show the failing-test commit beside the fix that passes the same test.

inputs.name: Request
inputs.description: Commit-linked regression results for the selected unit

outputs.name: Result
outputs.description: Readable failure and pass cards with revision links and optional recorded output

errors.name: Invalid proof
errors.description: Missing or damaged evidence is shown as a gap; no result is invented.

declarations.title: Evidence replay controls
declarations.responsibility: Provides playback, frame, scene, speed and fullscreen controls for an evidence replay.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.playing
inputs.description: Required current playback state, choosing the play or pause presentation.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.index
inputs.description: Required current frame index, used for timeline position and previous/next availability.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.count
inputs.description: Required frame count. The timeline spans zero through count minus one, bounded at zero, and is disabled below two frames.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.elapsed
inputs.description: Required elapsed playback time, formatted in seconds.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.total
inputs.description: Required total playback time, formatted in seconds.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.title
inputs.description: Required replay title displayed in the controls.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.scene
inputs.description: Required selected scene number or null. Null leaves the scene selector on its placeholder.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.scenes
inputs.description: Required scene choices. An empty array hides the scene selector.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.fullscreen
inputs.description: Required current fullscreen state, selecting the appropriate toggle presentation.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.speed
inputs.description: Optional bindable playback multiplier, defaulting to 1, chosen from the component’s supported speed options.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.ontoggle
inputs.description: Required callback to toggle playback.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.onseek
inputs.description: Required callback receiving a requested frame index from the slider, previous/next controls or latest-frame action.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.onscene
inputs.description: Required callback receiving the selected scene number.

inputs.name: ReplayControls.onfullscreen
inputs.description: Required callback to toggle fullscreen.

outputs.name: ReplayControls
outputs.description: Playback toolbar, frame timeline, elapsed/total time, speed and optional scene selection. It requests actions from the host and does not run its own playback timer.

declarations.title: Recorded report checks
declarations.responsibility: Lists the checks and diagnostic details stored in a report.

inputs.name: ReportChecks.checks
inputs.description: Required recorded checks, supplying status, grouping, counts and optional command/output details.

inputs.name: ReportChecks.embedded
inputs.description: Optional compact presentation, defaulting to false. True omits the enclosing panel and Checks heading.

outputs.name: ReportChecks
outputs.description: Check list with statuses, available count values and expandable diagnostic details, or an explicit empty state. It displays recorded checks without executing commands.

declarations.title: Report findings
declarations.responsibility: Shows recorded findings and links to their supporting evidence.

inputs.name: ReportFindings.findings
inputs.description: Required findings, supplying each status, title, detail and optional evidence identifiers.

outputs.name: ReportFindings
outputs.description: A findings section and cards when the list is nonempty. Evidence identifiers become anchor links; an empty list renders no section.

declarations.title: Report overview and downloads
declarations.responsibility: Summarizes the report’s recorded outcome, evidence gaps, lifecycle and available exports.

inputs.name: ReportSummary.report
inputs.description: Required report supplying status, summary, findings, coverage, checks, revision, timestamps and export availability. The gap count includes failed, blocked or not-proven findings and coverage plus a missing revision; it does not count failed checks.

inputs.name: ReportSummary.downloadBase
inputs.description: Required address prefix used to build available PDF, ZIP and HTML download links.

inputs.name: ReportSummary.portable
inputs.description: Optional portable-view flag, defaulting to false. Hides ZIP and HTML downloads while retaining an available PDF link.

outputs.name: ReportSummary
outputs.description: Outcome and summary, passed-check and evidence-gap counts, lifecycle and historical/stale notices, and expandable run metadata. Missing revisions remain not proven. Exports are shown only when available, otherwise as pending; finalizing receives its own notice.

declarations.title: Report viewer
declarations.responsibility: Presents a report with its recorded evidence and expandable review details.

inputs.name: ReportView.report
inputs.description: Required report providing summary, findings, checks, acceptance criteria, coverage, evidence and replay data.

inputs.name: ReportView.assetBase
inputs.description: Required media address prefix passed to evidence and replay viewers.

inputs.name: ReportView.downloadBase
inputs.description: Required download address prefix passed to the report summary.

inputs.name: ReportView.portable
inputs.description: Optional portable presentation, defaulting to false. True changes the brand destination and hides project-history navigation and upload eligibility.

inputs.name: ReportView.onUploaded
inputs.description: Optional callback forwarded to evidence uploads so the host can receive the updated report.

outputs.name: ReportView
outputs.description: Report summary, findings, evidence gallery, replay and footer. Checks, acceptance and coverage open in a dialog; closing returns focus to the triggering button. Upload eligibility is passed only for an active, nonportable report.

declarations.title: Report select control
declarations.responsibility: Provides a labeled native selection control with shared report styling.

inputs.name: Select.value
inputs.description: Optional bindable selected value, defaulting to an empty string.

inputs.name: Select.label
inputs.description: Required accessible label for the select.

inputs.name: Select.id
inputs.description: Optional HTML identifier.

inputs.name: Select.name
inputs.description: Optional form field name.

inputs.name: Select.required
inputs.description: Optional native required flag, omitted by default.

inputs.name: Select.disabled
inputs.description: Optional disabled state, defaulting to false.

inputs.name: Select.children
inputs.description: Required snippet supplying the option markup.

outputs.name: Select
outputs.description: Native select with a decorative arrow. Binding updates its selected value; disabled and required behavior follow the browser. Forced-color mode restores the native appearance.

declarations.title: Live site activity
declarations.responsibility: Keeps a supplied project activity snapshot visible while refreshing its live observations.

inputs.name: SiteActivity.shown
inputs.description: Required initial recorded and live activity snapshot. Remains visible until a newer read arrives.

outputs.name: SiteActivity
outputs.description: Project activity for the most recent successful read, with reading age, failure state and refresh control. On mount starts the activity client and a five-second age clock; on destruction stops both. A failed refresh retains prior data and marks the read as failed.

declarations.title: Report status badge
declarations.responsibility: Shows a report status using its translated label and status styling.

inputs.name: StatusBadge.status
inputs.description: Required report status, used for the CSS class and translation key.

outputs.name: StatusBadge
outputs.description: Inline status badge with translated text and a decorative dot hidden from assistive technology.

declarations.title: Audio evidence upload
declarations.responsibility: Adds a single recording or paired before-and-after audio evidence to a report.

inputs.name: UploadAudio.reportId
inputs.description: Required report identifier included in submitted form data.

inputs.name: UploadAudio.onUploaded
inputs.description: Required callback receiving the returned report after a 201 response with an evidence array.

outputs.name: UploadAudio
outputs.description: Expandable audio upload form with single/comparison modes, required title up to 120 characters, optional source up to 200 and notes up to 2000. Rejects selected files above 50,000,000 bytes before posting. Controls lock during upload; failures appear in status text. Success resets fields and file pickers while retaining the mode.

declarations.title: Screenshot comparison upload
declarations.responsibility: Submits before-and-after screenshots and their comparison details to a report.

inputs.name: UploadComparison.reportId
inputs.description: Required report identifier included in the upload body.

inputs.name: UploadComparison.onUploaded
inputs.description: Required callback receiving the successful response cast as a Report.

outputs.name: UploadComparison
outputs.description: Expandable form with required title up to 120 characters, optional viewport and two required PNG, JPEG or WebP file selections. Posts form data, displays progress or failure, and resets fields and file labels after success. Submission is disabled before mount or during upload.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Non-success HTTP responses raise the returned error or Upload failed inside the submit handler. The handler catches errors and renders their message rather than exposing them to the caller.
