declarations.title: Activity refresh client
declarations.responsibility: Refreshes site activity while a browser page is visible and reports missing readings.

inputs.name: activityClient.arrived
inputs.description: Callback receiving parsed activity after a successful request while the client remains active.

inputs.name: activityClient.missed
inputs.description: Callback invoked when an active request fails, including an HTTP or JSON failure.

outputs.name: activityClient
outputs.description: Returns refresh and stop methods. Refresh skips overlapping or stopped requests and uses a no-cache activity request. Polls every 15 seconds while visible and when visibility changes to visible; it does not request immediately on construction. Stop removes the timer/listener and aborts the request.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A non-success HTTP status creates Activity unavailable. internally, but refresh catches it and calls missed while active.

declarations.title: Activity labels and links
declarations.responsibility: Formats recorded activity timestamps, agent states, counts and commit navigation.

inputs.name: commitHref.base
inputs.description: Explorer address prefix.

inputs.name: commitHref.commit
inputs.description: Commit to open in history.

inputs.name: commitHref.branches
inputs.description: Branch choices; uses the first or a retained-commit route when none exist.

inputs.name: activityTime.iso
inputs.description: Timestamp to format.

inputs.name: plural.count
inputs.description: Count to display.

inputs.name: plural.word
inputs.description: Singular word to pluralize by appending s unless the count is exactly one.

inputs.name: activityDisplay.agents
inputs.description: Registered agent roster with a working count or null for unknown.

outputs.name: agentStates
outputs.description: Labels for working, stale, ended, completed and failed agents.

outputs.name: commitHref
outputs.description: History address formed from the base and commit route.

outputs.name: activityTime
outputs.description: UTC date and minute for a valid timestamp; otherwise the original text.

outputs.name: plural
outputs.description: Count followed by the word in singular or simple plural form.

outputs.name: activityDisplay
outputs.description: Sentence stating the registered working-agent count, or that it is unknown when no agent has registered. Explicitly excludes unregistered agents.

declarations.title: Activity freshness
declarations.responsibility: Determines which registered agents a sampled roster can still describe as working.

inputs.name: activityReading.agents
inputs.description: Roster and its reported working count.

inputs.name: activityReading.sampledAt
inputs.description: Time the roster was sampled.

inputs.name: activityReading.now
inputs.description: Current time in milliseconds since the epoch.

outputs.name: readingAge
outputs.description: Freshness allowance of 60,000 milliseconds.

outputs.name: activityReading
outputs.description: Returns whether the reading is at most one minute old, a working count reduced by expired working entries or null when unknown/old, and a labeling function. Finished states retain their labels; old working observations become Not confirmed and individually expired ones become Stale.

declarations.title: CPU sampling client
declarations.responsibility: Refreshes browser CPU observations and explicitly reports unavailable samples.

inputs.name: analyticsCpuClient.update
inputs.description: Callback receiving a parsed CPU snapshot, or null when an active request fails.

outputs.name: analyticsCpuClient
outputs.description: Returns refresh and stop. Starts one request immediately and polls every five seconds while visible; overlapping requests are skipped. Stop cancels the timer and aborts the request, suppressing subsequent delivery.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A non-success HTTP response creates CPU sample unavailable. internally; refresh catches failures and delivers null while active.

declarations.title: Analytics number formatting
declarations.responsibility: Formats assessment proportions and counts for analytics views.

inputs.name: analyticsDisplay.value
inputs.description: Fraction to display as a percentage, or null when no assessments exist.

inputs.name: analyticsCount.value
inputs.description: Count to format using the runtime locale.

outputs.name: analyticsDisplay
outputs.description: Rounded whole percentage, or No assessments for null.

outputs.name: analyticsCount
outputs.description: Locale-formatted count.

declarations.title: Recorded invocation reader
declarations.responsibility: Reads recorded function input/output cases while distinguishing missing or malformed evidence.

inputs.name: artifactCases.document
inputs.description: Parsed artifact document of unknown shape.

inputs.name: artifactCases.unit
inputs.description: Optional expected unit identifier. When supplied, recorded invocations must name that unit.

outputs.name: caseForm
outputs.description: Supported form: schema version 1, function-invocations kind, at most 64 cases and case names up to 160 characters.

outputs.name: artifactCases
outputs.description: Returns invocation cases only when every case has a nonempty bounded name, input and exactly one of output or error, with valid unit/symbol metadata. Otherwise returns a stated gap. Legacy top-level input/inputs/request plus output/outputs/response become one observation row; false, zero, null and empty values are retained.

declarations.title: Audio asset validation
declarations.responsibility: Checks supported audio content and derives a content-addressed filename and metadata.

inputs.name: audioAsset.bytes
inputs.description: Nonempty audio bytes, limited to 50,000,000 bytes.

inputs.name: audioAsset.filename
inputs.description: Original filename whose lowercase extension selects the format.

outputs.name: audioAsset
outputs.description: SHA-256 filename with the original lowercase extension, audio MIME type and media kind, plus WAV metadata when applicable. MP3, Ogg and M4A undergo header/container checks; no file is written.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects empty/oversized data, unsupported formats and content that fails the selected format check. WAV parser failures propagate.

declarations.title: Audio comparison pairing
declarations.responsibility: Finds unambiguous before-and-after audio pairs in recorded evidence.

inputs.name: audioPairs.items
inputs.description: Evidence items; only audio with a nonblank comparison name and before/after phase participate.

outputs.name: audioPairs
outputs.description: Map from each after-item identifier to its before item, grouped by exact comparison text and viewport. Only groups with exactly one item on each side are paired; ambiguous and incomplete groups are omitted.

declarations.title: Harness brand geometry
declarations.responsibility: Provides shared mark geometry, colors and standalone favicon SVG.

outputs.name: brandGrid
outputs.description: The 32-unit geometry grid.

outputs.name: brandTiles
outputs.description: Five 10-unit square tiles at the corners and center of a three-by-three lattice, spaced in 11-unit steps, with stable numeric identifiers.

outputs.name: brandColors
outputs.description: Gold #f2bf3f and navy #0b1a37 colors.

outputs.name: brandMark
outputs.description: Standalone SVG text with gold tiles inset by ten units on a navy 52-unit rounded square.

declarations.title: Match browser error expectations
declarations.responsibility: Classify observed browser errors and retain expectations that were not observed.

inputs.name: browserErrorRows.diagnostic
inputs.description: One attempt’s observed errors and declared expectations. Each expectation matches exact type and message and, when specified, exact source.

outputs.name: browserErrorRows
outputs.description: Rows in observation order marked Expected or Unexpected, followed by unused expectations marked Missing expected error. Each expectation accounts for one occurrence; matching rows retain diagnostic context and add the expectation reason. Inputs are not modified.

declarations.title: Capture provenance labels
declarations.responsibility: Explains capture origin and acceptance separately from the revision a verification attempt targeted.

inputs.name: captureProvenance.record
inputs.description: Record supplying validity, outcome and target revision.

inputs.name: captureProvenance.scenario
inputs.description: Scenario supplying tested revision, inheritance and original record.

inputs.name: captureProvenance.capture
inputs.description: Capture supplying status, source build and optional provenance.

inputs.name: scenarioOrigin.scenario
inputs.description: Scenario whose result origin should be summarized.

outputs.name: captureProvenance
outputs.description: Standing, label, facts and full-revision note. Invalid records take precedence over failed captures; otherwise captures are rejected, inherited or fresh. Rejection labels distinguish a different recorded build from a required build stamp that is missing.

outputs.name: scenarioOrigin
outputs.description: Inherited origin, tested revision for a passed scenario, or failed-attempt revision plus distinct other capture revisions when present.

declarations.title: Portable verification export
declarations.responsibility: Builds a standalone HTML report for one recorded verification with available media embedded.

inputs.name: consoleExport.input
inputs.description: Commit, optional record identifier, index/detail JSON and asynchronous media loader. Requested records fall back to a valid passed record, then the first record.

inputs.name: consoleExport.assets
inputs.description: Compiled viewer assets used by the portable page renderer.

outputs.name: consoleExport
outputs.description: Resolves to portable HTML, or undefined when the requested commit summary or any usable record choice is absent. Media bytes become data URLs; missing media is marked missing.

declarations.title: Local console access
declarations.responsibility: Supplies local history files and the cached access guard used by the reports server.

outputs.name: consoleDirectory
outputs.description: Resolved history directory from the trimmed console-data environment setting, or undefined when unset.

outputs.name: consoleData
outputs.description: Disk-backed JSON and media readers. Rejects lexical paths outside the history directory and returns undefined for missing or unreadable files; media includes MIME type. Intended for server code that has already passed its guard.

outputs.name: consoleServer
outputs.description: Lazily cached ConsoleAccess configured from owner mode, bind address and address-header settings, with local data and portable export support.

declarations.title: Prepare typed contract fields
declarations.responsibility: Prepares public types, readable field groups and honest example labels for one opened entity.

inputs.name: typeLabel.type
inputs.description: A public type expression that may contain an inferred module import.

inputs.name: contractFields.unit
inputs.description: The entity whose contract fields and declared JSON examples will be displayed.

inputs.name: contractFields.category
inputs.description: The entity category; configs call their outputs Provides.

inputs.name: contractFacts.rows
inputs.description: Prepared readable contract rows, including facts beyond individual fields.

inputs.name: contractFacts.unit
inputs.description: The entity whose execution targets may be listed as contract facts.

inputs.name: contractFacts.category
inputs.description: The entity category; functions also expose execution targets.

outputs.name: typeLabel
outputs.description: The type expression with inferred import paths removed.

outputs.name: contractFields
outputs.description: Input, output and error groups with descriptions and declared examples. Safe simple types may get labelled placeholders; opaque types keep explicit gaps.

outputs.name: contractFacts
outputs.description: Whole-contract facts without duplicate field summaries, plus execution targets for functions.

declarations.title: correctedLocation
declarations.responsibility: Says where an explorer address of an entity belongs at its revision: under the category the entity has there, with its branch, commit, section and tab kept.

inputs.name: correctedLocation.at
inputs.description: The address that was asked for.

inputs.name: correctedLocation.entities
inputs.description: The entities of the shown revision, each with the category its manifest declares there.

outputs.name: correctedLocation
outputs.description: The same address under the category of the entity at this revision; null when it is already there, names no entity or the revision does not hold it.

declarations.title: Isolated browser-run fixtures
declarations.responsibility: Resolves, creates and cleans per-run fixture locations and assigns browser-test ports.

inputs.name: e2eFixtures.env
inputs.description: Optional environment map, defaulting to process.env; requires HARNESS_E2E_ROOT.

inputs.name: freePorts.count
inputs.description: Number of loopback ports to sample; zero returns an empty list.

inputs.name: openE2eRun.env
inputs.description: Optional mutable environment map, defaulting to process.env. Existing directory and named ports are retained; unnamed ports are assigned.

inputs.name: namedE2eRun.env
inputs.description: Optional environment map, defaulting to process.env, inspected for a named root without an owner.

inputs.name: closeE2eRun.env
inputs.description: Optional environment map, defaulting to process.env; cleanup requires this process to own its root.

outputs.name: e2eFixtures
outputs.description: Run root, report/console/analytics/build locations and a site-path function. Console and analytics environment overrides are honored.

outputs.name: freePorts
outputs.description: Ports that were available when a child process briefly listened, then released them. They are not reserved for later use.

outputs.name: openE2eRun
outputs.description: Creates a temporary run directory and records this process as owner when none was named, assigns missing port variables, and returns fixture locations.

outputs.name: namedE2eRun
outputs.description: True when a root is set without an owner marker.

outputs.name: closeE2eRun
outputs.description: Removes the owned run directory and its frozen build cache. Does nothing when another process owns the run or no root exists.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Missing HARNESS_E2E_ROOT throws explicit guidance. Filesystem, child-process and parsing failures may propagate.

declarations.title: Readable behavior results
declarations.responsibility: Groups recorded behavior results by scenario and state without strengthening the host’s conclusion.

inputs.name: entityBehavior.behavior
inputs.description: Host-derived behavior comparison, rows, scenario statuses and uncertainty explanation.

inputs.name: behaviorDuration.record
inputs.description: Verification record to inspect, or null.

inputs.name: behaviorDuration.scenarios
inputs.description: Scenario identifiers whose end-to-end job durations should be summed.

outputs.name: entityBehavior
outputs.description: Grouped before/after result cells, label and reasons. A current result passes only when something was recorded, every shown group passed and all scenario after-statuses passed. Missing results and unknown or byte-only differences remain uncertain.

outputs.name: behaviorDuration
outputs.description: Sum of durations for end-to-end jobs named with one of the scenario identifiers followed by a colon, rendered in milliseconds; null when no such jobs exist.

declarations.title: Entity collection rows
declarations.responsibility: Builds readable collection rows and applies search, change filtering and ordering.

inputs.name: isShared.related
inputs.description: Resolved relations to inspect for shared use.

inputs.name: entityCatalog.entities
inputs.description: Entities available at the shown revision.

inputs.name: entityCatalog.category
inputs.description: Category to list.

inputs.name: entityCatalog.relations
inputs.description: Lookup called once for each entity in the requested category.

inputs.name: catalogFilter.rows
inputs.description: Collection rows to filter without mutating the original array.

inputs.name: catalogFilter.filter
inputs.description: Search text, changed-only flag and supported ordering choice. Search matches name and purpose case-insensitively after trimming.

inputs.name: listed.names
inputs.description: Names to summarize in a table cell.

inputs.name: listed.most
inputs.description: Maximum names to show before the remainder count; defaults to one.

outputs.name: catalogOrders
outputs.description: Supported orders: name, name-desc, changed and failed.

outputs.name: orderLabels
outputs.description: Readable labels for the supported orders.

outputs.name: isShared
outputs.description: True when more than one entity uses the unit or more than one page shows it.

outputs.name: entityCatalog
outputs.description: Rows sorted by English name, including purpose, verdict, relation names, target kinds and component count. Only direct or added changes count as changed.

outputs.name: catalogFilter
outputs.description: Matching rows in the requested order. Changed-first and failed-first ties sort by name; failed-first includes every verdict that is not passed.

outputs.name: listed
outputs.description: none for an empty list; otherwise names joined by middle dots, with a remainder count when the limit is exceeded.

declarations.title: Readable entity contracts
declarations.responsibility: Converts declared interfaces and applicable scenario states into readable contract rows.

inputs.name: humanize.name
inputs.description: Identifier to split into ordinary lowercase words.

inputs.name: requiredStates.unit
inputs.description: Unit whose required states are requested.

inputs.name: requiredStates.scenarios
inputs.description: Scenario declarations to examine.

inputs.name: requiredStates.units
inputs.description: Registry units used to determine which scenario states actually show the unit.

inputs.name: entityContract.unit
inputs.description: Unit supplying its responsibility, contract and runtime.

inputs.name: entityContract.facts
inputs.description: Display category plus optional app route and applicable states.

outputs.name: humanize
outputs.description: Words separated at camel-case, acronym and underscore/dot/hyphen boundaries, trimmed and lowercased.

outputs.name: requiredStates
outputs.description: Unique required state identifiers from scenarios naming the unit, narrowed through scenarioFor.

outputs.name: entityContract
outputs.description: Category-specific rows: pages include purpose, address and required states; configs show purpose and provided outputs; other categories show inputs, outputs and errors, with service runtime and supplied states. Field descriptions are retained, with missing descriptions stated when some fields are described. Component-self markup outputs read rendered markup.

declarations.title: Entity history presentation
declarations.responsibility: Formats history verdicts, recorded timing comparisons, budget reviews and measurement changes.

inputs.name: historyVerdict.coverage
inputs.description: Recorded coverage status.

inputs.name: historyListed.rows
inputs.description: Candidate history rows in their supplied order.

inputs.name: historyListed.read
inputs.description: Lookup of already-read revision details by commit.

inputs.name: entityHistory.index
inputs.description: Index containing benchmark series.

inputs.name: entityHistory.unit
inputs.description: Unit whose benchmark series should be used.

inputs.name: entityHistory.rows
inputs.description: Listed commits in newest-first order; each compares only to the next listed commit in the same series.

inputs.name: historyProfiles.timings
inputs.description: Timing map whose profile identifiers should be collected.

inputs.name: reviewChanges.review
inputs.description: Budget review containing new limits and optional prior limits.

inputs.name: signedBytes.delta
inputs.description: Byte difference, or null/undefined when no comparison exists.

inputs.name: signedCount.delta
inputs.description: Count difference, or null/undefined when no comparison exists.

outputs.name: historyVerdict
outputs.description: Passed only for verified coverage; other labels distinguish verification failure, unusable evidence and missing evidence.

outputs.name: historyListed
outputs.description: Listed rows known to have changed the entity directly, been added or removed, plus a separate list of unknown rows whose details have not arrived.

outputs.name: entityHistory
outputs.description: Map of timings at listed commits, preserving workload, metric, target and profile. A before value is included only when that same series has a point at the next listed commit.

outputs.name: historyProfiles
outputs.description: Distinct profiles in first-occurrence order.

outputs.name: reviewChanges
outputs.description: One readable sentence per new limit, including the old-to-new change when a prior value exists. Emitted-size keys receive target labels.

outputs.name: signedBytes
outputs.description: Empty for a missing comparison, No change for zero, otherwise signed human-readable bytes.

outputs.name: signedCount
outputs.description: Empty for a missing comparison, No change for zero, otherwise a signed count.

declarations.title: Entity navigation context
declarations.responsibility: Builds related explorer locations while preserving branch and revision context.

inputs.name: entityLens.from
inputs.description: Current explorer location.

inputs.name: entityLens.to
inputs.description: Optional target commit, category, entity, section and tab. Omitted commit/category retain the current values; null commit explicitly selects current mode.

inputs.name: shortCommit.commit
inputs.description: Commit text to abbreviate.

outputs.name: entityLabels
outputs.description: Titles, singular labels and descriptions for the six explorer collections.

outputs.name: entityLens
outputs.description: New location retaining the branch. Entity, section and tab are carried only when explicitly supplied, and section/tab are omitted without a target entity.

outputs.name: shortCommit
outputs.description: First seven characters of the supplied commit.

declarations.title: Entity measurement display
declarations.responsibility: Formats one unit’s recorded size and declared performance measurements without combining profiles.

inputs.name: byteSize.count
inputs.description: Byte count to format; sign is retained.

inputs.name: entityMeasure.unit
inputs.description: Unit supplying identity, emitted targets and performance budgets.

inputs.name: entityMeasure.record
inputs.description: Host-selected verification record, or null when none is available.

outputs.name: notMeasured
outputs.description: The Not measured placeholder.

outputs.name: tolerancePolicy
outputs.description: Maximum accepted declared timing tolerance of 0.05, used to flag looser budgets.

outputs.name: byteSize
outputs.description: Decimal B, KB or MB size, rounded to at most one decimal place using 1,000-based units.

outputs.name: entityMeasure
outputs.description: Source, emitted-size and complexity rows plus one performance row per matching measurement/profile or an explicit unmeasured row. Own size metrics exclude workload/profile measurements. Partial and unavailable notes remain visible; timing tolerance above five percent is flagged.

declarations.title: Recorded change explanations
declarations.responsibility: Summarizes recorded reasons within writing limits while retaining full notes, attempts and outcomes.

inputs.name: boundedText.notes
inputs.description: Notes to normalize, deduplicate and join.

inputs.name: boundedText.limit
inputs.description: Maximum character count and optional word limit for the combined text.

inputs.name: entityReasons.reasons
inputs.description: Recorded explanations with behavior, simplification and performance attempts and outcomes.

inputs.name: reasonsTried.reasons
inputs.description: Prepared reasons whose attempts should be summarized for a history row.

inputs.name: reasonUses.uses
inputs.description: Subject/kind/outcome uses of an attempt to group.

outputs.name: boundedText
outputs.description: Combined normalized text and whether it was cut. Truncation uses whole words and an ellipsis when possible; an overlong first word is cut by Unicode characters.

outputs.name: entityReasons
outputs.description: Bounded behavior and attempt summaries, distinct outcomes and original full notes/attempts grouped by normalized text with subjects. long is true for multiple reasons or any truncation.

outputs.name: reasonsTried
outputs.description: Nonempty attempt summaries for simplification then performance, omitting exact duplicate attempts already represented by simplification.

outputs.name: reasonUses
outputs.type: Array<{ kind: ReasonKind; outcome: string; subjects: string[] }>
outputs.description: Groups by reason kind and outcome, listing their subjects.

declarations.title: Removed scenario declarations
declarations.responsibility: Explains scenarios or states declared by a parent that the selected commit no longer declares.

inputs.name: entityRemoved.evidence
inputs.description: Before/after evidence coverage supplied by the host.

outputs.name: entityRemoved
outputs.description: Sentences for each removed whole scenario or removed state. Uses coverage declarations rather than inferring removals from absent captures; no before coverage yields an empty list.

declarations.title: Entity screenshot selection
declarations.responsibility: Selects matching recorded screenshots and builds gallery items while retaining capture provenance and explicit gaps.

inputs.name: screenOptions.scenarios
inputs.description: Scenario declarations; only those with viewports become screenshot choices.

inputs.name: screenPick.options
inputs.description: Available scenario/state/viewport options.

inputs.name: screenPick.wanted
inputs.description: Partial requested selection; unknown choices fall back to the first available choice at each level.

inputs.name: entityScreens.evidence
inputs.description: Host-selected evidence for the current revision or compared revisions.

inputs.name: entityScreens.pick
inputs.description: Selected scenario, state and viewport, or null when there is no visual scenario.

inputs.name: galleryItems.evidence
inputs.description: Evidence whose screenshot and audio captures should become gallery items.

inputs.name: catalogShot.evidence
inputs.description: The host-selected evidence for one entity at the shown revision. Captures from other states or entities must already be excluded by its declared coverage.

outputs.name: screenOptions
outputs.description: Scenario choices with required states and labeled viewport dimensions.

outputs.name: screenPick
outputs.description: Resolved choice, or null when no scenarios exist. Missing state or viewport choices become an empty string.

outputs.name: entityScreens
outputs.description: After screenshot or explicit gap, plus before at a selected commit. Matches scenario/state/viewport exactly; current mode rejects a non-current capture rather than borrowing it. Includes freshness and inherited-origin information.

outputs.name: galleryItems
outputs.description: Before media then after media in commit mode, or current media alone, with sequence order, status, provenance and media details. Includes recorded screenshot/audio items even when unusable or inherited, retaining their labels. Source identifies the capture build revision, never the target of inherited proof.

outputs.name: catalogShot
outputs.description: A usable screenshot of the shown version, preferring a fresh capture. Validated unchanged evidence keeps its original captured commit, standing and explanation. Returns null for missing, rejected, unvalidated, wrong-build or unrelated evidence; never borrows from the parent.

declarations.title: Entity text search
declarations.responsibility: Ranks revision-bound entity search results using names, identifiers, purpose and contract terms.

inputs.name: entitySearch.entries
inputs.description: Searchable entities retaining their category and commit.

inputs.name: entitySearch.query
inputs.description: Whitespace-separated query words, matched case-insensitively. Every word must match an entry.

inputs.name: entitySearch.limit
inputs.description: Maximum returned results, defaulting to 20; applied with array slicing.

outputs.name: entitySearch
outputs.description: Matching entries ranked by exact name/id, name prefix, id-part prefix, name-word prefix, name/id substring, purpose and contract-term matches. Ties use category order then name. Blank queries return no results.

declarations.title: Entity overview data
declarations.responsibility: Assembles an entity’s readable contract and measurements using the host’s revision context.

inputs.name: entityShown.host
inputs.description: Shown revision and optional parent context.

inputs.name: entityShown.entity
inputs.description: Entity to describe, including category, unit and removal state.

inputs.name: entityChanged.host
inputs.description: Shown revision holding recorded explanations.

inputs.name: entityChanged.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier used to select its explanations.

outputs.name: entityShown
outputs.description: Readable contract, measurements and the selected verdict record. Removed entities use parent declarations for applicable states when available, while measurements still come from the head verdict record.

outputs.name: entityChanged
outputs.description: Bounded and full explanations recorded by the head for that unit.

declarations.title: Entity relationship sections
declarations.responsibility: Arranges resolved relations into users and categorized dependencies for display.

inputs.name: entityUsage.relations
inputs.description: Host-derived pages, consumers, categorized dependencies and support units.

outputs.name: entityUsage
outputs.description: Deduplicated users with pages first, nonempty dependency groups with icons, support units and total dependency count. Deduplication uses identifiers and preserves their first position; later duplicate values replace earlier values.

declarations.title: Evidence media formatting
declarations.responsibility: Determines supported media MIME/type labels and formats audio duration.

inputs.name: mediaMime.file
inputs.description: Filename whose final extension is checked case-insensitively.

inputs.name: evidenceMedia.item
inputs.description: Evidence with optional explicit media type and file address.

inputs.name: audioDuration.seconds
inputs.description: Optional duration in seconds.

outputs.name: mediaMime
outputs.description: Known MIME type for supported image, audio, video and document extensions, otherwise application/octet-stream.

outputs.name: evidenceMedia
outputs.description: Explicit media type when present; otherwise audio for an audio extension or data:audio/ URL, and image for everything else.

outputs.name: audioDuration
outputs.description: Floored duration as minutes:seconds or hours:minutes:seconds. Empty for absent, negative or nonfinite values.

declarations.title: Verified artifact reader
declarations.responsibility: Reads stored artifact bytes, checks their recorded hash and extracts structured run observations.

inputs.name: artifactText.value
inputs.description: Recorded value to render as text.

inputs.name: artifactBehavior.document
inputs.description: Parsed document to interpret as run observations.

inputs.name: explorerArtifact.capture
inputs.description: Recorded capture with media location, expected SHA-256 and optional gap explanation.

inputs.name: explorerArtifact.mediaBase
inputs.description: Address prefix prepended to the capture media filename.

inputs.name: explorerArtifact.fetcher
inputs.description: Optional byte-fetching function, defaulting to browser fetch.

outputs.name: artifactText
outputs.description: Not recorded for undefined, strings unchanged, otherwise indented JSON.

outputs.name: artifactBehavior
outputs.description: Structured scenario/environment/fixture, steps, input/output, assertions, trace and remaining fields, or null for a non-object or array. Uses the first recognized input and output aliases; assertions retain named status and additional details.

outputs.name: explorerArtifact
outputs.description: Resolves to verified text/document/behavior when bytes match the hash. Missing media, unsuccessful HTTP responses and hash mismatches return an unverified result with a problem; mismatched bytes remain text only. Non-JSON text may still be hash-verified.

declarations.title: Recorded behavior comparison
declarations.responsibility: Aligns headless results from selected evidence and distinguishes byte differences from established behavior changes.

inputs.name: behaviorSummary.found
inputs.description: Aligned behavior rows to summarize.

inputs.name: explorerBehavior.evidence
inputs.description: Host-selected before/after evidence and scenario context.

outputs.name: behaviorKinds
outputs.description: Output, assertions and trace capture kinds; benchmark captures are excluded.

outputs.name: behaviorSummary
outputs.description: Summary and optional reason, with unknown taking precedence over unread byte differences. Empty rows are unknown; all unchanged rows are unchanged; other resolved differences are changed.

outputs.name: explorerBehavior
outputs.description: Union of result rows matched by scenario, state, evidence and kind, with after-side order first and before-only rows afterward. Unusable captures become absent cells and unknown changes. Equal hashes are provisionally unchanged; different hashes only differ until read. No before side yields not-compared, while missing records or incompatibility prevent comparison.

declarations.title: Explorer unit classification
declarations.responsibility: Assigns units to readable explorer categories and role names.

inputs.name: explorerCategory.unit
inputs.description: Unit kind and owned source files to classify.

inputs.name: explorerRole.unit
inputs.description: Unit kind and owned source files to label.

outputs.name: explorerCategory
outputs.description: Pages for units owning a +page.svelte file; otherwise the shared kind classification, with non-rendering route/page kinds treated as services. Returns null for kinds outside explorer collections.

outputs.name: explorerRole
outputs.description: Page for rendering routes, Route loader for non-rendering route kinds, otherwise a known friendly role or words derived from the kind.

declarations.title: Scenario coverage evaluation
declarations.responsibility: Judges declared scenario coverage against a selected record and recorded change impact.

inputs.name: coverageAffected.detail
inputs.description: Revision with record-specific comparison and first-parent source impact.

inputs.name: coverageAffected.record
inputs.description: Record whose applicable impact should be inspected.

inputs.name: coverageAffected.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier to look for in direct, indirect or added impact.

inputs.name: explorerCoverage.detail
inputs.description: Revision supplying registry units and comparison evidence.

inputs.name: explorerCoverage.record
inputs.description: Selected record, or null for absent evidence. Current tests and inherited origin-test summaries may include browser diagnostics.

inputs.name: explorerCoverage.unit
inputs.description: Unit whose applicable scenario states should be judged.

inputs.name: explorerCoverage.absent
inputs.description: Optional absent-record standing and reason, defaulting to missing with no verification record attached.

outputs.name: coverageAffected
outputs.description: True when applicable impact includes the unit, false when that impact exists and excludes it, or null when no applicable impact is recorded. Prefers comparison for this record, otherwise source impact with the record’s base.

outputs.name: explorerCoverage
outputs.description: Returns a scenario-evaluation function. It narrows states to the unit, checks declarations, test outcomes, result lineage and required captures, then returns tests, state details, inheritance and worst standing. Inherited results require a bound origin and recorded proof that the unit was unaffected; missing origin test evidence stays incomplete. Each listed check retains optional diagnostics from the record where it ran: the current record for fresh results and the origin-test summary for inherited results. Diagnostics are carried for display; this helper judges check outcomes from their recorded status.

declarations.title: Explorer entity registry
declarations.responsibility: Builds categorized active entities and selected-commit removal entries from revision data.

inputs.name: explorerChange.head
inputs.description: Revision whose first-parent source impact is inspected.

inputs.name: explorerChange.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier to classify as changed.

inputs.name: explorerEntity.head
inputs.description: Revision providing verdict and change context.

inputs.name: explorerEntity.unit
inputs.description: Unit to convert to an explorer entity.

inputs.name: explorerEntities.head
inputs.description: Shown revision with registry and source impact.

inputs.name: explorerEntities.parent
inputs.description: Optional first-parent revision, used to show removed units in their last active form.

outputs.name: explorerChange
outputs.description: First matching impact mark in added, direct, indirect, removed order, or null without a match.

outputs.name: explorerEntity
outputs.description: Named entity with category, role, purpose, source unit, verdict, change and app route; null for an uncategorized unit.

outputs.name: explorerEntities
outputs.description: Active head entities grouped in category order, plus units explicitly removed by head and active in the supplied parent but no longer active in head. Removed entries retain their parent contract and receive a removed/not-proven verdict.

declarations.title: Revision-bound entity evidence
declarations.responsibility: Selects the exact revision evidence for an entity and records why before/after results may not be comparable.

inputs.name: explorerEvidence.scope
inputs.description: Resolved branch/current-or-commit scope and first-parent identifier.

inputs.name: explorerEvidence.revisions
inputs.description: Shown revision and parent state: undefined while loading, null when unavailable, or the stored parent revision.

inputs.name: explorerEvidence.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier whose scenarios and captures should be selected.

outputs.name: explorerEvidence
outputs.description: After evidence bound to the exact shown commit, and first-parent evidence only in selected-commit mode. Each side includes the chosen verdict record, applicable coverage, captures and explicit gaps. Current captures must be usable and not inherited. Scenario/state/viewport declarations from both sides are retained; differing profiles, viewport dimensions or tests are listed as comparison limits.

declarations.title: Entity change history
declarations.responsibility: Builds ancestor-only entity history with recorded measurements, reviews and revision detail.

inputs.name: explorerHistory.index
inputs.description: History index with revision summaries, unit growth and reviews.

inputs.name: explorerHistory.scope
inputs.description: Resolved scope whose commit bounds the ancestry search.

inputs.name: explorerHistory.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier whose direct changes are listed.

inputs.name: historyDetail.detail
inputs.description: Stored revision to inspect for this entity.

inputs.name: historyDetail.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier to inspect in that revision.

outputs.name: explorerHistory
outputs.description: Newest-first rows for the shown commit and known ancestors that directly changed, added or removed the entity, plus rows whose change status is unknown. Each retains first-parent identity, measured values, changes from the preceding retained measurement and reviews at that commit. Known unchanged or indirectly affected commits are omitted.

outputs.name: historyDetail
outputs.description: Whether registry/impact information is available, active presence, change mark, version, matching explanations and the entity verdict when present.

declarations.title: Readable entity names
declarations.responsibility: Derives display names and page addresses from declared titles and ownership.

inputs.name: explorerName.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier, kind and title used for display naming.

inputs.name: explorerAppRoute.unit
inputs.description: Unit kind, title and owned files used for the page address.

outputs.name: explorerName
outputs.description: Preserves a human-written multiword title when it passes the title rules; otherwise uses route screen words, identifier words or the final identifier segment. Known initialisms stay uppercase; an empty result becomes Unnamed.

outputs.name: explorerAppRoute
outputs.description: For page or layout kinds, a slash-prefixed title or the owned +page route address; null for other kinds or no matching route file.

declarations.title: Behavior artifact comparison
declarations.responsibility: Reads and verifies behavior artifacts, then compares recorded content while excluding explicitly declared run metadata.

inputs.name: artifactDifferences.before
inputs.description: Earlier recorded value or document.

inputs.name: artifactDifferences.after
inputs.description: Later recorded value or document.

inputs.name: explorerReading.behavior
inputs.description: Initial behavior comparison with capture references and uncertainty state.

inputs.name: explorerReading.mediaBase
inputs.description: Media address prefix used to read artifacts.

inputs.name: explorerReading.fetcher
inputs.description: Optional artifact byte loader, forwarded to the verified artifact reader.

outputs.name: artifactRun
outputs.description: Run metadata declaration: harnessRun, version 1, and the recognized startedAt, finishedAt, at, durationMs and pid keys.

outputs.name: artifactDifferences
outputs.description: Paths where values differ, comparing arrays by index and objects by sorted key union. Properly typed metadata is excluded only inside a supported run declaration; undeclared times and process IDs remain behavior. Trace-entry declarations are considered when the root has a supported declaration.

outputs.name: explorerReading
outputs.description: Resolves to rows carrying verified reads and content differences. Different-byte rows become changed or unchanged from their content; unverified reads become unknown. Existing not-compared or explained unknown summaries are retained. Reads within one invocation are cached by SHA-256.

declarations.title: Revision entity relationships
declarations.responsibility: Finds categorized dependencies, consumers and containing pages within an active revision registry.

inputs.name: explorerRelations.head
inputs.description: Revision providing active unit definitions and dependency edges.

inputs.name: explorerRelations.id
inputs.description: Entity identifier whose relationships should be traversed.

inputs.name: explorerRelationsReader.head
inputs.description: The recorded, read-only revision to browse. Create a new reader when its data changes.

inputs.name: explorerRelationsReader.built
inputs.description: Optional entities already listed for this same revision. Their existing verdicts are reused; removed entries from a parent are excluded.

outputs.name: explorerRelations
outputs.description: Categorized dependencies, non-page users, containing pages and support units. Traversal stops at categorized entities but passes through support units; containing pages are reached upward to any depth. Cycles and duplicate visits are bounded by identifier sets. Missing or inactive identifiers return empty groups.

outputs.name: explorerRelationsReader
outputs.description: A reusable lookup of Uses and Used In at this revision. It builds the dependency graph once and keeps each answer while the reader is held. Its answers are read-only; no global cache is created.

declarations.title: Explorer address resolution
declarations.responsibility: Resolves an explorer address to the exact stored branch and revision or an explicit missing result.

inputs.name: explorerScope.index
inputs.description: Stored branches and revision summaries.

inputs.name: explorerScope.location
inputs.description: Requested branch, optional selected commit and screen address.

outputs.name: explorerScope
outputs.description: Resolved scope with current/commit mode, branch tip, viewed commit, at-tip flag, first parent and summary. Returns a missing message for an unknown branch, unstored tip or commit, or a commit not recorded on the requested branch; never substitutes a different revision.

declarations.title: Revision search entries
declarations.responsibility: Builds searchable entity summaries bound to the displayed commit.

inputs.name: explorerSearchEntries.entities
inputs.description: Explorer entities from the displayed revision. Removed entities are omitted.

inputs.name: explorerSearchEntries.commit
inputs.description: Commit identifier attached to every search entry.

outputs.name: explorerSearchEntries
outputs.description: Search entries containing identifier, category, display name, purpose and contract field names, with the supplied commit. No owned source paths are added.

declarations.title: State and capture coverage
declarations.responsibility: Narrows scenarios to relevant states and judges whether each required recorded capture supports its bound revision.

inputs.name: reasonText.text
inputs.description: Recorded reason whose file-location wording should be simplified.

inputs.name: scenarioFor.declared
inputs.description: Full declared scenario.

inputs.name: scenarioFor.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier whose applicable states are requested.

inputs.name: scenarioFor.units
inputs.description: Optional registry units, defaulting to an empty list, used to follow active consumers transitively.

inputs.name: coverageWorst.standings
inputs.description: Coverage standings to prioritize.

inputs.name: captureUnbound.capture
inputs.description: Capture whose recorded build binding is checked.

inputs.name: captureUnbound.commit
inputs.description: Commit that the capture should support.

inputs.name: explorerState.judged
inputs.description: Scenario declaration, result, record and bound commit, or null when there is no result to judge.

inputs.name: explorerState.declared
inputs.description: Declared state and coverage requirement.

inputs.name: explorerState.absent
inputs.description: Fallback standing and reason tuple. The standing is used when a required state lacks a judged result; its supplied reason text is not copied by this helper.

outputs.name: reasonText
outputs.description: Reason with matching in-file location phrases removed and other matching file paths replaced by a file.

outputs.name: scenarioFor
outputs.description: Scenario narrowed to states naming the unit directly, otherwise states naming a transitive consumer, otherwise the unchanged full scenario.

outputs.name: coverageWorst
outputs.description: Worst standing in failed, stale, missing, incomplete, passed order; inapplicable when none of those occurs.

outputs.name: captureUnbound
outputs.description: Reason when the capture names another revision or a screenshot/actual capture has no build stamp; null otherwise.

outputs.name: explorerState
outputs.description: State coverage with reasons and evidence slots. Inapplicable states stay exempt; other nonrequired declarations are incomplete. Required states must be recorded as required and include each declared evidence/kind/viewport slot with a passed, stored, correctly bound capture. Missing declarations and slots never count as passed.

declarations.title: Entity verification verdict
declarations.responsibility: Judges an entity using the newest valid record of its exact revision and its applicable coverage.

inputs.name: verdictRecord.detail
inputs.description: Revision whose records should be selected.

inputs.name: verdictCoverage.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier whose scenarios should be judged.

inputs.name: verdictCoverage.detail
inputs.description: Revision providing registry and verification records.

inputs.name: explorerVerdict.unit
inputs.description: Unit whose overall proof is requested.

inputs.name: explorerVerdict.detail
inputs.description: Revision supplying records, coverage and budget findings.

outputs.name: verdictRecord
outputs.description: Newest valid record whose source commit exactly matches the revision, ordered by finishedAt text, or null.

outputs.name: verdictCoverage
outputs.description: Coverage of scenarios naming the unit, narrowed state by state. No registry yields an empty list; absent usable records leave required states without proof.

outputs.name: explorerVerdict
outputs.description: Passed only when applicable checks leave no blocking reason: required gates exist, global gates and tests pass, scenarios establish applicable coverage, and the unit has no open failures or budget findings. Labels distinguish unusable, failed, stale, missing and incomplete evidence; reasons are deduplicated and stripped of matching file-location wording.

declarations.title: Dependency map viewport
declarations.responsibility: Calculates map fitting, zoom, panning, visible edges and directional keyboard navigation.

inputs.name: wholeView.layout
inputs.description: Layout to fit.

inputs.name: focusView.layout
inputs.description: Layout containing requested nodes.

inputs.name: focusView.ids
inputs.description: Node identifiers to focus.

inputs.name: focusOn.layout
inputs.description: Layout to consider for automatic focus.

inputs.name: focusOn.ids
inputs.description: Requested node identifiers.

inputs.name: zoomView.view
inputs.description: Current viewport.

inputs.name: zoomView.factor
inputs.description: Zoom factor dividing the viewport width.

inputs.name: zoomView.whole
inputs.description: Whole-map bounds used for the maximum zoom-out width.

inputs.name: panView.view
inputs.description: Current viewport to move.

inputs.name: panView.dx
inputs.description: Horizontal shift in map units.

inputs.name: panView.dy
inputs.description: Vertical shift in map units.

inputs.name: drawnEdges.layout
inputs.description: Layout whose edges may be drawn.

inputs.name: drawnEdges.selected
inputs.description: Selected node or null.

inputs.name: nextNode.layout
inputs.description: Layout supplying node positions.

inputs.name: nextNode.from
inputs.description: Current node identifier.

inputs.name: nextNode.key
inputs.description: Arrow key specifying direction.

inputs.name: nextNode.shown
inputs.description: Identifiers eligible for keyboard navigation.

outputs.name: wholeView
outputs.description: Whole layout with 24 units of padding on every side.

outputs.name: focusView
outputs.description: Bounds of requested nodes with at least about four cells of context in each dimension; returns the whole view for none or all of the nodes.

outputs.name: focusOn
outputs.description: Focused bounds only for maps above 60 nodes; otherwise null.

outputs.name: zoomView
outputs.description: Centered zoom preserving aspect ratio, clamped between two node widths and 1.5 whole-map widths.

outputs.name: panView
outputs.description: Viewport translated by the supplied offsets without changing size.

outputs.name: drawnEdges
outputs.description: All edges for at most 60 nodes; otherwise only edges touching the selection.

outputs.name: nextNode
outputs.description: Nearest eligible node ahead, minimizing along-axis distance plus four times sideways distance; stays at the current node when none is ahead, and returns undefined for an unknown origin or non-arrow key.

declarations.title: Frozen build copy
declarations.responsibility: Copies a completed build and checks that source and destination retain the same build identity.

inputs.name: frozenBuild.source
inputs.description: Finished source build directory.

inputs.name: frozenBuild.target
inputs.description: Destination directory, removed before copying.

inputs.name: frozenBuild.copied
inputs.description: Optional async copy operation, defaulting to recursive filesystem copy.

outputs.name: frozenBuild
outputs.description: Target directory, source build identifier and file count after matching the source-before, source-after and copied identities.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws if the source has no build or identities differ; a mismatch removes the target. Identity, filesystem and copy failures can also reject.

declarations.title: History ancestry and choices
declarations.responsibility: Finds recorded ancestors and builds branch and revision choices.

inputs.name: harnessAncestry.index
inputs.description: Index with recorded parent links.

inputs.name: harnessAncestry.commit
inputs.description: Commit whose ancestors are requested.

inputs.name: branchNames.index
inputs.description: Index whose usable branch names are requested.

inputs.name: defaultCommit.index
inputs.description: Index holding possible initial revisions.

inputs.name: defaultCommit.asked
inputs.description: Requested commit, honored only if stored.

inputs.name: branchCommits.index
inputs.description: Index whose revision order is retained.

inputs.name: branchCommits.branch
inputs.description: Branch name or the Retained commits pseudo-branch.

inputs.name: branchOf.index
inputs.description: Index used to choose a branch for a commit.

inputs.name: branchOf.commit
inputs.description: Commit to locate.

inputs.name: revisionLabel.item
inputs.description: Revision summary to label.

outputs.name: retainedBranch
outputs.description: The Retained commits pseudo-branch label.

outputs.name: harnessAncestry
outputs.description: Set reached through recorded parent links, normally excluding the starting commit; includes named parents even when their own details are not indexed.

outputs.name: branchNames
outputs.description: Source branches with indexed members, plus Retained commits when any retained revision exists.

outputs.name: defaultCommit
outputs.description: Requested stored commit, else first stored branch head, else first indexed revision, else an empty string.

outputs.name: branchCommits
outputs.description: Revisions belonging to the branch, or retained revisions, in index order.

outputs.name: branchOf
outputs.description: Retained commits for a retained revision, otherwise its first branch, first offered branch, or an empty string.

outputs.name: revisionLabel
outputs.description: Short commit, subject and readable coverage status.

declarations.title: Frozen metric description
declarations.responsibility: Explains a measured value and the reviewed limit that applies without treating unavailable data as zero.

inputs.name: harnessBudget.found
inputs.description: Recorded measurement or undefined.

inputs.name: harnessBudget.finding
inputs.description: Optional budget finding supplying baseline, status and measured value.

inputs.name: harnessBudget.known
inputs.description: Optional reviewed-limit knowledge, defaulting to a declared freeze with no numeric limit.

outputs.name: harnessBudget
outputs.description: Value, limit and optional partial/growth note. Prefers the finding baseline over the ledger limit; otherwise distinguishes reviewed-unmeasurable, no value, merely declared freeze and no limit. Missing measurements and null values remain explicit.

declarations.title: Console data client
declarations.responsibility: Loads and caches requested console JSON resources.

inputs.name: harnessClient.base
inputs.description: Console mount prefix used before /data/.

inputs.name: harnessClient.fetcher
inputs.description: Optional fetch implementation. Supplying one creates an independent client; otherwise clients are shared by base.

outputs.name: harnessClient
outputs.description: Client with index, revision, stored-side and activity readers. Each path caches its promise, including successful responses; rejected reads are evicted so later calls retry. Construction makes no request.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Non-success HTTP responses reject with the resource path and status. Fetch and JSON errors also propagate to the caller.

declarations.title: Recorded media alignment
declarations.responsibility: Aligns recorded before-and-after media while retaining each side’s own provenance or gap.

inputs.name: comparisonChoices.base
inputs.description: Earlier revision and its selected record, which may be null.

inputs.name: comparisonChoices.head
inputs.description: Later revision and its selected record, which may be null.

inputs.name: harnessComparison.base
inputs.description: Earlier revision and selected record.

inputs.name: harnessComparison.head
inputs.description: Later revision and selected record.

inputs.name: harnessComparison.choice
inputs.description: Scenario plus optional empty state/viewport selectors; empty state or viewport includes all matching choices.

outputs.name: comparisonChoices
outputs.description: Sorted unique scenario, state and viewport choices from scenarios containing screenshot or audio media on either side.

outputs.name: harnessComparison
outputs.description: Gallery items paired by scenario, state, evidence and viewport-or-kind, plus readable aligned-state summaries. Missing sides receive explicit gaps. Captures keep their own provenance, and no other revision fills a gap.

declarations.title: Build-output measurements
declarations.responsibility: Formats native/Wasm build sizes, reviewed limits and comparisons separately by target.

inputs.name: emittedBytes.count
inputs.description: Number of bytes to format.

inputs.name: emittedLabel.target
inputs.description: Target kind to label.

inputs.name: emittedKey.target
inputs.description: Target kind for the ledger key.

inputs.name: harnessEmitted.unit
inputs.description: Unit with declared execution targets and emitted limits.

inputs.name: harnessEmitted.record
inputs.description: Record whose unprofiled, workload-free build measurement is used, or null.

inputs.name: emittedChange.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier to compare.

inputs.name: emittedChange.sides
inputs.type: Array<{ units: HarnessUnit[]; record: HarnessRecord | null }>
inputs.description: Comparison sides in before/after order; targets are gathered from supplied unit definitions.

inputs.name: emittedTargets.index
inputs.description: Index with emitted growth values and notes.

inputs.name: emittedTargets.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier whose targets are requested.

outputs.name: emittedBytes
outputs.description: Count followed by byte for one, otherwise bytes.

outputs.name: emittedLabel
outputs.description: Friendly native-process or Wasm label, otherwise the original target.

outputs.name: emittedKey
outputs.description: artifact-bytes followed by a colon and target kind.

outputs.name: harnessEmitted
outputs.description: One line per declared process/Wasm target with size, limit and findings. Units declaring neither receive an explicit no-output line. Missing measurements remain unavailable.

outputs.name: emittedChange
outputs.description: Before and after numeric sizes or null, separately for process and Wasm targets declared on either side.

outputs.name: emittedTargets
outputs.description: Process/Wasm targets found in growth values or notes, in fixed target order.

declarations.title: Build-output growth history
declarations.responsibility: Builds per-target emitted-size history with the limits and reviews associated with each commit.

inputs.name: harnessEmittedGrowth.index
inputs.description: Index with unit growth, review ledger and newest-first revisions.

inputs.name: harnessEmittedGrowth.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier.

outputs.name: harnessEmittedGrowth
outputs.description: Targets and oldest-first rows, with measured size, nonzero delta from the last available size, missing notes and prior-review limit. Reviews at the row’s commit are attached separately. changed compares current availability/value to the immediately preceding row; the first row is not marked changed.

declarations.title: Verification report conversion
declarations.responsibility: Converts stored verification captures and outcomes into the existing report-view format.

inputs.name: mediaFile.capture
inputs.description: Capture whose media name is requested.

inputs.name: harnessEvidence.detail
inputs.description: Revision supplying scenario viewport labels.

inputs.name: harnessEvidence.record
inputs.description: Record whose screenshot and audio captures should appear.

inputs.name: harnessReport.summary
inputs.description: Revision summary supplying title and commit identity.

inputs.name: harnessReport.detail
inputs.description: Revision details supplying capture context.

inputs.name: harnessReport.record
inputs.description: Record supplying results, checks, failures and gates.

outputs.name: mediaFile
outputs.description: Media name without a leading media/ prefix, or an empty string for null media.

outputs.name: harnessEvidence
outputs.description: Ordered screenshot/audio gallery items retaining missing media and provenance. Invalid records produce not-proven item statuses; each capture has a unique sequence-based identifier.

outputs.name: harnessReport
outputs.description: Finalized historical Report with recorded tests, failures, gate acceptance text and evidence. State coverage maps inapplicable to skipped, missing/empty captures to not-proven, otherwise capture statuses to passed or failed.

declarations.title: Verification failure grouping
declarations.responsibility: Summarizes repeated failure causes while retaining the original total count.

inputs.name: harnessFailures.failures
inputs.description: Recorded failure strings. Subject-prefixed messages with shared text can become one cause.

outputs.name: harnessFailures
outputs.description: Total failures, whether at most five allow plain display, ordered causes and omitted-cause count. Shared causes list up to three subjects; longer summaries show at most five causes.

declarations.title: Recorded measurement trends
declarations.responsibility: Builds source-size, complexity and dependency trends while keeping benchmark profiles separate.

inputs.name: harnessGrowth.index
inputs.description: Index holding unit growth and revision order.

inputs.name: harnessGrowth.unit
inputs.description: Unit whose growth is requested.

inputs.name: unitTimings.index
inputs.description: Index containing benchmark series.

inputs.name: unitTimings.unit
inputs.description: Unit whose benchmark entries are requested.

inputs.name: signed.delta
inputs.description: Optional numeric difference to format.

outputs.name: growthMetrics
outputs.description: The source-bytes, complexity and dependencies metric keys.

outputs.name: harnessGrowth
outputs.description: Oldest-first growth rows with values, notes and differences from the immediately preceding growth point when both values exist. Missing metrics stay undefined; changed is true only for a nonzero numeric delta.

outputs.name: unitTimings
outputs.description: Matching benchmark entries unchanged, preserving their independent series.

outputs.name: signed
outputs.description: Empty for zero, undefined or other falsy numeric values; a plus sign for positive differences, otherwise the numeric string.

declarations.title: Explorer icon catalog
declarations.responsibility: Provides shared SVG paths and category-to-icon mappings.

outputs.name: harnessIcons
outputs.description: Named SVG path data on a 24-by-24 grid for categories, verdicts, evidence and controls.

outputs.name: solidIcons
outputs.description: Readonly-typed set containing passed and failed, the two filled verdict icons.

outputs.name: categoryIcon
outputs.description: Icon name for each of the six explorer categories.

declarations.title: Revision impact selection
declarations.responsibility: Chooses recorded or source-derived impact and falls back to active-registry dependency comparison.

inputs.name: harnessImpact.base
inputs.description: Earlier revision, or undefined when no base is selected.

inputs.name: harnessImpact.head
inputs.description: Later revision containing recorded comparison and source impact.

inputs.name: harnessImpact.compared
inputs.description: Optional precomputed source-side comparison, used only when its commit pair matches.

inputs.name: comparedSides.client
inputs.description: Client able to load stored source sides.

inputs.name: comparedSides.base
inputs.description: Earlier revision naming its stored side.

inputs.name: comparedSides.head
inputs.description: Later revision naming its stored side.

outputs.name: harnessImpact
outputs.description: Impact groups, scenarios, uncertainty and marks. Prefers a record comparing the exact base, then matching source impact, then version changes and transitive consumers across both active registries. Marks prioritize removed over added, direct and indirect.

outputs.name: comparedSides
outputs.description: Loads both stored sides and delegates their comparison, returning the commit pair and impact; undefined if either side reference is absent.

declarations.title: Dependency map layout
declarations.responsibility: Places units in dependency layers and builds deduplicated connecting edges.

inputs.name: mapColumns.count
inputs.description: Unit count used to choose a row width.

inputs.name: harnessLayout.units
inputs.description: Units and their declared dependencies to lay out.

inputs.name: harnessLayout.perRow
inputs.description: Optional units per row, defaulting to mapColumns for the supplied count.

outputs.name: nodeSize
outputs.description: Node dimensions of 176 by 34, with horizontal gap 16 and vertical gap 46.

outputs.name: mapColumns
outputs.description: Ceiling of the square root of 0.75 times count, clamped between six and 24.

outputs.name: harnessLayout
outputs.description: Nodes grouped by dependency depth and sorted by identifier within layers, wrapped into rows, with dimensions and one edge per known dependency pair. Cycle traversal is bounded and missing dependency nodes are ignored.

declarations.title: Explorer page resolution
declarations.responsibility: Resolves console paths into canonical redirects, revision-scoped pages or explicit missing results.

inputs.name: homePath.index
inputs.description: History index used to find the canonical home.

inputs.name: harnessPage.index
inputs.description: History index used for canonicalization and scope resolution.

inputs.name: harnessPage.path
inputs.description: Console-relative path.

inputs.name: harnessPage.search
inputs.description: Optional query string, defaulting to empty.

outputs.name: homePath
outputs.description: Canonical home route or null when no home can be resolved.

outputs.name: harnessPage
outputs.description: Redirect for a canonical alternative; page with validated scope for a stored branch/commit; otherwise missing message and optional home link. Root with no history and invalid explorer addresses remain missing.

declarations.title: Explorer navigation model
declarations.responsibility: Builds navigation destinations and revision controls within the displayed scope.

inputs.name: plainClick.event
inputs.description: Mouse event to test for application-handled navigation.

inputs.name: harnessShell.input
inputs.description: Navigation context with base, optional resolved scope/index, commits and address builder.

outputs.name: plainClick
outputs.description: True only for an unmodified primary-button click that has not already been prevented.

outputs.name: harnessShell
outputs.description: Brand destination, six category entries and optional revision controls. Categories retain branch/commit and clear entity context. Revision choices include the viewed commit when absent; branch changes select the tip or newest retained commit. Actual addresses come from the host’s href function.

declarations.title: Historical report media
declarations.responsibility: Converts older report references and media without presenting them as build-bound verification.

inputs.name: legacyLink.report
inputs.description: Historical report with linked commit or gap.

inputs.name: legacyLink.commit
inputs.description: Currently viewed commit.

inputs.name: legacyEvidence.report
inputs.description: Historical report and its media entries.

outputs.name: legacyLink
outputs.description: Text identifying this commit, another linked commit, or the report’s missing-commit explanation.

outputs.name: legacyEvidence
outputs.description: Ordered gallery items labeled legacy, with no recorded build, original report attribution and missing-media markers. Unknown statuses become not-proven; MIME types beginning with audio select audio presentation.

declarations.title: HTTP media response
declarations.responsibility: Serves media bytes as a full response or a single validated byte range.

inputs.name: mediaResponse.bytes
inputs.description: Complete media bytes.

inputs.name: mediaResponse.mime
inputs.description: Content MIME type.

inputs.name: mediaResponse.range
inputs.description: Optional Range header, null or empty for a full response.

inputs.name: mediaResponse.disposition
inputs.description: Optional Content-Disposition header, defaulting to inline.

outputs.name: mediaResponse
outputs.description: Response with no-store, nosniff and byte-range support. No range returns all bytes with 200; valid single closed, open-ended or suffix ranges return 206 and matching length/range headers. Malformed or unsatisfiable ranges return 416 with total length.

declarations.title: Scoped navigation search
declarations.responsibility: Accepts search entries only for the currently displayed revision and validates result destinations.

inputs.name: navbarSearch.scope
inputs.description: Resolved explorer scope, or null while unavailable.

inputs.name: navbarSearch.given
inputs.description: Entries for the displayed revision, null/undefined while loading.

outputs.name: navbarSearch
outputs.description: Accepted entries only when a location exists and every entry matches its commit, plus a scope label and destination resolver. Destinations require matching commit, category and identifier in the accepted set, and preserve the displayed branch/revision mode.

declarations.title: Portable report HTML
declarations.responsibility: Wraps a prepared report and compiled viewer into one HTML document.

inputs.name: portablePage.portable
inputs.description: Report whose media should already be inline for a self-contained export.

inputs.name: portablePage.assets
inputs.description: Compiled script and stylesheet text.

outputs.name: portablePage
outputs.description: HTML with escaped title, embedded report JSON and inline viewer assets. JSON escapes less-than and Unicode line/paragraph separators before placement in a script.

declarations.title: Model picker host connection
declarations.responsibility: Connects the picker to its MCP host or explicitly enabled standalone preview endpoint.

inputs.name: providerPickerClient.receive
inputs.description: Callback receiving picker snapshots from preview initialization or qualifying host tool results.

outputs.name: providerPickerClient
outputs.description: Client with preview flag, async tool call and close. Standalone preview requires both the body marker and a top-level window, posts JSON to /tools and loads open_model_picker immediately. Otherwise connects an MCP App and forwards structured results.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects preview HTTP failures and MCP tool error results with guidance; connection, request and JSON errors can also propagate.

declarations.title: Model picker mount
declarations.responsibility: Mounts the model-picker component into its standalone browser container.

outputs.name: providerPickerEntry
outputs.description: Svelte mount result for the picker in the element named app. The module also invokes this function immediately on import.

declarations.title: Evidence storage configuration
declarations.responsibility: Resolves required R2 settings while allowing isolated temporary test stores to omit remote storage.

outputs.name: r2EvidenceConfig
outputs.description: Complete R2 configuration, or undefined for an allowed temporary local-only store or an unconfigured temporary test store. Reads environment and the configured adapter configuration file, except that test mode does not pass the file override.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws when local-only storage is requested outside a temporary descendant directory, required R2 settings are missing, or an endpoint override is not an HTTP 127.0.0.1 server with an explicit port.

declarations.title: Prepare readable test values
declarations.responsibility: Builds a bounded presentation of recorded evidence without changing the original values.

inputs.name: recordedValue.value
inputs.description: A value already parsed from a verified JSON recording.

outputs.name: recordedValue
outputs.description: Typed fields, list items or table cells, limited to four levels and twelve items per collection.

declarations.title: Screenshot replay sequence
declarations.responsibility: Builds ordered replay frames from available non-before image evidence.

inputs.name: replayStart.frames
inputs.description: Replay frames to choose an initial position from.

inputs.name: replayFrames.items
inputs.description: Evidence to filter and order.

outputs.name: FRAME_SECONDS
outputs.description: Three-second duration per frame.

outputs.name: REPLAY_SPEEDS
outputs.description: Playback multipliers 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16.

outputs.name: replayStart
outputs.description: Index of the first frame whose title names a scene, otherwise zero, including for an empty list.

outputs.name: replayFrames
outputs.description: Available image frames excluding before-phase items, sorted by explicit order or original position. Each gets a sequential index, three-second start/duration and optional scene number parsed from a title beginning Scene followed by digits.

declarations.title: Replay translations
declarations.responsibility: Registers the English screenshot-replay dictionary once per module instance.

outputs.name: replayLocale
outputs.description: Registers replay labels and messages with the locale library on the first call; later calls return without repeating registration. No value is returned.

declarations.title: Screenshot replay video
declarations.responsibility: Creates or reuses a cached silent MP4 of the report’s available replay screenshots.

inputs.name: replayVideoKey.report
inputs.description: Report whose ordered replay frame identifiers and filenames determine the cache key.

inputs.name: replayVideo.report
inputs.description: Report providing screenshots and registered evidence files.

inputs.name: replayVideo.directory
inputs.description: Report directory containing assets and the replay cache.

outputs.name: replayVideoKey
outputs.description: SHA-256 key of ordered frame identifiers/filenames and the fixed three-second, 1280-by-720 versioned encoding recipe.

outputs.name: replayVideo
outputs.description: Promise resolving to an existing regular cached MP4 or a newly encoded file. Frames are rendered in batches of four, fitted/padded to 1280 by 720, then encoded at ten frames per second with three seconds per screenshot. Temporary encoding files are removed in finally.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects zero or over 500 frames, symlinked replay cache/artifact, screenshot conversion failure and encoding failure. Asset validation, subprocess and filesystem failures may also propagate.

declarations.title: Report asset files
declarations.responsibility: Checks evidence signatures, stores content-addressed assets and resolves registered local files.

inputs.description: Nonempty image bytes, at most 50,000,000 bytes.

inputs.name: imageAsset.filename
inputs.description: Image filename with PNG, JPG, JPEG or WebP extension matching the signature.

inputs.name: writeImageAsset.directory
inputs.description: Report directory under which an assets folder is created.

inputs.name: writeImageAsset.name
inputs.description: Destination asset filename, expected to be supplied by the trusted asset-name generator.

inputs.name: writeImageAsset.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to write without further validation by this helper.

inputs.name: reportAssets.directory
inputs.description: Report directory receiving an imported asset.

inputs.name: reportAssets.source
inputs.description: Local source file to import; symlinks and non-files are rejected.

inputs.name: registeredAsset.directory
inputs.description: Asset directory to resolve through realpath.

inputs.name: registeredAsset.name
inputs.description: Requested filename, which must be registered and contain no slash or backslash.

inputs.name: registeredAsset.registered
inputs.description: Allowed asset names.

outputs.name: imageAsset

outputs.name: writeImageAsset
outputs.description: Promise that creates the asset directory and writes bytes with restrictive creation modes; no value is returned.

outputs.name: reportAssets
outputs.description: Promise resolving to stored audio or image metadata after validation and writing the content-addressed file.

outputs.description: Promise resolving to a registered regular non-symlink file whose real path remains within the resolved asset directory.

errors.name: Error
