declarations.title: Reports build identity
declarations.responsibility: Calculates and caches the identity of the compiled reports server or identifies a development instance.

inputs.name: reportBuildIdentity.directory
inputs.description: Optional build directory, defaulting to the nearest compiled server directory found within six ancestor checks of the running module.

outputs.name: reportBuildIdentity
outputs.description: Cached digest of regular files and relative names in the chosen directory. Returns harness-reports-development when no directory exists or no regular files are found.

declarations.title: Retention cleanup history
declarations.responsibility: Records cleanup results while retaining recent bounded history.

inputs.name: reportCleanupLog.root
inputs.description: Report store root containing the retention log.

inputs.name: reportCleanupLog.result
inputs.description: JSON-serializable cleanup result to record.

outputs.name: reportCleanupLog
outputs.description: Promise that rewrites the log with parseable entries newer than the retention cutoff and a timestamped new result, keeping only the latest 300 lines. Missing log files start empty; no value is returned.

declarations.title: Report command parsing
declarations.responsibility: Parses report command options and reads required values or JSON input.

inputs.name: reportCli.argv
inputs.description: Arguments beginning with the operation, followed by flags and positionals.

inputs.name: inputData.flags
inputs.description: Parsed flags; a truthy file takes precedence over inline data.

inputs.name: required.flags
inputs.description: Flags to inspect for a required string.

inputs.name: required.name
inputs.description: Required flag name without leading dashes.

outputs.name: reportCli
outputs.description: Operation or empty string, parsed flags and remaining positionals. Uses permissive argument parsing with declared string and boolean options.

outputs.name: inputData
outputs.description: Promise resolving to parsed file or inline JSON. The result is cast as an object without checking its shape.

outputs.name: required
outputs.description: Original nonblank string value, retaining its surrounding whitespace.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws when JSON input is absent or a required option is missing/non-string/blank. Argument-parser, file-read and JSON errors also propagate.

declarations.title: Legacy report destination
declarations.responsibility: Routes an older report link to its stored revision or the explorer home.

inputs.name: reportDestination.index
inputs.description: History index or null.

inputs.name: reportDestination.report
inputs.description: Report identifier and optional recorded revision, or null.

outputs.name: reportDestination
outputs.description: Console-relative Pages address for the first stored match among the report revision and imported legacy linkage; otherwise canonical home. Empty when there is no index or home.

declarations.title: Report status and time labels
declarations.responsibility: Formats report activity status, stale state, timestamps and evidence anchors.

inputs.name: reportDisplay.report
inputs.description: Report whose lifecycle and update time determine display status.

inputs.name: reportStale.report
inputs.description: Report to check for inactivity.

inputs.name: reportStale.now
inputs.description: Optional current epoch milliseconds, defaulting to Date.now().

inputs.name: dateLabel.value
inputs.description: Timestamp to format.

inputs.name: timeAgo.value
inputs.description: Timestamp for elapsed-time wording.

inputs.name: timeAgo.now
inputs.description: Optional current epoch milliseconds, defaulting to Date.now().

inputs.name: evidenceAnchor.id
inputs.description: Evidence identifier used in an anchor.

outputs.name: reportDisplay
outputs.description: Finalized report status unchanged; otherwise interrupted after more than 15 minutes without an update, or running.

outputs.name: reportStale
outputs.description: True only for a nonfinalized report more than 15 minutes past its update time.

outputs.name: dateLabel
outputs.description: Timestamp formatted in en-GB with medium date and short local time.

outputs.name: timeAgo
outputs.description: English relative age using the largest supported unit and whole elapsed units. Under one minute, including future dates, reads just now; invalid timestamps return empty.

outputs.name: evidenceAnchor
outputs.description: evidence- followed by the supplied identifier.

declarations.title: Report store file helpers
declarations.responsibility: Resolves the report root, validates identifiers and reads or atomically replaces JSON files.

inputs.name: reportFiles.root
inputs.description: Optional root override; empty falls through to environment and then the user-home default.

inputs.name: safeId.id
inputs.description: Identifier containing only ASCII letters, digits, underscore or hyphen, from one to 100 characters.

inputs.name: readJson.path
inputs.description: JSON file to read.

inputs.name: atomicJson.path
inputs.description: Destination JSON path.

inputs.name: atomicJson.data
inputs.description: Serializable value to write.

outputs.name: reportFiles
outputs.description: Explicit root, PROJECT_REPORTS_HOME, or the project-reports directory under the user’s Codex home folder.

outputs.name: safeId
outputs.description: Validated identifier unchanged.

outputs.name: readJson
outputs.description: Promise resolving to parsed JSON cast to the requested type, without runtime shape validation.

outputs.name: atomicJson
outputs.description: Promise that creates parent directories, writes formatted JSON to a UUID-suffixed temporary file and renames it over the destination.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Invalid identifiers throw Invalid report or asset ID. Read, parse, serialization and filesystem failures propagate.

declarations.title: Report and evidence filtering
declarations.responsibility: Classifies viewport sizes and filters report galleries and project lists.

inputs.name: screenSize.item
inputs.description: Evidence viewport label to classify.

inputs.name: galleryEvidence.items
inputs.description: Evidence items to choose gallery representatives from.

inputs.name: galleryEvidence.pairs
inputs.description: Optional after-to-before audio pair map, defaulting to audioPairs(items).

inputs.name: reportFilter.items
inputs.description: Evidence items to filter.

inputs.name: reportFilter.filter
inputs.description: Search text and optional exact category, phase and status filters.

inputs.name: reportFilter.pairs
inputs.description: Optional after-to-before pair map allowing either member to satisfy all filters.

inputs.name: projectFilter.run
inputs.description: Report to test for a project-list match.

inputs.name: projectFilter.query
inputs.description: Case-insensitive text query, not trimmed.

inputs.name: projectFilter.project
inputs.description: Optional exact project identifier; empty accepts all projects.

outputs.name: screenSize
outputs.description: Mobile/tablet/desktop from known words first, otherwise the first numeric width with boundaries at 700 and 1100; other when no positive width is found.

outputs.name: galleryEvidence
outputs.description: All non-before items plus unpaired before-audio items. Paired before audio and all before images are hidden as separate gallery entries.

outputs.name: reportFilter
outputs.description: Matches where either the item or its paired before item satisfies all filters, sorted by order with missing order treated as zero. Search spans title, notes, category, viewport, source and transcript.

outputs.name: projectFilter
outputs.description: True when project selection matches and the lowercased project name, title or summary contains the query.

declarations.title: Report HTTP resources
declarations.responsibility: Serves site-scoped report identity and registered evidence or export files.

inputs.name: reportFile.id
inputs.description: Report identifier loaded through the site repository.

inputs.name: reportFile.type
inputs.description: Requested file group; only assets and exports are supported.

inputs.name: reportFile.file
inputs.description: Requested registered evidence or export filename.

inputs.name: reportFile.range
inputs.description: Optional HTTP byte range.

outputs.name: repository
outputs.description: Site-scoped report repository shared by these handlers.

outputs.name: reportHttp
outputs.description: JSON identity response with app/version, actual build identity, optional verification revision and a hash of the repository root.

outputs.name: reportFile
outputs.description: Promise resolving to local or remote file bytes through the range-response helper. Assets render inline; exports use attachment disposition. Missing evidence remains unavailable rather than being served as present.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Missing R2 evidence configuration throws; repository, storage and filesystem errors may also reject.

errors.name: HttpError 404
errors.description: Throws HTTP 404 for an unsupported group, unregistered export or unknown evidence. Registered evidence with no available instance instead throws HTTP 410.

declarations.title: Report record ingestion
declarations.responsibility: Applies one sanitized record to a report and imports evidence files when needed.

inputs.name: reportIngest.report
inputs.description: Report object to mutate and return.

inputs.name: reportIngest.record
inputs.description: Record kind and payload. Summary/acceptance replace their values; check, finding, coverage and evidence records replace an existing item with the same identifier and append the new item.

inputs.name: reportIngest.directory
inputs.description: Report directory used when importing evidence assets.

outputs.name: reportIngest
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the same mutated report with a fresh update timestamp. Evidence uses the original source path for import, discards caller-supplied path/storage fields, and applies generated file metadata with default Evidence category and not-proven status.

declarations.title: Local report retention cleanup
declarations.responsibility: Removes old nonreserved files and untracked run contents while preserving known runs and symlinks.

inputs.name: reportLocalCleanup.root
inputs.description: Report store root, which must not itself be a symlink.

inputs.name: reportLocalCleanup.cutoff
inputs.description: Finite modification-time cutoff in epoch milliseconds; files at or before it are eligible.

inputs.name: reportLocalCleanup.dryRun
inputs.description: Optional dry-run flag, defaulting to false. True counts eligible files without deleting them.

inputs.name: reportLocalCleanup.knownRuns
inputs.description: Optional set of known run identifiers, defaulting to empty; known run directories are skipped.

outputs.name: reportLocalCleanup
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the number of eligible files removed or counted. Skips root dot entries and reserved metadata, traverses other directories and orphan runs, skips symlinks and removes empty old directories during a real cleanup.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects a nonfinite cutoff or symlinked root/runs directory. Filesystem inspection and deletion errors propagate.

declarations.title: Report English locale
declarations.responsibility: Registers report translations and initializes English as the report locale.

outputs.name: reportLocale
outputs.description: Returns en. Importing the module registers the English report dictionary and starts locale initialization with English fallback and initial locale.

declarations.title: Exclusive report operation
declarations.responsibility: Runs an asynchronous report update under an exclusive lock file.

inputs.name: reportLock.directory
inputs.description: Existing report directory where the lock file is created.

inputs.name: reportLock.operation
inputs.description: Async operation to run after acquiring the lock.

outputs.name: reportLock
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the operation result. Tries exclusive lock creation up to 200 times, with 25-millisecond delays. An older-than-five-second lock with a valid PID is removed only if that process no longer exists. The lock is closed and removed after the operation.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with Report is busy; retry this update after exhausting attempts. Other filesystem and operation errors propagate.

declarations.title: Cloudflare Pages publication
declarations.responsibility: Deploys a prepared report bundle through the configured Pages project.

inputs.name: reportPages.bundle
inputs.description: Prepared publication directory, report identifier and optional revision.

outputs.name: reportPages
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the first deployment URL matching the configured Pages project in command output. Runs pinned Wrangler 4.93.0 against a report-specific branch, supplying account and configuration-home environment values.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects an invalid project name, missing Cloudflare account, failed deployment command or missing deployment URL. Configuration and subprocess errors may also propagate.

declarations.title: PDF Python executable
declarations.responsibility: Chooses the Python executable used by report PDF generation.

outputs.name: reportPdf
outputs.description: PROJECT_REPORTS_PYTHON when set; otherwise the bundled Codex-runtime Python if its path exists, or python3. This chooses a command and does not execute it.

declarations.title: Report subprocess execution
declarations.responsibility: Runs a command and captures bounded combined output and elapsed time.

inputs.name: reportProcess.command
inputs.description: Executable to spawn directly without a shell.

inputs.name: reportProcess.args
inputs.description: Arguments passed separately to the executable.

inputs.name: reportProcess.cwd
inputs.description: Optional working directory; otherwise the process inherits its current directory.

inputs.name: reportProcess.environment
inputs.description: Optional environment map replacing the child environment; defaults to process.env.

outputs.name: reportProcess
outputs.description: Promise resolving to exit code, combined stdout/stderr and duration in milliseconds. Keeps the last two million string characters; a null exit code becomes -1. Nonzero exit status is returned rather than thrown.

declarations.title: Report publication bundle
declarations.responsibility: Stages a finalized report’s exports and evidence into a locally hashed Pages-ready bundle.

inputs.name: reportPublication.repository
inputs.description: Repository used to read the report and resolve report/store directories.

inputs.name: reportPublication.id
inputs.description: Report identifier to publish.

outputs.name: reportPublication
outputs.description: Promise resolving to report id, optional revision, temporary staging directory, files with bytes/MIME/hash and a digest of their ordered path/hash list. Writes exports, unique evidence files and response-header rules to staging; this helper does not deploy.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects expired or nonfinalized reports, absent exports, missing evidence, unexpected export names, evidence filenames that do not match content hashes, or any asset above 25 MiB. Registered-file and filesystem errors propagate.

declarations.title: Published report verification
declarations.responsibility: Checks every listed deployment file against the staged bytes and MIME type.

inputs.name: reportPublicationVerify.bundle
inputs.description: Bundle listing expected file paths, SHA-256 values and MIME types.

inputs.name: reportPublicationVerify.url
inputs.description: HTTPS deployment URL with a deployment subdomain and project subdomain beneath pages.dev, optionally ending in a slash.

inputs.name: reportPublicationVerify.request
inputs.type: (input: string | URL | Request, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>
inputs.description: Optional request function, defaulting to fetch.

outputs.name: reportPublicationVerify
outputs.description: Promise completing without a value only after all listed files return successful responses, matching hashes and Content-Type prefixes. index.html is requested at the site root; each request receives a 30-second abort signal.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects an invalid deployment URL, unavailable file, digest mismatch or MIME mismatch. Request, timeout and byte-reading failures propagate.

declarations.title: Report expiry policy
declarations.responsibility: Determines whether a report has reached its retention lifetime.

inputs.name: reportRetention.report
inputs.description: Report start timestamp; later updates do not extend this calculation.

inputs.name: reportRetention.now
inputs.description: Optional current time in epoch milliseconds, defaulting to Date.now().

outputs.name: reportLifetimeMs
outputs.description: Thirty days expressed in milliseconds.

outputs.name: reportCloudPrefixes
outputs.description: Cloud storage prefixes for report evidence, uploaded screenshots and published reports.

outputs.name: reportRetention
outputs.description: True once the start time plus thirty days is at or before now; false before that boundary.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws Invalid report retention timestamp when the start date or current time is not finite.

declarations.title: Reports runtime directory
declarations.responsibility: Finds the reports package runtime root for supporting tools and assets.

outputs.name: reportRuntimeRoot
outputs.description: Environment override HARNESS_REPORTS_RUNTIME_ROOT when non-nullish, otherwise the resolved directory two levels above the current module URL.

declarations.title: Recorded report server lifecycle
declarations.responsibility: Stores a server’s process identity and stops only the process matching that recorded identity.

inputs.name: processStarted.pid
inputs.description: Process identifier whose system start time is requested.

inputs.name: reportServerRecord.root
inputs.description: Report store root used for server records.

inputs.name: reportServerRecord.port
inputs.description: Port naming the server record.

inputs.name: stopReportServer.root
inputs.description: Report store root whose recorded server should be stopped.

inputs.name: stopReportServer.port
inputs.description: Port identifying the recorded server to stop.

outputs.name: processStarted
outputs.description: Trimmed system start-time text from ps for that PID, or undefined when the command fails or returns no value.

outputs.name: reportServerRecord
outputs.description: Record file path plus async read, write and remove methods. Reads suppress filesystem failures as absence, but malformed JSON rejects; writes create the server-record directory.

outputs.name: stopReportServer
outputs.description: Loads the record, compares PID and start time, sends SIGTERM only to a match, waits in roughly 100-millisecond intervals for up to five seconds, then sends SIGKILL if the same process remains. Removes the record and reports whether a matching process was initially found.

declarations.title: Reports site ownership
declarations.responsibility: Binds a reports server to its application checkout and delegates repository-identity ownership checks.

inputs.name: ownedBySite.project
inputs.description: Project path whose ownership should be checked.

outputs.name: reportSite
outputs.description: Cached site root, primary-checkout directory name and repository identity. On first call uses trimmed HARNESS_SITE_ROOT or the current directory, resolves the Git root when available, and falls back to the requested directory.

outputs.name: ownedBySite
outputs.description: Result of comparing the configured site root with the supplied project path through the shared same-site helper.

declarations.title: Report initialization and outcome
declarations.responsibility: Creates an active report and derives an outcome from its recorded items.

inputs.name: reportState.input
inputs.description: Project, title and feature/suite mode, with optional environment, revision, historical flag, summary and acceptance.

inputs.name: resultStatus.report
inputs.description: Report whose checks, findings, coverage and evidence determine the result.

inputs.name: interrupted.report
inputs.description: Report whose unfinished inactivity should be detected.

outputs.name: reportState
outputs.description: Sanitized new report with UUID, project identity derived from the resolved path, matching creation/update timestamps, running/active state and empty result arrays. Environment defaults to local, summary to empty and acceptance to an empty array.

outputs.name: resultStatus
outputs.description: Failed if any item failed; otherwise blocked if any item is blocked, not-proven, interrupted or running. With no checks returns not-proven; all skipped checks return skipped; otherwise passed.

outputs.name: interrupted
outputs.description: True for a nonfinalized report whose last update was more than fifteen minutes ago, using the current clock.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws when project or title is falsy, or mode is neither feature nor suite.

declarations.title: Report data redaction
declarations.responsibility: Redacts recognized credential patterns and removes sensitive URL parts from recorded text and data.

inputs.name: sanitize.value
inputs.description: Text to sanitize.

inputs.name: cleanData.input
inputs.description: Value to recursively clean.

outputs.name: sanitize
outputs.description: Text with recognized authorization tokens, secret assignments and key/token patterns replaced by redaction markers. HTTP(S) URLs lose user information, query and fragment; Stripe checkout URLs also lose their path.

outputs.name: cleanData
outputs.description: Strings sanitized recursively through arrays and enumerable object fields, with matching sensitive keys replaced entirely by a redaction marker. Other primitive values remain unchanged.

declarations.title: Hosted site activity
declarations.responsibility: Reads activity only for the application to which the reports server is bound.

outputs.name: siteActivity
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the site’s activity and live observations from the activity service, requesting twenty commits; undefined when any part of the read fails. Undefined means unavailable, not an empty activity result.

declarations.title: Site-scoped CPU observations
declarations.responsibility: Filters agent CPU observations to processes attributed to the hosted repository.

inputs.name: siteProcesses.snapshot
inputs.description: CPU sample with machine totals, groups and optional agent entries.

inputs.name: siteProcesses.directoryOf
inputs.description: Optional PID-to-working-directory lookup. Defaults to reading the process directory, falling back to lsof; unknown directories exclude the agent.

outputs.name: siteProcesses
outputs.description: Snapshot preserving machine data and non-agent groups, with only site-owned agents, recalculated agent totals and recalculated tracked percentage unless it was null. Samples lacking agents or groups are returned unchanged.

declarations.title: Tooltip placement
declarations.responsibility: Chooses a tooltip position and optional height based on its anchor and available viewport room.

inputs.name: tooltipPlace.mark
inputs.description: Anchor rectangle in viewport coordinates.

inputs.name: tooltipPlace.tip
inputs.description: Tooltip width and height.

inputs.name: tooltipPlace.view
inputs.description: Viewport width and height.

outputs.name: tooltipPlace
outputs.type: { left: number; top: number; height?: number }
outputs.description: Centered horizontal position constrained toward eight-pixel margins. Prefers below when it fits, otherwise above; when neither fits, uses the roomier side and supplies its available height for scrolling.

declarations.title: Pointer-centered image zoom
declarations.responsibility: Converts pinch gestures into bounded zoom requests and helps keep an image point under the pointer.

inputs.name: imageAnchor.image
inputs.description: Image whose rendered rectangle supplies coordinates.

inputs.name: imageAnchor.pointer
inputs.description: Pointer position in viewport coordinates.

inputs.name: keepPointerInPlace.viewport
inputs.description: Scrolling viewport to adjust.

inputs.name: keepPointerInPlace.image
inputs.description: Image after its size has changed.

inputs.name: keepPointerInPlace.anchor
inputs.description: Normalized image point to preserve.

inputs.name: keepPointerInPlace.pointer
inputs.description: Pointer location that should remain over that image point.

inputs.name: trackpadZoom.node
inputs.description: Element receiving wheel and gesture listeners.

inputs.name: trackpadZoom.controls
inputs.description: Function returning current/minimum/maximum zoom and an apply callback, or null when zoom is unavailable.

outputs.name: imageAnchor
outputs.description: Normalized image coordinates clamped to zero through one.

outputs.name: keepPointerInPlace
outputs.description: Adjusts horizontal and vertical scroll offsets to keep the specified image point under the pointer; returns no value.

outputs.name: trackpadZoom
outputs.description: Installs nonpassive Ctrl-wheel and Safari gesture listeners and returns destroy for cleanup. Zoom is clamped to supplied bounds, with null passed for fitted size. Ordinary wheel scrolling is untouched; active Safari gestures suppress duplicate Ctrl-wheel zoom.

declarations.title: WAV metadata validation
declarations.responsibility: Validates supported WAV container/sample structure and calculates audio duration.

inputs.name: wavInfo.bytes
inputs.description: Complete RIFF/WAVE bytes, at least 44 bytes long, with format and nonempty audio chunks.

outputs.name: wavInfo
outputs.description: Duration in seconds from data length divided by the validated byte rate. Accepts PCM with 8/16/24/32-bit samples or 32-bit IEEE float, one to eight channels and sample rates from 4,000 through 384,000 Hz.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects invalid RIFF length, truncated or misaligned chunks, missing format/data, unsupported encoding/channel/rate, inconsistent sample alignment/byte rate and data lengths not divisible by sample alignment.

declarations.responsibility: Owns the / route layout.

declarations.title: ExplorerEvidence
declarations.responsibility: Describes the proof an entity is shown with: the coverage of each scenario state by state, the captures of each side, and the behaviour recorded on both sides.

declarations.title: ExplorerScreen
declarations.responsibility: Describes what the host of the explorer gives the content of a screen, and the component that takes it, without naming any renderer.

declarations.title: Explorer
declarations.responsibility: Describes what the explorer shows of a history: the scope of an address, a verdict, an entity with its relations, and the history of an entity.

declarations.title: HarnessBudget
declarations.responsibility: Describes a reviewed line of the budget ledger and the limits a revision freezes for what a unit emits, as the console reads them.

declarations.title: HarnessLegacy
declarations.responsibility: Describes a report from before Git-backed records as the history index keeps it.

declarations.title: Harness
declarations.responsibility: Describes the parts of the history index and revision details the console reads.

declarations.title: Report
declarations.responsibility: Owns the Report data model.

declarations.title: console
declarations.responsibility: Mounts the console into the document a host serves.

declarations.title: portable
declarations.responsibility: Owns the portable library module.

declarations.title: /analytics
declarations.responsibility: Redirects the former analytics address to the explorer; the console has no analytics page.

declarations.title: /harness/analytics
declarations.responsibility: Redirects the former console analytics address to the explorer.

declarations.title: /harness/branch/[branch]/[...at]/components
declarations.responsibility: Shows the components of this repository at a branch tip or a selected commit, to search, order and open.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.description: The branch, as one encoded path segment. Its tip is shown unless a commit is named.

inputs.name: commit
inputs.description: After /commit/: the selected commit, compared with its first parent. Absent, the tip is shown alone.

outputs.name: +page
outputs.description: The components of the shown revision in a table, each with its verdict and what the commit changed, to search, order and open.

outputs.name: title
outputs.description: Components · Harness

errors.name: not-in-history
errors.description: A branch or commit the history does not hold, or a commit the branch does not contain, is said. No other revision is shown.

errors.name: no-registry
errors.description: A revision that stores no unit registry says so. The registry of another revision is not shown.

errors.name: not-admitted
errors.description: A request the owner policy does not admit is refused before any history is read.

declarations.title: /harness/branch/[branch]/[...at]/components/[entity]
declarations.responsibility: Shows one component at a branch tip or a selected commit: its contract, size, performance and what proves it.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.description: The branch, as one encoded path segment. Its tip is shown unless a commit is named.

inputs.name: commit
inputs.description: After /commit/: the selected commit, compared with its first parent. Absent, the tip is shown alone.

inputs.name: entity
inputs.description: The id of the component, as one encoded path segment.

inputs.name: tab
inputs.description: Query: the tab shown in place of the overview.

outputs.name: +page
outputs.description: The component with its verdict and its screenshots: one at a branch tip, before and after at a commit. Relationships and tests by tab.

outputs.name: title
outputs.description: Component · Harness

errors.name: not-in-history
errors.description: A branch or commit the history does not hold, or a commit the branch does not contain, is said. No other revision is shown.

errors.name: no-registry
errors.description: A revision that stores no unit registry says so. The registry of another revision is not shown.

errors.name: not-at-revision
errors.description: A component the shown revision does not hold is said, with the way back to the collection.

errors.name: other-category
errors.description: A unit that is not a component at this revision is led to the address of its own category.

errors.name: not-admitted
errors.description: A request the owner policy does not admit is refused before any history is read.

errors.name: not-in-history

errors.name: no-registry
errors.description: A revision that stores no unit registry says so. The registry of another revision is not shown.

errors.name: not-at-revision

errors.name: other-category

errors.name: not-admitted

declarations.title: /harness/branch/[branch]/[...at]/components/[entity]/history
declarations.responsibility: Shows the commits that changed one component, with their reasons, sizes and standing.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.description: The branch, as one encoded path segment. Its tip is shown unless a commit is named.

inputs.name: commit

outputs.name: +page
outputs.description: The commits that changed the component, newest first, each against its first parent, with reasons, sizes and reviews. A commit whose change is unknown says so.

outputs.name: title
outputs.description: Component history · Harness

errors.name: not-in-history
errors.description: A branch or commit the history does not hold, or a commit the branch does not contain, is said. No other revision is shown.

errors.name: no-registry
errors.description: A revision that stores no unit registry says so. The registry of another revision is not shown.

errors.name: not-at-revision
errors.description: A component the shown revision does not hold is said, with the way back to the collection.

errors.name: other-category
errors.description: A unit that is not a component at this revision is led to the address of its own category.

errors.name: not-admitted
errors.description: A request the owner policy does not admit is refused before any history is read.

declarations.title: /harness/branch/[branch]/[...at]/configs
declarations.responsibility: Shows the configs of this repository at a branch tip or a selected commit, to search, order and open.

inputs.name: branch

declarations.responsibility: Redirects a former report page to the explorer: Pages at the commit the report names when this history holds it, else Pages at the branch tip.

declarations.title: /harness/[...view]
declarations.responsibility: Leads the root, a branch or commit alone and every earlier console address to the explorer page it stands for, and shows a commit that no branch reaches.

declarations.title: /reports/[id]
declarations.responsibility: Redirects a former report address to the console, which opens the explorer where that report belongs.
Redirects the root of this server to the explorer.

declarations.title: ReportRepository
declarations.responsibility: Owns the ReportRepository persistence boundary.

declarations.title: SiteReportRepository
declarations.responsibility: Presents the report store as one site may see it: reports of another application are absent.

declarations.title: build_pdf
declarations.responsibility: Owns the build_pdf build or maintenance script.

declarations.title: build_zip
declarations.responsibility: Owns the build_zip build or maintenance script.

declarations.title: fake-r2
declarations.responsibility: Owns the fake-r2 build or maintenance script.

declarations.title: freeze-build
declarations.responsibility: Gives the browser run it belongs to its own checked copy of the finished build and prints where it is.

declarations.title: harness-audit
declarations.responsibility: Owns the harness-audit build or maintenance script.

declarations.title: harness-emitted-seed
declarations.responsibility: Adds to the synthetic history a unit built for two execution targets and takes it through a missing limit, a baseline, growth of one output while the other shrinks, an approval and an output that is no longer built.

declarations.title: harness-explorer-seed
declarations.responsibility: Adds to the synthetic history what the explorer acceptance needs: a page with nested components, a config, and scenarios that record screenshots and end-to-end results.
